༄/ /mnangagasnying po'i rtsa tshigagi 'grel bstan brgyud/ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rnams thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsgrub pa ni 'dod bya'i don gyi snying po mthar thug par shes pa'i ched du yin no/ /gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ tshul 'di 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ snyan brgyud man ngag 'dzin pa yis/ / snying gi bu la brtse bas gdams/ / zhes gsungs te go sla'o/ / de ltar legs tshogs thams cad kyi gzhi rten bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus bcos ma ma yin pas lam gye rtsa ba tshugs par byas la/ bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i gus pa chen po bskyed de ci gsung mtha' dag dang / khyad par skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas bgrod tshul ji ltar gdams pa rnams bka' bzhin du bsgrub pa dang / de thams cad kyi tshe byang chub bde lam las/ spyi bor bla ma lha bsgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas zhes dmigs skor re re bzhin du gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang sbrags nas byed cing / rjes kyi bya ba thams cad kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor de'i shugs kyis zin pa'i sgo nas sgo gsum bag med pa'i phyogs su cung zad kyang ma shor bar cha mtha' dag nas don ldan du 'gyur bar bya/ de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du btang ste/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang rnam par dag pa nod cing / dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i sten tshul gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba gzhir byas pa'i steng nas smin byed bskyed rim la slob pa na'ang /sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa nas bzung bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang sprags nas bya/de rjes rdzogs rim la slob pa'i tshe snying ga'i rtsa mdud dbye ba'ang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis dbye zhing / rlung sems mtha' dag bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi mthus las rung du bsgrub pa la brten nas bden pa gnyis kyi rdzogs rim la sogs pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rnams rgyud la skyes te zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du 89

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/bgrod dgos pas/ man ngag 'di'i steng nasalam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa la bag chags ci thebs byas te/ dal ba'i rten bzang thob cing bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa dang mjal ba 'di nyid don dang ldan par bya'o/ / smras pa/ 'dul 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan nye bar 'khor/ / dka' thub spyod pas ming la thos pa dga'/ / snyan brgyud bka' bab chos kyi rdo rje rnams/ /gcigagyur ye shes mtshan can khyod min su/ / long pas phyag dar khrod nas rin chen bzhin/ / snyigs ma'i klong nas blo chung bdag 'dras kyang / / snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa 'di/ / e ma khyod kyi bka' drin bsam las 'das/ / de phyir mi smra snying la 'chang 'os kyang / / col chung sor mo'i rtse la g.yeng ba 'dis/ / skal bzang blo ldan 'ga' yi don 'gyur ram/ / chud zos gye nar 'bor ba cha ma mchis/ / zab cing rgya che'i gdams pa nam mkha'i mtha'/ / nyam chung sprang bu'i 'dab mas gzhal ba yis/ / nongs par gyur gang rgyu bcas sbyong ba dang / / dge tshogs bstan 'gro'i gsos su byin gyis rlobs/ / tshe rabs kun tu zeg mchog bshes gnyen gyis/ / rjes bzung gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing / / 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying po thos bsam sgom/ / mthar phyin 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog gyur cig / ces zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag snying po'i rtsa tshig gi 'grel pa snyan brgyud gsang ba'i lde mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ 〉lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las pa yang dag pa'ilam bzang 'di la mchog tu mos pa'i blo can ja sag zhabs drung ye shes bskal bzang gis yang yang nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dbus 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing blo bzang snyan brgyud kyi bka' bab dpal ldan bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / bka'i 'khor los thub bstan yongs la 'dod dgur mnga' bsgyur ba khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun 90

༄/ /mnangagasnyingayo'i rtsa tshig gi 'grel balhan brgyud/dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po rnam gnyis kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i bka' drin las/ bstan pa spyi dang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i cha shas phra mo tsam rna bas thos pa'i skal ba can du gyur pa/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya gnyis pa rnam byung gi lo dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gtsug lag 'byed pa'i blo mig can sti gru ratna yā nantas bgyis pa 'dis kyang snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig / / /91

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ra dza/ /maṇḍa ba gyi khrid yig dpag bsam snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang la brten na srid dang zhi ba yi/ /legs tshogs 'bras bu ma lus 'byung ba'i zhing / /bla ma yi dam rin chen rnam gsum la/ /snying nas 'dud do dngos grub mchog sbyin mdzod/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas spyan snga ru/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor mkho dgu'i longs spyod bcas/ /mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba'i tshul/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gangs ri las 'ongs shing / /dri med lung dang rigs pa'i rlabs 'phreng can/ /bsod nams gser gyi bye ma 'bab pa'i klung / /byang chen rgya mtsho'i ngogs su 'dren la spro/ /'jig rten mu mtha' yas pa'i chags tshul shes/ /srid 'byor snying po med pa'i ngang tshul rig /bsod nams tshogs chen sgrub pa'i tshul rtogs pa'i/ /blo ldan skal bzang de dag 'dir zhugs shig /de'ang bla ma gong ma rnams gdams pa zab mo phal cher nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro la/ bstan pa spyi'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro dang / theg chen lam gye 'jug sgo sems bskyed phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig pa sbyong ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs gsog pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid bzhi la sngon 'gro khrid chen bzhi'am/ sngon 'gro 92

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khrid yigadapag bsamasnyem/'brel ba can bzhir grags pa las/ 'dir maṇḍal gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir spyi don gyi sgo nas gtan la dbab pa dang / de nyid lag tu len pa'i tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ / dang po la gsum/ gang las gsungs pa'i khungs dgod pa/ maṇḍal gyi ngo bo/ de'i dbye ba so sor bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni dkon mchog sprin las/ me tog gi rnam pa'am/'bras bu'i rnam pa'am/ dpag bsam gye shing nga yir bya ba med pa/ yongs sugazung ba med pa de dag kyang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dbul lo/ / zhes dang / bzang po spyod par/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ de dag rgyal pa thams cad la yang mos/ / zhes sogs dang / dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po las/rin po che'i ri rnams dang / thang las skyes pa'i rin po che la sogs pa phyogs bcu na rnam par gnas pa nga yir bya ba med pa yongs su gzung ba med pa rnams dbul lo/ / chu thams cad dang kha na ma tho ba med pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / gser gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams chags pa rnams na ro dang reg pa mchog tu phun sum tshogs pa'i sa zhag dang / bdud rtsi'i myu gu dang / ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling dang / 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag pa rnams na yod pa mchog tu nyams dga' ba'i longs spyod rnams dbul lo/ /zhes dang / gsal rgyal la gdams pa las/ rang gzhan gyi dge tshogs la rjes su yi rang byas te sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas gzhan don du bsngo bar gsungs pas mtshon lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phul nas sems can kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i rgyur bsngo ba bslab btus kyi btang bsrung dag srel bzhis bsdus 93

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlan me'i gsung 'bum/pa'ibyang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa rlabs po che ston pa phal cher maṇḍal gyi khungs su 'gro la/ khyad par du dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdo las/chu bcas lce ba sbyin pa ste/ / zhes pa nas/ pha rol phyin drug 'di rnams nyid/ / thub pa'i maṇḍal byas pas thob/ / ces sogs maṇḍal 'bul tshul gyi phyag len ston pa'i khungs yin la/ gtso bor tshom bu'i grangs la sogs pa cha tshang bar ston pa'i khungs mthar thug pa ni/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u brgyad pa las/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ / mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang la/ / dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ / nyin rer shes rab can gyis dbul/ / zhes pa 'di yin te/ zhing 'di zhes pa yul phyogs re re tsam la zer ba min gyi/ bdag cag gi ston pa lta bu rgyud gcig pa'i mchog gi sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya dus mnyam du byung ba'i nang nas ma mtha' mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi 'dul zhing du gyur pa ste/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / / ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / / zhes pa ltar/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab rtse mor rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor du gling bzhi gling phran brgyad nyi zla zung gcig dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bco lnga bstan/ rin chen sna bdun zhes pas rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun bstan la/ sgon gsal las/ padma rā ga dang / ind+ra dī la dang / beeḍūrya dang / margad dang / rdo rje dang / mu tig dang / byu ru zhes bya ba rin chen sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang ba/ zhes rin chen bdun 'dren tshul zur pa zhig kyang bkod pa ni mdo gzhan nas 'byung ba'i bshad pa'i rnam grangs yin la/ gtso bor rin po che'i rigs sogs mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad 'byung ba'i gter chen po bstan pa yin pas/ snga ma'i steng du bsnan pas brgyad de tshom bu nyer gsum ma 'di ni paṇa chen nā ro pa dang slob dpon a sgyu kā ra sogs rgya gar grub chen mang po'i 94

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridabagadapag bsamastes/phyag bzhes yin/ rje bdag nyid chen po nas bzung dben sa pa yab sras kyang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa mang po rnams la bshad sgrub byed pa'i tshe maṇḍal nyer gsum ma sngags dang bcas pa 'di nyid gtso bor mdzad do/ / mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang zhes pa mkhas pa'i don bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la mkhas zhes gsungs shing / 'og tu/ bsam gtan gyis kyang thams cad bskyed par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa gung bsgrigs na rgyal srid bdun sogs dngos su yod pa'ang don dam par ma grub cing / yid kyis sprul pas kyang tshogs rdzogs pa sogs kyi bya bar bsnyon med du nus pas/ snang stong snga ma'i tshul gyis mchod pa'i tshogs rab 'byams spro mkhas pa la bya'o/ / dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ / zhes pa dngos grub 'dod pa tsam gyis mi chog gi / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsung ba/ / shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ / bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ / zhes dngos grub 'byung mi 'byung bla ma bsten tshul legs nyes kyi rjes su 'goldog mi 'khrul zhing / khyad par zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'grub pa bla ma kho na la ltos pas/ rgyud dang grub chen mang po'i gzhung du/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / / bla ma rin chen lta bu zhes mthun par gsungs la/ sgron gsal las kyang / de'i man ngag gis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pas/ zhes gsungs so/ / shes rab can zhes pa/ spyir shes rab la dbye sgo mang yang gtso bo ji lta ba rtogs pa'i shes rab/ ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis su 'dus pas/ yul la sbyar na ji lta ba rtogs ba'i shes rab kyisabla ma chos sku'i rang bzhin du mthong / ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bla ma srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas gcig pur 95

lhu/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mthong / mchod pa la sbyar na ji lta ba rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis mchod pa'i 'khor gsum bden med du rtogs/ ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis mchod pa'i phan yon dang mtha' yas par spro tshul sogs shes par byed do/ /maṇḍal 'bul ba'i yul la skyabs gnas mtha' dag yod kyang / gtso bo'i dbang du byas na bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod par byed dgos te/dper na rgyal po spyan drangs pa'i tshe gtso 'khor thams cad la yon dang 'tsho ba stob dgos kyang / snying nor gces shos de rgyal po rang la phul nas dgos don gyi gtso bo zhu dgos pa ltar/ tshe gcig nyid la mchog 'grub pa bla ma kho na la ltos pas lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa maṇḍal du spungs nas 'bul yul bla ma la byed dgos so/ / 'di la dgongs te sgon gsal las/lha rnams dang bla ma'i thun mong gi mchod pa bstan nas/ bla ma la khyad par gye mchod pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ zhes sogs kyis phyag rgya 'bul tshul dang / de'i mjug thogs su/ bla ma la khyad par can gyi rdzas dbul bar bya ba'i don du tshad yongs su chad pa med par bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa zhes gsungs so/ / 'o na de gnyis ka bla ma'i sgos mchod yin na snga ma'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ / zhes spyi la sbyar ba dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ dogs pa 'di dpal ldan zla ba nyid kyis sel bar mdzad de/ sgron gsal las/ sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ zhes bya ba la/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pas/ bla ma gcig pu'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgras rnam par brjod de de la dbul zhing rab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ / zhes yul gcig la phul na'ang sangs rgyas thams cad la phul ba'i phanaphan 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo chen po bla ma la mchod pa 'di yin 96

༄/ /mastol gyi khrid yig dpag bsamasnyem/par go ba'i ched du de ltar gsungs pa yin no/ / yang 'di snyam du/ de bla ma gcig pu'i khyad chos ma yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos zhus pa las/ bzang po rgyal ba gcig la mchod byed na/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la ni mchod 'gyur te/ / 'di ltar de dag nga yi chos dbyings dang / / tha dad bya ba nam yang yod ma yin/ / zhes gsungs shing / gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las kyang de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhe na bshad par bya ste/ sangs rgyas gang yang rung ba gcig la phul pas sangs rgyas thams cad la phul bar 'gro ba ni/ 'bul pa bo chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid la nges pa gting tshugs shing /chos dang chos nyid ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni chos nyid thams cad dang ro gcig tu zhugs shing / sangs rgyas rnams chos kyi skus rab tu phye ba sogs la myong ba mthar son pa rnams kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ dper na sa ra ha'i thod pa'i dkyil chog las/'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag phyir/ / tha dad par ni bzlas mi bya/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa len pa na/ sngags rim las/ 'khor gtso bo'i yan lag yin pas gud du bzla mi dgos par gsungs pa ni dngos po la de ltar yin pas mi chog gi / stong nyid la mthar thug par gtugs nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid rten dang brten par shar ba'i tshul la nges pa brtan po rnyed pa la dgongs/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin gang zag khyad par can gyi dbang du byas pa yin zhing / bla ma la phul na thams cad la phul ba'i phan yon 'byung ba bka' drin gye sgo nas yin pas phal pa la'ang 'byung ngo / / de ltar maṇḍal dbul ba de rtag par dus drug tu ma chag pa dgos pa go ba'i phyir/ nyin rer shes rab can gyis dbul/ / zhes gsungs pa yin gyi/ nyin rer lan re 97

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/dbul ba lta bu min te/ 'di'i dgongs par byas nas bla ma lnga bcu par/mchog tu dad pas dus gsum du/ / dkyil 'khor me tog bcas thal mos/ / ston pa bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing / / zhabs la spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /zhes dang / de'i ṭīkka las/ dkyil 'khor te maṇḍal me tog gi tshom bu dang bcas pa dbul ba sngon du btang nas/ zhes so/ / dus gsum zhes gsungs na'ang / lnga ṭīka las snga dro la sogs pa'i dus gsum zhes 'byung bas/ nyin la dus gsum du byed par bstan pa'i shugs kyis mtshan la'ang gsum du byas te drug tu go dgos shing / rtsa ltung rnam bshad las kyang / rin 'byung gi dam tshig lan drug tu bya bar gsungs pa ni dam tshig gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa maṇḍal gyi ngo bo'i don ni maṇḍal zhes pa dkyil 'khor gyi skad dod yin zhing de la ma'i sgra las drangs nas ma nu sa ra zhes pa snying po dang / la'i sgra las drangs te lā li ta byas na 'dzin pa rol pa sogs la 'jug la ti na byas na len pa dang 'dus pa sogs la 'jug pas bsdoms na snying po len cing 'dzin pa zhes pa yin/ 'on kyang skabs so so la sbyar na dman mchog gi snying po len tshul mi 'dra ba so sor shes dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ dkyil ni snying po zhes brjod de/ / byang chub sems ni bde chen po/ / len par byed pas dkyil 'khor nyid/ / 'dus pa dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ / ces dang / de'i bshad rgyud sasna ṭa las/dngos po kun gyi snying po mchog / len cing gcod pa nyid kyi phyir/ / zhes gsungs te/ des na dbang bzhi gang du thob pa'i yul dang rdzas mi 'dra'ang /de la brten nas len rgyu'i snying po bde stong gi ye shes su 'dra bas/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs thams cad la dkyil 'khor gyi sgra sbyar ba yin no/ / 'on kyang sasgru 98

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridathagadapag bsamasnyes/ṭa las len cing gcod pa zhes dkyil 'khor gyi sgra don kho na min te/ brtag gnyis su/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ci zhes brjod/ / ces dri ba bkod nas lan du dkyil 'khor gyi don dang 'khor lo'i don so sor ga sungs pa de'i don bsdus nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems des bde chen gyi snying po len pa dang / sgrib pa'i dri ma gcod pa gnyis ka go ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis rnam bshad mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las/ 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams te/ nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i yul stong pa nyid de rtogs pas sgrib pa gcod pa'i phyir/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi sgra don las logs su gsungs so/ / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs spyod rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ / bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa'i/ / rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / / de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ / zhes pa tshig ris snga ma dang cha 'dra'ang don zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes snying por bzhag ste de len pa la byed dgos pas mtshon las dang po bas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten blosablangs te phul ba la maṇḍal zhes pa de bsod nams rlabs po che'i snying po len pa la byed pa sogs dkyil 'khor gyi ming maṇḍal 'dra'ang don sna tshogs la sbyar te snying po 'dus tshul re byed dgos pa'i phyir/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyi rnam bshad las/ dkyil 'khor zhes btags pa rnams kyi ming gi don ni 'dus pa yin la/ zhes so/ / thams cad la de ltar btags pa'i dgos pa ni snying po dang yang snying rim par blangs te mthar bde stong zung 'jug gi snying po len pa lagazhol ba'i ched yin no/ / spyir stong gsum sogs 'jig rten ci tsam rgya che'ang sdug bsngal rgya che ba yin na'ang / 'di ltar thabs mkhas kyis bsod nams mi zad pa'i lo tog spel shes na gtan bde'i zhing sa rgya che ba yin/'di ltar bsod nams spel ba dang 'khor bar yid 'byung skyed pa gang la'ang 99

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'isgron me'i gsung 'bum/mngon pa gong 'og nas 'jig rten chags tshul gsungs pa'i don spyi chags pa dgos kyi/ de'i spyi ma shar bar kha nas ri rab gling bzhi zhes ci tsam smras kyang maṇḍal steng gi 'bru de tsam las dmigs pa'i 'khyer so gzhan mi 'byung ngo / /gsum pa maṇḍal gyi dbye ba la/ bum dbang dang 'brel ba phyi'i maṇḍal/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba nang gi maṇḍal/ sher dbang dang 'brel ba gsang ba'i maṇḍal/ dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal bzhi/ dang po ni yongs grags ltar gyi maṇḍal te/ snga phyir bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /nangagi maṇḍal ni/ pags pa rab mdzes gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng / khrag chen bdud rtsi'i chu yis chag chag btab/ / sha khrag me tog phang phung tshom bur gyur/ / yan lag rnams las gling chen bzhi dang ni/ / nying lag gling phran brgyad du gyur ba'i dbus/ / khog pa rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i rtser/ / mgo bo rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang mdzes/ / mig gnyis mun sel nyi ma zla ba dang / / snying ni yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ / dbang po nang khrol yongs su gyur pa las/ / lha mi'i 'dod yon dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ / zhes pa ltar gzhan rnams go sla zhing / / yan lag dang nying lag 'byed tshul ni/ rkang lag gi lhu gsum gsum 'brel ba yan lag dang / lag pa'imakhrig ma dang rkang ba'i bre mo long gi mtshams nas bregs te mgo gnyis gnyis su gshag pa nying lag tu byed par gsungs so/ / 'on kyang gsang dbang gi dgos pa rtsa khams sbyong byed yin la/ maṇḍal de'ang de dang 'brel ba zhig dgos pas/ phyi'i lus rags pa tsam ma yin par de dag dngos su smos pa'i shugs kyis don lnga snod drug dbang bo lnga sogs so so dang 'brel ba'i rtsa rags pa sman gyi gzhung las 'byung ba dang / zhib tu phye bas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis phyi'i lus rags pa'i rtsa bar gyur ba'i nang gi khams so dang 100

/ /martol gyi khridayig dpag bsamasnyem/sen mo 'bab pa sogs bde mchog gi rgyud las gsungs pa de thams cad maṇḍal du bkod pa dgos so/ / tshul 'di ni 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇḍal 'bul chog las kyang / lus kyi gtso bo snying bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bsams te/ pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ khrag chu'i byugs pa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ yan lag bzhi gling bzhi/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ nyi ma ltar dmar ba gser/ zla ba ltar dkar ba dngul/ byang chub kyi sems lha dang mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa/ snying ma gtogs pa'i don rnam pa lnga/ sgod rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa dang drug snod la gnas pa'i bde ba'i cha dang bdun rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun/ spyi bo'i haṃ las byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa 'dod 'jo'i ba/ lus la sku gsum rang chas su yod pa ma rmos pa'i lo tog rtsa dpag bsam gyi shing / gzhan yon tan gye cha dpag tu med pa yod pa rnams zas gos dang / 'bru dang longs spyod la sogs par bsam par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs te/ 'dir skyabs yul nang du bsgoms nas tshur 'bul bar gsungs pa 'gal ba med kyang / nang gi maṇḍal du 'gro ba de'i cha nas bzhag pa min pas de ltar dgos pa'i nges pa med cing gzhan rnams legs par snang ngo / / 'di dang phyogs mtshungs pa kun gzigs lnga ba'i bla mchod cho gar yang / 'byung ba bzhi 'dus lus kyi sa gzhi'i steng / / rnam par shes pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po la/ / phung khams gser ri rol mtsho bdun gyes bskor/ / skye mched bcu gnyis gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ / ro rkyang nam mkha'i nor bu mtshan mo'i mgon/ / dbang po lnga yi gter chen bum pa sogs/ / dkyil 'khor gtso bo dpal ldan bla mar 'bul/ / zag med bde ba che la spyod par shog / ces gsungs/ rang gi lus kyi cha shas so so las gzhal yas khang skyed pa la lus dkyil du bzhag pa 101

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/ltar/ rang gi phung khams phra rags sgrub gzhir byas te/ de yongs su gyur ba las ri rab gling bzhi sogs kyi rnam par byas nas phul na'ang nang gi maṇḍal du 'gro ste/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor las/bdag lus ngag yid phung khams skye mched rnams/ / yongs su gyur las grangs med 'jig rten snod/ / 'dod dgu'i phun tshogs gter gyis gang ba 'di/ / bla ma lha yi tshogs la gus pas 'bul/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal ni/ snga ma phal cher so sor phye ste 'jog ma thub par gcig tu bsdoms nas bshad de/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis kyang / gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇḍal ni dbang yon tan rim pa las/ rang sems bla mar snang ba de/ / gnyis med slob dpon dam pa'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ rang gis sems mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhir gyur pa ni bla ma yi dam gyi lha yin pas/ maṇḍal ni kun gzhi 'khor 'das kyi rgyur gyur pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ de snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral ba chu'i byugs pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ de las tshad med pa bzhi skye ba ni gling bzhi/ thabs shes rab zung 'brel du nyams su len pa nyi zlas skor ba byed pa/ gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ba 'dod 'jo'i ba/ longs sku spros pa dang bral ba ma rmos pa'i lo tog / sku dang ye shes mdzad pa 'phrin las la sogs pa thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing dang / 'bru dang longs spyod la sogs par bsam/ zhes gsungs te/ ming gsang ba'i maṇḍal du btags kyang zung 'jug gi rtogs pa'ang der bsdus pas de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal de las logs su byar med do/ / kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ rdo rje'i lus kyi gser ldan lto ba na/ /mnyam sbyor rdo rje padma'i lhun po mchog / bcu drug dga' ba'i ri mtsho gling 102

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridayig dpag bsamasnyem/bzhis bskor/ / dbu ma bcu gnyis khyim gyi rgyu lam du/ / ro rkyang rlung gi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'char/ / sgyu ma'i lus su ldang ba'i rin chen bdun/ /zung 'jug bum bzang yongs 'du sa brtol sogs/ / dkyil 'khor mgon podapal ldan bla mar 'bul/ / zhes gsang ba'i maṇḍal dang / dri bral rang sems dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ / rang bzhin gdod nas stong ba'i sa 'dzin che/ / med kyang rdzun par snang ba'i gling bzhi sogs/ / rmi lam yul gyi rol pa ji bzhin 'bul/ / zhes de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal du mdzad pa dgongs pa drangasanas bshad chog kyang dngos zin de tsam mi gsal bas/ 'dir rje bla ma'i dgongs pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang thang sag pa sogs kyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar/ dbang gsum pa'i rtogs pa bde stong dbyer med kye ye shes dang / dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rtogs pa hūṃ yig gi rnam par spros pa yongs su gyur pa las ri rab gling bzhi mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor sogs kyi rnam par bsgyur nas 'bul pa la maṇḍal phyi ma gnyis su rgyal dbang bdun pas gsungs shing / 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad kyang / thabs mchog bde chen rdo rje'i rol rtsed kyis/ / stong phyogs shes rab padmar rol pa las/ / zag med lhan skyes dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ / snod bcud dkyil 'khor bkod pas mnyes gyur cig / ces dang / bde chen kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol gyi/ / mchod sprin cir yang snang ba'i sgyu ma rnams/ / gdod nas rang bzhin stong par nges rnyed pa'i/ /zung 'jug bla med mchod pas mnyes gyur cig / ces so/ / de ltar na maṇḍal phyi ma gnyi ga rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes yin pa la rnam pa ri gling sogs kyi rnam par shar ba tsam du 'dra bas khyad med du 'gyur ro snyam na 'di ni phra zhing ches rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas shig yin te/ rtsa she las/ gang 103

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/la stong pa nyid rung ba/ / de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa la bya byed thams cad 'grub rung yang /yul de rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong tsam dang / blos rang bzhin med par rtogs pa tsam gyis bya byed thams cad sgrub mi nus/ de bzhin du spyod bsdus su rgyud drangs pa las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ / gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do/ / gsungs pa bzhin dag pa'i brtan g.yo mtha' dag bde stong ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul yin kyang dbang gsum pa'i rtosas pa dpe don gyi 'od gsal 'grub pa tsam gyis brtan g.yo rab 'byams gang 'dod du sprul zhing sgyur bar byed mi nus/ mthar thug zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob pa na sngar bshad pa thams cad kyi nus pa gcig tu rdzogs nas gang 'dod pa bzhin byed nus/ de'i gnad kyis de dang bstun pa'i mchod pa la'ang rgya che chung gi khyad par chen po 'byung ngo / / snga ma rnams mchod pa de gnyis so sor 'byed mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan dbang gsum pa'i bde stong dbyer med las lhag pa zhig dbang bzhi pa la sbyor rgyu ma rnyed pas de tsam zhig zung du 'jug tshul mthar thug tu byas pa'i dbang gis yin no/ / rang lugs rim pa bzhi pa man chad du kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma'i sku dang don dam bden pa 'od gsal gyi ye shes gnyis res 'jog tsam las mi 'byung bas bden gnyis ya bral du song ba yin la/ zung 'jug gi tshe de gnyis stobs mtshungs su 'byung ba yu gnad ste ya bral du ma song ba zung du 'jug tshul snga ma las ches lhag pa yin no/ / de'i tshul ni 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ na chung gzhon nu mig yangs pa/ / gzugs bzang gzhon pas brgyan pa ni/ / lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon rnyed/ / byol song las kyang rab tu brtag / ces pa 'dis gsungs te/sgronagasal las/ bden pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi mig dang ldan pa'i 104

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khrida'agadapag bsamasnyem/phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa de ni mig yangs pa'o/ / zhes dang / lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon pa/ / zhes bya ba ni lha'i nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi phyag rgya chen po'i sku bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid can/ zhes zung du 'jug tshul mdor bsdus na sgyu 'od gnyis sam sku thugs gnyis zung du 'jug pa yin la/ zhib tu phye na phung po lnga/ khams lnga/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga/ ye shes lnga ste nyer lnga po thams cad zung du 'jug pa yin no/ / brtson 'grus 'phags kyi rgyud saki las khams bzhi dbang po drug ces 'byung yang / sgon gsal rnam nges sogs las mchan gyi tshig ris sor bzhag pa kun dang 'grig go / de rnams zung du 'jug tshul ni lhan cig tu tshogs pa dang gcig gis gcig rtsis zin pa tsam la mi bya yi/ snga ma'i rdzas rgyun dang ldog cha tsam gyis so sor bzhag pa ma gtogs/ de thams cad ngo bo dang nus pa dang byed las gang gi cha nas kyang mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba 'byed rgyu med pa yin no/ rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis par/khyed kyi sems lus lta bu dang / lus sems lta bu dang / sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur skyed cig / ces pa'ang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs las bskyed rim pa'i sku gsung thugs byin rlabs la sbyar/ spyod bsdus kyis de las gong du song ste gsang chen rigs gcig gi lus dben la sbyar ba rdo rje'i tshig gcig la don du ma mi 'gal bas/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal nas 'di'i don lam gyi bgrod pa mthar thug pa'i tshe ye shes kyang gang 'dod kyi gzugs su shar nas gzugs kyi bya ba byed/ gzugs kyi cha thams cad kyis kyang ji lta ji snyed ma lus par rtogs pa sogs ye shes kyi bya ba byed/ de'ang yul dus phyogs re ba tsam ma yin par yid la gang 'dod dang tshig tu gang brjod ltar 'grub nus pa yin par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i legs bshad yin te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing / /105

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/kun tu spyan ldan dbu dang zhal/ / kun tu gsan ldan 'jig rten na/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs/ / zhes phung khams dang dbang po rnams re res kyang phyag gi bya ba len cing 'dzin pa/ zhabs kyi bya ba 'byon bzhugs/ spyan gye bya ba gzigs pa/ zhal gyi bya ba chos ston pa/ snyan gyi bya ba sgra gsan pa sogs thams cad 'byung la/ de'i rtsa ba ni dper na nyi 'od kyis sa steng thams cad g.yogs te kun la drod dang skems pa smin pa sogs kyi byed pa 'jug pa ltar/ ye shes chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis chos can mtha' dag khyab par g.yogs nas bzhugs pa'i dbang gis de thams cad la de'i byed pa ma tshang ba med par 'jug pa yin te/bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pas skra nyag ma gcig gis kyang nyes pa thams cad bsreg pa dang chos thams cad gzigs shing gsal bar byed nus tshul/ mtshan brjod las/ skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor gyis kyang gzigs so/ / de bzhin du mdzod spus kyang gzigs so/ / de ltar mtshan re res kyang gcig car phyogs bcu rnams su 'jig rten gye khams rab 'byams thams cad gzigs so/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug kyang sku thugs dbyer med pa 'dir 'bab/ 'on kyang de gnyis dbyer med du sgrub tshul gsal bar ma gsungs pas sngags su mi 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du 'khor 'das chos dbyings su dbyer med pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du bya bar gsungs pa'i chos dbyings dang 'bras bu mthar thug phar phyin theg par gsungs pa de sngags la de ltar yin kyang / de'i thabs tshang bar ma bstan pas mdo sngags khyad med du mi 'gyur la/ de bzhin du rim pa bzhi pa'i skabs su 'od gsal la gnas 106

༄/ /maṇḍapa gyi khrida'agadapag bsamasnyes/bzhin pa'i dus sgyu ma'i skur ldang ba sogs byed mi nus/ sgyu ma'i skur ldang ba na 'od gsal gyi mnyam gzhag las g.yo dgos pas dus nyi tshe ba dang res 'jog yin/ mthar thug gi tshe rjes thob kyi bya ba sprul bsgyur sogs nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu bstan kyang kun rtogs g.yo byed kyi rlung zad pas yang dag pa'i mtha' las ldang mi dgos pa'i phyir/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/khyod thugs bde ba chen po'i nyid byed 'od/ / mkha' dbyings stong nyid mdzes ma'i lang tsho la/ / rtag tu spyod pa'i rtse dga' mi gtong yang / / srid zhi'i dngos kun ma 'dres sa ler 'byed/ / ces gsungs te/ rlung de zad byed sngags la rag las pa'i gnad kyis rje bla mas yang dag mtha' dbyis phyin pa sngags la rag las par gsungs pa yin no/ / de dag gi gnad don dang dgos pa mthar thug pa sgron gsal las/ 'di'i don theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las kyang dgongs pas bshad pas ston te/ skra tsam khyon gcig la yang sangs rgyas ni/ / rnam mang gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed bzhugs/ / zhes bya ba dang /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ / sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag / ces bya ba gsungs pas lha'i de kho na nyid ston pa yin te/ nges pa'i don to/ / zhes dang / 'di'i dgongs pa bzhin dbu ma 'jug par yang sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba mthar thug pa ston pa'i tshe/ dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ / rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang / / 'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khya ba rdul ston mod/ / rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phrar mi 'gyur/ / zhes rdul gcig gi go sar 'jig rten mtha' yas pa shong ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mang po rdul gcig gis non pa sogs bzhed pa 'jug pa'i yon tan zhes/ thugs la gang bzhed dang / tshig tu gang brjod ltar 'grub thub pa 'di zung 'jug kho na'i 107

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/khyad chos yin te/ sgron gsal gyi mchan las/ 'di 'dra bayogo gcig mnan pas gzhan bzhugs pa la go mi 'gog pa ni de thams cad kyang zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'i dbang gis yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bye smras kyang thams cad mkhyen pa 'dod la/ phar phyin theg par yang rnam mkhyen bshad mod/ shes bya mtha' yas kyang gcig car gzigs thub pa dang / 'jig rten mtha' yas kyang de thams cad kyi don gcig car mdzad chog pa'i rtsa ba mthar gtugasan 'di la thug go / rtsa ba zung 'jug la de lta bu'i khyad chos yod pa'i gnad kyis zung 'jug dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa de'ang snga ma rnams las ches lhag par 'gro ba yin te/ maṇḍal lta bu'i tshe'ang rang gi lag gi maṇḍal der zhing rab 'byams kyi ri gling 'byor pa thams cad dgod cing / zhing rab 'byams kyi tshogs pa'i rdul re re la'ang nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi zhing khams dang rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs la/ rgyal ba'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa sogs phyogs gang nas kyang rgyar ma chad par 'byams klas pa dang / dus kyang da lta ba kho na ma yin par dus gsum du byung dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad lhan cig bkod nas dus kyang nyi tshe bar ma song bas snga ma las rgya che ba yin te/ phyed bcas bzhi brgya par/ sbyin bya la sogs mi dmigs kyang / / sbyin sogs tha mal nyid gyur pa/ / bdag med tha mal mi gzhom ste/ / 'khor lo mchog la de yod min/ / zhes pa'i thad kyi shārnyi pa'i 'grel pa las/ phyogs dus yongs su bcad pa med pa gang yin pa de ni chen po yin pas rgya che ba yin la/ zhes dang / sngags rim las/ yul dus phyogs re ba'i sgo nas rgya yongs su chad pa med pas thams cad kyi dbang du byas nas bsgoms pas rgya che ba yin la/ de 'dra ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor med na chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid tha mi dad pa'i zab mo'i rnal 'byor yod 108

༄/ /maskol gyi khridayigadapag bsamasnyes/kyang / chos can gyi ngos nas rgya ma chad par sgom pa med pas rgya chung ba yin no/ / zhes gsungs te/ 'dis mdo la chos nyid bsgom pa yod kyang lha'i rnal 'byor med pas sngags dang gnyi ga rgya che chung du 'gro lugs gcig dang /rim pa bzhi pa'i tshe chos nyid gzigs tshul mthar phyin kyang chos can brtan g.yo rab 'byams su 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba la dbang ma 'byor pas zung 'jug dang gnyi ga la rgya che chung 'byung tshul gcig kyang bstan pa yin/ tshul bzhi'i nang gi mthar thug la 'od gsal gyi mthar thug dang zung 'jug gi mthar thug gnyis su 'byed dgos pa'i rtsa ba'ang 'di la thug go / 'di dag gi dmigs legs par phyed na za ma tog bkod par/ bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje'i sgo zhes bya ba sogs ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang snod bcud kyi 'jig rten mtha' yas pa yod tshul gsungs pa de spyan ras gzigs kho na'i ma yin par zung 'jug brnyes pa kun gyi yon tan du go dgos la/dam chos pad dkar du dus phyi dro gcig la sa rum nas thon pa'i byang sems grangs med pa zhig gis bar gye bskal pa lnga bcur phyag 'tshal zhing bstod par gsungs pa'ang zung 'jug gi mthu yin par go bas/ mdo sngags gnyis skas kyigadang bu bzhin gcig gcig gi don du 'gyur tshul shes te gsung rab ma lusagadams ngag tu 'char bar 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa lag tu len tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum/ maṇḍal tshom bu sogs 'du bya ba'i tshul/ dngos gzhi ji ltar 'bul ba'i phyag len dang dmigs rnam skyong tshul/ mjug phan yon dran pas dga' ba skyed cing bsngo bas rgyas gdab tshul lo/ / dang po la/maṇḍal gyi rgyu rab gser dngul/ 'bring li zangs mkhar ba/ tha ma rdo leb dang shing sogs kyang rung ste/ rje bla mas kyang 'ol kha chos lung du bsag sbyang mdzad pa'i tshe rdo chen po ngos mnyam pa zhig la maṇḍal mdzad de phyag ngar gyis 109

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/phyis nas sku mtshal byung ba'i rjes da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa bzhin no/ / tshom bu'ang rab rin chen sna tshogs/ 'bring 'gron bu dang 'bru gtsang ma/ gal te ma 'byor na dkar gong gi phye mas kyang rung la/ 'byor ba yod bzhin rgyu gang ngan la mchod pa bya ba ni rang gi bsod nams nyams pa'i rgyu yin pas/dmus long gis mig ldan la mgo bskor byed pa dang 'dra bar po to pas gsungs so/ tshad khru gang yan chad bya bar slob dpon gaspa la'i maṇḍal cho ga dang / ye shes rdo rjes de nyid mthong ba'i lam du gsungs pa ltar byung na legs/ 'on kyang nges gzung mi dgos so/ / dbyibs kyang gasba la dang a rgyas las mthun gyi dbyibs blum po/ gru gsum/ zla gam/ gru bzhin rnams 'dam gar gsungs la/ / gzhan phal cher blum po dang gru bzhi gang rung gtso bor mdzad pas de bzhin bya'o/ / maṇḍal gye nang ba byung gis byugs shing 'bru sogs dri bzang gi chus sbags pa gal che ste/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/bshang gci chu la sogs pas byugs pa'am/ / rgyal ba mchod phyir rtag par rab tu bya/ / zhes pa'i bshang gci ba byung lnga dang / chu zhes pa dri bzang gi chu yin zhing / des sgrub gnas la byugs par bstan pas maṇḍal yang go dgos la/bde mchog rtsa rgyud las kyang / de la lci ba lding pa yis/ / dkyil 'khor sa ni nye bar byugs/ / zhes gsungs te/ des ba byung lhag ma'ang mtshon pas ba byung lngas byug go / zhes sbas don kun gsal du gsungs so/ / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i maṇḍal gyi cho gar don gzhan ma bshad par ba byung 'phab tshul dang byug tshul sogs kho na zhib mor bshad snang bas 'di shin tu gal che ba yon no/ / rgyas par byed na/ oṃ badzod ke hūṃ/ zhes pas ba byung dang dri bzang gi chu byin gyis brlab/ oṃya badzra buṣpe hūṃ zhes pas me tog byin gyes brlab/ oṃ ā badzra re khe hūṃ zhes pas maṇḍal byen gyis zlobs pa dang / 'khyil ba'i sngags 110

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khrida'ag dpag bsamasnyes/kyis mtshams gcod par yang gsungs so/ / sku gsung thugs rten dngos su bkram yod na des 'thus la/ med na dmigs rten du mchod pa'i maṇḍal las mtho ba'i stegs kyi khar maṇḍal tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i dbus su bla ma/ shar du yi dam/ lhor sangs rgyas/ nub tu chos/ byang du dge 'dun gsal btab pal sgrub pa'i maṇḍal zhes zer ro/ / bka' brgyud gong ma rnams 'di gtso bor lag len mdzad do/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i lag len dang dmigs rnam skyong tshul ni/ lag pa g.yon pa 'bru dang bcas pas maṇḍal bzung /g.yas pa 'bru dang bcas pa'i lag ngar gyis maṇḍal g.yas skor du lan gsum phyis na de'i ngos la byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsa yod pas las nyon sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang byams snying rjes rgyud brlan pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo yod la/ dmigs pa zhing khams der 'dam rdzab rdo gseg tsher ma sogs ma dag pa'i nyes pa rnams bsal nas rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi yangs shing khod stoms pa me long gi ngos lta bur gyur bar bsams na zhing dag sbyor ba'i nyams len du 'gro ste/rgyan las/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du/ snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa/ / de la dag par sgrub pa yis/ / sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di'i thad kye brgyad stong ba sogs su mu ge'i dgon pa dang / gcan gzan gyi dgon pa sogs su phyin pa na de'i rkyen gyis blo sbyong tshul gsungs pas mtshon rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i sdoms chen por gyur ba zhig yin no/ / phyis tshar ma thag lag pa g.yas pa'i nang gi 'bru de maṇḍal gyi dbus su bkod/ dbus stong bar bzhag na zhing khams stong par skye bar gsungs te/ 'gro ba gzhan med pa min gyi sangs rgyas mi 'byon pa'i mi khom pa'i gnas su skye ba'i don yin pas nyes dmigs che'o/ / de nas zhing khams 'bul bar zhu zhes pa lta bus snyan mnan la/ oṃ 111

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/badzra zu mi ā :/ zhes brjod cing 'og gzhi dang rin po che'i me tog tshogs pa sil mar bkram par bsams la thog khyab par me tog 'grem/ nyer gsum ma sngags dang bcas pa byed na/ oṃ badzra re khe ā ( zhes pas phyi lcags ri mu khyud/ oṃnya su ma phyo me ra we nā ma/ zhes pas dbus su ri rab sogs bkod la/so bdun ma'i 'don cha ltar byed tshe/ oṃ badzra re khe ā :/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ ces brjod pa'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gye khams 'di'i mtha'i lcags ri khor yug chen po dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten so so'i mtha'i lcags ri rnams gsal btab la maṇḍal gyi mtha' skor la me tog gis g.yas skor du bskor/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i mtha' 'khor yug chen po gcig gis bskor ba ni 'og gzhi'i rlung chu gser dkyil gsum brtsegs pa gcig gi steng du stong gsum chags par 'dod pa sa sde'i lugs yin gyi/ mdzod lugs gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten re re la de dag brtsegs pa re re so sor yod pas stong gsum lcags ri gcig gis bskor tshul med do/ / rgyan snang du mdzod kyi lung drangs pa las/ de stong la ni stong gsum gyi/ / 'jig rten khams ni bla na med/ /khor yug chen pos yongs su bskor/ / mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ / zhes snang ba ni rgya bod kyi dpe gang rung la mchan dkyus shor lta bu zhig byung bar mngon/ de nas dbus su tshom bu dgod cing ri'i rgyal po ri rab 'phangs dpag tshad khri phrag bcu drug yod pas brgyad khri rgya mtshor nub cing / brgyad khri steng du 'phags pa/ bang rim bzhi can/ nang ma nang ma mthoba'i gser ri bdun bre nang du bre bcug pa ltar byas pa'i bar gyi rol mtshobadun dang spel mar yod pa/ ri rab kyi rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas/ dbus su rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od 'bar 112

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridathagadapag bsamasnyem/ba/ mtha' skor du yongs 'du sa brtol sogs dpag bsam gyi shing dang /khrus kyi dzing bu dang / rin po che gzhal med khang dang / lha'i bdud rtsi dang /lha'i gos pañtsa lika dang / rin po che 'phreng ba brjod kyis mi lang ba dang /lha'i rnga chen po chos kyi dbyangs sgrogs pa sogs mchod rdzas dpag tu med pas gang ba/ bang rim la rgyal chen ris bzhi/ gnod sbyin gzhong thogs sogs dang / rol mtsho bdun la klu'i rgyal po rnams dpal 'byor chen po dang bcas te gnas par bsams/ ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa 'dra'ang / nges 'dzin mi 'dra ba du ma yod de mdzod rang 'grel las/gser gyi rang bzhin dang / dngul gyi rang bzhin dang / baiḍūrya'i rang bzhin dang / shel gye rang bzhin te ngos bzhi dag tu grangs bzhin no/ / zhes gsungs pa byang nas brtsams te g.yas skor du byas la/ de'i phyogs mdog dang gling gi nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs dgos pas shel zhes pa shel dmar por mchims mdzod las bshad de padma rā ga yin no/ / sa sder beeḍūrya dang shel gyi go rim bzlog ste 'byung bas rten sa'i mdo re yod par mngon la/gdags pa las shar shel lho beeḍūrya/ nub dngul/ byang gser du gsungs/dran pa nyer bzhag las/ shar dngul/ lho yeḍūrya/ nub gser/ byang shel dkar por gsungs la/ 'dir ri rab kyi dpangs dang gling gi tshad mngon pa gnyis las lhag pa re'ang gsungs so/ / dus 'khor gyi tshad dbyibs kha dog rwa'i yod tshul rnams 'di dang gtan mi mtshungs te/ phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor tshul gyi gnad mang po yod pas logs su shes dgos so/ / shar lus 'phags po zhes brjod pa'i tshe shar du tshom bu dgod cing shar lus 'phags po'i gling dbyibs zla ba phyed pa lta bu/ sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad kha dog dkar ba/ mi rnams gzugs bzang zhing sems rgyud 'jam pa/ longs 113

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/spyod che ba/ rin po che mang bos gang ba gsal gdab/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling zhes brjod pa'i tshe lhor tshom bu dgod cing / lho 'dzam bu gling dbyibs shing rta lta bu'am gru gsum gyi rnam pa/ sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad kha mdog sngo ba/ grub pa'i gnas mang po dang / mchod rdzas mang pos gang ba gsal gdab/ nub ba lang spyod ces bajod pa'i tshe nub tu tshom bu dgod cing /nub ba lang spyod kyi gling dbyibs maṇḍal ltar blum po/ sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad kha dog dmar ba/ longs spyod tshad med pa dang ldan pa gsal gdab/ byang sgra mi snyan zhes brjod pa'i tshe byang du tshom bu dgod cing / byang sgra mi snyan gyi gling dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad kha dog ser ba/ mi rnams gzugs bzang zhing 'od dang ldan pa/ longs spyod lha dang mnyam pa/ mchod rdzas khyad par du 'phags pas yongs su gang ba gsal gdab/ gling so so'i rgya khyon gyi tshad/ mdzod las/ 'dzam bu gling ste ngos gsum la/ / stong phrag gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs/ / gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ / shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra/ / ngos gsum 'di dang 'dra gcig la/ dpag tshad sum rgya lnga bcu'o/ / ba gling spyod gling blum po ste/ / stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin no/ / sgra mi snyan brgyad gru bzhir mnyam/ / zhes 'byung zhing / sa'i dngos gzhir lho gling gi ngos chung shos la dpag tshad lnga brgya/ shar gling gi ngos thung bar dpag tshad stong yod par gsungs/ dran nyer lho nub shar byang rnams la rim pa bzhin dpag tshad stong phrag bdun dang brgyad dang dgu dang bcu yod par gsungs/ gling gzhan gyi mi'i lus tshad kyang ta la bdun sogs su gsungs pas/ mdzod las/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi tshad/ / khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi/ / shar dang ba gling spyod dang ni/ / byang zhes bya ba nyis 'gyur skyed/ / ces pa dang ches mi 114

sa / /maṇḍal gyi khridathag dpag bsamasnyem/'dra'o/ / gling phran ni gling de dang rtsa ba mtsho nang na 'brel nas yod pa de'i gling phran du bzhag pa yin cing / phal chen las gling bzhi la gling phran bye ba brgyad cu yod par gsungs pa lta bu ches mang yang / dbyibs dang longs spyod mi'i sha tshugs sogs gling gtso bo las cung dman yang cha 'dra ba'i gling phran che shos brgyad du yod pas/ lus dang lus 'phags zhes brjod pa'i tshe shar gye tshom bu'i g.yas g.yon du tshom bu re dgod cing de'i gling phran gnyis bsam/rngayab dang rnga yab gzhan zhes brjod de lho'i tshom bu'i g.yas g.yon/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro zhes brjod cing nub kyi tshom bu'i g.yas g.yon/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla zhes brjod cing byang gi tshom bu'i g.yas g.yon du tshom bu re bkod la gling rang rang gi g.yas g.yon du gling phran gnyis gnyis byung bar bsams/ rin po che'i ri bo zhes brjod cing shar gling gi tshom bu'i nang logs su tshom bu zhig bkod de gling de'i 'byor ba'i gtso bo rin po che'i ri dpangs mtho la ngos yangs pa rin po che'i 'od sna tshogs 'char ba dang /dpag bsam gyi shing zhes brjod pa'i tshe lho gling gi nang du dzam bu dṛkṣa'i ljon partse mo dgung la bsnyegs shing gos dang rgyan sna tshogs pas spud pa bsams/'dod 'jo'i ba zhes nub kyi nang du 'o ma'i rgyun zad pa med pa sha rgyas shing sru sdug pa'i khyu bsams/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog ces byang gi nang du ma rmos ma btab par skyes pa'i lo tog ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa ste gling rang rang gi longasaspyod kyi gtso bo rnams gsal gdab/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas lha'i dbang pos gser gyi 'khor lo sogs sbyin par gsungs pas 'khor lo rin po che zhes shar gyi rin po che'i ri'i tshom bu'i nang logs su tshom bu zhig dgod/ de bzhin du lho'i nang ngos la nor bu rin po che/ nub tu btsun mo rin po che/ byang du blon po rin 115

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/po che/ shar lho'i gling phran gnyi ga'i bar gyi nang logs su glang po rin po che/lho nub tu rta mchog rin po che/ nub byang du dmag dpon rin po che/ byang shar du 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'bad med du 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i bum pa dgod/ rgyal srid sna bdun so so'i yon tan dang byed las sogs kyi khyad par ni/ rje bla mas/ dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser las legs byas shing / /rtsibs stong ldan pa'i dpag tshad lnga brgya pa/ / nyi ma gnyis pa lta bur mkhar 'phags te/ / dpag tshad 'bum lam nyi ma gcig gis gcod/ / ces sogs mdo dran pa nyer bzhag gi don je lta ba bzhin du bkod pa dang /mngon 'byung gi mdo las/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu blum/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don rnams kyang legs par nges par byas te dmigs rnam gsal thebs pa bya/ der ma zad mdo sde rgyan las/ shes bya ma rgyal rgyal ba'i phyir/ / dran pa dag ni kun tu spyod/ / ces sogs ltar byang chub yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur tshul dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos mdor bsdus pa las/ rin chen bdun ni 'di yin te/ / dbang gis 'khor lo rin chen dang / / zhes sogs dbang lam 'bras bu ci rigs la sbyar ba dang kā ma dhe nus sdong po bkod pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ pha rol phyin pa rtag 'byung 'khor lo yin te mngon par shes pa glang po mchog / ces sogs kyis kyang lam gye khyad par ci rigs la sbyar ba'i mtshon don legs par nges na de'i tshod kyis blo 'khul tshab che ba 'byung / 'khor lo la sogs pa de dag kyang re re tsam min te/ ye shes rdo rje'i de nyid mthong ba'i lam du rgyal srid sna bdun re re'i mthar de dang des gang bar bsams/ zhes 'byung bas bgrang las 'das pa bsam dgos so/ / de'ang mdzod las/ gser dngul zangs 116

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khrid yigadapag bsamasnyem/lcags 'khor lo can/ / de dag gling gcig gling gnyis dang / / gsum dang bzhi la mas rim bzhin/ / phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bshams dang / /mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med/ / ces zangs lcags kye 'khor sgyur gnyis gzhan la bsad mas sogs kyi gnod pa mi dgos kyang g.yu la bshams pa dang mtshon brtsams pa tsam gyis pha rol po 'dul bar 'gyur bas dmag dpon rin po che dgos/ gser dngul gyi 'khor 'o sa sgyur bas g.yul bshams pa tsam yang mi dgos pas/ 'dir 'khor lo gser gyi 'khor lo la gsungs kyang rin chen bdun gyi grangs su dmag dpon gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni rtsod ldan ches snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa po rnams la rgyu med par sdang ba mang bas/ de dag gi gnod pas mi badzi ba'i thabs su bla ma la dmag dpon rin po che phul te mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs na don shin tu che ba la dgongs pa yin no/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'phrin yig rnam gzhag tu/ khyim bdag mi 'dren par dmag dpon dang blon po grangs re rer 'dren pa la rin chen gcig chad pa'i skyon yod gsungs pa dang 'dren tshul de dag mi 'gal te/khyim bdag ces ma smos na'ang blon po dang dmag dpon zhes bgrang ba'i tshe blon pos khyim bdag dang gnyi ga'i go chod pas/ mngon 'byung gi mdor/bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan de/ / blon po rin chen/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun zhes pas dngos zin gyi rin chen bdun yang blon po dang dmag dpon zhes 'dren na khyim bdag blon pa'i khongs su sdud dgos shing / blon po dang khyim bdag ces 'dren na dmag dpon blon po'i khungs su sdud dgos te/ sgron gsal las/ bud med dang /skyes pa dang / rin po che dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri dang / glang po dang /117

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rta rin po che zhes pa'i thad kyi mchan las/ ral gri 'dzin pa'i dmag dpon zhes grags pa blon po rin po che/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de nas phyogs kyi 'khor lo sogs bzhi'i nang du/ sgeg mo/ 'phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma bzhi dang / mtshams kyi glang po sogs bzhi'i nang du/ me tog ma/ gdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma rnams kyi tshom bu dgod/ de dag kyang rje bla mas/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i smin legs gzugs/ / 'khri shing gzhon nu bzhin du lus phra zhing / / bzhin ras rgyas pas zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog / utpal sngon po'i mig can mchu sgros dmar/ / zhes sogs ltar shin tu yid 'phrog pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rang gi mchad rdzas de dang de thogs pa bsam zhing / rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad po de dag kyang re re tsam min par nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang ba/ rang rang gi mtshan dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs te mchod pa byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / nyer gsum ma'i steng du 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas 'di brgyad bsnan pa yin la/ snon pa'i rgyu mtshan ni khams gsum chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du rgyal srid sna bdun phul ba yin zhing / de nyid bsdus par rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lha tshogs 'god tshul 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal thabs kyi tshul du byas pa yin pas/nang gi grwa'i lha mo bzhi sras rnams kyi btsun mo'i tshul dang / phyi'i grwa'i lha mo bzhi pho nya mo dang / bran mo dang / mngags gzhug ma dang / gsol kha ma'i tshul du gsungs pa der bstun pa yin/ nag po ba'i dkyil chog sogs su/sgeg dang bcas pas 'phreng ba 'phang / / zhes sogs dbang gi mtha' rten rgyasapa byas te gsang sngags zab mo'i 'dod yon lam byed kyi gnad mang po yod par gsungs pa'ang dran par bya dgos so/ / de nas nyi ma zla ba zhes 118

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khrid yigadapagabasamasnyem/bajod cing ri rab kyi tshom bu'i mdun rgyab tu tshom bu re bkod pa na/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab bstod cha rgya mtsho nas yar 'phags pa la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa'i phyed dpag tshad bzhi khri'i mtshams ri gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo dang mnyam pa'i thad shar phyogs kyi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me shel gye rang bzhin dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ nub phyogs kyi nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba chu shel gyi rang bzhin dpag tshad lnga bcu pa/ gnyis ga'i 'od kyis gling dang gling phran rol mtsho'i bar sogs mtha' dag gi mun pa sel ba/ khyad par du nyi 'od kyis lo 'bras thams cad smin par byed cing /zla bas tsha gdung sel bar bsams/ bde gshegs kun bzang gi zhing du nyi ma gcig gis stong gsum ga'i mun pa sel bar gsungs pa lta bu'ang yod la/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis sa la gling gnyis tsam las lhag khyab mi nus par gsungs pa lta bu'ang yod/ spyir nyi 'od kyis khyab par zla 'od mi mngon yang / skabs 'diraganyi ga'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun la khyab par bsam dgos te/ de gnyis kyi mtshon don nyi ma mun pa drungs nas 'byin pa'i gnyen po yin pa ltar/don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis srid pa'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin gyi mun pa drungs phyung ste srid mtha' 'gog pa dang / zla ba bsil pa'i rang bzhin yin pas tsha gdung sel ba ltar/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni snying rje'i rtsa ba can yin pas rang gces 'dzin bsal te gzhan phan lhur byed pas zhi mtha' 'gog par byed/ thabs shes de gnyis kyang ya bral du ma song bar gcig gis gcig zin pa dgos shing / sngags lugs kyis de las kyang lhag pa/ ro gcig dngos po'i sems nyid do/ / zhes pa blo gcig gi ngo bor tshang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ / blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing goms pa phul du phyin pa rnams ni 'di'i khongs nas kyang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i e waṃ thams cad kyi don 119

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/'charabs sngagagabla med kyi zab gnas ma lus pa la bag chags 'jog nus so/ / de nas ri rab kyi tshom bu'i g.yas g.yon du tshom bu re dgod cing /rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes brjod pa na lho phyogs kyi steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can nam/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas gdugs phul tshul gsungs pa bzhin yu ba beeḍūrya dang / gdugs khebs gser las byas pa/ dar gyi sham bu nyi le bar rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i me shel rnams kyis nyi ma'i bya ba sa gsum snang bar byed cing / chu shel rnams bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sangs rgyas rnams la sku khrus gsol zhing / sems can rnams skom pa sogs sel ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha rnams snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byung bas sangs rgyas3mas la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yon tan brjod nas bstod cing / sems can so sor gang 'dod kyi chos ston pa sogs don gnyis rgya chen po byed nus pade lta bur bsam par gsungs so/ / ming gi rnam grangs a ma ra ko ṣar/gdugasani gdung ba skyob pa ste/ / zhes 'byung bas tsharji gdugs/ ā ta pa tram̐ gdung skyob ces so sor bshad kyang gdugs kyi skad dod tshaji la'ang gdung ba skyob pa'i don tshang ste/ 'dod 'jo las/ tshaji 'geb par byed pas gdugs te ṣāja'o/ / zhes sogs/ / byang phyogs su rgyal mtshan ni rje bla mas/mdzes pa'i srog chags mtshan ma yod med kyi/ / zhes gsungs te/ 'dul ba'i mdor yang / seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa dang / nya spu rgyas pa sogs srog chags gnyis 'dus kyi gzugs khyad par bas mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gsungs pa bzhin yin pas mtshan ma de 'dra yod pa rgyal mtshan dang / med pa ba dan du 'jog la/ gnyi ga'ang dar lce gsum pa yongs grags kyi 'phan lta bu zhig yin no/ / 'on kyang a ma ra ko shar/ ba dan dang ni rgyal mtshan dang / /120

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridathag dpag bsamasnyem/dmag dar ru dar zhes de bzhi ga rnam grangs su gsungs pa sgra yangs dog yin pas/ gang ltar yang mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba shes byed kyi mtshan ma yin pas rgyal mtshan zhes smos pa yin/ 'di ni rang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol te bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rang don phun tshogs kyi rten 'brel dang / gdugs ni 'gro ba mtha' dag rgud pa'i tsha gdung las skyob pa'i mgon dang skyabs su 'gyur ba gzhan don phun tshogs kyi rten 'brel te/ rim pa bzhin rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de nas dbus su tshom bu zhig phyur bur bkod cing rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gye rnam par sa dang bar snang yongs su bkang nas phul bar bsams la/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ / bzhes nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ phyogs kye ston tshul shar rang ngos la ston pa/ 'bul yul la ston pa/gnyi ga 'dam dar mdzad pa dang / dngos po la rang 'dzam gling du yod pas lho rang la ston pa sogs sna tshogs yod na'ang / 'bul rgyu'i rdzas gang yin kyang 'bul yul de la kha bltas nas 'bul dgos pa spyi lugs yin pas shar 'bul yul la bstan na legs zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dbang pos gsungs so/ / de'ang dang por ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa cha tshang re re legs par gsal gdab/ goms pa na bcu brgya stong sogs rgya je 121

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/cher btang ste stong gsum gyi bar du 'bul/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa ltar na phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud dang phal chen las gsungs pa ltar stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mtshams sbyor dang / de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud dang po/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud bar ma/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud gsum pa'am gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing khams su 'jog cing de ni sprul sku gcig gi 'dul zhing du gsungs pas de lta bur mos/ zhing gi dbyibs bkod kyang mdo sde sa bcu pa las/'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rgyas pa dang / tha gru che ba dang / tshad med pa dang / rags pa dang / phra ba dang / 'chol ba dang / steng g.yogs med cing gzhi phyal ba dang / 'jug pa'i khyim can zhes sogs dang / mdo sde phal po che las/ phyogs rnams kun na zhing khams rgya mtsho snang / / la la blum po la la zur gsum ste/ / de dag la la phyogs ni gru bzhir gnas/ / nor bu padma 'khor lo yan lag brgyad/ / kun kyang las rnams rgya mtshos rnam par bris/ / zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa bzhin dbyibs bkod rgya khyon sogs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su yod pas de bzhin bsam dgos/ 'on kyang ma dag pa'i skyon gyi cha mi bsam par/ dag pa'i zhing ltar snod bcud thams cad yon tan phun sum tshogs par bsam dgos te/ 'dir zhing 'bul tshul ni sangs rgyas rnams la bzhugs gnas su phul te 'dir bzhugs nas zhing 'di'i gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhu dgos pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i pho brang mchog / maṇḍal gang zhig byed pa dang / / zhes dang / slob dpon shī la sambha wa'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i man ngag las/ rin chen las byung gzhal yas khang / / mdzes pa 122

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridathag dpag bsamasnyes/nyid du gyur par bsam/ / de dbus bla ma yi dam lha/ / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de la dgongs te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas kyang /sangs rgyas zhing la dmigs te phul ba yis/ / byas na sangs rgyas rnams 'bul yul gye zhing la bshad pa lta bur 'gro/ zhing thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing dngos su song bar bsam dgos pas/ sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ / byas na legs gsungs so/ / de nas blo'i mthu cher goms pa na phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams dang / 'jig rten khams na mchod pa'i dngos por 'os pa gang yod mtha' dag blos bslangs nas 'bul dgos te/spyod 'jug las/ nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs par/ / yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ / blo yis bslangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog / sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / mdo lugs la 'di las gong mar gyur ba'am rgya che ba'i mchod pa 'bul tshul med pas bla na med pa'i mchod pa zhes bya la/ sngags lugs kyi dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel pa'i mchod pa gong du bshad pa ltar zhing rab 'byamasade thams cad kye rdul re re la'ang zhing khams mtha' yas pa da ltar yod pa tsam du ma zad/ sngar byung zin pa dang slar 'byung 'gyur tshun chad bkod de 'bul ba yin pas snga ma las ches shin tu rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'iganas yin no/ / gsum pa mjug tu phan yon dran pas dga' ba skyed cing bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa la/ maṇḍal gye phan yon ni mdo las/ ba yi lce ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ / legs par nyug par byed pa tshul khrims so/ / srin dang grog spur bsal ba bzod pa yin/ / bya ba la ni nyer zhugs brtson 'grus te/ / de la skad cig sems ni gcig byed pa/ / bsam gtan shes rab ri 123

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronatha'i gsung 'bum/mo gsal ba'o/ / thub pa'i maṇḍal byas pa yis/ / pha rol phyin pa 'di drug thob/ / gser gyi mdog 'gyur 'di dag ste/ / nad rnams kun dang bral bar 'gyur/ / zla ba ltar mdzes gsal pa yis/ / lha dang mi ni dam par skye/ / nor dang gser ni 'byor ba yi/ / rgyal po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes gnas skabs kyi nyer 'tshe zhi zhing 'dod don mtha' dag 'grub pa dang / gtso bor 'di'i nyams len du phar phyin drug ka tshang bar gsungs la/ de tshang na mngon mtho nges legs/ don gnyis/ bslab pa gsum/ tshogs gnyis la sogs pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug gi dgos don mtha'adag de'i khongs su 'grub 'gro bar mdo sde rgyan gyi phyin drug gi grangs nges sgrub pa'i skabs su gsungs pa bzhin no/ / dgra las rnam rgyal gyi maṇḍal gyi cho gar lung 'di drangs kyang lung khungs ma smos la/ abhya'i byang chub gzhung lam du drangs pa las/ chu bcas lce ba sbyin pa ste/ / yang dag byugs pa tshul khrims yin/ / grog spur phra sel bzod pa ste/ / zhes sogs rkang ba dang po drug ga'ang tshig thung du 'byung bas 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs snga ma dang 'dra la/ / lung khungs maṇḍal gyi phan yon bstan pa'i mdo zhes gsungs/ ye shes rdo rje'i nyid mthong ba'i lam du lung drangs pa phyi ma dang 'dra zhing lung khungs dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdo zhes gsungs pas gang ltar mdo tshig yin no/ /phyi mas drangs pa'i lung gi mjug tu/ sangs rgyas gyur nas yongs su zhing khams dag / ces gsungs pa'ang shin tu don che ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing spyod tshul ni zhing dang rnam pa mthun pa'i rgyu tshogs yang yang gsal btab ste mos pa skyed cing / dge rtsa rnams de'i don du smon pas mtshams sbyor ba la ragalas pa slob dpon chos bshes kyi tshig gsal las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba ni rang gi sems spyong ba ste/ zhing gi rgyur tshogs bsags nas smon 124

༄/ /maṇḍal gyi khridathagadapag bsamasnyem/lam 'debs pa'o/ / zhes dang / mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gsung las/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong du'ang 'gyur te/ dper na rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gye zhing dang rnam pa mthun par rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa bzhin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ za ma tog lta bu'i gtam las kyang / maṇḍal me tog bcas byed pa/ / 'gro ba'i bdag po tshe ring zhing / /sna tshogs nad kyi 'jigs las grol/ / gang yin de yis skad cig thob/ /bde gshegs maṇḍal byed de dag / pha rol phyin pa drug thob 'gyur/ / zhes gnas skabs tshe ring zhing nad med pa sogs mngon mtho'i yon tan dang mthar thug pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgo nas nges legs bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gsungs so/ / 'on kyang dbu ma rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dang po mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ / phyis nas nges par legs 'byung ba'o/ /gang phyir mngon par mtho thob pas/ / rim gyis nges par legs pa 'byung / / zhes pa ltar/ mngon mtho ni nges legs sgrub pa'i thabs tsam du don du gnyer ba yin gyi/ smon pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo gzhan don dang bla med byang chub la dmigs dgos so/ / rang cag rnams kha nas smon pa'i tshig zab cing rgya che ba ji tsam zhig brjod kyang yid kyis 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang yang rung ba re'i rgyur bsngos na legs nyes kun gyi rtsa ba sems dbang che bas dge rtsa chud zos su 'gyur ba mang ba la dgongs nas/ rje bla mas/ shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang / / 'khor dang longs spyod rnyed dang bkur ste'i rgyur/ / skad cig tsam yang nam yang mi smin par/ / bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig / ces gol sa rnams rjen par phyung nas gsungs pa bzhin bsngo ba log pa'i skyon rnams ring du dor te dag pa'i zhing khyad par can sbyong zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa dang / phan bde'i 'byung 125

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/gnas blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa'i rgyur bsngo ba sogs smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / smras pa/dal 'byor lus kyi dbang chen dkyel 'khor du/ / mkho dgu'i longs spyod ri gling khor yug can/ / byang chen mkhar bsnyegs dge ba'i lhun por bcas/ / bla ma mchog gsum mchod do brtse bas skyongs/ / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i sa bon dang / / zhing gi mthu brten tshogs bsags drod gsher gnyis/ / ya bral gyur la 'bras bu mi smin pas/ / zung du 'brel bar mdzod cig shes ldan dag / 'dun ldan blo gros dga' tshal las 'khrungs pa/ / rmad byung legs bshad dpag bsam gsar ba'i ljon/ / ji bzhin sgrub pas yongs smin bsod nams kyi/ / snye ma mi zad g.yur du za bar shog / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i 'od stong gis/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho kun tu khyab gyur te/ / sems can rgya mtsho smin cing grol byas nas/ / ye shes rgya mtsho myur du rtogs gyur cig / ces maṇḍal gyi khrid yig dpag bsam snye ma zhesabya ba 'di ni hal ha ja sag thu rgyal po'i shog nas lhag bsam blo gros kyi nor ldan dkon mchog smon lam gyis sngon 'gro khrid chen bzhi rgyas pa zhig byed dgos tshul nan cher byung bar brten 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sde snod 'dzin pa du ma la skyabs khrid nyin lnga/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyin gsum/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang maṇḍal nyin re byas te khrid phog skabs maṇḍal la bshad pa bgyis pa rnams de bzhin yi ger 'khod pa zhig dgos zhes gzhung lugs smra ba'i dbang po dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan grags pas bskul ba ltar khrig chags su bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / / 126

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing du bkrod pa'ibade lam/༄༅/ / rje btsun byams pa mgon po la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i rnam par bzhag pa dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ārya mai twa ye/ ring nas goms pa'i thugs rje'i phyag brkyang ste/ /srid mtsho nyam nga'i g.yang du lhung ba rnams/ / phan bde padma'i dga' tshal la 'god pa/ / mi pham mgon gyis bdag sogs 'gro 'di skyongs/ / de'ang rje btsun byams mgon la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'chad pa la/ spyir 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams su len tshul tshig zin la gsal bar bshad pa ni kha sbyor sogs ma rgyud kyi skor shes che la/ 'on kyang pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus ba'i bsre 'pho'i gnad rnams kyang 'di dag dang don mthun zhing / khyad par 'pho ba'i gdams pa mthar thugs pa sems dben sgrub tshul gye gzhung rnams yin par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtshor gsungs pa ltar yin no/ / rgyud sde 'og ma rnams su de'i rnam bzhag dngos su gsungs pa med kyang / bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyis des rgyas bkab nas 'od dpag med dang byams mgon sogs la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i rnam bzhag mdzad pa ni rgyud don man ngag gis phye ba'i srol phul du phyin par snang ste/dgag bya dang dgos pa phyogs mthun pa rnams la dbang gi rnam bzhag dang las tshogs ci rigs pa rnams rgyud sde dang lhag pa'i lha tha dad pa so so la phan 127

༄/ /gungathang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/tshun du rgyas bkab pa ni 'phags bod kye gzhung tshad ldan rnams las mang du 'byung ngo / / des na 'dir dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ rang gis skyong tshul/ gzhan la khrid 'debs tshul/ gshin po'i don du bya tshul dang gsum/ dang po la spyor dngos gnyis las/ sbyor ba 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba zhig dgos la/ dag pa'i zhing du bgrod pa'i 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bo ni ma dag 'khor bas bsdus pa'i lus longs spyod gnyen bshes sogs la chags pa 'di nyid yin te/ khams so so la rang rang gi sred pa'i bdag gir byas ma byas kho na khams de dang de las 'das ma 'das kyi don du gsungs so/ / rang gi ngos nas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la zhen pa ma btang na/sangs rgyas byang sems rnams ci tsam thugs rje che'ang 'dren par mi nus te/srin mo'i gling du tshud pa'i tshong pa rnams spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rta mchog bā la has 'dzam bu'i gling du sgrol bar bzhed kyang / tshong dpon ma gtogs pa rnams de dag gi bslu brid la chags pa'i dbang gis phyir ltung lte srin mo'i kha zas su gyur ba bzhin no/ / des na dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing tshe la long med pa'i tshul bsam ste/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs spyon pa'i zlos gar lta ba'i tshe 'di'i snang shas bzlog pa dang / las nges pa dang 'phel che ba'i dbangagis phyi mar 'gro sa ngan song las 'os med cing / der skyes na yun tshad las 'das par sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos la/ gal te phyi mar ngan song du ma lhung yang 'khor ba 'di las gtan tu thar ba zhig ma byung na/ las byas pa chud mi za ba'i dbang gis srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du song yang phyir ngan song ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa brgyud mar lhung ba las ma 'das pa'i tshul bsams te phyi ma'i snang shas bzlog pa dang gnyis kyi sgo nas khams gsum 128

༄/ /'pho khridadaga' ldan zhing dubagrod pa'ibade lam/'khor ba mtha' dag la btson ra lta bu'i 'du shes kyis zhen pa gting nas log pa zhig med mi rung du dgos so/ / mthun rkyen sgrub tshul yang / theg chen 'phoba'i man ngag ni/ stobs lnga nyid yin zhes tshe 'di la zhen pa bcad de dag pa'i zhing du skye 'dod kyi 'phen pa yang yang gtong zhing / 'pho ba'i dmigs rnam yun du goms par byed pa dang / khyad par yo byad gang yod dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur sogs rnam dkar gyi phyogs su btang ste/ de'ang 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rgyur smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams spyor ba ni dag pa'i zhing du skye ba 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi gtso bor gsungs so/ / der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa rnal ma skye ba la zhing gi bkod pa yid yul du 'char dgos la/de'ang mdzod las/ gnas nas gnas 'og ji srid pa/ / de nas de yi gong de srid/ / ces pa ltar gyi rigs pas gzhal na 'di nas steng tu dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri'i mtshams su lha'i bu rab dga' ldan gyis bskyangs pa'i dga' ldan spyi'i gnas yod cing / de'i ngos gcig na grong las dgon pa'i tshul du dag pa'i zhing mchog dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gnas/spyir bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis skye ba mngon par skye ba'i mdzad pa ston pa'i gnas su tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pas bsgrubs pa yin la/ bye brag da lta'i dus kyis khyad par du byas pa 'di ni rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu las grub pa yin no/ / de'i snod bcud kyi 'byor ba bsam gye mi khyab pa'i tshul sgos su ston pa'i mdo bod du 'gyur ba mi snang yang /dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs du mar sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po'i bkod pa gsungs pa dang cha mtshungs pas/ de dag gi rigs pa'i 'gros sbyar te bsam pa dang / lhag par zhing de'i dbus na rje btsun byams mgon gyi bzhugs gnas chos kyi pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po gser gyi rgya phibs nyi ma 129

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/stong gi 'od las lhag cing / nor bu'i dra ba dra phyed dang dril bu g.yer kha'i tshogs kyis spros pa/ lha'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang las kyang 'bum 'gyur gyis lhag pa dang / de'i mdun du chos ston pa'i kun dga' ra ba tha gru yangs shing rgya che la khor yug tu rin po che'i ljon shing gi phreng bas bskor ba/ gser gye sa gzhi la baiḍūrya'i mig mang ris su bris shing mnan na rnam byed cing / bteg na sbar byed pa/ de'i gong du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du rje btsun byams pa mgon po mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar zhing / sher phyin zab mo'i gdams pa rgyun mi chad par 'doms pa dang / g.yas su nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang / g.yon du rgyal sras 'jam dpal snying po sogs rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor nas bzhugs pa'i bkod pa yang yang yid la byed pa ni/ der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa skye ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur bar ma zad zhing sbyong gi man ngag kyang bla na med par gsungs so/ / de ltar blo sbyong ba'i dmigs rten du zhing bkod kyi bris thang sogs byung na shin tu legs la/ de ma 'byor yang byams mgon gyi sku bris 'bur ci rigs sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten legs par bkram ste/ gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa phul du phyin pa bsham/ stan bde ba la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de skyabs sems sngon du btang nas kun slong rnam par dag pa zhig gsal btab ste dngos gzhi la 'jug par byed dgos so/ / rang nyid lus sems bde ba tsam zhig gi phyir zhing der skye ba don du gnyer ba ni kun slong ma dag pa yin pas/ kun slong 'chos tshul yang brtan pa ma thob bar du snyigs ma bdo pa'i gnas 'di lta bur skye ba blangs na/ slar yang rkyen dang grogs ngan pa ji lta bu zhig gi dbang du 'gyur nges pa med pas/ des na slar mi ldog pa'i dag zhing khyad par can zhig tu skye ba len dgos pas de'i nang 130

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhingakhu bgrod pa'i bde lam/nas kyang rang cag gang la las 'brel shin tu che ba rje btsun byams mgon yin pas/ zhing khyad par can 'di nyid du skye ba blangs te rgyal ba ma pham mgon po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyod cing / de'i bstan pa'i don zab rgyas ya ma bral ba'i nyams len mtha' dag dang / khyad par du rgya che ba'i lam rim byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams lam gyi srog tu byas/ dmigs med kyi ltabs rgyas btab nas lam gong ma thams cad rim gyis bgrod de/ mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du byas la/ 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi sgo nas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyang bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed bcos ma tshun chad kyi sgo nas gsal 'debs dgos so/ / zab rgyas kyi lam gang la thog mar gtso bor slob pa'ang /dbu ma snying po las/ / yang dag shes tshol sngon btang ste/ / don dam rnam par nges gyur nas/ / lta ngan 'thib gnas 'jig rten la/ / snying rje kun tu skyedaganas su/ / zhes sogs ltar dbang po shin tu non pos thog mar yang dag pa'i lta ba btsal te/ de'i sgo nas snying rje chen po sogs la 'jug par gsungs/ gdul bya thun mong pa shas cher gyi don du 'gyur ba ni/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por thabs kyi cha la pyong ba brtan por byas te/ gzod dbu ma'i lta ba tshol ba yin no/ / der skye ba'i rgyu tshogs kun gyi gtso bor gyur ba ni/der skye 'dod kyi kun slong rnam par dag pa 'di kho na yin pas/ kun slong gi khyad par la de'i snod bcud kyi yon tan lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gang la gtso bor byed pa de dang sgo mthun pa'i rigs 'dra'i gnad tshang ba zhig med mi rung du dgos so/ dngos gzhi ni/ dga' ldan zhing mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin nas/ / rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po thugs rje gter/ / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 131

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'khor dang bcas pa kun/ / brtse bas 'dir gshegs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ / zhes brjod pa na skad cig gis dga' ldan nas rje btsun byams mgon 'khor dang bcas pa bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin thogs pa med par byon te/ smin mtshams mda' gang gi thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla sogs kyi gdan la dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs par bsams/de nas/ ji snyed su dag ces pa nas chen por bsngo/ / zhes pa'i bar gyes yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs ma lus 'bul/ sdeg ltung kun gshegs dge la rjes yi rang / rtag tu bzhugs shing chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / dge tshogs kun kyang byang chub chen por bsngo/ / zhes bsag sbyang mdor bsdus pa bya/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba byams pa mgon po rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'atres lo/ / mchod do/ / skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig brgya rtsa sogs brjod cing / skabs 'dir byams mgon gyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rang gi spyi bo nas bzhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dang / 'di snang gi zhen pa sogs dag pa'i zhing du skye ba dang 'pho ba 'byongs pa la gegs byed kyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag / de'i sku gsungs thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams rang rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa byed/ de nas/ rang lus shel gyi bum pa ltar gsal ba'i/ / dbus su dbu ma smad phra stod yangs pa/ / yar sne spyi po'i gtsug tu kha phye zhing / / mar sne lte ba'i 'og tu sleb pa yi/ / snying ga'i thad kyi dru tī'i dbus nyid du/ / shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i rlung sems dang / / dbyer med dkar gsal 'od kye thig le'i 132

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing du bgrod ba'i bde lam/gzugs/ / yang zhing 'phar la khad pa'i rnam par gyur/ / ces brjod cing /rangagi lus shel gyi bum pa bzhin phyi bltas nang gsal pa'i dbus cung zad rgyab gzhung la nye ba'i char dbu ma rag dung kha gyen bslang lta bu/ mar sne phugs rdug lte 'og sor gsum gyi thad du sleb pa/ yar sne gro sog bcad pa bzhin spyi bo'i gtsug dang kha da chad kyi tshul du bu ga yangs ha re yod pa/ snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang der shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i thig le dkar po kha dog dkar la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can shin tu gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ rlung cung zad phog pa tsam gyis kyang bskyod nus ba'i shing bal lta bu/ shin tu yang zhing 'phar la khad 'phur la khad pa zhig tu bsams/ skabs 'dir sngags bla med lta bu'i rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom tshul la sogs pa med par/ lus kyi dkyil du rtsa dbu ma srog shing gi tshul du bsgom pa tsam yin pas skabs don de tsam gyis 'grub cing / rgyud sde 'og ma la'ang sbyar chog par mngon/ de'ang zhal lung las lam bzang po yis yid 'ong gnas/ / lam ngan gyis ni srid par skyon/ / zhes pa ltar rnam shes 'pho ba'i sgo ngan pa rnams 'gog pa gal che zhing / bla med nas gsungs pa'i lam 'gog byed kyi yi ge rnams skabs 'dir mi 'ong bas/ sgo de rnams gong du bdud rtsi 'pheb sbyang byas pa'i mthar/'od dang bdud rtsi gser zhun ma lta bus dam gyis bkag cing / rnam shes sgo de rnams nas 'pho mi nus par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa byas pas 'grub bo/ / de nas byams mgon rang gi spyi bor spyan 'dren pa'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dusakyi/ / ngo bo blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po dang / / dbyer med byams mgon thugs rje'i gter khyod la/ / snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes 133

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/rlobs/ / zhes dal bu'i sgo nas lan gsum mam gcig brjod pas/ skyabs yul mtha' dag bsdus te byams mgon la thim zhing / de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon nas rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i dmigs pa byas la/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams/ / rim gyis bsdus te ma pham mgon la thim/ / de nyid rang gi spyi bor rigs bdag gi / tshul bzhugs dbu ma smad yangs stod phra ba'i/ / thugs ga'i thad du mai yig gser gyi mdog / ye shes lnga ldan bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ / 'od zer 'bar ba mthong ste de'i ngo bor/ / 'pho 'dun drag pos slar yang gsol 'debs bya/ / zhes pa'i tshig ris ltar la/ de'i rtsa dbu ma'i mar sne dang rang gi rtsa dbu ma'i yar sne gnyis srub cung zad kyang med par 'byor zhing dbyer med lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa byed pa gal che'o/ / de nas rang sems 'od kyi thig le de nyid kyis dbu ma'i lam nas yar bltas pas byams mgon gyi thugs ka na gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin mi yig gsal zhing dwangs pa 'od lam me yod pa mthong nas des yid phrogs te/ rang nyid kyang der sleb nas de dang gcig tu 'dre ba zhig byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas/ 'gro sgrol thabs kyi rnam pa ma lus gzigs/ / kun la thugs rje nye ring med par 'jug / gzhan phan 'phrin las dus las mi yol ba/ /skyabs mchog mtshungs med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba gcad du gsol/ / las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus sbyang du gsol/ /gnad gcod gshin rje'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / 'khrul snang bar do'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ / mi khom ngan song skye sgo gcad du gsol/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / lam bzang bag chags mngon du gyur par mdzod/ / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas der 134
