༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing dubagrod pa'i bde lam/drang du gsol/ / zhes phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa gsum mam bdun sogs byas pas spyi bo'i byams mgon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sdom gyi ba thag lta bu zhig dbu ma'i lam nas mar 'ongs rang sems 'od kyi thig le la reg pas/ khab len gyis lcags phye la reg pa'am/ nya la lcags kyus btab pa bzhin du yar drangs/ thur sel drag tu bsdam pas 'og nas btegs par bsam la nyika ces brjod pa na snying ga'i thad tsam du sleb pa'i dmigs pa dang / ka zhes brjod de sngar gyi rang gnas su phab/ yang hika ces brjod pas mgrin pa dang mgo bo'i nang tsam tshangs bug gi kha bar du sleb pa'i dmigs pa sogs byas te/ hika gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs 'debs shing / de re re'i mthar yang ka zhes sngar gyi rang gnas su phab/ tshangs bug nas phyir thon pa'i dmigs pa yang yang byas na tshe la gnod par gsungs pas/nyin re rer yang rang gi dbu ma nas byams mgon gyi dbu mar zhugs te/de'i thugs ga'i mai yig la reg tsam pa lan re tsam bya/ dam pa 'ga' zhig hika dang phaṭa 'dam nga can du gsungs kyang / phyis kyi bla ma rnams rlung gyen du bzlog pa la hika bzang bar gsungs la/ de'ang kha nas hika ces brjod pa tsam ma yin par/ de dang mnyam du rlung gyen du 'dren pa skyig bu'i rnam pa lta bu zhig dgos pa yin no/ / 'dir rang sems 'od kyi thig le gyen du 'phang ba'i dmigs pa skyong tshul yang / 'phen bya zur du bzhag nas rang nyid 'phen pa po logs su yod pa lta bur bsam ste ci tsam bsgom yang spyi gtsug za ba dang chu ser 'dzeg pa sogs kyi rtags byung na'ang / 'pho ba gnad du song ba min par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pas 'di go ba shin tu gnad che la/ de'ang nga dang nga'i lus nga'i sems zhes pa'i 'char tshul zhib tu byas na dbu ma 'jug par/135

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/gang phyir 'jig rten sa bon tsam btab nas/ / zhes pa'i rigs pa sbyar te rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las blo lhan skyes la bdag phung tha mi dad du snang bar gsungs pa bzhin 'char pa'i skabs kyang yod la/ rnam 'grel las/ mchog gzhan don du gnyer phyir dang / / zhes sogs ltar nor gyi bdag po bzhin brje tshong byed pa'i bdag po lta bu tha dad pa'i tshul du 'char ba'i skabs kyang srid pas/ dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod du/ res lus kyi steng na yod pa lta bu/ res sems kyi steng na yod pa lta bu zhes gsungs so/ / des na skabs 'dir phyi'i lus rten ni rang dang ngo bo tha dad pa'i gnas khang lta bur bsams la/ rang nyid rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi thig le de nyid dang ngo bo gcig tu yod pa/ de gyen du 'phang ba'i shul na 'phen pa po'i nga zhig lus rgyu med pa lta bu'i 'char tshul byung na skyong tshul gnad du song ba yin no/ / mjug tu spyi bo'i byams mgon 'od du zhu ba tshangs bug nas mar bstem pas/ dbu ma'i yar sne'i kha gser zhun gyi khu ba lta bus yongs su bcad par mos na byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug pa dang tshe bsring ba'i thabs su'ang 'gyur bar gsungs so/ / nam zhig 'chi kha'i tshe lag len du bya tshul ni/ phyi nang gi 'chi ltas brtag pa dang / zlog pa'i thabs sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pas/ zlog mi nus par nges pa na/ha cang lus zungs ma zad pa'i mtshams su bya dgos shing / de'i dmigs pa skyong lugs gshin po la bya tshul 'og tu 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa gzhan la 'debs tshul ni/ chos nyan pa'i kun spyod tshul dang mthun pas mdun du 'khod bcug la/ sangs rgyas chos dang zhes sogs skyabs sems lan gsum bya zhing / de'i tshe slob mas kyang bla ma'i gsung gi tshig ris dang bstun nas skyabs sems kyi dmigs pa skyong dgos so/ / de 136

༄/ /'pho khridadaga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'ibade lam/nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du 'pho ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid gsan par bya'o snyam pa dang /khyad par dus thog ma med pa zhig nas ngan song gsum du sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa bar mtshams med par pyong ba las/ da res stabs legs kyis lan gcig thar te dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu 'grig pa'i skabs 'dir ma mtha' 'ang ngan song gi skye sgo bcad de/ phyin chad der mi ltung ba zhig byed dgos la/ de'ang mdzod las/ bzod thob ngan song yongs mi ltung / / zhes dang / 'phags pa'i nyi khri snang bar/ bzod pa thob pa ni ngan 'gro yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ / zhes myang 'das brgyadakyi grangs su gsungs pa lta bu rtogs pa gong mar son pa'i stobs kyis ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs pa ni rang cag lta bur re zhig 'byung dka' bas/ des na btsan thabs 'tshang rgya 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di lta bu zhig gi sgo nas ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye sgo mtha' dag 'gog par byed dgos/ de'ang sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje byin rlabs khyad par med kyang / mthun pa'i smon lam mchog tu rmad byung zhing / / spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la/ / skal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren 'di dag thugs bskyed smon lam lhan cig pa'i stobs kyis gcig gi bstan pa la zhugs phyin bskal bzang rnam 'dren gang yang rung ba zhig gi bstan pa la nges can du smin cing grol bar gsungs/ khyad par bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang rje btsun byams mgon rnam gnyis slob pa lam gye gnas skabs su bla slob/137

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sku mched/ mdza' bshes sog4kyi rnam pas 'bral med lta bur 'khrungs tshul skyes rabs sogs su gsal ba ltar yin la/ der ma zad da lta'ang byams mgon gyis thub pa'i dbang po mchod rten gyi rnam par rtag tu spyi bor bkur ba lta bu thugs bskyed 'brel ba lhag par che bas/ rang cag thub pa'i dbang po'i rjes 'jug rnams rje btsun byams mgon gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad du 'phags pa zhig yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis byams pas zhus pa'i mdo/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo/ byams pa 'byung ba'i mdo/ byams pa sengage'i sgra'i mdo rnams su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la thos bsam cung zad re bgyis pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten skyu ru ra'i 'bru tshad tsam bzhengs pa/ nyin zhag gcig la bslab pa sna re tsam bsrang ba tshun chad kyang byams mgon gyis rjes su 'dzin cing de'i bstan pa dang mjal bar gsungs/ jo bo yab sras bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyang byams mgon gyi zhing du byon cing / rjes 'jug rnams la'ang der smon lam 'debs dgos zhes nan tan du gsungs/ rje bla ma'ang sku tshe rjes mar dga' ldan du 'byon par lhag pa'i lha du mas lung bstan cing / de'i rten 'brel gyes dgon pa'i ming la'ang dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes btags pa la brten nas grub mtha' spyi la'ang ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes mtshan du chags pa byung / rje bla ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor kun gyi nang na byin rlabs mi zad pa'i gter du gyur pa dga' ldan lha brgya mar grags pa 'di nyid yin zhing / de'i skabs su'ang dga' ldan gyi byams mgon gyi thugs ka nas spyan 'dren pa dang /de la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i skabs su'ang sku'i rnam pa gsal 'debs tshul tsam mgatogs dga' ldan gyi gnas su 'pho bar byed pa 'di dang gnyis ka khyad par med/ des na rang cag rje bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che 'dir bsam sbyor 138

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i bde lam/ci rigs pas 'brel thogs pa rnams kyis dga' ldan gyi gnas der skye ba'i rgyu bsgrubs na sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs bskyed 'brel ba'i stobs kyis shin tu sa chod chen po 'byung bas/ de yid la bzhag nas rang gi sgo gsum nus pa gang yod kyis der skye ba'i rgyu bsgrubs pa dang / sngon chad bgyis pa'i dge tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyang blos gcig tu bsdoms te zhing mchog dam pa de nyid du skye zhing / rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i gsung gi bdud ste ngoms med du myang nas/ sa lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can myur du bkrod pa'i rgyur bsngo ba dang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga'i tshig ris rnams la'ang nged kyis ji ltar brjod pa dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa ma yengs par byas te gsan par zhu/ dga' ldan zhing mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin nas/ / zhes pa nas/ mchod do/ / skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes spyan drangs te yan lag bdun pa/ bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang sogs gong bzhin bya/ de nas/ khyod lus shel gyi bum pa zhes dang / de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor rigs bdag gi / zhes tshig bsgyur te tshigs bcad gzhan rnams sngar bzhin bya ba'am/ yang na/ khyed rang lus drang por bsreng ste gnas pa shel gyi phru ma bus pa bzhin phyi bltas nang gsal ba'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma smad phra la stod yangs pa/ mar sne lte 'og tu slebs shing / yar sne spyi bo'i gtsug tu rgya mthongs kha phye ba ltar yangs tha le yod pa'i mar sne'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ shin tu gsal zhing 'tsher ba 'phar la khad pa zhig tu gsal btab ste/ mdun na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba byams pa mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'di bzhin 'debs par mdzod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi/ / mo nga snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ / de ltar du 139

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gsol ba btab pas 'khor gyi tshogs rnams me long la ha btab pa bzhin mtha'anas rim pa bzhin gcig la gcig zim pa'i tshul gyis gtso bo la thim/de nyid khyed rang gi spyi bor byon nas rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i sku'i dkyil drang thad du rtsa dbu ma smad yangs shing stod phra ba/ thugs ga'i thad du rgyal ba ma pham mgon po'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mai yig gser gyi kha dog lta bu gsal zhing 'od zer lnga 'phro bas mtshan pa/ de'i dbu ma'i mar sne dang khyed rang gi dbu ma'i yar sne gnyis shin tu kha mnyam par sbyar te dbyer med lta bur gyur ba'i mos pa dang / rang sems 'od kyi thig le'i rnam pa de nyid kyis byams pa mgon po'i thugs ga'i sa bon nor bu'i sgon me lta bur shin tu 'od gsal ba de nyid mthong ba la brten nas dga' ba dang dad pa tshad med pa skye zhing / rang nyid kyang de'i drung du sleb na snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag tu byed pa dang / de nas nged kyi tshig ris bzhin phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ nged kyi nyika ces brjod pa na rang sems thig ler gsal ba de nyid rlung gis gyen du btegs/ byams mgon gyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig byung nas gyen du drangs/ka zhes brjod pa na slar yang sngar gye rang gnas su babs pa'i dmigs pa sogs spel mar byed dgos pa thugs la 'dzin par zhu/ zhes tshig lhug pa'i sgo nas brda sprod cing / mang po la lhan du byed pa'i tshe khyed rang rnams zhes mang tshig sbyar na bde'o/ / de nas 'gro sgrol thabs kyi zhes sogs gong dang 'dra la/'di'i skabs su bla mas kyang tshig ris bzhin slob ma'i lus kyi rtsa gsal 'debs pa dang / rnam shes spar ba'i dmigs pa sogs byed dgos so/ /mjug tu/ 'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ / zhes sogs dang / sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab ces sogs dang / 'di nas shi 'phos 140

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing du bkrod pa'i bde lam/gyur ma thag / ces sogs bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor bar bya'o/ /gsum pa gshin po la bya tshul ni cho ga gang yang rung ba dang 'brel ba'i lho sgo lta bu'i mjug yin na rnam shes dgug pa zur du mi dgos la/ de ltar min tshe tshig tu dngos su brjod mi brjod ji ltar yin kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs bskul nas gshin po'i rnam shes bkug pa'i dmigs pa nan tan bya ba ni sngon 'gror med mi rung du dgos so/ / de nas/ skyabs sems dngaspyan 'dren dkyus ltar bya/ bar do ngo sprod snga phyir byed lugs kyi lag len mi 'dra ba ci rigs snang yang / tshogs bsag sgrib sbyang bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang sogs kyi dmigs pa skyong rgyu'i don du mtshams 'dir byas na phan che bar snang bas/ de'i tshul ni/ 'o lags so/ / 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khyod nyon cig / 'dul ba lung las/ skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba ste/ / 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ mi rtag srin pos ma zos pa'i/ /sems can de ni 'ga' ma mchis/ / gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor ba'iganas 'dir las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba zhig blang phyin skye mtha' 'chi ba'i chos las ma 'das shing / gnyen mdza' bshes sogs dang lhan cig ci tsam 'grogs kyang brtse ba med pa'i 'chi bdag gi pho nyas slebs pa na phan tshun gtan bral du gyur nas mya ngan chen po ldang ba'ang mchog dman bar ma kun gyi thog tu yod pa'i 'jig rten spyi'i ngang tshul yin te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ / 'chi bas so sor 'bral 'gyur te/ / mya ngan chen po ldang bar 'gyur/ / de yang 'jig rten 'di na nges/ / zhes sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis gsungs pa ltar yin/ de lta bu'i 'chi ba de da lan khyod kyi thog tu babs te/ tshe snga ma'i snang ba ni nub/ phyi ma 141

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/ma rnyed pas da lta srid pa bar do na gnas pa'i skabs yin/ de'ang gang gis shes na mdzod las/ sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ / dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu/ / las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ / mi ldog de ni dri za 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gang du skye 'gyur gyi phyi'i lus dang dbyibs mtshungs pa/ dbang po kun tshang zhing las kyi rlung gis bdas te sngon bgrod dka' ba'i gnas rnams lta ci smos/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i pha rol tu'ang skad cig tsam gyis sleb nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu yod pa/ de'i stobs kyis sngar 'dris pa'i gnyen dang mdza' bshes la sogs pa thams cad kyi rtsar song ste gtam la sogs pa smras kyang lan mi ster zhing shi ba'i gtam byed pa sogs kyis sems lhag par skyo zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / las las grub pa'i dgra gnyen gyi snang ba sna tshogs pas blo sna brid de/ res 'ga' dga' zhing spro ba dang / res 'ga' 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dga' sdug gi snang ba 'gyur ldog sna tshogs pa glo bur glo bur du 'byung ba'ang khyed rang bar dor gnas pa'i rtags yin/ sngar 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung thim pa'i stobs kyis ri bo nyil ba/ rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa/ nags la me shor ba/ bskal pa'i rlung g.yob lta bu'i sgra shin tu ya nga ba snying 'gas pa lta bu dang / dug gsum gyi rang gzugs dkar dmar nag pa'i g.yang sa chen po gsum du lhung ba'i nyams shar ba de dag gi tshe snga ma'i lus rten dor ba yin te/ da lta sngar dang mi 'dra bar nang du rags pa'i khams dkar dmar mi gnas pa'i stobs kyis phyi'i nyi zla sogs kyi snang ba mi 'char zhing / lus la grib ma'ang med pa 'di rten de nyid dor zin pa'i rtags yin/ spyir chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin mod kyang / khyad par bar do'i skabs kyi bde sdug dga' 'jigs sogs kyi snang ba 'di ni/ rmi lam du mes tshigs pa dang / lha'i dpal 'byor la spyad pa 142

༄/ /'pho khrid dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'ibade lam/bzhin dngos gnas la phan gnod ci yang 'byung rgyu med par ma zad/ de la 'khrul snang du ngo ma shes par rjes su 'brangs na skye gnas ngan pa sna tshogs su 'khrid pas shin tu bsgrim dgos/ rigs drug so sor skye ba'i rtags kyi snang ba 'char tshul yang / dmyal bar skye na lcags khang dang gangs ri'i 'khyag sbubs/yi dwags su skye na mya ngam gyi thang dmar po sogs rang rang gi gnas kyi bkod pa shas cher 'char la/ kha dog ni dmyal ba'i bar do sol ba lta bu/ yi dwags kyi bar do du ba lta bu/ dud 'gro'i bar do chu lta bu/ 'dod pa'i lha mi'i bar dogaser lta bu/ gzugs khams pa'i bar do ni dkar por mngal 'jug gi mdo las gsungs/ 'gro tshul lha'i bar do gyen dang / mi'i bar do thad ka /ngan song gi bar do spyi'u tshugs su 'gro bar gsungs la/ mdzod 'grel las phyi ma'i 'gro ba de dang de'i 'gro tshul dang cha mtshungs par yang bshad/ khyad par 'khor ba'i btson ra'i nang du 'khrid byed kyi gtso bosred pa yin pas/ brdzus te skye na gnas la sred pa skye/ drod gsher las skye na dri ro la sred pa skye/ sgo nga dang mngal las skye na rigs mthun gyi gang zag mthong ste tshul min gyi spyod pa la log par zhen pa'i dbang gis mtshams sbyor ba yin zhing / de ltar skye ba blang phyin phral dang yun du sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ de bas khyed rang gi mgon skyabs su bdag gis bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba byams pa mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas bzhugs yod cing /zhing dang dngos po bsam pa phun sum tshogs pas dge rtsa rnam par dag pa byed bzhin pa 'di yin pas/ khyod rang gis kyang 'khrul snang gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par dge rtsa 'di dag blos blangs te dga' ba bsgom pa dang / khyad par rgyal ba byams pa mgon po la dad gus shugs drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab na bar do'i sems can chu nang gi gru gzings ltar du kha bsgyur sla 143

༄/ /gung thang bayoba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bas/ ngan 'gro'i skye srid bzlog nas zhing khyad par can du skye ba la the tshom med/ des na nged kyi tshig ris bzhin du yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs rnam dang / re sa gzhan na med pa'i blo ltos bcas te phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pa'i mthar byams mgon khyed rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs te/ nged kyis hika lan gsum btab pa'i tshe byams mgon gyi thugs ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du bstem zhing / phaṭa ces brjod pa'i skabs su byams pa mgon po skad cig nyid la dga' ldan gyi gnas su gshegs/ de'i thugs ka nas phyir phyung ste padma'i sbubs su yid lus blangs nas byams mgon gyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur nges pa yin pas/ de ltar gyi 'dun pa dang mos gus rtse gcig tu skyong bar zhu/zhes brjod/ de'i tshe rang nyid kyis kyang mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul dang khyad par du gshin po de nyid bar do'i lam 'phrang dam por 'jigs pa'i dmag gis bskor ba/ rgyus med kyi gnas su grogs med gcig pur 'khyams shing /mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen ma mchis pa'i tshul bsams te snying rje shugs drag po bsgyed na/ ci tsam snying rje skyes pa bzhin gyi de'i don du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa'i blo'ang shugs drag po 'byung bas de lta bu zhig dgos kyi/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ mi shi ba ro yi sngas mgo la/ / nor len 'dod kyi ban bon ca co 'don/ / zhes pa ltar gshin po de'i rnam par shes pa da lta gnas skabs ci 'dra zhig tu yod snyam pa yid kyi dgu na'ang med par/ gnyen bshes sogs mgu ba 'ba' zhig lhur byas te rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu bar mi bya'o/ / de ltar dad pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i bsam pa khyad par can gyi ngang nas yan lag bdun pa dang / mtshan lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs brjod de bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang sogs bya ba gong dang 'dra la/ khyod lus zhes sogs dang / de ltar zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad tshan pa gnyis ngag tu 144

༄/ /'pho khridadaga' ldan zhing du bkrod pa'i bde lam/ma brjod par rang gis tshig ris bzhin dmigs pa bskyangs pas 'thus so/ / gsol 'debs kyi tshig rnams go rim bzhin du brjod cing / mthar hika gsum dang phaṭa lan gcig brjod pa'i tshe dmigs pa skyong tshul gong du brda sprod pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ / de nas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ padma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /bcom ldan ma pham mgon pos mngon sum du/ / lung bstan pa yang tshe 'das der thob shog / ces dang / 'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ / zhes sogs dang / 'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag / ces sogs smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba ma pham mgon po yi/ / thugs rje byin rlabs gru gzings la brten nas/ / mi bzad 'khor ba'i mtsho las rab brgal te/ / zhing mchog nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig / de nas byams mgon sras dang bcas pa yi/ / zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang / / zab rgyas gdams pa'i dga' ston myong ba yis/ / yang dag lam bzang lus stobs rgyas gyur cig / ces rje btsun byams pa mgon po la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i rnam par bzhag pa dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba 'di ni khya dge'i dgon nas yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol ba dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /145

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzhung bsrangs te mdo sngags cha tshang bar nyams su len tshul dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i nor bu'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chos kun de nyid 'byed pa'i blo gros nyin byed 'od kyis gdungs pa las/ / 'gro la rjes chags kun bzang thugs rje gangs kyi ri bo bzhus pa'i rgyun/ / gzugs sku dbang phyug yan lag brgyad ldan grags pa'i rlabs 'phreng rol pa can/ / snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dug can tshogs kyi dag byed gcig pu de la 'dud/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs sgol bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yi dam ste/ / bar gcod g.yul las skyob pa'i chos srung sogs/ / skyabs kyi dam pa mtha' dag gcig gyur pa/ / mgon po 'di yi thugs rje gru gzings la/ / brten nas srid zhi'i rgud pa'i rgya mtsho las /brgal te zung 'jug nor bu'i grong khyer du/ / 'jug par rigs so blo ldan skal bzang tshogs/ / de yang rang cag gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba kun gyi lhag pa'i lha skal gcig pur gyur pa 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po la brten pa'i zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ji snyed cig yod pa rnams kyi nang nas ches mchog tu gyur pa 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi man ngag zab mo dga' ldan lha brgya ma zhes rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs par 'phrin las khyab gdal du che ba 'di nyid kyi gzhung bsrangs te de'i khongs 146

༄/ /dga' ldan zhing du bkrod pa'irnar bu'i themaskas/su mdo sngags gnyi ga'i nyams len dang bsag sbyang gi gnad cha tshang bar byas te lag tu blang ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ga'i lugs ltar gyi zhing bkod thang ga'am/rjebla ma'i sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigs gtso bor gyur ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten legs par bkram/ de'i mdun du gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa yid du 'ong ba bsham/ rang nyid stan bde ba la rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du 'khod de rang rgyud la dge ba dang mi dge ba'i phyogs gang che brtag la/ dge bar song 'dug na rlung nang du rngub/ mi dge ba shas che na rlung phyir 'bud pa dang mnyam du nag phung nge phyir thon pa'i mos ba bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro'i yul gyi tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ /mdun du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ / rin chen las grub yangs pa'i khri steng du/ / rgyab la nye bar 'od 'bar nor bu'i khri/ / sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan bcas steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dpal snying po dang / / dbyer med thub dbang btso ma'i gser gyi mdog / gtsug tor mdzes ldem sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad/ / zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs/ / gur kum mdangs ldan chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ / nyin byed las lhag 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ / mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rab rdzogs pa'i/ / mdzes pa'i sku ni blta bas chog mi shes/ / yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa yi/ / snyan pa'i gsung ni thos pas ngoms pa med/ / mkhyen dang brtse ba'i gter du gyur pa yi/ / zab yangs thugs ni gting mtha' gzhal las 'das/ / nyes pa'i dri bral legs pa'i yon tan rdzogs/ / dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba sel/ / rab 'byams zhing du bcu gnyis mdzad pa sogs/ / gang 'dul ngo mtshar sprul pa sna tshogs ston/ / de yi g.yas g.yon padma nyi zla'i gdan/ / bla ma brgyud pa'i grangs snyed tshar du dngar/ / steng du g.yas su rgya chen spyod rgyud dang / /147

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/g.yon du zab mo lta rgyud tshogs rnams bzhugs/ / thub dbang mdun du gdan khri phun tshogs steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma mjal dus rnam pa can/ / chos 'brel mnos pa'i dngos kyi bla ma rnams/ / padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pas bskor/ / thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyab kyi steng gi char/ / dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / / byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams kyis/ / bskor ba pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ / thub dbang gtso 'khor rnams kyi phyogs bzhi ru/ / gsang 'dus 'jigs mdzad dus 'khor te ru ga'i/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams dang de dag mthar/ / yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang / / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas/ / zhi khro rab 'byams rang rang gdan la bzhugs/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang gtso 'khor rnams kyi mthar/ / 'dul mngon mdo dang dbang bshad man ngag gi / brgyud pa'i bla ma dpag tu med pa rnams/ / pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la mdzes par bzhugs/ / de dag rnams kyi mdun du rang rang gis/ / gsungs pa'i dam chos 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi/ / po ti'i rnam par gdan khri bzang po'i steng / / bzhugs pa'i skyabs yul nam mkha' gang ba rnams/ / dpag yas 'od zer spro bsdu'i rol pa yis/ / rab 'byams zhing du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / / rang la dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur/ / rang dang mtha' skor rigs drug 'gro ba kun/ / thog med nas bzung srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ / bzod dka' yun ring sdug bsngal gyis mnar yang / / da dung gting mtha' mngon par mi snang bas/ / de yi skyabs shig da lan btsal dgos shing / / de yang dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum la/ / blo 'gel nus na nam yang mi bsru bas/ / gdung shugs drag pos skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam 148

༄/ /dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'inor bu'i themaskas/pa'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / tsha sa skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod pa'i mthar/ skyabs yul rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa /bdag sogs kun gyi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ / de dag la brten nyes pa'i tshogs byang zhing / / byin rlabs ma lus rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ / ces lan gcig / 'bras skyabs su gyur pa'i dkon mchog gsum la gtso bor dmigs nas sems can thams cad kyi don du de thob byar byed pa theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi dmigs rnam gsal btab la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gang mang brjod de byang chub tu sems bskyed cing spyod pa phyin drug sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag po gsal gdab/mdun gyi bla ma thub pa'i dbang po las/ / rang 'dra chad de thim pas bdag nyid ni/ / thub dbang skur gyur de yi 'od zer gyis/ / 'gro kun byang chub mchog la bkod par gyur/ / ces sems bskyed 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du bsgom pa lan gcig bya/ nye ring ris su ma chad ma rgan rnams/ / sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las grol bde thob cing / / zag med dga' bas rol na ci ma rung / / de bzhin gyur cig de ltar bdag gis bya/ / de bsgrub nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol ba btab pa na/ / byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis char babs pas/ / 'gro kun tshad med bzhi la 149

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnas par gyur/ / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom pa lan gsum sogs bya/ nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin phung zhi ba bzhin/ / tshogs zhing mtha' dag thub pa'i dbang po la/ / bsdus te de yang rang gi smin mtshams nas/ / thim pas byin rlabs ma lus thob par gyur/ / ces tshogs zhing bsdu/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can kun don du/ / bde chen dang po'i mgon po bla ma lha'i/ / go 'phang myur ba myur bar thob bya'i phyir/ / zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byorabasgom par bya/ / zhes khyad par gyi sems bskyed lan gang mang bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin sngags kyi nyams len dang 'brel bar byed pa la rang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas shing de'i sgo nas mchod pa sogs byin gyis rlob par byed dgos pas 'di ltar/rang bzhin rnam dag spros bral chos dbyings las/ / rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed skur bzhengs pa'i/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gi /'od kyis snod bcud mchod rdzas dang bcas pa'i/ / ma dag 'khrul snang nyes pa kun sbyangs nas/ / dag pa'i rten dang brten par legs 'char zhing / /mchod rdzas mtha' dag khyad par gsum ldan gyi/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung por gyur/ / ces mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ de nas tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ / rin chen las grub yangs pa'i khri steng du/ / rgyab la nye bar 'od 'bar nor bu'i khri/ / sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas/ / gsum gyi dbus la cung zad mtho ba'i steng / / 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ / phyag gnyis chos 'khor phyag rgyas utpal/ / bsnams pa'i g.yas na shes rab ral gri dang / / g.yon pa'i steng du sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ / gur gum mdangs ldan chos gos gsum gsol zhing / / btso ma'i gser mdog paṇa zhwas dbu la mdzes/ / zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs/ /150

༄/ / dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'irnar bu'i themaskas/g.yas su sras mchog dar ma rin chen dang / / g.yon na smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal/ / chos gos gsum gsol paṇa zhwas gtsug mdzes shing / /chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / yab sras gsum char mtshan dpe'i dpal rdzogs pas/ / mdzes pa'i sku ni blta bas chog mi shes/ / zhes pa nas/ gzhan rnams gong ltar la/ yab rje'i mdun du gdan khri phun tshogs steng / / zhes pa dang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i rgyab kyi steng gi char/ / zhes pa dang / 'jam mgon 'khor bcas rnams kyi phyogs bzhi ru/ / zhes pa rnams tshig bsgyur dgos/ de nas/ rab 'byams zhing du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / / rang la dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur/ / de dag rnams kyi gnas lngar yi ge lngas/ / legs mtshan thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ / rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad nas/ /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas dang / / khyad par steng phyogs dga' ldan lha gnas las/ / grong dang dgon pa'i tshul du byas pa yi/ / zhing mchog dam pa yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes/ / ma pham mgon po'i thugs bskyed las grub ba/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal ming yang mi grags shing / / dag pa'i zhing gi snod bcud 'byor ba'i dpal/ / ma tshang med par lhun gyis grub pa'i dbus/ / nyi ma stong phrag 'od kyi 'dengs ka can/ / chos kyi pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po ru/ / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbus/ /mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ / bzang po'i bzhugs stangs tshul gyis 'khod pa yi/ / dga' ldan lha brgya'i mgon gyis thugs ka nas/ / rab dkar zho gsar spungs 'dra'i chu 'dzin rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ / sras dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / / thugs rjes tshad 151

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/med 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs/ / rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las rgyas mdzad pa/ / dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ / dza : baṃ ho ma shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so la thim par gyur/mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / / rje btsun bla ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar can/ / bdag blo dad pa'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /bstan pa rgyas phyir bskal brgyar bzhugs su gsol/ / bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ / rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / bka' drin mnyam med yongs 'dzin rin po che/ / dbyer med zhabs kyi padmor phyag 'tshal lo/ / shes bya'i khyon kun 'jal pa'i blo gros thugs/ / skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur legs bshad gsung / / grags pa'i dpal gyis lham mer mdzes pa'i sku/ / mthong thos dran pa don ldan la phyag 'tshal/ / khyod kyi ngo mtshar sprul pa'i zlos gar las/ / byung ba'i dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ / sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang srung mar bcas/ / zhi khro rab 'byams rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yid 'ong mchod yon sna tshogs me tog dang / / dri zhim bdug spos snang gsal dri chab sogs/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di/ / bsod nams zhing mchog khyed la mchod par 'bul/ / mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ / de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ / bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ / rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ / rnam dkar bshad sgrub bslab gsum rim gnyis sogs/ / rang gzhan kun gyi rnam dkar dge tshogs kyang / / yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin du legs bstar na/ / bzhes shing zad mi shes par byin gyis rlobs/ / rigs lnga yum bzhi'i rang bzhin dam rdzas rnams/ / rdo rje gsum gyi 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /152

༄/ /dga' ldan zhingadu bgrod pa'isgor bu'i themaskas/sbyangs rtogs sbar byas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ches/ / mchog tu sim zhing dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig / zhing sngags lhan skyes phyag rgyas tshogs spros te/ / rdo rje 'changadabang yum la dzim pa na/ / de dang snyoms 'jug dga' ba'i rol pa yis/ / 'khor bcas zag med dga' bas tshim gyur cig / chos kun spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / / gzugs sku'i 'ja' tshon cir yang 'char bzod pa/ / sku thugs zung 'jug lhan skyes bde ba che/ / byang chub rdo rje'i mchod pas dgyes par mdzod/ / mdor na phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon dang / / dbang bzhi dang 'brel mchod pa'i maṇḍa la/ / blo yis blangs te gus pas 'bul lags na/ / thugs rje che ldan nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig / rab rmongs bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams/ / ring nas gdul dka' sems kyis dbang bsgyur zhing / / sems nyid rmongs pas bran du bzung ba'i mthus/ / dpag yas sgo gsum sdeg pa ci bgyis pa/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa drag pos mthol bgyid na/ / bcom ldan thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ / byin rlabs mi zad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes thugs rje bskul ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas ltung bshags dang bla ma rdor 'dzin ma/ mjug tu/ gang zhig thogs med dus nas bsags pa yi/ / lus ngag yid kyis mi dge ci bgyis dang / / khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs/ / snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos so sor bshags/ / zhes pa lan gsum sogs bya/ de nas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang thos sgrub la brtson/ / chos brgyad spangs pas dal 'byor don yod byas/ /mgon po khyod kyi rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ / bdag cag bsam pa thag pas yi rang ngo / / rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ / chos sku'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ / ji ltar 'tsham pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma 153

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/la/ / lhun 'grub chos kyi char ba dbab tu gsol/ / bdag gis ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / /khyad par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ / bstan pa'i snying po ring du gsal byed shog / zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ oṃ badzra zu mi wa rtu/ zhes pa nas/zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa yab sras la sogs pa rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyan rang chos skyong srung ma rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sa gzhi spos kyis sogs dang / bdag gzhan lus ngag ma sogs brjod de/ rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig / ma dze gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrub pa po la bu ltar gzigs mdzad cing / / mo nga yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis spyod pa yongs rdzogs shing / / nyes kun bag chags bcas pa drungs phyung ste/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad pa/ / rgyal ba sras bcas kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /bshes la mi gus dal 'byor chud gzon zhing / / 'chi ba mi dran tshe 'di'i bde thabs bsgrub/ / ngan 'gror mi 'jigs rnam dag skyabs mi 'tshol/ /las 'bras mi sems blang dor log par bsgrub/ / 'khor ba bder 'dzin de rgyu las nyon spel/ / thar par mi spro bslab gsum bsten mi byed/ / ma rnams yal por rang nyid gces par 'dzin/ / bdag tu mngon zhen sngags la ma mos sogs/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag rnams/ / myur du 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / bshes la dad gus dal 'byor snying po len/ /'chi ba rjes dran tshe 'di'i 'dun ma bskyungs/ / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs dran 154

༄/ /dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'isgor bu'i them sa/dkon mchog skyabs su 'dzin/ / las 'bras bsams nas blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrub/ / 'khor ba'i skyon mthong las nyon spong bar 'dod/ / thar pa don gnyer rnam dag bslab gsum bsten/ / ma rnams gces 'dzin rang nyid yal bar dor/ / bdag sked don mthong sngags la mos pa sogs/ /phyin ci ma log blo sna mtha' dag rnams/ / myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / khyad par byams dang snying rje sems bskyed dang / / phyin drug la sogs rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ / snying po lam dus kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lus/ /yang snying 'bras bu'i dus kyi rdo rje'i sku/ / bdag med gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong ba yi/ / zhi lhag gnyis sogs zab mo lta ba'i lam/ / snying po dpe dang don gye 'od gsal gnyis/ / yang snying bde stong dbyer med chos sku ste/ / zab dang rgya che'i lam bzang snying por bcas/ / myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros rgyab kyi rdo rje 'chang la phog / de yi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / tshogs zhing gzhan rnams bsdus nas der thim zhing / / de nyid yab rje'i spyi bo nas zhugs te/ / ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ / de nyid la slar yang / lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / 'khor ba ma stong bar du legs bzhugs nas/ / 'gro la chos 'khor ma lus bskor du gsol/ / bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus dang / sa gzhi mas maṇḍal phul/sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / sgrib bral chos sku'i bdag nyid bla ma lha/ / thub dbang 155

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/nga / / bde chen logs sku'i bdag nyid bla ma lha/ / thub dbang ma / /sna tshogs sprul sku'i bdag nyid bla ma lha/ / thub dbang ྾ / / bla ma kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang ྾ / / yi dam kun 'dus ྾ / / thub dbang ྾ / / sangs rgyas kun 'dus nga / / thub dbang ྾ / / dam chos kun 'dus ྾ / / thub dbang ྾ / dge 'dun kun 'dus ྾ / / thub dbang ྾ / / mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ྾ / / thub dbang ྾ / / chos skyong kun 'dus ྾ / / thub dbang ྾ / / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par rgyal sras kun las rigs gsum mgon/ / mkhyen brtse nus pas khyad par 'phags pa bzhin/ / gangs can mkhas kun gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen brtse'i gter dang mthu chen thob bzhin du/ / mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje dang / / skyob pa'i nus mthu mtshungs zla ma mchis pa/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i ྾ / / nges pa'i don du 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i sgu yi rnam rol te/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mar gyur 'gro la rjes chags snying rje dang / / mtha' bral gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mchog / phyi nang bdud sde 'joms pa'i nus pa rnams/ / bdag sogs rgyud la skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ / zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i yon tan dran par byas te dmigs brtse ma yongs grags ltar ram/ dngos grub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag / 'jam dpal khros pa'i 156

༄/ / dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'inor bu'i them skas/zlos gar gshin rje'i gshed/ / gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ / blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba radebs/ / zhes sogs ltar gyi lnga skor drug skor sogs bya/ 'jam mgon yab sras gsum gyi thugs ka nas/ /thon pa'i 'od kyi spu gu'i lam brgyud de/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ / mi shes rmongs pa'i dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ / zhes ma dag pa 'khrud pa'i dmigs pa sngon du btang la/ bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams 'jam dpal zhi khro yi/ / sku yi rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / rab 'byams gzhung don 'byed la thogs med pa'i/ / rlabs chen shes rab thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams ྾ / / sngags kyi rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / dka' gnad phra zhib ma 'dres 'byed pa yi/ / shes rab gsal ba thob par byen ྾ / / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams ྾ / / sa bon rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / the tshom 'ching ba 'phral du gcod pa yi/ /shes rab myur ba thob par ྾ / / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams ྾ / / phyag mtshan rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / zab mo'i don gyi gting mtha' dpog pa yi/ / shes rab zab mo thob par ྾ / / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams gang zhig bshad bya yi/ / glegs bam rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ /tshig don kun la nges pa mchog ster pa/ / 'chad pa'i shes rab thob par ྾ / / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams shes rab ral gri yi/ / 'khor lo'i rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / smra ngan tshogs kyi spobs pa 'phrog pa yi/ / rtsod pa'i shes rab ྾ / / bdud rtsi'i rdul rnams gzhung gi glegs bam dang / /ral gri'i rnam par gnas pas lus gang ste/ / sgra don phun tshogs blo gsal dga' skyed pa'i/ / rtsom pa'i shes rab thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes dmigs skor bdun po re re'i 'tshams su dmigs brtse ma grangs ji ltar 'tsham pa re 157

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzlas te/ yang ma dag pa 'khrud pa'i dmigs pa dang sbrags nas rjes ma rjes ma byed pa'am/ yang na ma dag pa 'khrud pa tshar gcig gi mjug tu dmigs skor bdun gyi tshigs bcad rnams dkyus gcig la bajod de dmigs brtse ma bzla ba gang mos bya/ de nas/ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje/ / zhes sogs kyis lam yongs rdzogs la gshar sgom bya zhing / rkang pa tha ma lan gnyis gnyis su brjod pas dang po'i tshe de dang de'i rtogs pa skye ba la gegs byed kyi dri ma sbyangs pa dang / gnyis pa'i tshe de dang de'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i dmigs pa bya/ bde blag nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ zhes sogs kyis sdom pa bzung la/ de nas/ khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam khyod ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste/ / ma sa ra bar gcod srungs/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyes phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pas/ rje yab sras gsum ga dang khyad par du rje bla ma'i thugs ga'i rdo rje 'chang gi gnas gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rang gi gnas rnams su thim pas dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes par bsams la/ rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang gi / spyi bo'i oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ / lus kyi sgrib sbyangs bskyed rim bsgom pa dang / / 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa thob/ / mgrin pa'i ā yig las byung bdud rtsi'i chus/ / ngag gi sgrib sbyangs sgyu lus bsgom pa dang / / 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa thob/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ yig 'od dang bdud rtsi'i chus/ / yid kyi sgrib sbyangs 'od gsal bsgom pa dang / / 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /slar yang gnas gsum las byung bdud rtsi'i chus/ / sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs zung 'jug bsgom pa dang / / rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang 'grub pa yi/ /nus pa bzhag ste dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ / de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi/ / zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /de ltar gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig tu/ / gsol ba btab pas sras kyi thu 158

༄/ / dga' ldan zhing du bkrod pa'isgor bu'i them skas/boganyis/ / rje la thim zhing de nyid tshur byon te/ / rang lus dbus kyi dru tī'i stod yangs pa'i/ / yar sna thal gyis phye ba'i nang nas zhugs/ / snying ga'i padma'i dbus su rang sems dang / / dbyer med tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs par gyur/ / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma/ zhes sogs dang / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / skad cig tsam yang 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun bkag nas/ / yang dag lam bzang skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di snang 'gag tshe dga' ldan zhing mchog tu/ / ma pham mgon dang 'jam dpal snying po sogs/ / yab sras kun gyis dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / lam bzang dga' ston myong bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mgon khyod rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ / seng ge'i nga ror 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan tshe/ / 'khor du skyes nas zab mo'i lta ba dang / / gsang chen lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na dus dang gnas skabs gang du yang / / bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos/ / 'dren pa khyod min skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ / 'du 'bral med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas dgyes bzhin du/ / snying dbus bzhugs shing de yi 'dab ma rnams/ / zum pa'i phyi nas sngags kyis bsdams pa'i rtser/ / mi phyed rdo rje'i rgya yis mtshan par gyur/ / dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / skye zhing skye bar 'jam mgon bla ma dang / / 'bral med bsam dang sbyor bas legs bsten nas/ / bde chen ༷༵/sa ༵ di ṭwāṃ ༷ ༵dī ṭwāṃX ༷ dī ༷ ༷ za/sathu rshas ma ༈/༷ /༵dī ༈ ༵༵ ṭwāṃX ༷bye rdo ṭwā rji snying ga'i rje bla ma la phul ba'i dmigs pa byas pas dkor sgrib sbyong zhing tshogs rlabs po che zhar byung du rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / sgo gsum gyi spyod pa gang la'ang de nyid 159

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname gsung 'bum/dbang po'i tshul du bzhugs par bsams bas nyes spyod las ldog cing dge tshogs 'phel ba dang lha rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor mchog tu 'gyur la/ tshe rabs thams cad du rje bla ma dang mi 'bral zhing gsang sngags zab mo'i smin byed du 'gyur ba'i gnad khyad par rdobhe ༷bhe ༷// da/ shā~X ṭwāṃrdo ༵ dīdī ༵ dī rdo ṭwāṃ/༷ zlo / ༷༵ ṭwāṃrje ༷byenghru ༷ ༵ṭwāṃ~X ༵dī de nyid cung zad kha phye ba'i mtshams nas mar phebs te sngar bzhugs pa'i rje bla ma de nyid la bstem pa'i dmigs pa byas la/ slar yang sngags 'phreng gis bsdams pa sogs gong bzhin byas pas byin rlabs brtan pa sogs dgos pa shin tu che'o/ / smras pa/ ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa thub pa'i bstan/ / nyi ltar gsal mdzad 'jam dpal snying po zhes/ / snyan pa 'jig rten gsum na grags pa yi/ / mgon de ma pham rgyal ba'i drung na bzhugs/ / de yis legs gsungs bstan pa'i snying po la/ / mos pa'i blo can yab rje'i mdun sa ru/ / bsnyegs 'dod de dag nor bu'i them skas 'dir/ / dad brtson zung 'brel gom pa 'dor bar rigs/ / tshul 'dir 'bad las thob pa'i rnam dkar mthus/ / ma nor bstan pa'i snying po dar ba dang / / zogs kyis ma bslad bstan 'dzin gtsang ma yis/ / bstan pa'i bya ba gegs med mthar phyin shog / / / ces dga' ldan lha brgya mar grags pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung bsrangs te mdo sngags cha tshang bar nyams su len pa'i tshul dga' ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i nor bu'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni phul du byung ba'i lhag bsam rnam dpyod dang ldan pa tā bla ma rab 'byams pa kun dga'3ma rgyal dang / chos tshul 'byed pa'i blo mig mchog tu yangs ba ku shrī bkra shis rab brtan gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bigru ratna ā nanta'o/ / / /160

༄/ / blama'i3la 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung ༄7/ / gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs lhag lha du ma dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/na mo gu ru badzra dhā rā ya/ spyi bor sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i steng / / skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med mi bskyod mgon po sku mdog mthing / / nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ / rtsa phyag rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud/ / lhag ma g.yas su 'khor lo padma dang / / g.yon pa'i phyag gis rin chen ral gri 'dzin/ / rang 'od dang mtshungs reg bya rdo rje mar/ / mnyam sbyor rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ phung po khams dang skye mched yan lag rnams/ / sum cu rtsa gnyis lha yi ngo bo nyid/ / ces pa'am/ bde gshegs yab yum sems dpa' khro bo sogs/ / sum cu rtsa gnyis lha yi 'khor lor bcas zhes pa gang rigs sbyor/ / de nas/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum ma lus pa/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi/ / rnam par spyan drangs dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ / dam chos dkon mchog snying po bstan pa'i bcud/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi sgon me 'dus pa yi/ / lam bzang mchog gis 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa/ / bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje la phyag 161

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'tshal/ / nyer spyod 'dod yon bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs/ / ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod sprin rab 'byams dang / / bde stong padma'i snod du dam rdzas rnams/ / sbyangs rtogs sbar byas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mchod/ /mtshar sdug yid 'ong phyag rgya'i tshogs spros te/ / yum la dzim pas dga' ba'i mchog skyed cing / / stong dang bde chen sgyu 'phrul dbyer med pa/ / don dam de nyid mchod pas dgyes gyur cig / sdig ltung spyi dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chag ma lus snying nas bshags/ / zab cing rgya che rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ / skye 'phags dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / / 'gog med rdo rje'i sku lus mi g.yo zhing / / gsang chen gdams pa'i dga' ston stsal tu gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ / ring min byang chub rdo rje nyid gyur cig / de nas spron rigs lnga'i sdom gzung sogs kyang bya/de nas gong gi phyag 'tshal gyi tshig de gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba ci 'grub dang / de'i thugs gar hūṃ yig la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te de la thim zhing / slar yang 'od dang bdud ste'i rgyun byung ba rang dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs pas zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / des bskyed pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang la bkod byung snyam pa'i sgo nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags sam/ yang na gtso 'khor kun gyi sngags bzla/ mjug tu yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang / gang la brten na srid zhi'i 'jigs 'phrog cing / / lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi dpal ster ba/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po'i yis/ / mchod chen dga' ston mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ / sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang du gsol/ / rim gnyis lam gyi rtogs pa skyed du 162

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byor dngos grubakun 'byung /gsol/ / rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed bdag nyid kyi/ / sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol btab sbyi bo'i oṃ yig las/ /rab dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyes dbang bskur bas/ / lus kyi skyon sbyangs rim pa dang po yi/ / sbrul pa'i sku mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i ā las a mṛ ta/ / dmar po'i rgyun gyis ngag gi skyon dag cing / / snang phyogs sgyu ma'i lam gyi rlung sngags kun/ / sbyangs te longs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i hūṃ sngon bdud rtsi yis/ / yid kyi nyes kun bsal nas 'khor 'das chos/ / stong par rtogs pa'i 'od gsal ye shes kyi/ / sgrib bral chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'bru gsum thun mong 'od dang bdud rtsi'i mthus/ / sgo gsum dri ma phra rags kun zhi zhing / / sku thugs dbyer med yan lag bdun ldan gyi/ / zung 'jug go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ / khyod las lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ tshe rabs 'phreng bar dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / yang dag lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / rgyu yi theg pa'i lam gyes rgyud sbyangs te/ / 'bras bu gsang chen zab mo'i myur lam gyis/ / phra rags srid pa'i rgya mtsho nyer brgal nas/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon du bdag gyur cig / de nas sbyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rang gi spyi bo nas mar zhugs te/ rang sems dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la/ 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / bdag gi snying gar padma'i steng bzhugs la/ / bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / zhes sogs dang /gzhan yang tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam ci rigs pas mtshams spyor bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di yang dad brtson blo dang ldan pa sngags ram pa chos rgya mtshos bskul ngor 7btsun 163

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brag dkar lha zhol du bris pa'o/ / / / na mo gu ru shrī he ru kā ya/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang dbyer med du byas te zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas kun slong legs par bcos te/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / bdag nyid te ru gar gyur nas/ / sems can thams cad te ru ga'i/ / go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog / ces pa lan gsum gyis skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs bad nyi'i steng / / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med dpa' bo'i dbang phyug te ru ka / nam mkha'i mdangs ldan sngo ljang dmar ser zhal/ / nyi ma'i sbyan bgrad ral pa'i thor cog bcings/ /rtsa phyag rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud/ / gnyis kyis gti mug dag pa'i glang spags brgyangs/ / g.yas kyi lhag mas rim bzhin ḍā ma ru/ / dgra sta gri gug mdung thogs g.yon pa bzhis/ / kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo bsnams/ / g.yas brkyangs 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo dang / / g.yon bskums dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu ma mnan/ / gar dgu'i nyams ldan phyag rgya drug gis spras/ / sder 'phreng grol ba'i stag lbags sham thabs gsol/ /thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal 'phyang / / pang na lhan skyes dga' ba'i mchog sbyin yum/ / phag mo dmar mo rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin/ / gcer mo skra grol phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ / lang tsho rgyas shing lhan cig mnyam par spyor/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ / phung khams kun kyang rnam snang rdo rje sogs/ / lha yi rang bzhin gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis/ /mtshan pa'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis ye shes pa'i/ / 'khor lo spyan drangs dbyer med ro gcig gyur/ / 'od gsal ye shes 'bar ba'i gdengs ka yis/ / kun 164

༄/ / blasa'i rnal 'byoradangos grub kun khrung rmongs mthar mdzad brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun/ / lhan skyes bde ba'i 'khoramar sdom byed pa/ / bla ma te ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal/ / phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod pa'i tshogs/ / dmigs med sgyu ma'i rol pa ji bzhin du/ / 'bul zhing sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag kun/ / snying nas mthol lo byang zhing dag par mdzod/ / rab 'byams 'khor lo lnga yi lha tshogs rnams/ / spros te mkha' khyab zhing khams thams cad du/ / gang la gang 'tsham sprul pa'i bkod pa yis/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes brjod cing 'od zer spro bsdu dang snod bcud sbyang sgyur sogs kyi dmigs pa gsal ba'in pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ ā gu ru ratna shā sa na dī paṃ sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa lta bu rang gi bla ma'i mtshan sngags dang / oṃ shrī badzra he te ru ru ke hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la shaṃ wa re swāhā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sadru burnya ḍā ki dī ye badzra wazlo nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yum gyi snying po dang nye snying ci 'grub bzla/ te ru ga'iyig brgya brjod de lhag chad bskang / spro na bod skad dang rgya skad ci rigs pa'i rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / thun mong lam gyi rmang gzhi brtan pa'i sgos/ / gsang chen theg pa'i snod du 'gyur bar shog / dbang thob dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung / / rang lus lha skur sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor dang / / zhugs gnas thim pa'i bde chen 'od gsal thugs/ /dbyer med zung 'jug go 'phang thob par shog / mdor na bla ma bcom ldan te ru ka / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro tshogs dang bcas pa yis brtse bas bu bzhin 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ / zhes bajod cing snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad 165

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanama'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par gnas pa rnams rim gyis bsdus te bla ma te ru ka la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba rang la thim pas rang nyid te ru ga'i skur gyur/ rang yang stod smad nas rim gyis 'ong du zhu ba snying ga'i sa bon la thim pa'i mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur par bsams te lta thog tu bzhag la/ snod bcud mtha' dag bla ma'i skur bsdus te/ / rang la thim zhing rang nyid lha yi skur/ /bzhengs pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin gyur pas/ / dmigs med 'od gsal ngang du gnas par gyur/ / ces brjod cing / srid pa gsum 'bar sogs kyi bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang dad brtson ldan pa sngags ram pa dkon mtshog seng ges bskur ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /chos bden bdag nyid bla ma te ru ka / / khyod min skyabs gzhan gang du'ang mi 'tshol bas/ / sgo gsum dri ma mtha' dag drungs phyung ste/ / bde chen sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa na/ / sprul pa'i phag mo mkha' 'gro bzhir bcas pas/ / bum pa'i dbang bskur lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ / bskyed rim phra rags sprul sku 'grub par byas/ / he ru ga dang phag mo sbyar ba yi/ / gsang rdzas myang bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang / / rgyal gsung longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag / phag mo rang la phyag rgyar gnang ba dang / / snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes/ / yid kyi sgrib byang don dam 'od gsal gyi/ / rdzogs rim chos sku dang bcas 'grub par byas/ / bde chen thugs dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku/ / zung du 'jug pa'i don la ngo sprad pas/ / sgo gsum sgrib bral zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / / 'grub pa'i nus pa yongs su smin par gyur/ / 'di rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa'i 'phror bya 166

༄/ / blasa'i3la 'byoradangos grubakun 'byung /zhing / dbang bzhi len tshe gong gi skyabs sems kyi 'phror skad cig dkrong bskyed kyang cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bya dgos so/ / zhes sngar bris pa'i bde mchog gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor la dbang bzhi'i kha skong zhig dgos zhes dad brtson blo dang ldan pa 'jigs med shes rab dang sngags ram pa dkon mchog bshes gnyen gnyis kyis bskul ngor7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru badzra snyi ra wā ya/ 'dir lam zab mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par byed pa la/ / spyir mdo rgyud thams cad las bla ma ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten dang skyabs gnas mtha' dag 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du lan grangs du mar gsungs pas/ yi dam chos skyong gang dang sbrel nas kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang du yod la/ /khyad par dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / ma rungs gdug pa 'dul mdzad gshin rje'i gshed/ /mi yi gzugs kyi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ / dbyer med bla ma yi dam zhes gsungs pa ltar/rang cag ri bo dge ldan pa rnams/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong thams cad ngo bo gcig tu sgrub pa la rten 'brel gyi gnad shin tu che bas/ 'dir yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed dang sbyar te bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/dge sems khyad par can gye ngang nas/ rang gi spyi bor padma nyi zla'i steng / /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog / bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ rnam pa khams gsum za byed gshin rje'i gshed/ / dbu dgu 'bar bas nam mkha'i khyon gang zhing / / so bzhi'i phyag gis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ / bcu drug zhabs kyis sa gsum rnam par gnon/ / gtum drag khro bo'i nyams ldan ha har bzhad/ / rus pa'i rgyan ldan 'bar ba'i chas kyis brjid/ / phyogs kyi gos can bskal pa'i me yis 'khyud/ / de yi thugs gar 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / / 'od zer lnga ldan hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis gshin rje'i gshed/ / sras bcas rgyal 167

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ / jo rtu baṃ ho dbyer med bstem byas nas/ / dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab gyur/ / mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs/ / lus can nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod pa'i gsung / / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid pa'i sku/ / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor 'das spros bral ye shes rang bzhin las/ / kun khyab mchod sprin mtha' yas legs 'bul zhing / / nyes ltung sdig pa'i tshogs rnams kun bshags te/ / rlabs chen dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / bla ma yi dam dbyer med 'dren pa khyod/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs mthar spel ba'i phyir/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon du rtag bzhugs nas/ / legs gsung bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stsal tu gsol/ / 'di ltar bskrun pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ / bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / lam mchog sgrub pa'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ / rnam dag chos la gcig tu gzhol bar shog / de tshe bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po yis/ / 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /byin rlabs srung ba'i 'khor lo la brten nas/ / dam chos sgrub la bar chad med par shog / de yi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs shing / / dpal ldan rdo rje zeg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung bar shog / de nas rim gnyis lam bzang bgrod pa yis/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i g.yul bcom ste/ / bla ma yi dam go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ / lus can mtha' dag srid las sgrol par shog / ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni thugs dam dge sbyor la gcig tu brtson pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang dkon mchog gis bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris 168

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byor dngosayub na 'byungakapa'o/ / / /na mo badzra snyer wa ya/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang gi spyi bor padma nyi ma'i steng / / hūṃ yig mthing nag 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje khro bo'i zlos gar mkhan/ / khams gsum za byed phyi nang gshin rje'i gshed/ / dus mtha'i me dpung dra bas 'khyud pa yi/ / mig sman lhun po ling ling g.yo ba bzhin/ / gzi byin bzod dka' ha ha'i gad rgyangs can/ /'bar ba'i zhal dgu 'dren byed glog dmar g.yo/ / bden gnyis rwa gdengs dri 'dzin 'thor rlung gis/ / srid pa mthar byed me yi ral pa gzengs/ / gdab pa'i mtshon gdengs g.yas phyag bcu drug gis/ / 'das pa'i lha la bsdigs shing dngos grub 'bebs/ / rol ba'i mtshon thogs g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub rtse/ / thur phyogs mjig rten pa rnams skrag par byed/ / brgyad gnyis zhabs kyis tshangs dang log 'dren sogs/ / dbang byed gdengs can bdag pos ga shal byas/ / thod skam dbu rgyan mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / / rus pa'i rgyan spras yan lag sbom zhing rags/ / rdo rje ro langs ma dang mnyam spyor zhing / / phung khams rnam dag rigs lnga yum bzhi dang / / bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms sgo pa bzhi dang bcas/ / bcu gsum lha yi 'khor lo'i ngo bo nyid/ / de yi gnas rnams rdo rje gsum gyi bdag /yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyes/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor bcas ye shes pa/ / sbyan drangs dza shā paṃ ho dbyer med gyur/ / dmigs med rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni/ / bde chen snying rje sgyu ma'i rol gar gyis/ /gtum drag khro bo'i rgyal po'i skur bzhengs pa/ / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / / sbyangs rtogs sbar byas rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / dga' ba'i mchog sbyin mdzes sdug 169

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/phyag rgya dang / / bde stong dbyer med zung 'jug mchod pa'i tshogs/ / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed pa'i lha tshogs la/ / gus pas 'bul lo dgyes pa chen pos rol/ / sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i mgon po yi/ / gnas gsum sngags kyi 'od dang bdud rtsi'i chus/ / lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / nges 'byung yang dag lta dang byang sems kyis/ / legs sbyangs rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /bskyed rim gnyis dang rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhis/ / shes rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gang 'dul gzugs skur snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ / rlung sngags dbyer med bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ / 'od gsal thugs dang gnyis su mi phyed pa'i/ / zung 'jug go 'phang thob par byen gyis rlobs/ / zhes bdud rtsi 'phebs sbyang gi dmigs pa dang sprags te sngags gsum bzla/yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gong gi phyag 'tshal gye tshigs bcad gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba lan 'ga' brjod/ de ltar gsol btab spyi bo'i bla ma lha/ / byu tī'i lamanas rang gi snying gar byon/ / phra ba gnyug ma'i sems dang dbyer med par/ / byang chub bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / skye zhing skye bar 'jam dpal zhi khro yis/ / rjes bzung rnam 'byed shes rab mchog thob cing / / mtha' dag bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal gyur te/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur par shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pacho bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /na mo gu ru shrī he ru kā ya/ bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas te ru ga'i yig brgya bzla bar 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ spros bral dbyings las rang nyid te ru ka / / sku mdog sngon po 170

༄/ /blama'i /la 'byor dngos grub kun 'byungakazhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ / rdor dril bzung ste phag mo dmar mor 'khyud/ / g.yas brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka yi/ / hūṃ las 'od 'phros snod bcud skyon kun lhangs/ / dag pa'i brtan g.yo zag med mchod sprin dang / / oṃ ā ཿ gis sbyangs rtogs sbar byas pas/ / nang mchod zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ / rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang / / a las zla bar hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ / rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' zla ba'i mdog / rdor dril bzung ste rdo rje bsnyems mar 'khyud/ / skyil krung gis bzhugs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ / dar gyi na bzas klubs pa'i gnas gsum du/ / yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med bstem/ /slar yang dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ / zag med bdud rtsi'i chu yis dbang bskur cing / / spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab gyur/ / gang gi thugs rje byin rlabs 'od stong gis/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal grang reg gdung ba dang / / las nyon sdig sgrib mun pa'i 'jigs 'phrog pa/ / bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ / dngos bshams yid sprul yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ / dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas mchod par 'bul/ / brtse bas bzhes nas sngon byas dge tshogs kun/ / mi nyams gong du 'phel bar byin gyes rlobs/ / thog ma med nas ma rig dbang gyur te/ / sgo gsum nyes pa ji snyed bgyis pa dang / / khyad par sdom gsum dang 'gal nyes ltung kun/ / snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ / rnam smin 'bras bu'i sdug bsngal mi bzod bzhin/ / de rgyu sdig la rngams pa'i spyon pa bdag / thugs rje'i gter chen khyod kyis brtser dgongs te/ / srid pa ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bskyab tu gsol/ / sems nyid gdod nas dri ma las 171

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i nama'i gsung 'bum/'das kyang / / dam tshig nyams chag nyes pas sbags pa kun/ / bla ma lha yi thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chus/ / myur du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol btab thugs shar zla ba la/ / hūṃ mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las/ / 'od 'phro4sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus te bstem/ / slar yang de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ / spyor mtshams nas thon rang gi gtsug nas zhugs/ / lus kun gang bas sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs/ / rdor sems byin rlabs ma lus thob par gyur/ / oṃ badzra te ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ te ru ka twe no ba ti ṣṭha/ dṛ khye me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ saspru sirnyi me pra yatsā/ sadra garma su tsa me/ tsitta shrī yi ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho / bha ga wan badzra te ru ka ma me muñtsa/ te ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa ā ྅ phaṭa/ces ci 'grub bzla/ bla ma rdor sems dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyis/ / khyod kyi sdig ltung lhag med byang ngo zhes/ / dbugs dbyung mdzad cing thim pas sgo gsum dang / / de yi sku gsung thugs gsum dbyer med gyur/ / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / bla ma lha yis 'bral med rjes bzung mthus/ / sgo gsum nyes ltung dri mas ma sbags par/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni u rad shog nas gu shrī dge slong dkon mchog dge legs dang mar du su dge slong thos bsam gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru a mo gha sidha ye/ dngos grub gnyis kyi rtsa ba dam tshig rnam par dag pa la ltos pas de'i nyams chag skong ba'i phyir dam tshig rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/ / snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ / rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ / bde 172

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byor dngos grubakun 'byung gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ / rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol cing / / sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ / dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ / dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing / / rnying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab zhugs pa/ / brtub zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ / bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ / sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ / lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ / sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ / zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed shugs drag lan gsum sngon du btang la/ rang nyid yi dam lha yi skur gsal ba'i/ / thugs gar paṃ dang a las padma dang / / zla ba'i gdan la sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / / hā las ral gri 'chang bzung hās mtshan pa/ / de las 'od 'phros sras bcas rgyal kun mchod/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i dam tshig nyams chag sbyangs/ / tshur 'dus thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ / bcom ldan dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog ljang / / ljang nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis/ / ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ / g.yon na dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin/ /rang 'od dang mtshungs dam tshig sgol ma ni/ / phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang / / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i utpa la 'dzin cing / / g.yon gsum dril bu rin chen ral gri bsnams/ / thabs shes dbyer med phan tshun 'khyud pa yi/ / gnas gsum oṃ 〉 rtu gis mtshan par gyur/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros rgyal ba kun/ / dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ /dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par bstem/ / slar yang rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ / dbang bskur sku lus gang zhing dri ma dag / yab kyi dbu la 173

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/mi bskyod mgon po dang / / yum la don yod grub pas rgyas btab gyur/ /oṃ sazo ta thā ga ta arnya nas sta pra tītstsha nyuswāhā/ don yod rdo rje dzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ / dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / / dam tshig rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ / bcom ldan dam tshig rdo rje yis/ / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ / dam tshig nyams chag sdig sgrib kun/ / byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ / thugs gar zla dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / / hā yig sngags 'phreng bcas las 'od 'phros te/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu kun/ / bsdus nas bstem zhing de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / babs pas rdo rje'i khong gtams rwa rtse nas/ / thon te sku gang zag med bde chen myong / / de yi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir thon pas/ /rang lus gang ste nyes kun sbyangs par gyur/ / oṃ sko pradzñā dhrika hā hūṃ/ zhes brgya stong sogs ci nus su bzla/ bla ma'i zhabs brtan du byed na sngags ci nus bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ dpal ldan bla ma mtshan 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dam tshig nyams chag dang / de'i dbang gis byung ba'i nad sogs phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes sngags brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags la ci 'grub bzla/ 'di 'dra'i tshe hā yig gi mdun du bla ma'i mtshan gyi yi ge dang po 'god la/ de rang ngam bsgrub bya gzhan la'ang 'dra'o/ / mjug tu/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ / dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ / bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig / gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can / 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pa na/ / bcom ldan dam tshig rdo rje yis/ / khyod kyi dam tshig nyams chag kun/ / byang zhing dag go zhes gsungs nas/ / rang la thim par gyur pa yis/ / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / / dam tshig rdo rje'i sku gsung 174

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byoradangosakhrubakun 'byung thugs/ / dbyer med lha sku'i ngo bor gyur/ / ces brjod cing bsams la/'dir yang bla ma'i zhabs brtan yin na/ bla mar thim par gyur pa yis / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum dang / / zhes bsgyur la/ pha ma'am gshin po sogs kyi don du byas pa yin na'ang / de la thim zhes dang / de yi lus ngag yid gsum zhe4 sgyur/bzlas pa'i spel tshig kyang snga mas mtshon te shes par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad ldan ngag dbang shes rab dang gong 'phel gnyis kyis 'di'i cho ga tshigs bcad du byas pa'i 'don bde ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru badzra dhā rā ya/ 'dir zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos rnams tshags su tshud par byas te/ rang dang snod bcud kun la tha mal gyi snang zhen dang bral ba'i sgo nas/ mdun gye mkha' la dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser/ / seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ / skyabs gsum ngo bo bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / chos 'chad mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / de yi thugs gar thub dbang rdo rje chang / / bla ma'i mtha' skor skyabs yul rab 'byams kyis/ / yongs bskor thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros te/ / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol dbang gi rgyal/ / skyabs mchog rnam gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs ma lus 'bul/ / rnam smin mi bzad sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ / dge tshogs dang bcas byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ / maṇḍal dbul/ khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam zhes pa nas/ bar gcod srungs/ / lan gsum dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin 175

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bshes gnyen la ma gus pa dang tshe 'di'i snang shas kyi gdon gyi dbang du gyur te 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal mi sems shing / skyabs 'gro las 'bras sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams sogs la mi brtson pa dang / thog med nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rnams yal bar bor zhing / 'khor 'das kyi dngos po kun la bden par zhen pa la sogs pa phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag da lta nyid du zhi bar byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba nas bzung ste gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bar skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas bsdus pa'i blo sna phyin ci ma log pa thams cad da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul kun/ / rim gyis bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ / bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ / nyes kun byang zhing byin gyis brlab par gyur/ / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi snying gar zhes pa nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / tshe rabs kun tu mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ / theg mchog bshes gnyen dngos su mdzad pa'i mthus/ / zhes sogs dang / shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang zhes pa nas/bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dal 'byor don ldan du sgrub pa'i thabs la gcig tu gzhol ba rab 'byams pa dge 'dun 'jigs med kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dkyus su lam rim gye dmigs skor bsdus te shin tu 'jug pa bde ba'i tshul du bsdebs pa'o/ /na mo gu ru badzra wa ra ha ye/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med du byas 176

༄/ /blama'irnal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byung te gsol ba 'debs par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang la/mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus/ / sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / sku mdog brdu dzi ba ga ltar dmar/ / gcer mo skra grol lang tsho dar la bab/ / g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug thur du 'phyang / / g.yon pas thod khrag steng du bzung nas gsol/ /zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan dmar mo dang / / g.yon pa bskums te 'jigs byed nag po mnan/ / spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su gzigs/ / nu 'bur rab rgyas bde dga'i nyams dang ldan/ / mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan do shal dang / / phyag rgya lngas brgyan gzi byin rab tu 'bar/ / de yi thugs ga'i baṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ / phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i/ / rnam par spyan drangs dbyer med thim par gyur/ / sangs rgyas las dkon gsang chen gdams pa'i mchog / bstan pa'i snying po bde stong zung 'jug lam/ / skal bzang 'gro la snang byed sgon me mchog / mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bkod legs phyi yi mchod pa mtshar du dngar/ / sbyangs rtogs sbar byas nang mchod bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ / lhan skyes bde ster gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / / bden gnyis zung 'jug de nyid mchod pa 'bul/ / sngon bsags mi dge'i phung po mtha' dag dang / / khyad par rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las/ / 'das pa'i nyes tshogs snying nas mthol bshags na/ / bcom ldan thugs rjes lhag med byang gyur cig / rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i dngos/ / bcom ldan 'das mas thugs rjes nyer dgongs te/ / nam yang 'bral med bu bzhin rjes 'dzin zhing / / lam bzang rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sngon 'gro thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / 'jug sgo rnam dag dbang gis smin 177

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/byas nas/ / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung ba yis/ / dngos grub gnyis kyi sgo brgya 'byed par shog / khyar par rnal 'byor ma yi thugs rje mthus/ / rtsa rlung khams kyi nus pa yongs smin pas/ / lhan skyes dga' ba mchog dang stong ba nyid/ / dbyer med lam gyis srid rtsa dbyin bar shog /ces brjod cing / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng dang sku'i cha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs shing bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa byas la/ oṃ ā ratna shā sa na dī ༷༷ ṭwāṃ bye ṭwāṃ /nī ṭwāṃs/ daṭwāṃ /rtu ṭwāṃ ༷ ༵ ༵sna ༵/ ṭwāṃ hāka dīzhe ༷/ ci ༷byebawa ba ṭwāṃ ṭīyi ༵ /brgyas lhag chad bskang / bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje'i gter/ / yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun gyi dngos/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan nam yang mi 'tshol bas/ / byang chub bar du rjes su gzung du gsol/ / 'di snang 'gags tshe bcom ldan 'das mas zhal/ / mngon sum bstan nas dag pa mkha' spyod du/ / khrid de gsang chen myur lam la brten nas/ / dpa' bo'i dbangaphyug go 'phang myur thob shog / ces brjod cing / rang gi spyi bo nas mar byon te snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig le dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ / bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ / bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces bsngo smon dang bden stobs brjod pas rgyas gdab bar bya'o/ zhes pa 'di ni ming gan shog nas dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge slong skal bzang yar 'phel gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me bris pa'o/ / / /178

༄/ /masa'i rnal 'byor dngos grubakun 'byungakablo bzang rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dang / / dbyer med sgrib bral chos sku'i lha lam las/ / mkha' khyab zhing du gang 'dul gzugs kyi sku'i/ / nyi ma stong 'bar khyab bdag rigs kyi mgon/ / rab 'byams dkyil 'khor spro zhing sdud pa po/ / dpal ldan bla ma te ru ka dpal dang / / gnyid med ye shes rang 'od bcom ldan ma/ / gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ / sku mdog dmar po byu ru'i 'khri shing la/ / mthar byed me yig gdengs gas 'khyud pa bzhin/ / lang tsho'i dpal 'bar skra grol gcer mo'i gzugs/ / 'khril ldem rked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur rgyas/ / khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams kyi spyan gsum gdangs/ / tshems phreng mche ba zla ba'i myu gu gtsigs/ / phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug thur du brkyangs/ / g.yon pa thod khrag steng du bzed cing gsol/ / mchan khung g.yon par kha hūṃ ga yis mtshan/ / rus pa'i rgyan spras mgo rlon do shal 'phyang / / brkyang bskum zhabs kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan bcas/ / mnan te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa yi/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig las/ /spros pa'i 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ / spyan drangs dbyer med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / blo chen kun bzangabade chen thabs kyi bdag / mtshan 'dzin dmigs med shes rab chos kyi dbyings/ / dbyer med lhan cig skyes dga'i nyi 'od kyis/ /skyong mdzad bcom ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams yid sprul phyi nang gsang ba yi/ / mchod tshogs bde stong dbyer med ngang du 'bul/ / spyi dang bye brag dam tshig nyams chag kun/ / 'aspyod pas bshags so yongs su dag par mdzod/ / gsang chen spyod la dga' bas yi rang ngo / zab lam theg mchog chos kyi dga' ston stsol/ / dge bas thun mong lam gyis rgyud 179

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/sbyangs te/ / rnal 'byor ma rgyud lam gyi snod gyur cig / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig la gnas shing / / smin byed bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas grol byed zab mo'i rdzogs rim gyis/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / kun gyi ngo bor khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ / nam yang 'bral med brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal tu gsol/ / de nas/ blo chen kun bzang zhes pa'i sho lo ka gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba gang mang dang / gzhan yang gsol 'debs ci rigs dang / oṃ gsum ma'i sngags rnams kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mjug tu/ dpal ldan bla ma bcom ldan mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ / bdag gi snying gar zhes pa nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / zhes rang gi snying gar spyan drangs pas phra ba'izung sems dang ngo bo dbyer med du bzhugs par bsams la/ tshe rabs phreng bar bla ma rje btsun mas/ / 'bral med lhan skyes dga' bas rjes bzung ste/ / zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgol gyur cig / lha mo tshad ma zhes sogs smon lam gzhan gyis kyang mtshamasasbyor bar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni mkhyen dpyod yangs pa chos rje ngag dbang rin chen gyis bskul ngo 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sug bris su bgyis so/ / / /na mo gu ru za 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ dge sems khyad par can gye ngang nas/ mi 'gyur mchog yangs rang bzhin kun gsal mar/ / gser 'od 'khyug pa'i 'ja' sprin dra ba'i dbus/ / seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ / chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / rab dgyes 'dzum pa'i nyams ldan thugs rje'i gter/ /180
