༄/ / blasa'i rnal 'byor dngos grubakun 'byungakanam mkha'i mtha' klas tshogs zhing rgya mtshor bcas/ / mos blo'i zhing du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / legs byas sprin dkar phung po 'khrigs pa'i sku/ / legs bshad dbyar rnga dal gyis rgod pa'i gsung / / mkhyen brtse'i sbrang char khur gyis gtams pa'i thugs/ / skyabs mchog ma tshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes sgyu 'phrul me na ka tshogs kyes// / kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin legs bstar te/ / bsod nams zhing mchog rnams la gus 'bul na/ / zag med bde chen dngos por bzhes su gsol/ / thog med dus nas sems kyi dbang gyur cing / / sems ni rmongs pas bran du bzung ba'i mthus/ / ha la 'bar 'dra'i sdig ltung ci bgyis pa/ / de kun bsam pa thag pas so sor bshags/ / e ma yid 'ong 'bras bu kun gyi gzhi/ / ma smad 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba'i tshogs/ / skye 'phags gang gis bgyis pa de kun la/ phrag dog med par snying nas rjes yi rang / /dug gsum nad kyis gzir ba'i 'gro rnams kyi/ / skyob pa zla med sman pa khyod lags na/ / brtse bas dgongs te zab rgyas dam chos kyi/ / bdud rtsi'i sgo mo deng 'dir dbye bar mdzod/ / rdzu 'phrul rkang pas brten slad bskal pa'i mthar/ / gzhom gzhig bral ba chos kyi sku brnyes rnams/ / ring nas goms pa'i snying rje'i ma ma yis/ / 'gro kun mi gtong brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / snang mtha' yid bzhin 'khor lo bi dza yā/ / la sogs 'chi med dpal ster lha rnams kyi/ / thugs rje mthu nus bden pa'i byin gyis kyang / /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs phreng ba'i bar/ / mgon po khyod kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / /khyod gsung yan lag brgyad ldan klung rgyun gyis/ / las nyon dri ma drungs nas 'byin par shog / khyad par bde ldan zhing du skyes gyur te/ / 'od dpag 181

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/med pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / / zhing khams rgya mtshor sprul pa'i bkod pa yis/ / tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs byang chen myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo gros dang ldan pa sngags ram pa bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru ca 'dir lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste dge sems khyad par can gyis ngang nas/ sgrib bral mkha' la ye shes dbang po'i gzhu/ / snying rje'i rgyud du bkug pa'i lding khang dbus/ / srid pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos 'dab brgya'i rtser/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma ngur sprig 'chang ba'i tshul/ / chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / de yi gnas gsum sngags kyi mtshan pa yi/ / hūṃ yig 'od kyis spyan drangs bsod nams zhing / / dpag yas nam mkha' khyab par bzhugs su gsol/ / gang la brten na srid zhi'i rgud ba kun/ / drungs nas 'byin mdzad zeg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / sgo gsum gus pas lan brgyar phyag bgyid do/ / dngos bshams gzungs rigs kyis sprul mchod sprin gyis/ / rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing kun bkang ste 'bul/ / bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i/ / nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ / rang gzhan skye 'phags dus gsum dge tshogs la/ / phrag dog med par snying nas rjes yi rang / / bgrang yas bskal ba'i bar du zhabs brtan cing / / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar skul/ / gang gi thugs rjes bdag kyang thun mong dang / / thun mong min pa'i lam gyi rim pa la/ / nges pa rnyed de tshul bzhin bsgrub pa yis/ / shes rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'dir 'bad legs byas bde 'byung ral pa'i klung / / bsod nams klung phran stong gi rten gyur te/ / sgrib 182

༄/ /blaba'i3la 'byor dngos grubakun 'byungakaganyis sgrib gsum sgrib bzhi'i dri ma kun/ / sbyangs nas byang chen rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni a ro hor chen shog blo bzang blo gros kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ / / /na mo gu ru byu chos dbyings bde chen 'chi med rol pa'i lam /brtse chen sgyu 'phrul 'ja' tshon gur khang na/ / gdong lnga'i khri la padma nyi zla'i steng / / skyabs gsum kun 'dus ngo bo thugs rje'i gter/ / dbus su 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa/ / g.yas su rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang / / g.yon na rje btsun bstan pa'i sgon me rnams/ / sku mdog dkar gsal chos gos gsum gsol zhing / / gnas gsum ye ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ / thar lam ji bzhin ston mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel dam pa'i chos/ / byang chub lam gyi 'dren pa dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum kun dngos khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkha' khyab kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ / mi bzad nyes ltung ma lus snying nas bshags/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod la rjes yi rang / / bskal brgyar zhugs shing chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / 'dis mtshon dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / bshes gnyen rnams kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med dang / / skyabs 'gro las 'bras tshul bzhin sems par shog / 'khor ba me mdag 'khrigs pa'i 'obs 'di la/ / sred pa'i 'dun pa nam yang mi skye bar/ / bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog bslab gsum nyams len gyes/ / srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog / ring nas pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro kun la/ / rjes chags snying rjes drangs pa'i byang chub sems/ / rgyal sras spyod pa phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs/ / theg mchog lam 183

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzang myur du bgrod par shog / khyad par srid pa'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman/ / dngos 'dzin gdon chen 'joms pa'i rigs sngags gtso/ / dus gsum rgyal pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa/ / klu sgrub lugs bzang khong du chud par shog / sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa gsang sngags kyi/ / 'jug sgo smin byed dbang gis rgyud sbyangs te/ / mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ / rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang mthar phyin shog /mdor na dus gsum dge ba ci mchis rnams/ / srid pa'i phun tshogs rgyu ru mi smin par/ / thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam bgrod nas/ / mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo/ / zhes pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug slob zur blo bzang rin chen pa'i gsu gis 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung bar brten/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru bhya 'dir bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i zab lam bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas ngan 'gro'i skye sgo bcad de zhing mchog bde ba can du sgrod par byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lam bzang nyams su len pa la/ /thog mar rang dang rigs drug mtha' dag thog med nas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul bsam pa'i skyo shas dang / de las skyob pa'i nus pa bla ma dkon mchog la yod par yid ches pa'i sgo nas skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ rang gi spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i steng / / rab mdzes rma byas btags pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ / skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med/ / 'ja' tshon rnam bkra byu ru'i lhun po bzhin/ / sku mdog dmar gsal 'od brgya'i dra ba 'gyed/ / mnyam bzhag bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams/ / dgyes pa'i nyams ldan rdo rje skyil krung gis/ / bzhugs pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ / bde ldan zhing nas rgyal ba 'od 184

༄/ /blasa'irnal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byungakadapag med/ / rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan drangs te/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med thim par gyur/ / dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ / khyad par dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ / blo yis blangs te bla ma lhar 'bul na/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ / kun rmongs mun par zhugs pas mi dge'i las/ / ji snyed bgyis rnams 'gyod pa drag po yis/ / thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar bshags bgyid na/ / nyes tshogs byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / ngan song 'jigs las sgrol byed bstan pa'i bdag / dag pa'i zhing gi sa mkhan sgon me mchog / bla ma 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di snang zhen pa chod par byin gyis rlobs/ / bar do'i 'khrul snang sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ / ngan song skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma lha'i/ / sku las babs pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / sgo gsum sdig ltung dri ma kun byang nas/ / rang lus shel gyi gong bu bzhin du gyur/ / de yis dbus su dbu ma mda' snyug tsam/ / lte 'og nas bzung spyi bor zug pa yi/ / snying ga'i thad du rang sems zig le'i gzugs/ / dkar gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ / rigs kyi bdag po bla ma 'od dpag med/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / gnas ngan 'khor ba 'di las drang du gsol/ / zhing mchog bde ba can der khrid du gsol/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas thugs ka nas/ /'od kyi lcags kyus rnam shes gyen drangs te/ / 'od dpag med mgon thugs grwa'i hrī yig dang / / dbyer med ro gcig ngang du gnas par gyur/ / slar yang bla ma 'od dpag med dang bcas/ / thur du bab ste snying gar bzhugs pa 185

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/yis/ / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / nam yang 'bral ba med par rjes 'dzin shog / mdor na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma mchog gis dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin zhing / / mdo sngags zung 'brel lam bzang rim bgrod nas/ / zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog / de yang gsol 'debs grangs gsog byed na bsru med ma bzla zhing las la sbyor/dngos gzhi'i tshe slar yang zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi dod du/ de nas bla ma 'od dpag med dang bcas/ / bde ldan zhing der yud kyis gshegs gyur te/ /zhes sbyor ro/ tshul 'di ni mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang lhag bsam mchog tu dge ba rab 'byams pa ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rgyal ba 'od dpag med la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag med ngo bo dbyer mi byed pa'i mos gus dang /bde ba can gyi zhing gi rnam pa yid ngor gsal btab ste/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di'i sgo nas zhing der skye ba'i rgyu tshogs bsgrub bar bya'o/ / snyam pa'i 'phen pa sogs dge sems khyad par can gyis ngang nas/ mdun gyi mkha' la kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ / yid 'ong rma byas btegs pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ / 'dab stong padma'i lte bar zla ba'i steng / / skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma 'od dpag med/ / nyid 'od stong 'bar byu ru'i lhun po bzhin/ / sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ / mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas drang song snod mchog bsnams/ / rdo rje skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs pa yi/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / bde ldan zhing nas rang 'dra'i ye shis pa/ /mtha' yas rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ / sbyan drangs dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /186

༄/ / blasa'i3la 'byor dngos grubatwan 'byungakabastan pa'i bdud rtsis lus can gdung ba sel/ / yang dag thar lam gsal ba'i sgon me mchog / bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo / / rab 'byams mchod sprin dge ba'i dngos por bcas/ / gus pas 'bul lo brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes/ / sdig ltung ma lus bshags shing sdom bgyed na/ /khyodakyi thugs rjes byang zhing dag par mdzod/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir/ / bgrang yas bskal ba rgya mtshor brtan par bzhugs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba'i dngos po thams cad kyang / / khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing zhes sogs maṇḍal grangs gsog dang ltung bshags/ gong gi phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad dang / bla ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod ngo skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes pa rnams kyi sgo nas brgya phyag la sogs pa gnad du 'gro nges bya/ de nas/ sbyi gtsug byu tī'i yar sne phye ba'i steng / / dgyes bzhin byon te 'bral med bzhugs pa yi/ / dbu ma'i lam nas 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas rang rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ / zhes 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas mun khung du sgron me sbar ba bzhin sdig ltung thams cad sangs kyis dag nas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa byas la/ gong gi phyag 'tshal ba'i tshig de gsol ba 'debs zhes par bsgyur nas brgya stong sogs 'don/mthar/ bsru med skyabs mchog bla ma 'od dpag med/ / mgon med bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ / deng nas byang chub bar du khyod min pa'i/ / re sa gzhan med bdag gi bshes mdzod cig / mi khom ngan song gsum gyi g.yang las skyobs/ / bzod dka' 'jigs rung srid pa'i mtsho las sgol/ / rang nyid gces 'dzin 'ching ba kun bcad de/ / byang chub 187

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig tu/ / gsol ba btab pas byu tī'i lam brgyud de/ / snying gar byon nas phra ba'i rlung sems dang / / dbyer med ngang du brtan par bzhugs par gyur/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ / zhes sogs dang /'di ltar bsgrun pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ / zhes sogs tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gye smon tshig dang / bde smon yongs rdzogs sam/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ / zhes sogs smon lam gyes mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog mkhas grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni snyigruratna ā nanta'o/ / / /'dir mgon po 'od dpag med la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnam 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ / yid 'ong rma byas btags pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med/ / sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can/ / mtha' skor dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ / sangs rgyas so lnga bde bshegs bdun la sogs/ rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan rang chos skyong bcas/ / skyabs gnas ma lus dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nas kyang / / thugs bskyed bden mthus bskul te rang rang gi / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med du/ / bstim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur/ / bsru med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / ngan song 'jigs las sgol ba'i thabs bstan nas/ / thar lam gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me mchog / mgon po 'od dpag med la gus phyag 'tshal/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs zhing khams 188

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byoradangos grub kun 'byung /rab 'byams na/ / yid 'phrog mchod pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa/ / mtha' dag blo yis blangs te gus 'bul gyi/ / bdag cag bsod nams rdzogs phyir bzhes su gsol/ / thog ma med nas blang dor gnas rnams la/ / rmongs pa'i mun pa stug po'i dbang gyur te/ / sgo gsum nyes tshogs mtha' yas bsags pa rnams/ / thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ / dal 'byor lan cig rnyed nas bstan pa'i sgor/ / zhugs kyang bag med spyon pa'i spyod pa bzhin/ / sdom gsum bcas mtshams las 'das sdig ltung kun/ /'gyod pas bshags shing phyin chad sdom par bgyi/ / bslu med bla ma lha yi thugs rje'i mthus/ / nyes ltung dri ma ma lus byang ba dang / / rang gzhan kun gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i dngos/ / mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel gyur cig / khyad par 'di snang 'gag par nye ba'i tshe/ / gnad gcod gshin rje'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing / / ngan song ngan 'gro'i g.yang du mi ltung bar/ / bde ba can gyi zhing der khrid du gsol/ / 'od gsal mkha' dbyings dwangs par snang mtha' yas/ / nye sras dang bcas dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan cing / / snyan pa'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdzad pa'i mthus/ / dga' dang dad pa'i shugs kyis 'pho bar shog / mdor na dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ / 'od dpag med kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzad de/ / 'bral med gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa yis sa lam rtogs pa myur du mthar phyin shog / 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs gang du yang / / mgon po khyod min skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / thugs rje lcags kyus nam yang mi gtong bar/ / rjes bzung byin rlabs dga' ston bstsal tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams gtso bo la thim zhing / de nyid rang la thim pas byin byis brlab par mos te/ shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag 189

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/med/ / ces sogs kyi bsngo bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog yar 'phel dang / dge slong dkon mchog rab 'byor gnyis kyis 'di lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor stobs bzhi'i gnad tshang ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru lo ke shā rā ya/ 'dir bla med kye lugs dang 'brel bar thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang la dge ba'i bsam pa khyad par can gyi ngang nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag bzhi pa/ / rab 'byams zhing nas bla ma yi dam kun/ /byon te thim pas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur/ / ces mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'igadan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po rtsa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing / 'og mganyis kyis shel 'phreng dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i thugs ga'i hrī yig las 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams khyab par spros te dngos brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad spyan drangs nas thim pas bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te thim pas yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ yan lag bdun pa sogs kye sgo nas tshogs gsog pa ni/ sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing / / phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod tshogs 'bul/ / sdig ltung ma lus snying nas mthol zhing bshags/ / dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ / rab 'byams zhing khams dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / dbul zhing bla med byang chub rgyu 190

༄/ / blama'irnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung /ru bsngo/ / so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa yi/ / bcas mtshams mtha'adag tshul bzhin bsung bar bgyi/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa dbul zhing / sgrub pa'i mchod pa mchog tu gyur pa sdom pa gzung ba rnams blo 'khul nges su bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ /dam chos kun 'dus bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma thug rje'i gter/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan nam yang ma mchis pas/ / byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i dri ma bsal du gsol/ / las dang nyon mongs 'ching ba gcad du gsol/ / gces 'dzin rgud pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam bzang rim bgrod de/ / bde chen thar pa'i sa la drang du gsol/zhes rang dang mtha' skor na yod pa'i rigs drug sems can thams cad kyis rang rang 'khor ba phra rags kyi sdug bsngal mtha' yas pas mnar tshul la bsams nas 'jigs shing skrag pa dang / mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma thugs rje chen po ni skyabs gnas ma lus pa 'dus pa'i ngo bo rang gis blo bkal na srid zhi'i 'jigs pa gang las kyang skyob pa la thugs rje dang nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i tshul bsams te gdung shugs drag pos mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'i mos pa dang / lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa la gshar sgom dang 'brel par byin rlabs zhu ba'i dmigs rnams bskyangs la/ de nas thugs rje chen po de nyid kyi sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros te rang dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas la/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas gnas gsum las/ / 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ga'i tshogs/ / rim dang gcig car byung nas dbang bskur bas/ sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ / ces spyi bo'i oṃ yig las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab pas mgrin pa'i 191

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/rtsa 'khor gyi steng yan chad gang / lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs bum pa'i dbang thob cing sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag de bzhin du mgrin pa'i ā yig gi bdud rtsi dmar pos ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ gsang dbang dang longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag thugs ga'i hūṃ yig gi bdud rtsi sngon pos yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sher dbang dang chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa ba'ag / de gsum las bdud rtsi mnyam du bab pas sgo gsum ga'i dri ma sbyangs/ dbang bzhi pa dang zung 'jug 'grub pa'i nus pa gzhag par bsams de nas sems can so so'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs rnams 'od du zhu ste rang rang la thim pas de thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi skur gyur/ de dag kyang gcig lagacig thim gyis tshul du rim gyis bsdus te rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba rang la thim/ rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ rang nyid kyang sku'i stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu bas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur te/ snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi chos kun rang bzhin mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags shing chos kyi sku la nga rgyal bzhag 'od gsal de'i ngang las mngon byang lnga'i rim pas spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bzhengs pa longs sku dang sprul sku'i nga rgyal 'dzin cing skye shi bar do gsum sbyangs te rgyal ba'i sku gsum du bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ 'gro kun spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bsgyur cing / / rim gyi bsdus te 'od gsal stong par gyur/ / stong pa'i ngang las padma zla ba'i steng / / hrī dang pad dkar yongs su gyur pa las/ / rang nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i/ / thugs ga'i hrī yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas par/ / gzungs sngags kun bsdus 'od kyi 'phro 'du yis/ / snod bcud sbyangs bsgyur byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ / ces thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros te rgyud sde bzhi'i gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad bsdus nas de la bstem pas gzungs sngags kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/192

༄/ / blasa'i rnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung /snod bcud kun gye ma dag pa'i nyes pa sbyangs te/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad spyan rasagazigs kyi sku dang dag pa'i zhing khams/ sgra grags tshad 'phags pa'i gzungs sngags yid kye dran tog thams cad de'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mos pa 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas gzungs ring dang yig drug sogs ci 'grub bzlas la yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ zhes sogs bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dge spyor la mchog tu gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa dkon mchog rab rgyas kyis bla med dang 'brel ba'i thugs rje chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis gzhung bsrangs te bzlas brjod byed tshul zab gnad tshang zhing shin tu mdor bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ grub chen tshem bu pa dang rgyal ba dben sa pa sogs kyi man ngag gung bsgrigs te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa 'dis kyang skye bo kun la phan thogs par gyur cig / / /na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ rang gi spyi por padma zla ba'i steng / / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / sku mdog dkar gsal shel gyi ri bo bzhin/ / 'dzum pa'i zhal mnga' rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar/ / lhag ma'i phyag gis shel 'phreng pad dkar bsnams/ / rin chen rgyan ldan dar gyi na bzas klubs/ / rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mthar/ / dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ / rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan rang srung tshogs bcas/ / skyabs yul nam mkha' gang ba bzhugs pa rnams/ / bsod nams zhing du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / lung rtogs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i dpal gyur cig / las nyon sgrib pa'i mun sel sgron me mchog / bla ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phun tshogs bde dge ma lus mchod par 'bul/ / mi bzad sdig ltung mtha' dag snying nas 193

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bshags/ / rlabs chen thugs rje'i spyod la rjes yi rang / / slad kyang zab rgyas chos char dbab tu gsol/ / tshe 'di'i snang shas srid la zhen pa dang / / rang nyid gces 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba sogs/ phyin ci log gi blo sna kun 'gags shing / / lam bzang gegs med skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes brjod la gong gi phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs bcad gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba grangs gsog dang / / thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring thung gi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas/'dis mtshon bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur dus gsum gye/ / rnam dkar dge tshogs ji snyed mchis pa kun/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rgya mtsho dang / / 'dres te kun bzang spyod pa rdzogs gyur cig / rtag tu bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung nas/ / de yi bka' bzhin sgrub pa lhur byed cing / / khyad par 'jam mgon bstan pa'i snying po la/ / thos bsam sgom pas dus kun 'da' bar shog / 'di phyi'i phan bde'i legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / sde 'dir bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ / bshad sgrub bya ba gegs med mthar phyin shog / sgo gsum bgyi ba ma lus bstan 'gro la/ / 'phral dang yun du phan pa'i rgyur gyur te/ / mngon mtho nges legs dga' ston la sbyor bas/ / don gnyis gegs med lhun gyis grub gyur cig / bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / bdag gi snying gar padma'i zhes sogs dang / skye ba kun tu zhes sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams spyor zhing / sgo gsum gye bya ba kun la de nyid dpang po'i tshul du dran pa dang / zas gos gnas mal gang la longs spyod pa'i tshe de la dbul bar sems pa sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsalabyed dam pa lung bzang nang sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs bzhed bzhin 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dgon de nyid du bris 194

༄/ / blasa'i rnal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byung /pa'o / /na mo gu ru ārya lo ke shārā ya/ gnas spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i steng / / gdan seng khri padma nyi zla'i dbus/ / skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med pa 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / sku rab dkar shel gyi mchod sdong la/ / dar sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu yis spras/ /thabs shes rab phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyis/ / mgon rgyal rnams 'gro ba'i don du bskul/ / g.yas 'og mas shel dkar bgrang 'phreng dang / / g.yon skyon bral gser gyi padma bsnams/ / yongs dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i bdag / ma 'gro ba kun gye mgon dang skyabs/ / yul gangs can 'gro ba'i lha skal te/ / mi bdag gi 'di phyi'i skyabs gcig pu/ / mgon khyod min re sa gzhan med na/ / thugs brtse bas bdag gi mgon mdzod cig / lha dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i mkhar/ / chos lung rtogs bstan pa'i 'od snang gis/ / rgyud rmongs mun sel ba'i sgon me mchog / mgon spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ / pha thugs rje'i gter chen khyod la 'bul/ / ma 'gro kun don du bzhes nas kyang / / sdig nyes ltung byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gnas mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ / las nyon mongs gdon gyi dbang gyur te/ / dus thog ma med nas 'khyams pa bdag / mchog thar pa'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / chos zab zhi spros bral dbu ma'i lam/ / byams snying rje chen pos rgyas btab ste/ / srid zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /'bras byang chub chen po myur thob shog / dpal 'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob ste/ / chos zab gsang bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ / ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kyang / / gtan bde ba'i dpal la sbyor bar shog / ces pa 195

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'dini dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs rab rgyas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'o/ / / /mdun du pad zlar seng ge dkar mo'i steng / / bla ma'i ngo bo 'phags mchog seng ge sgra/ / g.yas g.yon rtse gsum padma'i snod kyis mtshan/ /dka' thub rnam pa rgyal po rol stabs can/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ / oṃ ā hrī sidha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas la/ bla ma seng ge'i sgra yi sku'i cha las/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi lus kun gang / / sdig ltung nad gdon ma lus lhag med du/ / byang zhing rnam smin phung po 'od gsal du/ /spyangs te stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ / rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge sgra/ / gdod lnga'i gdan la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /sku mdog datha/ra zhing shin tu skem pa'i tshul/ / g.yas pa skyabs spyin g.yon pa gdan la brten/ / mdun gyi bla ma spyan ras gzigs mgon yang / / 'od du zhu nas rang dang dbyer med gyur/ / thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng 'od kyi spro bsdu yis/ / skyon sbyangs rgyal kun byin rlabs bsdus par gyur/ / ces brjod cing /thugs gar hrī la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ klu dang sa bdag giganod pa sogs nad rims gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs bsdus te thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus thams cad gang bas legs tshogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa rgyas par bsams la sngags bzla/mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ / 'phags mchog thugs rjes 'bral med rjes bzung mthus/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces sogs bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni yu cu mu 196

༄/ / blama'i3la 'byor dngos grub kun 'byungakachin shog nas dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dpal ldan bkra shis kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus shig dgos zhes bskul pa ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /ngo mtshar mchod sprin 'khrigs pa nam mkha'i dbyings/ / seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bla ma dang / / dbyer med byams mgon bzang po'i bzhugs stangs can/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar chos 'khor phyag rgya mdzad/ /sras bcas rgyal bas bskor cing gnas gsum du/ / 'bru gsum gyes mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / dga' ldan gnas nas byams mgon ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dbyer med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / rgyal yum sbas don lam gyi rim pa kun/ / ma nor ma 'dres ji bzhin 'doms pa yis/ / skal ldanaskye bo byang chub mchog gi sar/ / 'khrid mdzad skyabs kyi dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams yid sbrul mchod sprin rab 'byams dang / /bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / blo yis blangs te gus pas 'bul lags na/ / bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig / ngan song mu med mtshan mo'i smag rum nas/ / dal 'byor glog gi snang ba skad cig tsam/ / thob kyang bag med sdig la spyod pa yi/ / rmongs ba bdagagi sdig ltung sbyang du gsol/ / rgyu med par yang 'gro la mnyes gshin pa/ / byams mgon nye sras dang bcas khyed rnams kyis/ / rtag tu bdag cag kho na'i don mdzad pa'i/ / bka' drin snying nas dran zhing rjes yi rang / / zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char phab ste/ / sgrib gnyis dri ma drungs nas 'byin pa dang / / 'gro kun srid zhi'i mtha' las sgol gyi bar/ /nam yang mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ / 'dis mtshon gtong dang tshul khrims thos bsam sgom/ / dge ba'i dngos po ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /197

༄/ /yo bamab yo tsha lagagacig tu bsdoms te sras bcas rgyal kun gyi/ /rlabs chen thugs bskyed rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /rtag tu mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan gyi/ /rten thob bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin cing / /'di snang 'khri ba chod pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs shing / / der gnas nyam thag 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ /rin chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /theg mchog lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / nam zhig 'di snang 'gag par rtsom pa na/ / khyod zhal mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yis/ /shugs drag dad pa'i ngang nas shi 'phos te/ /yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su skye bar shog /mdor na deng nas ji srid byang chub bar/ /'dren mchog ma pham mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /sa lam rtogs pa gegs med myur bgrod nas/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i sa la reg gyur cig /ce4pa 'di ni bzang po'i bag chagasakyi mthu brtas pa zhabasadrung dkon mchog chosa'abyor gyi4bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ / / /mdun gyi nam mkhar kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ /nor bu'i 'od chags seng khri pad zla'i steng / / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /ngo bo dbyer med rgyal tshab byams pa mgon/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan chos 'khor phyag rgya can/ /lha rdzas gos dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /bzang po'i bzhugs stangs mdzad pa'i thugs ka nas/ / 'od 'phros dga' ldan gnas nas byams mgon la/ /sras bcas rgyal bas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ / dbyer med bstem pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi/ / ngo bor bsod nams zhing du bzhugs gyur cig / dkon mchog kun 'dus thugs rje'i zlos gar gyes/ / zab 198

/ /blama'inal 'byoradangos bkun 'byungakargyas bstan pa'i gnad kun gdan gcig la/ / sgrub pa'i lam bzang gsal mdzad sgron me mchog / byams mgon bla ma mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i ngo bor legs 'bul na/ / thugs rjes bzhes nas bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ / shes rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sdom gsum bcas pa'i mtshams las 'das pa sogs/ / nyes kun gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol bgyid na/ / thugs rje che ldan byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chus/ /lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'dren pa khyod min skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / rtag tu 'bral med bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i gru char 'jo ba yis/ / dge ba'i lo tog gong du spel bar mdzod/ / ma 'ongs skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun tu yang / / dag pa'i zhing ngam dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten/ / rim brgyud bshes gnyen dam pa mnyes byas nas/ / mdo sngags lam la tshul bzhin slob gyur cig / mdor na bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs/ / kun gye ngo bor rtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs las bsgral te bla ma lha'i/ / go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / bka' drin mnyam med bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / bdag gi snying gar padma'i gdan bzhugs la/ / zhesasogasadang / 'dis mtshon dge ba'i zhes sogasadang / nam zhig rdo rje gdan gyi zhe4sogasabyamasamagon dang 'brel ba'i smonalam ci rigs pasamatshamayosbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni thoyobasam sgom pa zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rgyal mkhan po gragasapa rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabrigapa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru badzra dhā rā ya/ 'dir 'jam mgon bla ma la brten pa'i zab lamabla 199

sa / /gung thangabastanapa'izla ces gsung 'bumama'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan ltabargya ma'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gisarje'i sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigasakyis gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugasakyi rten legasapar dgram/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcasapa tshar gsum yan chad dang / /gzhan yang mar me brgya rtsa sogs mchod pa gang rgyas/ maṇḍal dang bcas pa legs par bstar/ skyab4sems rgyas par sngon du btang / dkon mchogagasum gyi bden pa dang / chos dbyings rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthu stobs kyis mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon pa'i mthu las skyabs yul rnams la zag pa med pa'i dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra marda ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa sbyakle burtswa ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dza badzre/ ma hā bi byu badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsi tta badzre/ mahā bodhi mato pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sa rba ka rma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungasalan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlab/ dga' ldan gyi zhing gi bkod pa yid ngor legs par gsal btab ste/ steng phyogs dga' ldan gnas kyi bye brag mchog /yid dga' chos 'dzin rgyal ba'i mdun sa nas/ /rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba ma pham mgon/ / nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gser ri bzhin/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar gzi brjid lham me ba/ /rin chen rgyan spras chos 'khor phyag rgya can/ /gdong lnga'i khri la bzang po'i bzhugs stangs mdzad/ /de yi thugs mtshan dpal gyi be'u'i nang / /'jam mgon bla ma yab sras legs bzhugs shing / /gzhan yang sar gnas dpa' bo grangs med sogs/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba thams cad kyang / /bdag sogs lho gling gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ / brtse ba'i thugs kyis mngon par dgongs pa yi/ / nyams 'gyur dang bcas rnam pa 200

༄/ /blaba'i3ba'abyor dngos grubakun 'byungakagasal bar gyur/ / dga' ldan lha brgya'i mgon gyi thugs ka nas/ / rab dkar zho gsar srungs 'dra'i chu 'dzin rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ / sras dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / / rje btsun bla ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar can/ / bdag blo dad pa'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /bstan pa rgyas phyir bskal brgyar bzhugs su gsol/ / de yang seng khri gsum gyi dbus ma la/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam mgon tsong kha ba/ / sku mdog dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags shing / / phyag gnyis thugs gar chos 'khor phyag rgya yis/ / ral gri glegs bam dang bcas yutpal bsnams/ /dri med gser mdog paṇa zhwas gtsug mdzes shing / / chos gos gsum gsol skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs/ / de yi spyi bor sku yi rdo rje'i dngos/ /lha mchog snying rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ / mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ / shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / thugs gar thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag nyid mchog / mthu stobs nus pa'i gter gyur gsang ba'i bdag / rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum kun gyi dngos/ / lha mchog gsum dang dbyer med ngo bo nyid/ / g.yas su chos kyi rgyal po dar ma'i mtshan/ / zhi dul nyams ldan chos 'chad mnyam bzhag mdzad/ / g.yon du smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal/ / chos 'chad mnyam bzhag dang bcas 'gying ba'i nyams/ / yab sras gsum gyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ / dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / / zhi khro rab 'byams yi dam 'khor lo'i tshogs/ / rab 'byams rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus pa/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyan rang chos srung kun/ / spyan drangs bsod nams zhing du bzhugs su gsol/ / ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 201

༄/ /gung cabayob mo tsha lasa'ajig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gi ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzangapo spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab bajod cing / /bde bar gshags pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /shes bya'i khyon kun 'jal ba'i blo gros thugs/ /skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur legs bshad gsung / /grags pa'i dpal gyis lham mer mdzes pa'i sku / /mthong thos dran pa don ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan sagasum ma sog4rje'i gsol 'debs dang bstod pa ci rig4'don zhing / spro na phyag 'tshal ba dang sbrags kyang rung / yid 'ong mchodayon zhe4pa'i sho lo ka gcig pu'am/ rgyal brgya mtsho ma sogasakyi mchod 'breng rgyasapa dang / 'dod yon rnam lnga rin chen sna bdun sogs kyang dbul/ ltung bshagasadang spyi bshagasasogasakyang bton te/ gang zhig thog med dus nas zhesapa mnacad mthar chags su bya/ de nasamaṇḍal so bdun ma rgyas par phul la/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma grangs bsags te bdun nam nyer gcig sogs dbul/ de nasabadud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi dmigs pa khrid yig sogasanasa'abyung ba ltar byas la dmigs brtse ma brgya stong sogs 'don/ de rjes/ rje bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi rigs gsum mgon po so so'i thugs gar rim pa bzhin zla gdan la hrī yig dang trī yig /nyi gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar 202

/ /blaba'i3la 'byor dngos grubakun 'byungakamos te/ rigayogasum mgon po'i snying po bgrang / khrusal sogasapa'i sgo nasagazhan gyi don sgrub pa'i tshe/ thugs ga'i gsang bdag khro bo'i rnam pa de nyid rdo rje rnam par 'jomasapa'i skur gyur par mos la/ de'i thugasaka'i sngagayo'aphreng las dud rtsi'i rgyun babasapasabum pa gang bar bsamasate/ de'i sngagasabazla zhing bum chu de nyid kyisabakru bya ba sogayodakyus bzhin bya/ desamatshon te mgrin pa'i 'jamadapal de nyid rdo rje 'jigasabyed kyi skur gyur par mosal de'i sngags bgrang ba sogasaskabayodang sbyar na rung bar gsungasaso/ / mjug tu rje bla ma rang gi snying gar byon par mos te/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes sogasadang / tshe rabasarjesa'adzin gyi smon pa sogasabya'o/ /zhe4pa 'di yang dad brtson ldan pa dge slong 'jigayomed bde chen gyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru maci sgo ṣā ya/ ye shes snang ba mchog tu 'bar ba'i gzis/ / nang gi mun pa sel ba'i nyin mor byed/ / 'jam dbyangs zhabs kyi padmo la btud nas/ / de la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bri/ / de'ang yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ /slob ma bzang po bla mar gusangaldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhasapa rnamasal rtag tu brten par bya/ /ci'i phyir zhe na mkhasapa'i yon tan de las 'byung / / de dag sheyorab pha rol phyin pa rjesasu ston/ / zhesagasungasapa ltar/ spyir srid zhi'i legasatshogasagazhan thamasacad ni bdag rkyen sang4rgyasakyi 'azin la4la brten cing sangs rgyasade ni yum shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lasa'akhrungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtogasapa ni dge ba'i bshesaganyen gyisarjesasu gdams pa la rag lasapasamador bsdu na legs tshogs yon tan thamasacad kyi rtsa ba dgeba'i bshes gnyen kho na la thug go / desan gnasaskabasamathar thug gi phun tshogasagang zhig bsgrub kyang de'i rten 'brel thams cad zam la brten nasabasgrig dgosate/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyasanasabazuba'aphag4yul paṇa grubarnamasadang jo bo yab sras/ 'jam mgon bla ma yabasrasathamasacad kyang rtsa ba 203

ro / /gung thangabastanaba'izla ma'i gsung 'thugabashesaganyen bsten tshul gyi rmang gzhi brtan pa'i steng nasasalam gyi rtogs pa bgrod tshul dang bstan 'gro'i don lhun gyis grub tshul rnam thar rnamasasugasal ba bzhin no/ /desan bshesaganyen sten tshul ni dmigasaskor thun re tsam gyisami rdzogasapa lam rim chen mor gsungasapa bzhin yin pas sangasargyasadangos su mthong ba'i dad pa dang rgyal ba kun lasabaka' drin che tshul rjes sudran pa'i gusapa chen posayid gting nasagayosate sgo gsum mtha' dag bla ma'i dbang du btang zhing bya ba thamasacad bla ma mnyesapa'i mchod par 'gyur ba zhig byung na mgo bshesaganyen sten tshul gyi sa ma log pa dang lam gyi rtsa ba tshugasapa yin pa4gnasa'adi la shin tu gzab par bya'o/ /'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul gyi rim pa tsam zhig zur du 'god pa la lhag pa'i lhasosodang spyar ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rigasasna tshogasashig yod kyang rje bla ma'i gdamasapa thun mong ma yin pa rnamayonyamasasulen skabasazamadang 'jam pa'i dbyangalongo bo dbyer med du byas na rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can yod tshul yab srasarnamasakyi gsung rgyun du ma layo'abyung ba ltar yin pas 'dir yang de'i dbang du byas te nyamasasu len pa la/ gnasakhang byi dor byas/ lam gtso'i tshogasazhing ngam 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rje bla ma/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam4kyi sku brnyan brisa'abur ci rig4kyisagatso byasapa'i sku gsung thugasakyi rten dgram/ yon chab dang mar me sogs dwangasashing gsal ba'i mchod pa legasapar bsham/ spyod lam tshul mthun gyisa'akhod de dge semasakhyad par can gyi ngang nas skyabs 'gro semasaskyed tshad med bzhi rnamasayongasagragasaltar dang / / khyad par ma sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa drungs nas phyung ste ye shes kyi snang ba phun tshogs pa la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bla ma lha'inal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya'o/ / zhes khyagapar gyi semasabaskyed bya/dngosagazhi tshigasasubacad pas brjod na 'jug pa bde bsa'adi ltar/ rnam dag 'od gsal chos dbyings lha yi lam/ / bde chen ye shes 'ja' tshon rnam lnga'i klong / /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gdong lnga 'bar ba'i khrir/ / srid pa'i skyon 2la

༄/ /blasa'i3la 'byoradangos bkun 'byungakabral 'dab stong rgyas pa'i rtser/ / thabs shes dbyer med nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / nyi gzhon bye ba phrag brgyas 'khyud pa yi/ gur kum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po bzhin/ sku mdog dmar ser lang tsho'i dpal gyis sgeg / zhal khyim rab rgyas yutpal spyan zung g.yo/ / smin 'khyog bisba'i mchu sgros 'dzum zhing mdzes/ / mthon mthing ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings/ / dngos 'dzin 'ching ba drungs nas gcod pa yi/ / shes rab ral gri g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'phyar/ / g.yon na chos kun snying po sher phyin gyis/ / nye bar mtshan pa'i yutpal sdong bu bsnams/ / me tog thod bcing nor bu'i dbu rgyan dang / / rna cha gdub kor do shal tshogs kyis mdzes/ / lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs sham thabs bgos/ / rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa yi/ / gnasalngar bde gshegs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i/ / rang bzhin yi ge lnga yis mtshan pa yi/ / hūṃ yig 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs bcas spyan drangs te/ / bstemapas skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur/ / spros bral dbyings dang dbyer med 'od gsal thugs/ / zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i gsub/ / gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba gzugs kyi sku/ / mi zad rgyan gye 'khor lo der phyag 'tshal/ / gang gi zhabs sen 'od kyis reg pa yis/ /mi shes rgud pa'i mun pa kun sel zhing / / phan dang bde ba'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ / bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gye yab gyur kyang / / rgyal sras tshul gyes 'gro kun srid las 'dren/ / ye shes lus can thugs rje'i gter khyod la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun bzang smon pa'i pir gyis bris pa yi/ /mchod pa'i ri mo zhing khams kun khyab pa/ / 'khor gsum dmigs med blo 205

༄khya/ /gung thang bstonapa'izla sa gsung 'khyam/yis 'bul lags na/ /zag med bde stong dga' bas dgyes gyur cig /ma rig dbang gyur nyes tshogs mtha' dag dang / /chos dang bla mar gus pa dman pa sogs/ / shes rab 'chal byed dam tshig nyams chag kun/ /shugs drag gdung ba'i yid kyis mthol lo bshags/ / dus gsum dge tshogs kun dang khyad par du/ / mgon khyod dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gyur te/ / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus bsgrub pa la/ / snying nas bsam pa thagapas rjes yi rang / /'gro ba'i las nyon dri ma kun sel ba/ / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul bdud rtsi'i chus/ / lus can snying gi gdung ba kun bcil te/ /yang dag lam gyi rtogs pa skyed par mdzad/ /ring nas 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i gnyen/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog /mgon khyod las lhag skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / bskal ba rgya mtsho brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ / nyes kun rtsa ba rmongs pa'i gdon bcom ste/ / ye shes lnga ldan 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi/ / go 'phang bde blag 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de nasagong gi phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs bcad gang yang rung ba gsol 'debayosu bsgyur ba ci mang bzlas la/ /mthar 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /rnam 'dren kun gye ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khyod zhabs gus mchod gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ / yang dag lam gyi rtogs pa mngon gyur te/ / sku gsum go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / kun byang blang dor gnas rnamasam lus pa/ /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i shes rab rlabs che zhing / /shin tu dpag dka'i gnas kun 'byed pa yi/ /zab mo'i shes rab thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ku sha'i rtse ltar phra zhing mdzangs pa yi/ /shes rab no gsal myur ba'i mtshon rnon gyis/ / the tshom dra ba 'phral du gcod pa la/ /thogs 206

/ /blaba'inal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byungakamedaspobs pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / ma rtogs log rtog dri ma kun sel zhing / / rgya chen gzhung la nges pa bde blag ster/ / yang dag lam du nye bar 'khrid nus pa'i/ / 'chad pa'i shes rab thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i rno rgyun 'bar ba yi/ / dgag sgrub gnam lcags phreng bas rgol ngan gyi/ / dam bca'i brag ri phye mar 'thag byed pa/ / rtsod pa'i shes rab thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / rjod byed snyan 'jebs rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed/ / brjod don zab lam byang grol 'jug ngogs ston/ /thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur pa yi/ / rtsom pa'i shes rab thob par byin gyisarlobs/ / tshig gi 'khrul ba sil ba sgra rig dang / / don la sgo 'dogs gcod pa tshad ma'i gzhung / / sgo gsum rnam dkar 'du byed bzo yi gnas/ / nyam thag gdung sel gso rig bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / thar pa'i 'jug ngogs nang don rig pa ste/ / rig gnas chen po rnam lnga skar rtsis dang / / mngon brjod la sogs rig gnas chung bar bcas/ / kun gyi mthar son gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin/ / rjes 'dzin mthu dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ / bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba 'bum sde'i gzhung / / lung dang rigs pa'i mngon pa dbu tshad mdzod/ / mdo sde'i mchog gyur pha rol phyin rnams kyi/ / dgongs don bde blag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / lha drug gis bsdus bya ba spyod par bcas/ / phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab rnal 'byor rgyud/ / bden gnyis gtsor gyur bla med rnam gnyis sogs/ / rgyud don mtha' dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na gzhung lugs kun la thos pas zhugs/ / de don tshul bzhin bsam pas sgo 'dogs bcad/ / rtse gcig bsgoms pas ji bzhin mngon gyur te/ / mdo sngags lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / thugs rje'i gter chen lhag pa'i lha khyod 207

༄/ /yo thangabastanaba'irna mthagayo 'chagakyi/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsis snying la bran pa yis/ /lam bzang snye ma g.yur du za ba'i rtser/ /sku gsum 'bras bu smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma lha/ / snying gar byon nas rang gi sems nyid dang / /dbyer med brtan par bzhugs nas mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub kun stsol rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / tshe rabs kun tu 'jam mgon bla ma yis/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen dngos su mdzad pa'i mthus/ / rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang de nyid las/ /skad cig tsam yang ldog par ma gyur cig /cesapa 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangasapa'i dge ba'i bshesaganyen rdo ram pa dkon mchog nam mkhasabaskur ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yoge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /kun rtogs spros dang bral ba'i dbyings kyi mkhar/ / dmar ser trī0yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /yid 'ong mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i mdangs ldan zhing / / brgyad gnyis lang tsho gsar ba'i dpal gyis sgeg / phyag g.yas rmongs pa'i 'ching gcod ral gri dang / / g.yon na gzhung mchog sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /gnag snum ral pa'i zur phud lnga ldan zhing / / mu tig 'phreng mdzes nor bu'i rgyan gyis srud/ / skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du/ /rdo rje gsum mtshon yi ges rgyas btab cing / /khyad par thugs ga'i ji0yig 'od zer gyis/ / mi 'gyur chos dbyings bde ba'i pho brang nas/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'jam dpal zhi khro'i tshogs/ / ye shes lhayi 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ / dbyer med bsod nams zhing du bzhugs par gyur/ /ma lus rgyal pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus dngos/ /ma nor lam bzang ston mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me mchog /bla 208

༄/ /blaja'irnal 'byoradangosakhrubakun 'byungakam 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun rtog zhen pa'i 'khor gsum yongs dag pa/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis rab 'byams zhing / /kun tu bkang ste dang bas 'bul lags na/ / kun nas brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol/ / mu med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i gnas skabs su/ / ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang du gyur pa yis/ / mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /ma lus 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ / mkhyen brtse'i 'odakyis thar lam gsal mdzad pa'i/ / rmad byung rnam par thar la rjes yi rang / /slad kyang 'khor ba srid du rtag bzhugs nas/ /legs gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzod bzung ste/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gye/ / srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa sel gyur cig / dkon mchog rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab me shel khams/ / mdo sngags bstan pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / skye rgu'i snying gi mun sel sgron me mchog / bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i dra ba gcad du gsol/ / rnam 'byed shes rab snang ba grul tu gsol/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gzi byin skyed du gsol/ / myur du mgon khyod lta bur byin gyes rlobs/ / snying rje che dang mtha' bral lta ba yis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i g.yang sa kun bkag ste/ / mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sar bgrod nas/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgrol gyur cig / cesarje btsun 'jam dbyangs labarten pa'i zama'i rnal 'byor 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed stag lung sprul pa'i sku nasabaskul ngor 7btsun padakon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /rnam dag 'od gsal dbyings kyi rol pa las/ / rgya chen tshogs gnyis 2khya

༄/ /yo cabasapa'isgronasa'i tsha la /'o ma'i chu gter dbus/ / srid pa'i skyon bral 'dab stong pad dkar rtser/ /dmigs med snying rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /sku mdog dkar gsal brgyad gnyis lang tshos sgeg /utpal spyan yangs smin ma'i 'khri shing mdzes/ / mchu sgros 'dzum ldan nor bu'i rna cha g.yo/ /phyag gnyis mchog spyin chos ston phyag rgya yis/ /yutpalaldong bu la gnas glegs ral 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis legs bzhugs shing / /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis zhing kun nas/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ /bsod nams zhing du dbyer med bzhugs par gyur/ /sangs ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༷ ༷༷kya nghru dībyeni dhri /༷ ༷/kyi rte byi/༷ ṭwāṃ/ tram̐ /ṭwāṃ trī byeṭwāṃshaṃ ༵/ ༷ bye dzhai~X dang / /nyer spyod rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /bkra shis rtags rdzas rin chen maṇḍa la/ / dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas mchod par 'bul/ /mi bzad nyes ltung ma lus snying nas bshags/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / /bskal brgyar bzhugs te chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /dge tshogs kun mkhyen ye shes rgyu ru bsngo/ /sa gzhi sbos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /zhesapa nas/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /cesapa'i bar gyisamaṇḍal grangasagasog /gong gi phyag 'tshal gyi tshigasabacadade gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba dang / oṃ wa kyi rda na ma zhes pa gnyis ci mang bzlasal bdud rtsi 'beebs sbyang gi dmigs rnam skyong / phul byung byams dang snying rje'i phyag brkyangs te/ / ngan song g.yang las sgrol ba'i 'dren pa mchog /yab gcig bstan pa'i sgron me thugs rje'i gter/ / bka' drin 210

༄/ /blama'inal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byungakadran pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba dang / / ngan song sdug bsngal bsam pa'i 'jigs skrag gis/ / skyabs 'gro las 'bras blang dor la 'bad nas/ / ngan song skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar khrims nod cing / / thar pa'i grong du 'jug pa'i lam ston pa/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgron me thugs rje'i gter/ / bka' drin dran pa'i yid kyi gsol 'debs na/ / rnam dag nges 'byung bsam pas rgyud 'khul zhing / / mi bzad nyes pa'i sgo bzhi yongs bkag ste/ / bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i nyams len gyis/ / thar pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugayopar byin gyis zlobs/ / theg pa mchog gi tshul khrims la bkod de/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las yongs su 'dzin/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgron me thugs rje'i gter/ / bka' drin dran pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / byams dang snying rje bdag gzhan brje ba'i blos/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi rtsa brtan zhing / / tshogs gnyis spyod pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa yi/ / theg mchog lam bzang skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'jug sgo rnam dag dbang gis smin byas te/ / gsang chen gdams pa'i dga' ston lhug par stsol/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgon me thugs rje'i gter/ /bka' drin dran pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig rnam par dag / mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ / gsang chen lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ / zung 'jug go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / 'dren pa khyod kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi myang ba yis/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog chosaldan gyis211

༄/ /yo cabayopa'icanama'i ga 'phagabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o// / /mu tig phreng ldan 'o ma'i chu gter dbus/ /'dab ma stong ldan pad dkaranye ba la/ /nya gang bsil zer byed pa'i dkyil 'khor steng / /rab dkar dzī yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mtshungs med mkhyen pa'i gter/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bcu drug lang tsho gsar pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /sku mdog rab dkar phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyis/ /shes rab ral gris mtshan pa'i yutpal dag /g.yon pa chos 'chad phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / dri med nor bu'i do shal g.yo ldan zhing / / 'od brgya'i snang ba spro bzhin bzhugs pa yi/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dbyer med du/ / gyur te bsod nams zhing du brtan par bzhugs/ /yid 'ong mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /yan lag drug cu'i sgra dbyangs rdzogs pa'i gsung / /dri med mkhyen dang brtse pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /bcas rang nyes ltung dri ma snying nas bshags/ /bskal brgyar bzhugs te chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba rdzogs byang rgyu ru bsngo/ /gzhan yang lhun po gling bzhi nyi zla bcas/ /rang lus longs spyod dge tshogs kun 'bul na/ /zab gsal myur ba'i shes rab snang ba yis/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i dra ba bsal du gsol/ /oṃ wa kye de na ma zhesaci 'grub bzla/ de'ang 'di'i klad kor ngesacan du nar bklag dgos te/ wa kye ngag la 'jug pas ngag gi dbang phyug gam dngosagrub dang / de zhesapa'i yoshesasosor phral na da na zhes ba sbyin pa la 'jug pasade ltar sbrel dgosal/ rang gi sde ba'i lnga par klag /212

༄/ /blaba'irnal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byungakaces kyang 'byung bas so/ / de na4yig brgyasalhag chad bskang la/ nor bu'i 'khri shing bzhad pa'i rtse mo na/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ / bcom ldan ngag gi dbang phyug mkhyen pa'i gter/ / brtse bas dgongs te bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / zab cing rgya che pha rol phyin pa'i lam/ / mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas btab rdo rje'i theg yan lag thun mong rig gnas bzhi la sogs/ / ji bzhin 'byed pa'i shes rab stsal tu gsol/ /'chad la mi 'jigs spobs pa'i lus stobs rdzogs/ / rtsod ngag nga ros phas rgol klad pa 'gems/ / sdeb legs rtsom pa ral pa'i khur 'chang ba'i/ / smra ba'i seng ge mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ / mdor na deng nas skye zhing skye ba ru/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma khyod kyis rjes bzung ste/ / legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myang ba las/ / sa dang lam gyi bgrod ba mthar phyin shog / ces 'jam dbyangs dkar po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong blobazang dkon mchog gi4bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /'gog med mchog tu dwangs pa'i yid mkha' la/ / ral pa'i khur 'chang gdong lnga 'bar ba'i khri/ / ma snyigs 'dab brgya'i phreng ldan rnam gsum gyi/ / dbus su rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / ngur smrig gar bsgyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / g.yas su kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / g.yon na rje btsun bstan pa'i sgron me rnams/ / thugs rje'i 'dzum dkar spro bzhin bzhugs pa yi/ / khor yug dngos rgyud bla ma yi dam sogs/ / skyabs yul mtha' klas sprin ltar gtibs pa rnams/ / bgrang du med pa rab 'byams bskal pa'i bar/ / bdag cag bsod nams zhing du bzhugs su gsol/ / mkha' dbyings gcig la nyi zla rgyu 213

༄/ /gung thangabamapa'itshonashā' ga 'phagaskar sogs/ / sna tshogs rol pa kun tu ston pa ltar/ / rnam pa tha dad skyabs gnas kun gyi dngos/ / rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi ngagi lhag mar gyur pa rgyal ba'i bstan/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin pa la/ /ma smad snying stobs mchog gi dpal mnga' ba/ /thub bstan rtsa lag gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / nam mkha'i mtha' klas kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /rang gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i dngos por bcas/ /bsod nams zhing mchog khyed la gus 'bul na/ / thug4rjes bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / mu med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /blang dor gnas la kun nas rmongs pa'i mthus/ / brnag dka'i sdug bsngal skyed pa'i las bsags pa/ / kun kyang khyod kyi thugs rjes byang bar mdzod/ / phul byung grags pa'i gzhir gyur mdzad pa'i mchog /legasagasung bdud rtsi'i dra ba 'gyed pa yis/ /lus can yid kyi gdung ba rab bcil nas/ rnam grol kurdo'i skyed tshal bzhad par mdzod/ / legs byas kha ba'i rdul brtsegs te se'i ri/ / legs smon drod kyis zhu ba'i gaṅgā mas/ / nyes ltung dug can dri ma rab sbyangs nas/ / dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rnyed par shog /de tshe 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras kye/ /zhabs rdul rnyog pa med pa gus bsten nas/ /tshang la ma nor bstan pa'i gnad kun la/ /thos bsam sgom bas tshul bzhin slob par shog / de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan la slob pa na/ /phyi rol nyer 'tshe'i bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /chos brgyad 'ching ba'i slad pa mi 'jug par/ / rnam dag chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /srid gsum mtha' dag dmyal ba'i btson ra dang / /sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bur mthong ba yi/ / nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba la/ /rtsol med myong ba brtan po rnyed par shog /de ltar thun mong lam gyis 214

༄/ /blama'irnal 'byoradangosakhyabakun 'byungakargyudasrin tshe/ / dpal ldan bla ma thugs rje'i gter chen rnams/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por legs bzhengs te/ / gsang ba mchog gi lam du 'khrid par shog / de nas rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / las rlung rgyu ba kun rtog phra mor bcas/ / yongs su dag pa'i rten dang brten pa kun/ / bde ba'i rol pa gcig tu 'char bar shog / mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / khyod kyis dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes bzung mthus/ / gcig tu dge ba'i lam la rab zhugs nas/ / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa bka' bcu 'jam dbyangasabakra shisakyisamaṇḍal dang thub pa'i sku brnyan bcas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar ba'o/ / / /skyabasasemasasngon du btang la/ /spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med bcom ldan klu yi dbang / / nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zla ba'i zhal/ / klu rnams dbugs 'byin phyag rgya can/ / chos gos dmar po gsum gsol zhing / / brgya rtsa bcu gnyis mtshan dpes spras/ / rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / / gnas rnams 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i/ / hūṃ yig 'od kyis ye shes pa/ / sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ /dbyer med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / byin rlabs bdud rtsis char rgyun gyis/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun sel zhing / / phan bde'i dga' ston stsol mdzad pa/ / klu dbang rgyal por gus phyag 'tshal/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs kun/ / dmigs med thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ / las ngan lan chags kyis bskyed pa'i/ / klu gnyan sa bdag gnod pa sogs/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus pa/ / rgyu bcas byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs 215

༄/ /yo cabasaba'ilhanama'i tsha 'chagate/ / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang bar bsam la/ taduthā/ oṃ ta thā ga tabha ga wān nā ga rā dze shā ra a dhiṣā na a dhiṣṭha te swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/dge 'dis tshe rabs thams cad du/ / dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob cing / /bcom ldan klu dbang rgyal po yis/ / 'bral med rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / yul phyogs 'dir yang nad mug sogs/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun zhi ste/ / sbrang rtsi can gyi zhing khams ltar/ / bde skyid dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni ming gan shog nasadad ldan dge slong blo bzang bsod nams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla dang / / khri snyan sa la'i pags pa'i gdan steng du/ / skyabs gsum ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med grub mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rje ni/ / sku mdog sngo bsangs skem zhing gzi byin 'bar/ / dka' thub spyod pa'i drang srong rnam pa can/ / g.yas pa'i phyag gi thal mo 'gram par brten/ / g.yon na bde skyong bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan bsnams/ / ka sha'i ras dkar 'dab ma'i na bza' gsol/ / lcang lo sil bur grol bas sku stod khebs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i klu dbyangs lhang lhang sgrogs/ / skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa yi/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhing nas ye shes pa/ / 'khor bcas spyan drangs dbyer med bstim par gyur/ / dkon mchog kun 'dus mi bskyod rgyal ba'i dbang / / gsangs chen bstan pa'i sgon me sbar ba'i phyir/ / grub pa'idabang phyug gar gyes rnam rol pa/ / bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi/ / mchod tshogs kun 216

༄/ /blama'i3la 'byoradangosakhrubakun 'byungaka'abul sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i dka' thub kyi/ /spyod pa bsam mi khyab la rjes yi rang / / zab rgyas gdams pa'i dga' ston mchog stsol cing / / bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'dis mtshon dge bas bdag sogs 'gro kun kyang / / tshe rabs 'phreng bar khyod kyis rjes 'dzin shog / grub pa'i dpa' bo khyod kyi rnam thar bzhin/ / mdo sngags lam bzang gegs med myur bgrod de/ / mi bskyod rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgol gyur cig / de ltar gsol ba btab pas tshangs bug nas/ / snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ / byon nas dbyer med brtan par bzhugs pa yis/ / yang dag lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar shog / cesapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa ri khrod pa dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog gisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyobrisapa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru mu ni yi chu ya/ de'ang 'di phyi'i legasatshog4ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ theg pa mchog gi lam gyi lus/ dngosagrubathamasacad kyi rtsa ba/ lam zabapobla ma lha'i rnal 'byor nyamasasulen par 'dod pas/ sngon 'grosbyor ba'i chosarnamasatshagasasu tshud parabyus la/ srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus pa sel zhing / 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde ma lu4pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul phyin ci ma log pa 'di la rag lasapar rgyal bsamado rgyud thamasacad nasamathun par gsungasashing / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegasapa'i dam pa gong mthamasacad kyisakyang sku nyamasasubastar ba'i tshul bsam ste ngesashesathun mong ma yin pa bskyed/de nasarang rgyud la bskor te brtag pa na/ nyon mongs pa'i gdon chen phugs su zhugasapa'i dbang gis/ rang gi snang tshul thams cad bdenabaden ltabu dang / bla ma'i mdzad pa skyon dang bcasapar mthong ba'i tshe blongan 'dis ni rang nyid phung grol chen po la spyor ba'i bdud kyi byed pa lta4ngan gyi gtso bo yin snyam du / dam pa gong ma mang po'i lo rgyus217

༄/ /yo cabs༅ yo sa ཿmasogasadang sbyar la rigalopa'i rnam grangasadu ma'i sgo nas bkag ste/ /sangs rgyas dngosasu mthong ba'i moyopa dang / sangasargyasathamasacad kyi 'dul ba'i zhing du ma gyur pa na/ bla ma 'dis ni rang dang skal ba 'tsham pa'i skur bstan te rgyal ba'i mdzad pa thamasacad bsgrub pas/ bka' drin gyi ngosanayosangasargyasathamasacad lasakyang lhag pa yin no snyam du gusapa bskyed la/ dngosagazhi ni skyabs semasasngon du 'gro ba4tshig don dran bzhin par/ mdun gyi mkha' la seng khri pad zla'i steng / / skyabs gsum kun 'dus ngo bo bla ma lha/ /g.yas g.yon chos 'chad skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad/ / chos gos gsum gsol gser mdog paṇa zhwas mdzes/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung sogs/ /mkha' dbyings khyab pas bskor te brtan par bzhugs/ /bslu med 'dren pa dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srog shing zla med pa/ /thar 'dod snying gi mun sel sgron me mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs la/ /sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / / 'khor ba ma stongs bar du rtag bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ / sa gzhi spos kyes byugs shing me tog bkram/ /zhes pa nas/ spyod par shog /khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam khyod ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste/ /zhe4pa nas/ bar gcod srungs/ lan gsum/byin rlabs dngos grub gter chen bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyes rlobs/ / ngan song 'khor ba'i gnas las yid 'byung 218

༄/ /blasa'irnal 'byoradangosagrubakun 'byungakabs/ /blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / rin chen byang chub sems kyi rgyas btab ste/ / dam chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyes rlobs/ /dngos 'dzin gdon chen bdud kyi dpung bcom ste/ / lam la bar chad med par byin gyis zlobs/ / rab dkar bdud rtsis bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ / rgyal ba'i gzugs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / bdud rtsi dmar pos gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ / rgyal gsung longs sku 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ / sngon pos shes rab ye shes dbang bskur te/ / thugs mchog chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / rnam gsum bdud rtsis bzhi pa'i dbang bskur pas/ / sku thugs zung 'jug 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun/ / ma lus lhag med zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ / bde blag nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / dus dang gnas skabs kun tu khyod min pa/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma mchog / dgyes bzhin byu tī'i lam nas snying gar byon/ / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi snying gar padma'i gdan bzhugs la/ / bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ / sku gsung thugs kye dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / gong gi phyag 'tshal gsol 'debasasubasgyur ba grangasagasog dang / mthar/ tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma yis/ / theg mchog bshesaganyen zhesasogasadang / dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ /zhes sogasadang / skye ba kun tu zhesasogasabasngo smon gyis mtshamasasbyor zhing / rgyun du'ang snying dbus kyi bla ma'i 'du shesam brjed pas/ de nyid dbang por byasate dge sdigagi blang dor la bag zon byed cing / spyod lam kun dude la brten pa'i tshogasagasog sgrigaspyong gi nyam4len chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar bya'o/ /zhesazama'i rnal 219

༄/ /gung cabastanapa'itshonace' sa gartsaga'abyor shin tu bsdusapa mdo sngagasaspyi'i lam gyi 'gros dang sbyar ba 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangasapa rdo ram pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyiyobaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad tshang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/ na mo gu ru mu nīnd+ra badzra dhā rā ya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / ngo bo dbyer med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ / gser gye mdog can sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /thugs gar khyab bdag dpal ldan te ru ka / /sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan bde stong rol pas dgyes/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lo ma lus pa/ / spyan drangs dbyer med gcig tu 'dus pa yis/ / skyabs gnas kun gyi bdag nyid thugs rje'i gter/ /bdag gi bsod nams zhing du brtan par bzhugs/ / cher snyigs lnga bdo'i 'gro ba mgon med la/ / thar pa'i lam bzang ji bzhin ston pa yis/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub mdzad pa/ /bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa yi/ / theg ṭwāṃrte sdi rte ༵༷ṭwāṃ dī ༷ /kyi /ṭwāṃX de bye~X hūṃni/༷༵/༷༷ /dīX ༷༷ bheṭwāṃ /༷༷/ pa'i sprin du legs bstar nas/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i yid kyis 'bul lags na/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes te byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / / mi rtag las 'bras bsam nas 'di phyi yi/ /snang shas bzlog ste 'khor ba me 'obs ltar/ /mthong ba'i nges 'byung 220

༄/ /blama'i3la 'byoradangosakhyabakun 'byungakaskye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ / rin chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / / srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin byed pa'i/ / yang dag lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / tha mal snang zhen spyong ba'i bskyed rim dang / / rlung sems dbu mar gzhug byed dben pa gsum/ / zhugs las sgyu 'od zung 'jug skur ldang ba'i/ / rim gnyis rnal 'byor 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na blo bzang rgyal bstan snying bo'i bcud/ / ma tshang med par thos bsam sgom pa yis/ / nyams su blangs te bshad sgrub mthar phyin nas/ / don gnyis lhun gyes grub par byin gyes rlobs/ / zhes pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes sogs kyis snying gar bstem zhing tshe rabasarjesa'adzin gyi smon pas mtsham4sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhesalam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad cha tshang ba dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ 7'jam mgon rgyalab gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa sum pa mkhan chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas gser gyi me tog dang bcasabaskul ma gnang ba'i bzhed pa ba'in/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4bris pa'o// / /chos dbyings spros dang bral pa lha yi lam/ / bde chen snying rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i klong / / mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gdong lnga 'bar ba'i khri/ / srid pa'i skyon bral yid 'ong 'dab brgya pa/ / thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ / zhi khro rab 'byams skyabs gnas ma lus pa/ /dbyer med gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / zhi zhing dul la dgyes pa'i nyams dang ldan/ / thugs rje'i spyan gyis mkha' mnyam 'gro la gzigs/ / nges don rdo rje thal mo'i spyor ba yis/ / bden zung gnyis su mi phyed rdo rje 'dzin/ / paṇa zhwas gtsug mdzes 221

༄/ /gung cagasapa'icaname'i ga las/chosagos gsum gsol zhing / /mi phyed rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /gnas lngar ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ / rigs lnga'i rang bzhin sa bon lngas mtshan pa'i/ /hūṃ yig 'od kyis lhun grub chos dbyings nas/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes pa/ / mtha' dag spyan drangs dbyer med bhebyebye byerte ṭwāṃbheX/ ༷/tt+waṃ ༷ sdi bye rdobhe /llī sdi ༷/bye snyeshaṃ ༷ bheṭwāṃ/ bhe/ phyogs 'dzin ma'i khyon kun la/ / thub bstan snying po nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / rab 'byams phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi/ /mchod tshogs ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul/ / rgya chen nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin mthus/ / byin gyis brlabs te dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad dang / /khyad par sdom gsum bcas 'gal nyes pa kun/ /shugs drag gdung ba'i yid kyis mthol lo bshags/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyes rlobs/ / bdag gis dus gsum dge tshogs ci bgyis pa / /de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru/ /mgon po khyod kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / bka' bzhin sgrub pa lhur len rgyur gyur cig / nges 'byungasang sems zab mo'i lta ba sogs/ / thun mong lam sbyang rim pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /gsang chen theg pa mchog gi sgor zhugs te/ /dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin bsrung gyur cig / thabs shes zung 'brel zab mo'i myur lam gyis/ / ring min srid pa'i rgya mtsho mthar byas te/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ / 'gro kun thar pa'i gling du 'khrid gyur cig /222

༄/ /blama'i3la 'byoradangosakhrubakun 'byungakacesabla ma rang gi snying gar spyan drangasapar bsamasal/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa zhes sog4dang / skye ba kun tu zhes sogasasmon lamagyisamatshamasasbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen mtshungs zla mamachisapa rje btsun dam pa blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug 'jigalomed rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhal snga na4la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni hal ha khyare chen mo'i grwa rigasadad ldan dge slong dkon mchog dge legasakyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /na mo gu ru badzra dhā ra su ma ti wa gimi ya/ dag pa rab 'byams byed po bdeb che/ spros bral dbyings su rtsen pa'i sgyu 'phrul las/ / 'byams klas kunabazang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ / seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng / /rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang zhabs/ / thal mo bsnol te zab rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / chos gos gsum 'chang paṇa zhwa leb mor gsol/ / rab dgyes 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yis/ / dpral mgrin thugs gar rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ / yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / skyabs gnas ma lus ṭwāṃbye dītt+waṃ ༷ mche rdo| ༷/ dī/༷ zlobhebye ṭwāṃsdub/ /ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༷ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ~X hūm̐ ༷ niX ༷ gsol ba 'debs/ / cher snyigs dmu rgod gdul dka'i 'gro ba la/ / rgyal kun thugs bcud gdams pa'i mchog stsal te/ / skal ba ji bzhin srid zhi'i rgud pa las/ / sgol mdzad skyabs kyi dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ / bslu med thugs rje'i gter chen mgon khyod kyis/ / 'bral med byang chub bar du rjes 'dzin cing / / 'khrul med 'jam mgon zhal lung bdud rtsi'i chus/ / thog 223

༄/ /gung bangabastanaba'isgronace' ga las/med las nyon dri ma byang bar mdzod/ / lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos/ / mtha' dag zhum med blo yis legs 'bul na/ / zag med bde chen ngang du rnam rol cing / / mthar thug byang chen rgyu ru smin par mdzod/ / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing zhesasogs kyis maṇḍal dbul/ gsol 'deb4kyi bzlasabarjod bya bar 'dod na/ mdo rgyud man ngag cesasogayokyi sho lo ka de grangasagasog nas bzla/ phra rags srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal gyi bar/ / bla ma yi dam chos srung kun gyi dngos/ / 'dren pa khyod min skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag gis drang du gsol/ / dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus dang / / nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba'i gnad/ /zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor la sogs pa/ / lam bzang gegs med skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na mgon khyod thugs rje'i sprin phung las/ /mchog thun dngos grub gru char 'jo ba yis/ / phan dang bde ba'i dga' tshal rgyas gyur te/ / bla med thar pa'i 'bras bzang smin gyur cig / de nasazam rangagisnyi bo nasamar phebasate snying gar rang sems dang dbyer med du bzhugasapa'i mosapa byas la/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi snying gar zhesasog4dang / tshe rabasarjesa'adzin gyi smon pasamatshamasasbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyun du zasagos gnas mal sogasagang la longasaspyod pa na snying ga'i bla ma la dbul ba'i dmigasapa chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bzhin du byasan dkor sgrib spyong zhing rang gzhan gnyis ga'i tshogasardzogs pa dang / bla ma rjesasudran pa dang mi 'bral zhing dgye4bzhin rjesasu'adzinapa'i rten 'brel gye sgo khyagapar can yod pa thab4sna tshogasakyisasgo nasadal 'byor la snying po blang bar bya'o/ / zhesarje btsun bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po chosabargyad kyi snang ba btsan chod du byed pa'i rje btsun mi la gnyis pa klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang blo bzang pa'i zhal snga nasakyi zama'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ rje btsunade nyid la rtse gcig tu mos guyocan kha kya'i raba'abyamasapa blo bzang brtson 224

༄/ /blasa'i3la 'byoradangosakhrubakun 'byungaka'agrugakyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesadaben gan4yid dga' chosa'adzin nasabri4pa'o/ / / /rang gi spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ / rdor sems dkar po phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin/ / gri thod 'dzin mdzad dbyings kyi dbang mos 'khyud/ / de yi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ / slar yang 'od 'phros rdo rje gsum gyi lha'i/ / thugs ga'i yig brgya dkar dmar mthing ga'i tshogs/ / spyan drangs spyi bo'i rdor sems gnas gsum du/ / 'khod pa'i bdud rtsis lus kun gang bar gyur/ / mi bzad nyes ltung dri ma kun sel zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol mdzad pa/ / bla ma rdo je sems dpar gus phyag 'tshal/ / rang gzhan sdig ltung byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol btab spyi bo'i rdor sems las/ / 'gro drug grangs snyed rdor sems yab yum spros/ / kun gyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nyes kun byang bar gyur/ / de na4yig brgya bzla/ rdor sems 'od du zhu bas 'gro ba kun/ / de yi skur bzhengs de dag thams cad kyang / / gcig bsdus rang la thim pas rang nyid dang / / rdor sems dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba'i tshe rabs kun tu yang / / bla ma rdo rje sems dpas rjes bzung ste/ / rnam dag dam tshig sdom pa'i gru gzings la/ / brten nas zung 'jug nor bu'i gling bgrod shog / ces pa 'di ni or du su dar had shog gi dge slong rin chen bzang po dang / dge slong dkon mchog chosa'aphel gnyisakyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /225

༄/ /gung bsaba'itshanama'i tsha lagache dpag med dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i la 'byor bzhugs/bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mdun gyi nam mkhar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rma byas btegs ba'i khri la pad zla'i steng / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /gnyis su med pa bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas/ /nyi 'od stong 'bar byu ru'i lhun po bzhin/ /sku mdog dmar gsal mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis brjid/ /mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bsnams/ /lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du/ /yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /bde ldan zhing nas mgon po tshe dpag med/ /spyan drangs dam tshig ༷ rdo dī ༷ dīdī /du dhī~X/ theg/༵ dī dīdal dīkodī ༷༵/ ༷sum dī ༷ ༷ ༵ dī/khrid/ dīdzad didī ༵ dīṭwāṃ~Xsame yi/ choṭwāṃl ngo/ ༵hūṃsdi ༷ chodī dīdīg spridid la rdoX ༷rdoX rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ / blo yis blangs te gus pas 'bul lags na/ /brtse bas bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las skyobs pa dang / / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'grub pa'i phyir/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /thugs rjes myur ba myur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab bas bum nang dang / /thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng 'od kyis rang gi tshe/ /nyams pa gsos shing brtan g.yo'i byin rlabs bcud/ / tshe dpal kun bsdus rang la 226
