༄/ /blama'inal 'byoradangos grubakun 'byung /thim par gyur/ / cesargyal ba srasabaca4kyi byin rlabs/ lhadang drang srong 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ 'byung ba lnga'i bcud/ rang gi tshe sngar god pa rnams dang bcayopa bsdusate sngagasa'aphreng la thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebasapa'am/ dang po nasarang la bstem pasalegasatshogasakyi yon tan thamasacad rgyas shing / slan chad 'tshe ba gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i srung ba chen por gyur par bsams la gzungasaring thung rnams bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyasalhag chad bskang / tshe dpag med mgon bdud rtsir zhu ba'i rgyun/ / tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang ba yis/ / mi shigs g.yung drung tshe yi rten gyur cing / / gsang gsum byin rlabs ma lus thob par gyur/ / cesabarjod cing de ltar bsamasal/dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na/ / de yi mod la tshe dpag med mgon sku/ / zhes sogasadang / tshe rabs kun tu tshe dpag med pa yis/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen dngos su mdzad pa'i mthus/ / zhe4sogs smon pasamatshamasasbyar bar bya'o/ /zhesapa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa yomo sprul pa'i sku blo bzang dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi4bskul ba bzhin 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesaXsgor ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /gsum /ṭwāṃX dzhai dīshid bde dīn blo 'a ༷༷ngalo ༵la steX ga/ nyi/sa dīb sdu dkotrī ༵ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ/༵ ༵ ༷spya rdo 'imaṭwāṃdī di rdo gaphyag /༵ ṭwāṃ nadul dudī sa/ ༵༵ dī ༷༵ ṭwāṃ~X /ba'i/ 'khor lor bcas/ / mi bdag gi mgon du rtag par bzhugs/ / ches snyigs ma bdo ba'i dus mtha' 'dir/ / yongs thub bstan snying po dri ma med/ / bshad sgrub pas nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ / rje thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / blos 227

༄/ /yo thang bstanapa'itshonas g.yo ཿmablangs te gus pas 'bul lags na/ / thugs brtse ba chen pos legs bzhes nas/ /mchog thar pa'i rgyu ru byin gyis rlobs/ / dus ya mtha' gtugs pa med pa nas/ / sems nyon mongs bran du gyur pa yis/ / las sdig pa'i dngos po gang bgyes pa/ /yid 'gyod pas mthol lo byang bar mdzod/ /rgyu med par 'gro la mnyes gshin pa/ / mgon rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang / /rje bla ma'i rnam par thar ba la/ / sems rtse gcig dad pas rjes yi rang / /dus ring nas 'gro ba'i dug gsum gyi/ / nad gdung ba sel ba'i thugs bskyed bzhin/ /chos zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i gter phye ste/ / las nyon mongs nyes kun spyang du gsol/ / dge 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa yi/ /las rnam dkar phung po bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / yongs legs tshogs rtsa ba drin can rje/ / bsam sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten par shog / dus rtag tu dal 'byor rten thob cing / / tshe 'di snang gdon gyis mi bslu bar/ /las rgyu 'bras ngang tshul legs bsam nas/ / skyabs mchog gsum gtsug gis sten gyur cig / gnas 'khor ba gshin rje'i btson ra la/ /yid gting nas log pa'i nges 'byung gis/ / lam bslab gsum gru gzings la zhugs nas/ / mchog thar pa'i gling du bgrod gyur cig / ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /snying brtse ba'i gzhan dbang gyur pa yis/ /lam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ / yongs rgyal sras spyod la slob gyur cig /rgyu'i theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / ches zab gsang myur ba gsang sngags kyi/ / sgor zhugs nas dam tshig legs bsrung zhing / / lam rim gnyis spyod la slob gyur cig / da mdor na blo dman byis pa bdag /sngar dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob kyang / / dus de ring yan chad stong par zad/ /deng tshe lhag chos kyis 'da' bar shog / mgon rgyal kun thugs kyi 2༅

༄/ /blasa'irnal 'byoradangosakhyabakun 'byung bcud bsdus pa/ / rje blo bzang bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / / sngon ji bzhin bsgrub par ma nus pas/ / da tshul bzhin nyams su lon par shog /lam 'khrul bral tshang la ma nor ba/ / rje blo bzang rgyal ba'i bka' rgyud kyi/ /lam bzang po phyogs brgyar spel ba yis/ /ma 'gro kun srid las sgrol gyur cig / ceyopa 'di ni gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang phyugayogrwa tshang 'og gi slob zur lharam pa 'phrin lasadapal bzang / mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid grwa tshang bla ma zhab4drung 'jam dbyangasargya mtsho/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangasapa gzhung lasapa 'jam dbyangasabazang po rnamasakyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gser dgon dga' ldan dam chosagling du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagayoram pa ratna ā na 'o/ / / /229

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'izla sa gsung 'thug༄7/ / mgon po 'od dpag med la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /srid mtsho nyam ngar 'gyu ba'i 'gro ba la/ / rjes chags thugs rje'i spyan zur gtod bzhin du/ / 'phrin las kyo bas rtag tu gzas pa yi/ / 'dren mchog snang mtha' yas pas rjes su zungs/ / de'ang mgon po 'od dpag med la brtenapa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ / spyir gamig4skor sogasayig chung du byayopa blo la nges thog gzhung dngos gzhi ngag 'don byas na 'jug pa bde'ang /phal cher yig chung rnams mi dgosapa zhig tu go nas don du mi 'gyur ba mang zhing /dmigs skor 'phral du gsal ma thebs kyang tshig tsam yang yang bskyar na rim gyi4rgyud la 'char ba 'byung bas/ 'dir dkyus gcig tu ngag 'don byed rgyu'i dbang du btang ste lhug par 'god pa la/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyan rang chos srung dang bcas skyabs yul nam mkha'i khams gang ba bkra lam me bzhugs par gyur/ rang dang rang gi mtha' skor na gnas pa'i pha ma rigasadrug gi sems can 'di dag thams cad thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi dbang tu gyur te/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sa chen po'i rdul bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bsags/ de'i dbang gis dmyal bar me nang du bar mtshams med par btso bsreg 'ba' zhig gi ngang la bskal pa bye ba phrag 230

༄/ / blama'irnal 'byor zhingasachogasgo spyod/khrig mang por gnas pa sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa zhig myong du zin yang / da dung dal 'byor yud tsam pa lan gcig thob pa'i steng 'dir btsan sa zhig ma zin na/'di nas rdog sna gcig 'dred ma thag ngan song gi g.yang sa brgyud ma nas brgyud mar lhung ste bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal shugs drag la yun ring po'i pha mthar phyin dus shig mi yong bar 'dug des na 'jigs pa chen po de las skyob pa'i skyabs shig da lta nyid du btsal dgos shing / de'ang skyabs dkon mchog gsum las gzhan na med de/ khong rnams kyi ngos nas sngar rgyu tshogs thams cad bsgrubs yod pa la/rang gis blo ma gtad pas lan par 'dug pas/ da ni skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyed shes kyis blo lings kyis bkal te/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ / khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa sras kyi thu bo gnyis la sogs pa 'khor rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / yang bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes sogs gsum mam bdun sogs bya/ de nas/ phul byung mdzad pas 'gro la mi zad dpal ster zhing / / lan gcig dran pas 'chi bdag 'jigs pa ring du dor/ /rtag tu brtse bas 'gro la bu bzhin dgongs gyur pa/ / lha mi'i ston pa tshe dpag med la skyabs su mchi/ / thub pa'i dbang pos lan grangs du ma ru/legs par yongs su bsngags pa'i zhing gi mchog / bde ba can du skye phyir smon pa yi/ / re ba ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / rigs drug dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can 'di dag thams cad bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pa la/ da lta ni sdug bsngal gyis mnar zhing bde bas shin tu phongs par 'dug / brgya la zag bcas 'khor ba'i bde ba tsam 231

༄/ /yo cabasasgo ma'i sa lagathob kyang yid brtan med pas bslu brid kho na yin/ des na nye ring med par sems can 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi ming yang mi grags shing / bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas las slar mi ldog pa dag pa'i zhing bde ba can du khrid de rim gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis lam zab mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor 'di'i sgo nas 'dren pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang myur ba myur bar mngon du byed nus pa zhig byung na ci ma rung / de ltar byed nus par shog cig /de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pas rang nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad kyang 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur/ces tshad med pa bzhi'i tshul gyis sems bskyed pa 'bra4bu lam byed dang bcas gnad du 'gro nges byasal de'i ngang du dar cig bzhag / dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang / chos kyi dbyings rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i stobs las mdun gyi nam mkhar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gye phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la hrī yig dmar po de yongs su gyur ba las/ bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan zhing mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ sku la chos gos dmar po gsol zhing 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs 232

༄/ /blasa'irnal 'byor zhingamachogasgo 'byed/bcur 'phro ba'i klong na shin tu dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang bcas te rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dang g.yon du mthu chen thob la sogs pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ nub phyogs bde ba can nas mgon po 'od dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/'di nas nub phyogs bde ldan zhing khams na/ / 'tsho bzhes 'gro ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med/ / brtse ldan rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshogs bcas la/ / rgyang nas 'o dod 'bod do dgongs su gsol/ / blang dor gnas rnams ma rig mthug pos bsgribs/ / khong khro'i mtshon gyis mtho ris srog 'phrog cing / / 'dod sred zhags pas 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings/ / las kyis chu bos srid pa'i rgya mtshor khyer/ / na rga'i sdug bsngal rba rlabs mang pos g.yengs/ / mi bzad 'chi bdag chu srin khar chud pas/ / mi 'dod sdug bsngal khur gyis non gyur pa/ / mgon med bdag gis nyam thag nga ro yis/ / yid la smon pa 'grub pa'i dpang po ru/ / phongs pa'i gnyen gcig 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal sras mthu chen thob/ / 'khor dang bcas la gus pas gsol 'debs na/ / dpag med bskal par bdag cag rnams kyi phyir/ / thugs mchog bskyed pa'i dam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ /'dababazang gtso bo lha yi lam la bzhin/ / rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis brtse bas 'dir gshegs shig / jo rtu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ yang dag lam bzang ston mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel dam pa'i chos/ / blang dor sgrubs pa'i grogs gyur dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gi 233

༄/ /yo bsaba'isgroname'i sa 'gamatshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / / phra rags 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol te/ / zag med bde ba mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ / bla ma 'od dpag dībhe dhi phyagang ditsha ༵nga ༷/jig/༷ byā ༵ bye /༷ṭwāṃ /dīX bogaṭwāṃm 'asde/ ༷ṭwāṃ rsha ༷ rsha ༷ṭwāṃ ༈ tta༈ ༵ṭwāṃ nam nghru/ 'ong/ lda rji sa'o rsha /rdogag ṭwāṃdī ༵ ༷ dhri ༵༵ ༵༷sa/ te/ dbulabar bgyi/ / bdag sogs 'gro ba'i bsod nams rdzogs slad du/ /thugs rje'i gter chen nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig / khyad par rang gzhan dge ba'i char gtogs kun/ / dbul lo khyod thugs zag med dge ba'i mtshor/ / 'dres te nam yang chud mi za ba dang / / khyod bzhed 'bras bu kun gyi rgyur gyur cig / gting mtha' med pa ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa ru/ /sdig pa'i las kye gar stabs bsgyur ba yi/ / spyon pa bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ / shes rgyud sdig dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dug gsum nad kyi gdung sel skyabs gcig khyod/ / sku yi bkod pa g.yo med rtag bzhugs te/ / ring nas 'gro la phan dgongs thugs bskyed bzhin/ / zab rgyas chos kyi sman mchog stsal tu gsol/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba bcad du gsol/ / dngos 'dzin rmongs pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ / gces 'dzin 'gong po'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / yang dag lam bzang sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ / snang ba mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon/ / 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ / stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ / de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi/ / de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ / 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang / / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / / de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi/ / bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag pas/ /234

༄/ / blama'i rnal 'byor zhingamachogasgo 'byed/kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis/ / bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ / thugs rjes spyod pa ma 'khrul ba/ / spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / / nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ / sdig ldan bdag la skyabs su gsol/ / 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / / sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ / thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ / skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ / gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi/ / pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ / skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa/ / rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ / sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ / da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ / khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ / 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa nye sras brgyad la sogs pa'i rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par gyur par bsamasa'i/ bslu med dkon mchog cemasogs kyi sho lo ka de/ phyag 'tshal zhesapa gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba gang mang dang / bla ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do/ / skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes grangs gsog / tshe gzungs/ yig drug / badzra pā ṇi sogs bzlas la spyi'i dmigayopa snga ma'i steng du 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang / rab tu rnam 'byed kyi yoshes/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ chos sgrub pa la gdon bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i nus mthu thob pa sogs skabs thob kyi dmigs pa gang mos su sbyar kyang rung ngo / mjug tu yi ge brgya 235

༄/ /gung cabalomi'icanama'i ga las/ba ci 'grub bzla/ rang gi lu4longs spyod tham4cad blos ling skyur gyis skyabasayul rnams la phul bar mo4te/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ / sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / gnas ngan 'khor ba dgra bo'i btson rwa 'dir/ / bde ba'i go skabs nam yang ma mchis pas /ded dpon mtshungs med bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du drang du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim zhing / de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon nas bzhugs/ de'irtsa dbu ma stod phra zhing smad yangs pa'i mar sna dang / rang gi lus kyang shel sgong bzhin du dwangs shing gsal ba'i nang gi dbu ma smad phra zhing stod sbom pa'i yar sne gnyis dbyer med du 'dres/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi thugs gar hrī yig dang / rang gi snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i rnam pa gsal bar gyur/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / 'di snang 'khrib chod par byin gyis rlobs/ / las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / ngan song skye sgo khegs par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhing mchog bde ba can der 'khrid du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa na thugs ga'i tī yig gi 'od zer sdom gyi ba thag ltabus rang semayothig ler gsal ba la reg pasakhab len gyis lcagasakhye drangs pa bzhin cung zad re sbar ba'i dmigasapa byasate hi ka dang / rang gan4su phab stoka zhesabarjod pa spel nas lan gsum sogs bya/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa de nyid 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'od du zhu ba dbu ma'i lam nas zhugs te tshangs pa'i bu ga khrigs kyis gtams par gyur/ zhesabarjod cing bsams/ de nas rgya4par byed na/236

༄/ / blasa'irnal 'byor zhingamachogasgo 'byed/bdag dang gzhan gyi dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i zhes sogasabade smon yongs rdzogs dang / bsdu na/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /padmodam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ / snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sumadu/ / lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog / nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba na/ / 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i 'od dpag med/ / mig gi lam du gsal bar mthong gyur nas/ / dad dang snying rjes bdag rgyud gang bar shog / bar do'i snang ba shar bar gyur ma thag / rgyal sras brgyad kyis ma nor lam bstan te/ / bde ba can du skyes nas sprul pa yis/ / ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba 'dren gyur cig / ji srid thub mchog go 'phang dam pa de/ / bdag gis mngon du ma byas de srid du/ / rnam dag lam bzang sgrub pa'i rten rnyed cing / / rab tu 'byung zhing tshe rabs dran par shog / gzungs spobs ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ / mtha' yas yon tan du ma'i mdzod 'dzin cing / / mkhyen brtse nus pa zla dang bral thob nas/ / byang chub spyod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na/ / de yi mod la tshe dpag med mgon sku/ / gsal bar mthong nas 'chi bdag dpa' bcom ste/ / 'chi med rig 'dzin myur du thob par shog / tshe rabs kun tu tshe dpag med pa yis/ / theg mchog bshes gnyen dngos su mdzad pa'i mthus/ / rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang de nyid las/ / skad cig tsam yang ldog par ma gyur cig / sems can yal bar dor nas rang don la/ / re ba'i blo ni nam yang mi skye zhing / /gzhan don bsgrub pa'i tshul la ma rmongs pa'i/ / thabs la mkhas pas gzhan don lhur len shog / bdag gi ming tsam brjod dang dran pas kyang / / sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bus mnar ba kun/ / phun tshogs bde ba'i dpal rab 237

sa / /gung thangabastananga'atshonaza' gsung 'buma'abyor gyur nas/ /theg mchog bgrod pa'i them skas 'dzegs gyur cig /rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar phyogs tsam zhig /mtshon par byas pas rgyal sras spyod pa'i gegs/ /ma lus zhi zhing mthun pa'i tshogs chas kun/ /yid la bsam pa tsam gyes 'grub par shog /shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ /bde gshegs 'khor bcas rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i/ /bden pas smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /cesasogasabasngo smon gyisargyayogadab/ rgyun du tshul khrimasamig 'brasabazhin du bsrung ba sogasasgo gsum bag yod pa'i brtul zhug4la gnas te sgo mtha' dag nas dge ba'i las la 'bad pa dang / dge ba gang byas thams cad kyang zhing mchog bde ba can du skye zhing / bla ma 'od dpag med kyis rjesasu'adzin pa'i rgyur bsngo4te gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa'i thabasal 'bad pa lhur bya'o/ /zhes mgon po 'od dpag med la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing mchog sgo 'byed ce4bya ba 'di ni dadabartson blo dang ldan pa bsod namasarin chen gyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon meyobrisapa'o// / /238

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/ra bya/ / mdo sngags kyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig sogs bslab bya sna chogs kyi skor bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol tsong kha pa/ / dngos grub kun stsol bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ / rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs kyi padmo la/ / gus pas 'dud do brtse bas rjes su zungs/ / skye bar btags pas mngon rlom tshangs pa dang / / khengs dregs 'byor bas g.yeng pa'i 'dod lha'i rigs/ / ma yin blo gsal tshul mthun don gnyer can/ / slob gnyer tshul bzhin byed par 'dod rnams la/ / gdams ngag cung zad sbyin no nyon cig ang / / dal ba'i rten thob rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ / mtshan ldan bshes dang chos mthun grogs kyis bskyangs/ / mthun rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pa 'di 'dra ba/ / yang yang rnyed par dka' la don che bas/ / phyi bshol spangs te snying po longs shig ang / / las kyis bsdus pa'i pha yul nye du kun/ / bzhag ste rgyang ring yul du song na yang / / rgyus med yul nas don med mdza' bshes sogs/ / bsdus te rnam g.yeng byed pa spyon pa yin/ / 'ongs don thos 239

༄/ /yo cabs༅za'atsho tsha lagabasam las la sgrims shig ang / / sgo gsum dge la sbyar phyir ming dang don/ / mthun pa'i bshes shig rang gi dge rgan du/ / bsten nas chos kyi bya ba ma lus pa'i/ / rtsa bar mthong ste bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa yis/ / rten 'brel mgo nas 'grigs par gyes shig ang / / sdig grogs yin zhes rwa can mi 'byung gis/ / gces shing phan pa'i zol gyis 'dzum bstan nas/ / rtse rgodagayeng ba'i grogs byed bag med kyi/ / las la spyor de sdig pa'i grogs yin pas/ / 'go pa'i nad bzhin ring du spongs shig ang / / cha rkyen yod na mi bzod myur du brlag / med na mi bzod bu lon stong 'jal byed/ / ci byas chos kyi gegs su 'gro ba 'di/ / grogs ngan 'du 'tshogs mang ba'i skyon yin pas/ / bse ru lta bur gnas par gyis shig ang / / ming la mthun rkyen zer yang chos phyogs las/ / nyams byed 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo ste/ / 'dod chung chog shes sngon byon dam pa rnams/ / dbul bas ma mnar don gnyis rtser son pas/ / 'phral phugs khe nyen gang che dpyod cig ang / / gdol spyod khyim pa'i rjes 'jug g.yo khram mkhan/ / chos min spyod pa'i than snye mgo 'phangs mtho/ /lto skya gos hrul thos dang tshul khrims kyi/ /bcud ldan snye ma'i mgo bo dma' na yang / / gtan gyi skyid sdug 'dra 'dra min no ang / / bla ma la gus mtho la phrag dog med/ / dman la brtse sogs nang nas dul gyur na/ / phyi bltas col chung skye bos mngags tshad la/ / mi nyan gyong bor snang yang skyon med pas/ / phyi 'jam khong tsub spyod pa spongs shig ang / / mngon mtho nges legs yon tan kun gyi rgyu/ / bstan pa'i gzhi ma lhag pa'i tshul khrims 'di/ / rnam grol don gnyer lam gyi srog yin kyang / /tshul 'chos spyod pa 'di yis thar dka' bas/ / bslab khrims ngo skog med par srungs shig ang / / kun spyod gtsang bas gzhan gyi yid du 240

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabs/'thad/ / smra ba nyung bas phog thug g.yeng ba med/ / dad brtson dran shes brtan pos nyin re bzhin/ / yon tan yar tshes zla ltar 'phel 'gyur bas/ / sgo gsum bag dang ldan par gyis shig ang / / dang bo thos pa'i sgron me ma sbar na/ / kun nas nyon mongs srid pa'i skyon mtshang dang / /rnamabyung thar ba'i lam gyi bgrod tshul sogs/ / blang dor ji ltar bya ba mi shes bas/ / thos pas blo mig sbyangs bar gyis shig yang / / don gyi rgan po tshig gi 'khar ba la/ / brten phyir gzhung tshig blo 'dzin mi byed par/ / dpe klog tsam dang ngag sgros than thun gyis/ / nyin re 'gro thabs des kyang mi phan pas/ / dpe 'dzin skyor sbyangs yun du gyis shig ang / / gzhung tshig mang du bzung ste bskyar na yang / / don la mi sems rim gro'i chos klog dang / ne tse'i 'don pa lta bu brgya tshar gyis/ / brjod bya'i gnad la sgro 'dogs mi chod pas/ / don la rtags dpyad zhib mo gyis shig yang / / kun byang 'jug ldog tshulal ma rmongs shing / / tshogs kyi dbus su smra mkhas dpal 'dod na/ /da lta bza' btung gnyid kyi bde ba la/ / chags pa'i skyid chos 'di yis mi 'grub pas/ / dka' spyad sdug rus bzod par gyis shig yang / / nyin re zas kyang mi dran brtson 'grus rtsom/ / zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'dod/ / zhag gsum lon tshe rjes med g.yeng bas khyer/ / de 'dra de la ci yang mi yong bas/ / brtson pa chu po'i rgyun bzhin sten cig ang / /dkor dang sgrib bas bying zhing rmugs pa'i steng / / da dung zas dang gnyid kyi tshod mi rig / lang shor blo ngan 'phro zhing rgod pa'i thog / phyi phyir 'chal gtam du mas g.yeng ba sogs/ / dgag bya'i rigs la bsgrub byar ma 'dzin ang / / skyon yon blang dor rang gis yibyed par/ / grags skam 'ud kyi rjes su 'brang na yang / / nyes skyon su yis lag pas mi sel la/ / yon tan 241

༄/ /yo ca༄napa'i yo tsha las/sus kyang kha ru mi ldug pas/ /blun po chu sna gar khrid ma byed ang / / zab zab man ngag zer dgu tshol ba dang / /thob thob mang po'i rnam grangs gsog byed cing / /sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs la mgo 'khor ba/ /gzhung lugs thos bsam rnal ma'i gegs yin pas/ / rtsa ba bor nas yal ga ma 'dzin ang / /rang rang gzhung gi brjod bya dgos don sogs/ / ma mthong shag 'gyed tshig 'khri skam po dang / / rigs pas dpyad pa mi bzod go thob kyi/ /bam bshad 'dis kyang brdar sha mi chod pas/ / go rigs zung du 'brel bar skyongs shig ang / /'khrul bral gzhung re nges bzung gzhir byas nas/ / gzhan rnams de dang sbyar te dpyod ba las/ / gang byung dpe la lta zhing thams cad kyi/ / rjes su 'brangs pa shes rab 'chal 'gyur bas/ /rang lugs gtad so yod par gyis shig yang / /dpyad pas nges pa lam tsam rnyed na yang / / chos tshul zab pas thag chod mi snga zhing / / 'grig 'grig mngapos rnam rtog rgya skyed pas/ / dpyad pa ma thal gzhung la 'khril bzhin du/ /rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i dpyad tshul gyis shig yang / /ma rig mun sel thosapa'i me sbar yang / / nga rgyal du ba'i ngo bor 'khyil ba yis/ / phyi phyir skyon yon mthong ba sgrib byed la/ / chos su song na shes rgyud dul dgos pas/ /snye ma yong ba mgo 'phangs ma mtho ang / /mthon po'i sgang la chu bo mi chags pas/ / dman sa bzung ste gus pa'i brtul zhugs kyes/ / chos mthunablo kha mtho ba thams cad las/ / blo skyed gang lon bre sog phul sog gis/ /sgo 'dogs 'phral dang 'phral du chod cig ang / /dbu tshad zung du 'jugapa'i lta ba dang / / chos mngon mdzod dang pha rol phyin ba'i sgom/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba'i spyod pa rnams/ / ma tshang bslab gsum ya bral 'gyur ba'i phyir/ / bka' pod lnga la tshang par spyongs shig ang / /242

༄/ /༅gnyerabaspababya/dka' bas bsags pa'i mang thos nor bu yang / / brjed nges rkun pos dal gyis 'joms byas te/ / rin chen gling nas stong par ldog srid pas/ /rgyun du goms 'dris dran shes brtan po yis/ / gang shes brjed pa med par sogs shig ang / / snyigs dus blo dang bsod nams dman pa'i phyir/ /lhag pa'i lha dang yi dam chos srung la/ / rtse gcig gsol 'debs phyag mchod maṇḍal sogs/ / tshogs bsags sgrib spyong 'bad pa drag po yis/ / zhing gi mthu la rgyab brten gyis shig ang / / thun mong lam sbyangs sngon du ma song zhing / / gzhung don lta ba'i blo mig ma phye bar/ / cho ga'i ngag 'don byang ba tsam zhig gis/ / gsang sngags 'chang ba'i gral du mi tshud pas/ / bstan la rim ba bzhin du slobs shig ang / / gsang chen rgyud kyi rgyal po'i sman hrog rnams/ / sbyor bar bsdebs pa bskyed rdzogs rim pa sogs/ / yin phyir gzhung lugs che rnams yal bor nas/ / man ngag kho nar dga' ba gnas minapas/ / rtsa bshad sbyar te rgyud don tshol cig ang / / gsang sngags de yang 'phral gyi rkyen sel lam/ / tshe dang nor sgrub dbang sdud mngon spyod sogs/ / tshe 'di'i lag cha kho nar 'khyer ba ni/ / sa mchog tsan dan sol bar byas 'dra bas/ / chos kyis ngan song bsgrubs pa ma byed ang / / sngags gzhung thos bsam byas ba'i nying dgos su/ / rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig gyur rtag pa'i bka'/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig bsrung ba 'dir/ /'bab ba'i tshul la go ba gting tshugs pas/ / gtan 'dun 'chug pa med par gyes shig ang / / khyad par lta ba snyigs ma'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /dmabaca' tsam gyis mkhas rlom skye bo yi/ / sngon med legs bshad skad kyi 'chal gtam yang / / bsod chung shes 'chal rnams kyi rnar 'gro bas/ / ri bong cal gyi rjes su ma rgyugs ang / / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyin bzhin 243

༄/ /yo cabalopa'i tsa' ga lam/gdams pa yis/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' dag mngon gyur pa/ /blo bzang rgyal ba yis kyang ma thon pa'i/ / gsar bshad phra men ma yi so nam des/ /phan las gnod pa che bas sgrims shig yang / / thugs bcud zab mor bsngags pa tsam min par/ / rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen thams cad kyi/ / rang gzhung dpang por bzhugs pa'i mdo rgyud kun/ / gsal byed rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang 'dir/ /blo rtse gcig tu dril te 'jus shiga.ang / /gar rgyug phyogs su dkyus ston byed pa bzhin/ /dang po nyid nas gcig shes gnyis shes kun/ /srid par 'khyer ba'i dmu rgod sems kyi rta/ /'di nyid gdul thabs kho nar 'khyer ba yis/ /thos bsam chos su 'gro bar gyis shig yang / / 'khor lo bzhi ldan rten bzang thob skabs 'di/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba gcod pa'i dus yin pas/ / 'khor gsum skor ba'i thabs tsam ma yin par/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs don nges rnyed nas/ /'khor gsum dag pa'i dge spyor gyes shig ang / /chos kyi rtsa ba bsam pa'i bzang ngan yin/ /chos kyi sgo 'byed rnam dag thos ba yin/ /chos su song tshad 'di snang zhen log yin/ /chos kyi snying bo thabs shes zung 'jug yin/ / chos la chos bzhin sbyod par gyis shig ang / / rnam mang gzhung lugs zab yangs chu gter las/ / rnam dag thos ba'i nor bu len ba'i tshul/ /rnam par bshad ba'i mig sman thur ma yis/ /rnam grol don gnyer yongs kyi mig phye ste/ / rnam kun mkhyen pa'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces mdo sngagasakyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig ce4bya ba 'di ni/ spyir deng sang bstan pa snyigasama'i mthar son pa'i dbang gis nyamasalen dgosapa'i gtam tsam yang nub/ thos bsam dgosapa'i gtam tsamayod kyang / gang la thos pa bya ba'i yul dab/ thosapa ji ltar byed pa'i 2pha

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/tshul sogasalegs par shes pa shin tu dkon par snang bas/ 'di 'dra zhig 'bri 'dun sngar nas yod pa'i thog nye char dar han pe'i li'i shog nasablo dang ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog rdo rjesabaskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgom mesathoyodon rgyud la sbyar ba'i nyams len ma thub kyang / bla ma gong ma zhig gi ming tsam la skyabasasu ma mchi bar grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugasabazhin slob gnyer la sdug rus cung zad byagaba'i rang myong dang / dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun la brten nas ragayorim zhig brisapa'i mtshamasasu da ltaphan par smras kyang go ba dkon par snang bas dgoyopa mi 'dugasnyam nas bzhag ba'i tshe/ bstan la gcig tu sman pa'i lhag bsam dang mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dam pa dgon pa'i khri thog pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pasa'adi'i 'thobaskang stecha tshang ba zhig dgosazhes nan tan gnang ba bzhin mjug grub par byasapa'i yige ba ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis ba 'disakyang don gnyer can rnamasal phan thogs par gyur cig / / /yang dag lam bzang gsal mdzad bla ma dang / / rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ / rnam dag dad pas lan brgyar phyag byas nas/ / spangs blangs rnam gzhag 'ga' tsam bsnyad par bya/ / bslab bar bya ba rnam grangs mang na yang / / gnad la phan pa rang la rag las pas/ /bya ba gang la'ang las 'bras dbang bzhag nas/ / rnam dkar las lam dag la 'bad par bya/ / dal ba brgyad ldan sangs rgyas bstan dang phrad/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dag dang mjal/ / da lan 'dra ba slan chad tshang dka' ba/ / yang yang bsam nas dal ba 'bras ldan 'tshal/ / khas blangs bcas mtshams phra rags thams cad la/ / nan tan bsam pa thag pas 'bad byas na/ / sras bcas rgyal bas rab bsngags lam bzang yang /rang rang lag na gnas pas 'bad bar 'tshal/ / zab rgyas man ngag mtha' yas mnyan na yang / / kha bshad tsam la 'phyan na phan dka' bas/ / mtha' 245

༄/ /yo cabaloba'ilha sa ga ཿma/dag rang rang bsam pa dang sbyar nas/ /nan tan lag blang bya ba man ngag gnad/ /snga char mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa btsal/ / slad nas zab rgyas gdams ngag tshang bar mnyan/ / tha mar gdams ngag mtha' dag nyams blangs na/ /sangs rgyas sar chas skal bzang ldan pa lags/ /bsam rgya ma mang gang brtsams pha mthar bskyal/ /skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la dad pa sbyangs/ /dkar nag las 'bras bsam nas spangs blangs bya/ /'bad pa 'bras dang bral la ngal ba spangs/ /gzhan la bsam ngan 'chang bas rang rang nyams/ /'chal gtam smra ba mang bas bya ba 'chag / nga rgyal chags sdang can la dgra sdang bas/ /rang dang gzhan la gang phan brtag nas bya/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras bcas pa thams cad kyang / /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa las bltams pas/ / rtag par gzhan phan bsam pa sbyangs pa dang / /mtha' bral yang dag lta bas rgyas gdab bya/ /sngar bsags las ngan mtha' dag 'bad pa brgyas/ /bshags nas g.yang sa nyam nga dgag pa dang / /rnamadakar gang byas ma rgan thams cad la/ /phan slad bsam pa thag bas mtshams sbyar bya/ /lugs zung sgrub tshul gzhung lugs nyung bsdus su/ /'grig 'grig tshig gi bar gyis bris 'di yis/ /legs nyes 'byed byed ye shes gter rnyed de/ / stobs sogs yongs rdzogs mgon po mchog thob shog /ce4lugs gnyisakyi bslab bya mdor bsdusa'adi ni blo dang ldan pa rab 'byamasapa 'jigasamed gragasapasabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dbyangasangesapa'i tshul du bri4pa'o/ / / /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba kun las kyang / /drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i thugs rje can/ /tha mal gyi tshul 'dzin dang po'i mgon/ /pha bla ma snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ / gnas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i thog ma med/ /246

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabaphya/sgos ngan song gsum gye btson dong du/ / bzod med kyi sdug bsngal myong myong nas/ / dus da lan dal ba'i rten cig rnyed/ / tshe mi rtag gnyid kyi thun chung la/ / don med kyi dga' sdug mi lam 'khrug / glo bur du sad dus ngan song gi / tsher dong der yod na ci rang byed/ / dus da lta rang dbang rang la yod/ / mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen btsal na legs/ / 'jigs yer re gshin rjes khrid pa'i tshe/ / skyabs med kyi sdug smras su la 'don/ / dro 'jam gyi gos dar 'dzom na yang / / de yun ring gyon gyi rang dbang med/ / rab 'bar gyi lcags sreg leb mo de/ / gyon ma dgos tsam zhig mdzad na legs/ / zas zhim mngar 'dzom pa'i dkor nag la/ / 'dzem med du spyod ba'i dred po khyod/ / lo bye ba 'bum phrag stong gi bar/ / zangs zhun gyi khu ba 'thung nus sam/ / gnyen mdza' bshes mang yang za grogs yin/ /lam rgyus med kyi 'phrang du gcig pur 'gro/ / las bsags pa'i rnam smin rang gis myong / / 'di soms la mthun 'jug g.yeng ba spongs/ /phyogs thag ring mgron po'i lam zhag 'dra/ / 'di snang kun don med bslu brid yin/ / tshe phyi mar phan pa gzhan med pas/ / rang nus pa gang yod dge la spyor/ / chos zab mor grags pa mang na yang / / dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba 'di / / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba dgyes byed dang / / gtam 'dun gyi sgrub pa'i yang rtse yin/ / bsten na ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ / bsam na ni dkar nag las 'bras soms/ / byed na ni dam pa'i lha chos kyis/ / dus nam yang bslu ba med do kye/ / chos zab mo glu ru blangs pa yi/ / gtam tshig gsum smras pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / blo dam pa'i chos la phyogs pa yi/ / lam gegs med bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ce4pa 'di ni dge spyor la brtson pa 'jigasamed mkhasamachog gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon 247

༄/ /yo caganab yogayo lam/mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabrisapa'o/ / / /mgon thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / bod bur rgyal 'dren pa dkon mchog 'bangs/ / dus da lta 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /lha bla ma dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs/ /bod chen po byang gi phyogs mthar 'dir/ / ma 'gro ba'i bde skyid bstan la rag / chos bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas khyed kyi drin/ / 'di bsam zhing bka' drin snying nas dran/ /sngonabla ma dri ma med pa dang / / ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes sogs/ /yongs gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo kun/ / mgrin gcig gis lung bstan ji ltar mdzad/ / kyai gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /ces lung bstan gyi gdul bya'i dus la babs/ /ches snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus ngan dang / /las sdig la spyod pa'i yul mtha' 'dir/ /lha snying rje'i gter chen khyod min pa/ / nga nyam thag gi mgon skyabs su la zhu/ / chos mdo sngags bstan pa nyi rgas 'dra/ /de bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin dkon/ /chos tshul bzhin sgrub la dgra bo mang / / dus snyigs ma'i rang mtshang mtsho ltar rdol/ /'di bsams na shes pa gting nas skyo/ /sems skyo yang las ngan sgrog gis bcings/ / nga gdungs ba'i 'o dod rgyang nas 'bod/ /lha thugs rje chen pos gsan lags sam/ /sgos tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la/ /nyin de ring yan chad gdon gyis spyos/ /las don med sdig bas rang rang phung / /da 'gyod kyang 'aspyod pa 'phyis nas gda'/ /mi rgan gzhonamed par 'chi ba la/ /khyad med pa rang gis mngon sum mthong /nga rang rang de ltar glo bur du/ /'chi mi dgos blo rtse ci zhig yod/ /ri lung ba gser gyes bkang na yang / / rang 'chi dus rdul tsam 'khyer dbang 248

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/med/ /gzungs yig drug tshar gcig bton na yang / / de 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam rgyag yin/ / chos gcig la byin rlabs che ba de/ / sngags gzungs mchog yi ge drug ma yin/ / khong byis pa tshun chad shes pa de/ / nged bod kyi chos skal yin pa'i rtags/ / mi sdig can btsan thabs 'tshang rgya'i chos/ /dkor bag chags ngan pa spyong ba la/ / ches zab pa'i mthar thug sgyung gnas yin/ / 'di'i phan yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ / dus deng sang ngan ba mgo mtho yang / /lam bar do'i 'phrang ring brgal ba'i nyin/ / dgra gshin rje'i dmag gis bskor ba'i tshe/ / chos tshul bzhin byas pa'i mi de skyid/ /'phrang ya nga'i 'jigs pa sel 'dod cing / / mar ngan song gi skye sgo gcod 'dod na/ / lha thugs rje chen po'i zhabs la 'jus/ / dus nyin mtshan med par gsol ba thob/ / yar mtho ris thar pa'i go 'phang dang / /mar ngan song gsum bo gang du 'gro/ / dus da lta 'dam kha rang gi lag /mtshams 'di las 'das na thar pa dka'/ / kho 'chi bdag bdud kyis khrid pa'i skabs/ / ming go sa dpa' rtsal stobs 'byor sogs/ / rgya ci tsam che yang phan pa med/ / phan nges pa dam pa'i lha chos yin/ / nor longs spyod sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ / sdig rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod/ /gnyen mdza' bshes tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ / dus ring por mi sdod gyes nas 'gro/ / gzugs lang tsho ston ga'i me tog 'dra/ / zhag re re bzhin du rim gyis yal/ / las skyid sdug thag mkhan rkang stabs 'dra/ / gang dar ba'i tha ma rgud pa yin/ / gnas 'khor ba 'di yi phun tshogs la/ / mthar mi bslu bya ba gcig kyang med/ / de soms la dam ba'i lha chos gyis/ / chos zab mo 'phags pa'i bsgom bzlas gyis/ / dus nam zhig sem rig bral ba'i nyin/ /lha thugs rje chen pos zhal bstan nas/ / bu bde ba can du shog 249

༄/ /yo cabastanapa'isgronas ga 'thugacig ces/ / mgon 'od dpag med kyi drung du 'khrid/ / don de phyir sgo gsum dge la 'bad/ /dge gang bsags de yi don du sngos/ /de byas na mi lus don dang ldan/ /chos bstan dang mjal ba'i dgos pa 'grub/ /tshul de ltar smras pa'i dge bas kyang / / nged yon mchod blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /las dkar po dge la rtag spyad nas/ /mchog thar pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ce4sgyung gnasasogasadang 'brel bar ma ṇi bskul ba'i mgur dbyangasa'adi ltabu zhig dgosazhesa'aphagasapa thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i sgyung gnasapa dge slong ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes kun gyisago bde bar briyopa 'disakyang skye bo rnams la phan thogasapar gyur cig / / /keng rus gcal bkram 'jigs pa'i dur khrod dang / / khang bzang nyams dga' 'byor bas brgyan ba gnyis/ / gang nas bltas kyang chags bral rgyur mtshungs kyang / / ngang ba 'dam la sred bzhin rmongs bas bslus/ /cang shes rta dang glang po gser dngul dar/ /chang dang bu ram bza' bca' btung ba sogs/ / jing gir rgyal bo'i 'byor pa la 'khu yang / /nying dgos snying po til 'bru tsam yang med/ / tang ting shag gi sgrar bcas ri sul lam/ /thang stong yangs por bag phebs rgyu byed cing / /deng ni shi yang 'gyod ba med snyam du/ /nang nas dga' ba rgyas de skyid pa'i mchog /bang na gnas pa'i nor bu rin chen yang / /phang ba med par sbyin par btang byas te/ /bang mdzod mtha' dag stong par byed nus na/ /mang pos 'phya yang rang don 'grub pa yin/ / tsong kha pa yi ring lugs dri ma med/ /tshang la ma nor 'di 'drar mjal dus su/ /mdzangs blun dbye ba shan 'byed dus yin pas/ /pha wang bzhin du rang mgo ma skor cig /zhing 250

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/sagashin por sa bon btab pa bzhin/ / zang zing dngos po dkon mchog mchod par phul/ / 'ong bar nges pa 'chi ba'i dgra yin pa/ / yang yang bsams te phyi ma'i so chos mdzod/ / rang nyid rang la shin tu gces na yang / /lang shor blo ngan 'di yis phung du 'jug / shing ltar gyong ba'i shes rgyud 'di btul na/ / sangs rgyas go 'phang de yang thag mi ring / / hang 'gros tsam gyi ka mad sum cu la/ / ang yig srog tu zhugs pa'i glu chung 'di/ / yid dga' chos 'dzin dben ba'i ri sul nas/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes glu ru blangs/ / / /ka ye gzhung lugs mang du thos na yang / / kha bshad skam po chu nang rdo ba bzhin/ / ga ler rang gi rgyud la ma sbyar bas/ / nga ni 'gyod de rang la le zhigabada'/ / ca ris bzhin du kha 'khum lag 'khum zhing / / cha rgyus yod med kun la gzhog slong gis/ / ja mar rtsam sogs ji tsam 'ongs na yang / /nya ltar ltogs pa'i sems 'di brgyag dus med/ / tā ras gser dngulagos dar rta dang nor/ / tha na dong rtse rdog gcig yan chad kyang / /da lta bsog dus dgos dgos 'dra ba la/ / na 'chis bcom nyin phan pa sru tsam med/ / pa tra ltar 'khyog 'di snang bya byed kyi/ / pha mthar mi phyin dal 'byor stong par zad/ / ba lang rten dang khyad par ma dod na/ / ma la bu skyes dgos ba ma byung ngo / / tsa tur lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms shing / / tsha rkyen grang rkyen thub ba'i gnas skabs der/ dza ya'i bka' bzhin dam chos ma bsgrubs pas/ / wa ler lus sems gnyis po 'grib nas thal/ zhwa ser bstan pa nyams pa'i than ltas su/ / za chog mkhan po nga dang nga 'drar yang / /'a 'ur grags pas mi rnams skyabs 'tshol te/ / ya re nga 'o mdzo sprel g.yang bskyur 'dra/ / rwa gdengs gshin rje'i rgyal bo ma gas shing / / la 251

༄/ /yo cabastan 'isgronace' ga 4ma/lung myul ba'i pho nya grangs mang la/ / sha za ma mo'i gnod pa mthu che bas/ /sa steng yun ring sdod pa'i re ba med/ / ha cang rtag 'dzin ma che blo sna bstungs/ / a ho a ho nges par 'phyis 'dug go / / /glu rta kha la ma gyer sems la zungs/ / rang lcag rang gis brob la snying phur tshugs/ / / /ka ye dam pa rnams ni zhi bar gshegs/ / kha lta grogs mched phal cher 'das na yang / / ga le sos bder sdod pa'i mdo med po/ / nga ni rang gis rang la gros shig 'debs/ / ca co don med gtam gyis sems rtsa dkrugs/ / cha byad mtshar dgu'i bslu brid sred pas bcings/ / ja sogs 'dod yon rjes su rgyug ba yi/ / nya mo 'chi bdag lcags kyus zin la nye/ /ta la'i 'dab ltar rgyas ba'i dpal 'byor kyang / / tha mar dran pa'i yul du bskyur nas 'gro/ / da lta dbyer med lta bu'i lus sems kyang / / na rga 'chi ba'i dbyen gyis so sor 'byed/ / pa tra'i mjug ldan gnas 'dra 'khor ba'i mtsho/ / pha 'tha' mi mngon sdug bsngal brgyas gang bar/ / ba spu tsam yang mi g.yo snying kham can/ / ma rig gdon gyis myos te ha cang 'khrul/ / rtswa sngon ba mos reg pa'i grang nyams dang / / tsha ba'i chu thigs phog pa mi bzod de/ / dza zhes 'gug byed las kyi lcags kyu yis/ / wa le dmyal pa'i me nang 'khrid kyis dogs/ / zha 'theng 'on long bde sdug longs spyod dang / / za ma ma ning pho mo'i rten la sogs/ / 'a cag 'dod dang mi 'dod dbang na med/ / ya mtshan dkon pa las kyis byas nas 'gro/ / ra bar chud pa bshan pa'i lug bzhin du/ /la 'ur gshed mas nam 'dzin cha med pas/ / sha khrag gdosabacas lus 'di dor ba'i tshe/ / sa 'og mun par mi ltung thabs shig mdzod/ / ha ha kha bshad mkhas la bsam brlag khyod/ / a ho bsam bzhin 252

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/rang nyid mi brlag na/ / ha la'i dug mtshungs srid dang dam chos kyi/ / a mṛ ta gnyis ma nor ma bsre zhig / / /a ā dal 'byor rten bzang lan gcig thob pa 'di ngo mtshar/ / yi ste 'di nas lhung na 'gro sa ngan song rang yin no/ u lca ma kir lhung phyin thar pa'i dus tshod cig med do/ / ṛ dṛ me ri 'bar ba'i spubs der ci 'dra byas sdod pa/ / le thā las ngan lus la smin na bya thabs dang bral lo/ / ye ye gnasader mi lhung thabs shig da lan rang byed dgos/ / o yo thabs shig byed na skyabs 'gro las 'bras rang yin no/ / rma i bsam blo gtong sa'i 'gag mdo 'di ka rang red a ke la sha 'am rdza ri sprug po yi mgul du/ /khe 'dod grags 'dod med pa ri dwags kyi bu bzhin/ ge sar dri bsung 'thul ba'i dzi ngad la snoms shing / / nge rang gcig pur bag yangs rgyu ba zhig byung na/ ce spyang bzhin du zas kyis gdungs pa 'di spangs shing / / che mtho'i cha lugs sde dpon spyod tshul 'di dor te/ / je ring je ring dbeen pa'i bas mtha' ru phyin nas/ / nye du mdza' bshes 'brel thag 'chad ba zhig byung na/ / te lo nā ro'i rnam thar 'khyong ba ru dka' yang / / the gtogs gros bsdur mang po'i bya byed 'di bzhag nas/ / de na 'di na med pa skyi ser gyi rlung bzhin/ / rte'u gseng spang ljongs gang dgar myul ba zhig byung na/ / be har dkor mdzod bsrung 'dra'i gnyer kha yang ma dgos/ / phe ra rgyag pa'i khrims dpon spyod pa yang ma dgos/ / be'u lug tshun chad bor brlag dogs ba yang ma dgos/ / me chu shing gsum 'dzom pas chog pa zhig byung na/ / tse nesangs pa kho nas gzhis rdzogs kyi 'gro bde/ / tshe 'di gang skyid pha yul byedapa yi 'dug bde/ / dze reg phog thug med par kun snyoms kyi 'grogs bde/ / we ltar gar yib mi shes stabs bde zhig byung na/ / zhe sa ngo 'dzin 253

༄/ /gung cabasapa'i po ga ཿma/dgos pa'i dpon po yang med la/ / ze ba yar 'then dgos pa'i g.yog po yang med cing / / 'e gnod dogs pa dgos pa'i dgra bo yang med par/ /ye shes lha tshogs kho nar bsten pa zhig byung na/ / re thag bcad pa'i mnga' thang rgyang skyur du byas la/ / le lo spangs pa'i dam chos rnal ma zhig byung te/ /shes rab thabs kyis zin pa rgyal sras kyi spyod bas/ /sems can kun la phan pa sgrub nus shig byung na/ / te he yid smon ltar gyi skal ba zhig yod na/ /e ma de las lhag pa'i dga' rgyu zhig ci yod/ / e kye dga' ba chen bo'i glu dbyangs zhig blangs te/ / e waṃ zung 'jug sa la bro brdung zhig bya'o/ /dbyangs gsal gyi mgur ma 'di yang yosbrul ston zla gnyisapa'i tshes lnga'i nyin nges 'byung spu su zhig gisabaskul te sug brisasubagyis pa'o/ / / /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skyabs gnas kun la gus bas phyag byas nas/ / gzhung lugs kun la thos bsam byas pa'i don/ /nyams len kun la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul/ /rang gzhan kun la phan phyir mdo tsam spel/ / legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba bla ma ste/ / yon tan kun gye gzhi rten tshul khrims dang / / dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba dam tshig yin/ / gtan bde'i rtsa ba 'dzug na de la dgongs/ / bya ba kun la las 'bras dbang bor zhog / re dogs kun la ltos med thog dzis thongs/ /skyid sdug kun la lam gyi bogs 'byin bcol/ / sgrub tshugs mtha' ru skyol na de la dgongs / /'dod yon kun la bdud kyi g.yab mor zungs/ / snyan grags kun la brag ca'i gdangs su soms/ / gnyen bshes kun la tshong 'dus mgron por ltos/ /chos brgyad 'khri ba gcod na de la dgongs/ /sdig ltung kun la 'go ba'i nad bzhin 'dzod/ /dge tshogs kun la bre sog phul gsog mdzod/ /spyod lam kun la dran shes bag yod sten/ / blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub na de 254

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/la dgongs/ / chos mdzad kun la mos gus dag snang spyongs/ / gsung rab kun la bag chags ci thebs dang / / 'jug ldog kun la rigs bas zhib mor dpyod/ / nyes spyod sgo mo 'gog na de la dgongs/ / srid 'byor kun la zhen log nges 'byung dang / / 'gro ba kun la rjes chags byang chub sems/ /'khor 'das kun la zhen bral lta ba ste/ / nyams len snying por dril na de la dgongs/ / mdor na thos don bsgrubs de mkhas pa yin/ / blang dor ngo lkog med na btsun pa yin/ / nyon mongs gdon gsum thul na grub zob yin/ / mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dod na de la dgongs/ / mang du thos kyang nyon mongs gnyen po ru/ / ma song bro ba'i glu bzhin don med pas/ /gang shes mtha' dag rang rgyud 'dul byed du/ / sbyor bar byed pa gdams pa'i rgyal por zungs/ / de skad gtam du byas pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ / rang gzhanakun gyi blo sna chos su 'khul/ / spong ba bsam gtan 'khor lo mthar phyin te/ / mkha' mnyam lus can yongs kyi don byed shog / cesapa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed sprul ba'i sku lharam pa ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyisabaskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabrisapa'o/ / / /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / legs tshogs rten 'brel kun gyi sgo gcig pu/ / bshes gnyen dam ba tshul bzhin bsten byed cing / /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba'i tshul/ / bsams te blo sna chos su bsgyur bar bya/ / shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye'i gdeng med pas/ / skyabs 'gro las 'bras blang dor la 'bad cing / / srid las nges 'byung rnam dag bslab gsum gyis/ / sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgyun lam bcad par bya/ / ma rnams gces 'dzin snying rje'i sems mchog gis/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzhung bsrangs shing / / bstan pa'i snying po mtha' bral stong ba nyid/ / klu 255

༄/ /gung cabayomi'izla sa'i sa lam/sgrub dgongs pa ji bzhin btsal bar bya/ /sngon 'gro thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /'jug sgo rnam dag dbang gis smin byas nas/ / dngos grub gnyis kyi gter gyur dam tshig sdom/ /mig gi 'bras bu ji bzhin bsrung bar bya/ /rgyud sde gzhan gsum gdams par shar ba yis/ /bla med lam la nges pa mchog rnyed nas/ / bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor legs bsgoms te/ /skye shi bar do'i 'phrang las thar par bya/ /lus dben sku yi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gzhir/ / rlung sngags mnyam sbyor rdo rje bzlas ba'i mthus/ /dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa las byung ba'i/ /dga' bzhi'i lam gyis 'od gsal 'dren bar bya/ /de yi ngang lasasgyu ma'i skur bzhengs te/ /de nyid yang yang stong bar bcug pa yis/ /don dam 'od gsal ye shes mngon gyur te/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin bar bya/ / dag cing 'od gsal thugs kyi mkha' dbyings las/ / gang 'dul gzugs sku'i snang ba 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /'gog med rtag 'char sgyu 'phrul dra ba che/ / zung 'jug go 'phang byur du bsgrub par bya/ / de ltar byas na rgyal kun dgongs pa'i bcud/ /tshang la ma nor blo bzang rgyal bstan dang / / mjal ba'i dgos don lag rtser son pa yis/ /'gyur med gtan gyi rgyal sa zin par nges/ /rang la nyams myong med kyang dam pa'i gsung / /ji bzhin nyung ngu'i tshig gis bsnyad pa'i dges/ / 'jam mgon lugs bzang phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang / /rang gzhan mtha' dag smin cing grol bar shog / cesamado sngags kun gyi gnad 'dril ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdusapa 'di ni sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa gu shrī blo bzang tshe 'phel gyisa'adi ltabu tshigs bcad nyung ngur bsdebayopa zhig dgosazhes bskul ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4brisapa'o/ / / /don gnyis phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpyid 'jo ba/ /bslu med skyabs 256

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabaphya/kyi dam pa mchog gsum la/ / gus pas btud nas lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i/ / bslab bya'i snying po mdo tsam spel bar bya/ / mchog 'bring dman pa'i skye bo gang la yang / / las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin dpyod pa ni/ /bde legs kun gyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ / spang blang ma nor lag tu len pa gces/ / khyad par rnam grol thar pa'i grong khyer gyi/ / 'jug ngogs gsalabyed ting 'dzin shes rab gnyis/ / gang la brten pa lhag pa'i tshul khrims ni/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa kun gyi gzhi rten yin/ / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dri bzang can/ / mang thos sbrang rtsis gtams pa'i padma de/ /dregs ldan lha brgya'i gtsug gi rgyan 'gyur zhing / / phun tshogs bung ba'i 'phreng ba ngang gis 'du/ / bla ma lha yi thugs rje sprin sngon la/ / mi phyed dad pa'i mig yangs gyen du gtod/ / bsnyen sgrub las kyi gar stabs sgyur byed na/ / don gnyis dge pa'i gtos bzang 'dzin par nges/ / sgo gsum spyod pagang la 'jug pa'i tshe/ / sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar rjes su slob/ /rnam g.yeng bag med bya ba ring spangs tshe/ / bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub la'ang dka' ba med/ / yul dus skye bo'i blo dang mthun 'jug gis/ / nye ring bar ma kun gyi sems gzung zhing / / rang gi dge ba'i bya ba mi lhod pa/ / gang de lugs gnyis zung 'brel dga' ston yin/ / chos kyi mdun ma gtso bor gyur pa yi/ / phan par smra ba'i ngag las mi 'da' zhing / / chos min gtam gyi rjes su mi 'brang ba'i/ / bzang ngan grogs kyi 'grogs lugs shin tu gces/ / mdor na lha chos rtsa ba dad pa yin/ / mi chos rtsa ba kun dang mthun pa yin/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa yin/ / rtsa ba de gsum thugs kyi dkyil du chongs/ / khyad par chos srid gnyis las lha chos dang / /'di phyi gnyis las phyi ma gtsor byed pa/ / de yi bya ba gang la zhugs 257

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'isgronas ga 'phaganayang / /'phral dang yun du phan pa kho nar 'gro/ / des na dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud btul/ / gzhan la'ang thar pa'i bag chags ci thebs kyis/ / bstan 'gro'i don la brtson pa rgyun chags mdzod/ / mdor na rgyun du rang gi sgo gsum la/ / brtag ste skad cig tsam yang mi lhod par/ /nyin mtshan don yod chos kyis 'da' byas na/ / legs tshogs thams cad lhun gyes 'grub par 'gyur/ / lugs zung 'dab ma'i gar gyes rol pa yi/ / bslab bya mkha' 'gro dkar po'i phreng ba 'dis/ / khyod thugs ma dros klung du rtsen pa las/ /legs byas rlabs kyi phreng ba rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mtshan sgrogasamakhan chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che ngag dbang 'jam dpal bstan pa rab rgyasakyis 'di 'dra zhig dgo4tshul byung bar brten 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni/ /dus mthar thub bstan rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i phyir/ /gsum ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol pa/ /yab rje 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dam pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig mdo sngags kyi/ / lam bzang sgrub tshul bslab bya dgos so zer/ /gzhan la phan pa'i bslab bya byed pa po/ / rang nyid bsam zhing rang la yi mugabyas/ /'di phyi'i skyabs su bla ma bsten na yang / / bden kha rang gis bzung ba yid re mug / dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' zer bzhin du/ /don med stong par gzad pa yid re mug /nor rkun mthong nas shin tu zon byed kyang / /mi rkun gshin rje'i zon med yid re mug /skog gyur gnas lugs 'tshol ba'i khul byed kyang / / mngon 'gyur 'chi ba mi mthong yid re mug /nyes spyod chu bo thur du rgyug bzhin du/ / bde 'gro'i ri rtser phyin 258

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabs/'dod yid re mug / bde 'gror ma zad bde ba can 'dod kyang / / dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed ba yid re mug / skyid sdug 'dam dbang yod cing shes bzhin du/ / thar med btson rar 'jug pa yid re mug / gzhan la 'di phyi'i skyabs 'jug khas len yang / / rang nyid gar 'gro med pa yid re mug / bstan 'dzin gong ma'i gral du 'tshang na yang / / bstan pa'i sgo ru ma chudayid re mug / sdom gsum nor bu'i gter kha phye ba las/ / nyes ltung rnyog chu rdol ba yid re mug / grol ba thar ba don gnyer zer bzhin du/ /sred mkhos phyi phyir 'ching ba yid re mug / thar 'dod skyes bu yin pa gzhir bzhag la/ / ci byas 'khor ba'i rgyur song yid re mug / mig rtsa nor la gtad de chog shes kyi/ / gdams ngag bro ba'i chos bshad yid re mug /dka'atshegs che la 'di phyi gang du yang / / phan med sha sdug khyi sdug yid re mug / rtse gcig dad pa'i rgyu nor bsags bsags kyang / / 'chi tshe cam gyis bskyur dgos yid re mug / 'di bas 'di dgos mang ste bshol ba'i 'os/ / dam chos gcig pur bab pa yid re mug / bstan pa'i bya bar btags nas sde dgon bskyangs/ / chags sdang ru mar song pa yid re mug / gra slob sbyin bdag ngan pa yar then pas/ / rang nyid thur du lhung ba yid re mug / rgya chen gzhung lugs lta ba'i mig bgrad nas/ / blang dor lag nom dgos ba yid re mug / 'grig 'grig chos gtam bshad kyang spyod tshul la/ / bltas kyin grogs kyi zhe khrel yid re mug / g.yo sgyu 'phral la gzhan gyi ma shes kyang / / mchog gsum thugs khrel 'byung ba yid re mug /snying rje'i nyams btod rang mkho phugs su bcug / byi la'i 'jam skad 'donapa yid re mug / dge spyor byas kyin sems dang rmi ltas tshun/ / je thur je thur 'gro ba yid re mug / mi tshe chos la bskyal ba'i mal sa nas/ /259

༄/ /yo bamaba'i me'i tsha 'gadud 'gro'i bem po byung na yid re mug / da lta gdeng yod khul gyis sos bder bsdad/ / 'chi kha sdug smras shor na yid re mug / mdor na 'khrul pa med pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ / sngon byon dam pa'i gsung dang rnam par thar /'khor 'das skyon yon gang gi sgo nas kyang / / rang gi sems la bltas na yid re mug / 'on kyang kho bo da lta mi rnams kyis/ / dam par bkur bas rang rgyus shes bzhin du/ / stong 'ur lang bas dam pa'i khur 'dzin cing / /de yi rdzun 'gebs g.yo sgyu ci yang byas/ / rang gi ngang tshul 'di yis rjes dpag na/ snyigs dus bla sprul dge ba'i bshes gnyen du/ / grags pa'i khrod na'ang phyi nang go 'dzol ba/ / nga 'dra yod dam snyam du dogs pa skyes/ /mchod gral lder bzo lta bu'i bla chen dang / / bcos ma'i me tog 'dra ba'i sku skye'i rigs/ mkhas dang grub pa'i 'bag spyon gar mkhan rnams/ / gzhan mgo 'don pa'i sngon la rang mgo thon/ / ngang tshul drang por smras pa'i bden gtam 'dis/ / mi rnams rang sems lta ba'i mig 'dren du/ / song ste skyon yon blang dor ngos zin nas/ / chos la chos bzhin spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rtse dbu sprul sku 'jam dbyangasabashesaganyen gyi4bslab bya zhig dgosatshul byung ba ltar bri bar brtsamasapa'i tshe/ gzhan laslob pa la rang ji 'drar song 'dug snyam du rnam rtog gi rgyu tshul 'di 'dra zhig byung pa ltar skyo klu'i tshul du 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphral du smra4pa'o/ / / /kwa ye thar 'dod kyi skal ldan skyes bu rnams/ / kha tsam min pa ru chos shig byed 'dod na/ / ga ler phyi bshol gyi dbang du ma btang bar/ / nga yis bsgo ba bzhin myur bar nyams su long / / ca co long gtam gyis nyin zhag chud gzon zhing / / cha lugs gsog brun gyis dam sdom ngo tsha 'dral/ /260

༄/ /༅gnyerab4byu/ja sogs zas gos kyi sred pas bslu zhing 'brid/ / nya lto ba bzhin du 'khri ba bcad na legs/ / ta thā ga ta yi bstan pa nyin bzhin 'grib/ / tha chad snyigs dus kyi rang mtshang mtsho ltar rdol/ / da ni mi tshe yang phal cher song zin pas/ /na 'chis ma slebs rang bsgrims 'bad na legs/ / pa ra mi ta yi gzhung la sbyangs pa yang / / pha rol shag 'gyed kyi spyor ba tsam min par/ / ba spu g.yo ba yi nges 'byung byang sems dang / / ma lus chos kun gyi de nyid rtogs phyir 'bod/ / rtsa ba khas blangs kyi tshul khrims gtsang dang gcig / tsha grang bkres skom gyi dka' spyad bzod dang gnyis/ / dza lang spangs pa yi zhi dul spyod dang gsum/ / wa ler 'dzom pa de chos pa'i yang rtse lags/ / zhwa gos mtshar mtshar 'di sgyu ma'i slu brid yin/ / za 'dod grong chog 'di rang gzhan gnyis phung yin/ /'a 'ur grags skam 'di bdud kyi phye gtor yin/ / ya mtshan snying po de chos las gzhan na med/ / rwa gdengs 'chi bdag gi pho nyas ma zin gong / / la 'ur snying stobs dang brtson pa'i shugs bskyed de/ / sha khrag gdos bcas kyi dal 'byor g.yar po 'dis/ /sagasum rnyed dka' yi lam bzang bsgrubs na legs/ / ha sa badzra sogs dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / / a thra ta 'dra yi gdams pa'i bdud rtsi myang /phyi nang rten 'brel kun 'dzom pa'i dus tshod 'dir/ / thar ba'i btsan sa zhig ye zin 'bad pa gces/ / mdor na skyid sdug gi 'dam dbang yod dus 'dir/ /'dun pa 'phyug med cig dgos so grogs po dag / gtam 'di bsnyan pa las byung pa'i dge ba yang / / 'gro kun byang chub la gzhol ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byam4ba dkon mchod don grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ / / /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / chos bsgrubs par 'dod na gtam 261

༄ / /gung thangabastanapa'azla sa gsung 'chaga'adi nyon/ /rten dal 'byor don che rnyed par dka'/ /'jig sla zhing nam 'jig cha ma mchis/ / tshe phyi mar phan pa chos las med/ / 'di go bas mi chog lag tu longs/ / sngar lus rten bzang po don med du/ /chud zos la gtang bar mi 'gyod dam/ /las sdeg pa mang bas ngan 'gror 'gro/ /de'i sdug bsngal bzod dang bcos thabs med/ /'chos 'dod na da lta bcos su yod/ /'di skyid sdug gnyis kyi so mtshams yin/ / slar thar med ngan 'gro'i sgor 'jug pa/ / snying gdon gyi brlams pa ma lags sam/ / rang las 'bras log par ma bsgrubs na/ / lha dkon mchog gsum gyis mi bslu bas/ /ci byung yang khong la blo snying gtod/ / gang byed kyang las 'bras dpang por zhog / rang bsam bzhin g.yang sar 'phyong bzhin du/ / yar 'then gyi re ba go log yin/ / nges 'byung dang byang sems lta ba gsum/'di gsung rab kun gyi snying bo yin/ / dus da lan bag chags thebs pa dgos/ /mi bsgoms kyang smon lam mi 'debs bam/ /blo chos su phar la mi 'jug par/ /chos tshur la yong re ham pa che/ /legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin/ /yon tan gyi gzhi ma tshul khrims yin/ /dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas dam tshig yin/ / yin byas pas mi chog yin bzhin sgrubs/ / rkyen 'dzom pa'i dus 'dir mi sgrub na/ /dgra gshin rje zin tshe 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ /da bshad bshad mang ba'i kha na med/ /chos shes pa mang ste sgrub pa dkon/ /tshig gcig kyang nyams su blangs na phan/ /don ma bsgrubs mang yang dgos pa med/ /chos zhes pa sems rgyud 'chos pa yin/ / de soms la blo sna nang du skor/ /rang nyams myong med pa'i kha bshad glus/ /gzhan blo sna bsgyur pa dka' mod kyang / / mgon dam pa'i gsung sgros bskyar ba yin/ / 'dis 'gro rgyud chos la 'khul bar shog / cesapa 'di ni lob ga tā pi li'i shog nas 262

༄/ /slobaganyerab4khya/dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byamasapablo bzang mkhasabatsun gyis bslab bya semasal gzer btab pa lta bu zhig dgos zhesabaskul ba ltar mtshang 'bru'i tshul du 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabrisapa'o/ / / /na mo ye/ rang nyid kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs byin rlabs mngon gyur ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ka ye lho rgyal 'dzam gling byang gi phyogs/ / kha ba can gyi cha shas mdo khams smad/ / ga ju tho'u ju'i nye 'khor mdzo dge smad/ nga yi lte khrag 'bo pa'i sa cha yin/ / ca co'i rdzun gtam grags pa mched pa dang / / cha le cho le rang yang kha blas shing / / ja lag 'ga' zhig ngos 'dzin byas pa yis/ nya mo lcags kyus drangs bzhin sa 'dir blus/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / / tha mal bag med byis pa'i spyod pa bskyangs/ / da lta bsam na spyod tshul 'ga' zhig ni/ / na tshod smin pa'i dus las dga' ba'ang snang / / pa sangs ltar dkar lhag bsam med na yang / / pha rol bslu phyir lhag bsam che mdog bstan/ / ba sru tsam yang g.yo ba med bzhin du/ / ma rgan sems can zer nas mig btsum byed/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tshad nor phyir yang / / tsha grang khyad du bsad nas grong chog nyul/ / dza ya'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong byas so lo/ / wa skyes rgyal por bskos pa'i rnam thar yin/ / zhwa ser bstan pa skad po che 'di yang / /za chog mkhan po nga 'dras 'dzin dgos tshe/ / 'a 'ur grags pa ci tsam che na yang / ya ma brla zhig min pa yong sa med/ / ra ltar gyong pa'i sems 'di ma thulan/ / la lung dben par bsdad kyang dgos pa chung / / sha thud dkor zas bag med sbyod bzhin du/ / sa lam bgrod pa'i re ba a tsa ma/ / ha ha mgo 'phangs rkyang las mtho ba 'di/ / a a 'jig rten phyi mar ji 'dra yin/ / bsam gyen bsam gyin rang la phyag 'tshal zhing / / gsol ba 263

༄/ /yo cabalo pa'isgronama'i ga 'phaga'adebs so rang rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'di ni gzhan mang pos gsol 'deb4kyi skul ma byung bsarkyen byas/ skor bar 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs shig semasakyi 'char sgo thol byung du smrasapa'o/ / / /mgon dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal skyin dngos/ / pha bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / /rje 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs pad la/ / dus byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /mdang thun gsum gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /blo dga' sdug gi ri mo ci yang snang / / dus de ring thams cad rdzun du gda'/ /rkyen de yis skyo ba'i nyams shig shar/ / lus zhag 'ga' g.yar po'i mgron khang la/ /lar phan gnod kyi re dogs mang ba las/ / nga zer pa'i gces phrug 'di thog tu/ /gtan skyid sdug ci 'byung mno bsam thongs/ /nor longs spyod rmi lam gser gyi ri/ /nga'i yin snyam rloms sems dregs pa bskyes/ /gnyid yer gyis sad tshe stong hang nge / / de 'dra ma zhig 'chi ba'i nyin mo 'byung / /dkor ha la'i dug gi rang bzhin can/ / zas zhim ngar bro ba myong bzhin spyod/ /dug smin tshe drag po'i gzer rgod kyis/ /lus dum bur gas na bzod glags med/ / gos mdog legs 'ja' tshon ltar bkra bas/ /lus mi gtsang phung bo g.yogs na yang / / dus mi ring snod bcud gnyi ga yi/ / mtshang 'gran pa bzhin du bstan nas 'ongs/ / bre stong ba sngags kyis btab pa'i mkhar/ /steng lha yul gyi bde skyid yod snyam byed/ /sgyu mig 'phrul bshig tshe skyo ba skye/ /gzhi khang khyim las kyi sgyu ma yin/ /'bu bse bo gyang la 'dzegs pa de/ /phyir lhung gin sun med sdug thag 'chad/ /don med par ma shes rmongs pas bslus/ / ming go sa mtho 'dod de dang 'dra/ /mtshan snyam grags stong skad 'brug gi sgra/ /las bsod nams sprin phung yal ba'i rgyu/ / col chung gi shing lo rlung khyer de/ / mthar smad pa'i 2yo

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/rdzab tu 'jug nyen yod/ / lar zin med 'khor ba'i bya ba kun/ / sngar ma bsgrub dus na mkho mkho 'dra/ / grub zin tshe dgos med rkyang bar go / don snying po med pa'i rang rtags yin/ / sa lho byang mgron po tshong khang du/ /zhag 'ga' la dga' dga' ltar du 'grogs/ / slar gyes nas gtan du phrad pa med/ / grogs mdza' bshes 'dus pa de dang 'dra/ / yul mtha' med 'khor pa'i phyogs phyogs nas/ / don med par 'dus pa gnyen du rlom/ /phan btags pa med kyang bral ba yi/ / sdug snying la bzhag ste phyir yang 'gro/ /lar rtags na ci byas spyon pa'i gar/ / gang bsags pa thams cad sdig pa'i khur/ / rang phung ba'i dgra bor nga yin na/ / phugs bde ba'i skabs shig ga na yod/ / phugs skyid 'dod skyid kyi sbyor ba la/ / 'jug dka' ba brgya phrag spyad na yang / / don myong khom med par pha rol 'gro/ /de 'di sdug phyi sdug ma lags sam/ / nyam chung gi byi'u phrug thang 'khyams de/ /las nyon mongs dmu rgod byis pas bzung / / gang dran tshad sdug las sna dgu yis/ / co 'dri yang mi bzod rang dbang med/ / gzhan chos la gzhug pa'i bla ma tshang / / sku don dang thugs brel mang ba 'di/ / btsan chod kyis chos shig ma gnang na/ / btsan gcod cig byung tshe sku tshegs yin/ / mi rang thog tu mi 'ong nges shes pa/ / bod sog po'i mtha' yi 'dang rgyag las/ / rang thog tu 'ongs nges mtha' ring po/ / tshe phyi ma'i don la zon zhig gyes/ / ngag lhang lhang 'tsher ba'i glu 'di yang / / dus yud tsam gye 'char sgo lags na yang / / sems rta rgod kha lo 'chun dka' bas/ / don med kyi thang la dkyus nas 'gro/ / don de phyir bla ma mchog gsumagyis/ / blo tshul bzhin chos la 'jug pa dang / / chos yang dag lam du 'gro ba dang / / lam bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhesapa 265

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'izla sa gas ཿma/'di'ang rmi lam gyi snang ba 'ga' zhig la brten nas skyo shas kyisabaskul te thun gseng du bris pa'o/ / / / dal 'byor don che dang rnyed dka' bsams na/ / don med bya ba la bkol ba 'phang ngo / / nam 'chi nges med dang bzlog med bsams na/ /bag med sos dal du sdod pa 'khrul lo/ /bzod dka' thar med kyi ngan song bsams na/ /skyabs shig de ring rang mi btsal thabs med/ /las 'bras nges pa dang 'phel tshul bsams na/ / dge sdeg phra mor yang bag zon byed dgos/ /'khor ba mtha' ngan gyi ngang tshul bsams nas/ / nges 'byung tshul khrims la slob par byed dgos/ /drin lan 'khor med kyi ma rnams don du/ /sems bskyed phyin drug gi spyod la slob dgos/ / khyad par mtha' bral gyi lta bas rgyas btab/ / zab lam gsang sngags kyis snon pa 'debs dgos/ /de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen/ / sten tshul rten 'brel gyi mgo nas 'grig dgos/ /zhe4pa'ang rje nyid kyi gsung yin no/ / / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la brtse ba'i dbang gyur te/ / bya dka'i spyod pa dpag med goms pa yis/ / yon tan kun rdzogs skyob pa bla na med/ / bla ma thub pa'i dbang pos dus kun skyongs/ / dal ba'i rten thob rgyal pa'i bstan dang mjal/ / dam pas rjes bzung mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /don med g.yeng bas rang nyid ma bslus par/ / rnam gzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub bar rigs/ / ya mtha' gtugs pa med pa'i dus shig nas/ /gting zab 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir/ / las dang nyon mongs rlung gis rab bdas te/ / dbang med zo chun 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ /khyad par lcags sreg 'bar ba'i dmyal khang du/ / bzod glags med par sdug bsngal 'ga' zhig gi / ngang du mtha' yas bskal par gnas 266

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/pa las/ / dal 'byor thob pa da lan tsam zhig yin/ / yar 'gro mar 'gro gnyis kyi so mtshams 'dir/ /skyid sdug 'dam ga rang la gtad pa'i tshe/ /brtson pa drag pos btsan sa ma zin na/ / slar yang dmyal ba'i gnas der 'khridapar nges/ / rlung nang mar me lta bur g.yo ba'i srog / sngon chad ma 'gags bla ma lha yi drin/ / da ni de ring kho na mi 'chi ba'i/ / blo gdeng med phyir phyi bshol ga la rigs/ / gnyen 'khor longs spyod ji tsam 'dzoms na yang / /rmi lam ji bzhin dran pa'i yul du 'gyur/ / phyi mar 'gro tshe lus dang grib ma bzhin/ / rjes su 'gro ba dkar nag las 'bras yin/ / de phyir bag yod dran shes brtan po yis/ / sdig ltung phra mo tsam yang spong ba dang / / dad dang shes rab brtson 'grus shugs drag gis/ / sgo gsum dge ba'i las la bkol bar gyis/ / khyad par bstan pa'i gzhi ma so sor thar/ /bde gshegs gzhung lam byang sems sdom pa dang / / dngos grub rtsa ba gsangs sngags dam tshig gsum/ / tshul bzhin bsrung ba chos kyi nying khu yin/sdom gsum mig 'bras lta bur bsrung ba las/ / lhag pa'i nyams len snying po gzhan med par/ / rgyal kun mgrin dbyangs gcig gis gsungs pas na/ / bstan pa'i snying po 'di la 'bad par rigs/ / rang gis sgo gsum dge ba gang byas kyang / / de nyid rnam dag chos su 'gyur ba la/ / 'di snang chos brgyad gdon gyis ma bslad par/ / srid las nges 'byung bsam pas zin pa gces/ / ma lus 'gro kun pha mar mthong ba yis/ / de phyir byang chub sgrub 'dod sems bskyed dang / / dngos 'dzin rtsa bral shes rab zung 'brel te/ / theg mchog lam gyi dga' ston myong bar bya/ / mdor na byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sgos/ / thub bstan yongs la bag chags ci thebs kyis/ / nyin bzhin dal 'byor don ldan byed pa dang / / bsngo smon dge ba'i 267

༄/ /yo cabasaba'irnanama'igayo la /mtshamasasbyor nan tan bya/ / blo dang brtson pa'i nus pa ci yod kyis/ / sngon rabs dam pa'i rjes su slob byed pa / / de ni skal bzang skye bo zhes bya ste/ /dal 'byor thob pa 'bras bur bcas pa yin/ / 'dir 'bad dge ba'ang don med 'khor bde'i rgyur/ /mi smin khro sogs rkyen gyis mi gzhom par/ /sras bcas rgyal bas gang du bsngos pa yi/ / 'bras bzang mtha' dag 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa brag lung ri khrod pa dkon mchog chosa'aphel gyisadage sbyor labaskul ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus zhig dgosazhes bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /rmad byung thugs rje chen po'i dbang gyur te/ / nyin bzhin zab rgyas chos kyi gru sbyar nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid mtsho las sgol ba'i/ / ded dpon mchog gis rtag tu skyong gyur cig / rnyed dka' don che dal pa'i rten thob cing / / 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying po mchog dang 'jal/ / mthun pa'i rkyen kun lan gcig 'dzoms dus 'dir/ / lam bzang sgrub pa snying por byed pa gces/ / de yang lam mchog sgrub par byed pa la/ / lam gyi rtsa bar gyur pa bshes gnyen te/ / rnam dag lam gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims dang / /lam gyi ngo bo sgrub pa nan tan yin/ / dang po mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gter/ / theg gsum lung rtogs chos kun 'byung pa'i gnas/ / gtan gyi bde skyid rten 'brel thog ma'i sgo/ / skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma ste/ / yi dam lha yi 'khor lo thams cad kyang / /'bral med rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab cing / / phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal kun dus drug tu/ / de la mchod cing bkur ste bya bar gsungs/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang dngos su byon na yang / rjes su ston pa 'di las gzhan med pas/ / sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin dran pa yis/ / bka' bzhin 268

༄/ /༅gnyerab4khya/bsgrub pa chos kyi rtsa ba yin/ / rgyal bas chos phung brgyad khri gsungs pa yang / / sde snod gsum du 'dus shing de yi don/ / ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pa rnam gnyis kyang / / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rjes su 'gro/ /sdigaltung so sos rnam smin bzod dka' ba/ / bskyed cing sa lam bgrod la gegs byed phyir/ / sdig pa kun las sdom gsum dang 'gal ba'i/ / nyes rnams srog dang bsdos te spong pa gces/ / mngon par mtho dang theg gsum thar pa'i lam/ / gsang chen rim gnyis rnal 'byor mtha' dag kyang / /rmangagazhi bslab khrims dam tshig gtsang ma la/ / ltos par rgyal kun mgrin dbyangs gcig gis gsungs/ / de phyir tshul khrims dag pa las lhag pa'i/ /nyams len snying po gzhan du ma mchis kyang / / de nyid gzhir byas mdo sngags lam rim la/ / dpyad 'jog sgom pa sgrub pa'i yang rtse yin/ /'on te zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams kyang / /ji bzhin gdams pa'i mchog tu 'gro ba ni/ / rang gi sems nyid kho nar rag las kyi/ / 'khor 'das kun la byed po gzhan na med/ / des na rgyun du dran shes bag yod kyis/ / rang sems dge ba'i srol du btsud byas na/ /ci byas byang chub mchog gi rgyur 'gro bas/ /gcig chog sgrub pa man ngag snying bo yin/ / mdor na sngon byon dam pa so so yis/ / yang dag lam gye 'jug ngogs mang gsungs kyang / / rtsa ba gsumapo 'di las ma 'das pas/ / nam yang brjed med snying gi dkyil du chongs/ / rang la nyams myong med pa'i kha bshad glus/ / gzhan rgyud chos la 'khol ba dka' mod kyang / / mtshan ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i zhal rlangs drod/ / ma nyams bdud rtsi thar pa'i srog zungs yin/ / 'dir 'bad dge ba'i dpung ba mi dman pas/ / lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs bzung nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las bsgral te/ / rnam grol 269

༄/ /yo cabastan༅ ryā khrung ཿma/sum rtsen grong du 'khrid gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa 'danas sprul ba'i sku dpal ldan thub bstan rgya mtshos sgrub pa snying por byed tshul gyi bslababya zhig dgos zhes bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /mchogaskyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / rje bla ma rnams la phyag byas te/ / chos zab mo byang chub lam rim don/ / tshig nyung ngu go sla'i glu ru len/ / dngos grub kyi gru char 'bebs 'dod na/ / log rtog gyi rlung dmar mi g.yo ba'i/ / dad gus kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la/ / bla ma byin rlabs sprin chen 'khrigs pa dgos/ / 'di legs byas kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ / rten 'brel kun gyi thog ma yin/ / de legs par bsam na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig ang / sngar dal 'byor thob pa'i grar bsdad kyang / / lto gos khol por zad pa yis/ / dud 'gro dang dbyer med gyur pas skyo/ / don ldan byed na dam chos kho nar 'bad/ / sos dal du sdod khom ga la yod/ /'di sems pa nang gi skul lcag yin/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ /blo sna nang du khug cig ang / / bzod med dang thar med kyi ngan song du/ / do nub kyang mi ltung gdeng med pas/ / da skyabs shig btsal na btsal ran yin/ / skyobs byed dngos gzhi las 'bras blang dor yin/ /rang bsam bzhin dmyal bar mchong tshul med/ / long pa spyo 'gros ma byed cig / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig ang / / tshe phyi mar bde 'gro'i rten thob kyang / / da lan bzhin stong par zad gyur na/ / sdug phyi thag ring pa khyad med pas/ / khams gsum 'khor ba kun las thar ba bde/ / de sred pas rang rang bcings pa yin/ / da kun la zhen log nges 'byung dgos/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo 270

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabs/sna nang du khug cig ang / / marig sred len zhen pa yis/ / las srid pa'i sa bon btab pa las/ sdug bsngal bdun gyi lo tog rgyas/ / yang btab cing brngas te yang btab pas/ / sdug bsngal gyi pha mthar phyin dus med/ / thar pa'i dgon par bros na legs/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ /blo sna nang du khug cig yang / / srin bu mi gtsang dri la 'khor ba bzhin/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag 'dzin gyi/ / rgyu las nyes tshogs kun 'byung bas/ /nyes kun zhi ba'i 'gog pa thob na bde/ / de thob byed yang dag rigs pa'i lam/ / de'i rtsa ba rnam dag tshul khrims yin/ / de legs par bsamasan rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig ang / / ma rgan long ba gcan gzan gyi/ / khar bor nas bros na khrel med yin/ / sdug rang gis 'khur ba'i go bgos na/ / ya rabs rgyal ba'i sras kyi grangs su 'gro/ / de nas phyin drug nyams len gyi/ / dam bca' mtha' ru 'don pa gces/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig yang / / blo 'khrul ngor nga zhes tshugs thub 'dra/ / gcig min gzhan min gyi sdod tshul med/ / der dpyad na 'ga' yang ma rnyed pas/ / snang ba tsam las rang bzhin med par nges/ / snang stong 'gal med grogs gyur 'di/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig yang / / gzugs can rnams phyogs kyi cha shas dang / / shes pa rnams skad cig snga phyi'i 'phreng / / ldan min yang yan lag tshogs pa la/ / btags tsam las ngo bo ma grub pas/ / bdag med gnyis stong gzhi'i khyad tsam las/ / gnad rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur gcig gis shes/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig ang / / thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / rnam dag dbang gis smin 271

༄/ /yo cabamapa'iskyonama'i ga lam/byas nas/ / rim gnyis rnal 'byor la 'bad na/ / don gnyis dga' ston rangagi lag tu yong / / de'i rtsa ba dam tshig bsrung ba yin/ / gtan 'dun 'phyug pa med par mdzod/ / de legs par bsams na rang la phan/ / blo sna nang du khug cig ang / / tshul 'di skad smras pa'i dge ba yis/ / dus rtag tudal 'byor rten thob cing / / lam bzang bo 'di dang mi 'bral bas/ /dpal sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog / cesapa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rgya mkhar dpon po dkon mchog choyo'abyor dang dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas gnyis kyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngags ram pa ratna lhananta'o/ / / /kye ma kye hud bsam blo nang du skor/ / yeng ma yeng la sdod thabs ga na yod/ / ci bya ci byed med pa'i dus shig 'byung / / rang mgo rang gis 'don dgos a tsa ma/ 'jigs 'jigs gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa na/ /rig rig mig gis phyogs bcur bltas na yang / / zhum zhum skyo ba'i grogs su gyur pa las/ / lhang lhang dga' ba skyed byed gang yang med/ / bsags bsags 'byor pa sog ma'i phon thag chad/ / 'grig 'grig kha bshad pi wang rgyud thag chad/ / mkho mkho mang po'i sems kyi re thag chad/ / 'dar 'dar ya nga'i 'phrang du a thang chad/ / ci drag ci drag bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / mkhyen no mkhyen no thugs rje lcags kyus zungs/ / zungs shig zungs shig ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyobs/ / skyobs shig skyobs shig bla ma thugs rje can/ / 'di'ang mtshamasakyi thun gseng zhig tu stsal pa'o/ / / /skyabs gnas bslu med mchog gsum/ / snying nas gsol ba 'debs so/ / byang chub snying po'i bar du/ / rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs shig /'di phyi'i legs tshogs rtsa ba/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal skyin/ / mtshan 272

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababyu/ldan bshes gnyen dam pa/ / bsam spyor dag pas sten cig / rnyed dka' don che'i dal 'byor/ /lan gcig tsam zhig thob pa/ / sngon chad stong par zad pas/ / tshe lhag don ldan gyis shig / sangs bya gnangs ba'i ngang la/ /'chi bdag dgra bos 'khyer bas/ / bya ba kun las thog mar/ / lha chos gtso bor mdzod cig / mchog gsum bsod nams zhing la/ / mjal ba da lan tsam yin/ / rlom sems g.yo sgyus ma bslad/ / phyag mchod tshogs bsags rems shig / blo rtsal stobs 'byor 'dzom yang / / skyid sdug legs nyes 'khyer so/ / dbang med las kyis 'khyer bas/ / de nyid dpang por zhog cig / srid 'byor ji tsam bsgrubs kyang / / rdul tsam 'khyer dbang med la/ / rnam smin phyi bzhin 'brang bas/ / don med sdig pa ma gsog / zab zab gdams pa mang yang / / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten/ /mi bsrung rang dbang med pa/ / khas blangs tshul khrims yin pas/ / dran shes bag yod sgo nas/ / nyams len snying por byas na/ / lung rtogs yon tan thams cad/ / yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel lo/ / 'on kyang rmongs pa'i mun sel/ / thos pa'i sgron me med na/ / blang dor bya thabs bral bas/ /slob gnyer nan tan gyis shig / kha bshad rlung la bskur na/ / chu nang rdo ba bzhin du/ / rang rgyud skam por ldus pas/ / gang shes rgyud la sbyor cig /mdoran sgo gsum spyod pa/ / ci byas chos dang sbyar te/ / 'chi ba thog tu babs kyang / / 'gyod pa med pa gyis shig / nye bar mkho ba'i bslab bya/ /nyung 'dus smras ba 'di yang / / snyan gong yutpal ma byed/ / snying gi dpal be'ur chongs shig / de skad bsnyad pa'i dge tshogs/ / blo gsal don gnyer can rnams/ / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom la/ / 'jug pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog thabasamakhas dang blo 273

༄/ /gung bangabayopa'i sgronama' g.yo ཿmabazangadakon mchog gnyi4kyi4bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ / blang dor ji bzhin 'doms pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ / theg gsum dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / phyin ci log gi rtog pa kun zhi ste/ / blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / sdom pa nod pa mang yang bsrung pa dkon/ / bslab bya zhu ba mang yang slob pa nyung / /gzhan phan dka' yang dad ldan slob ma yis/ / snying la 'ching rgyu'i bslab bya dgos so zhes/ / nan gyis bskul ba'i g.yar ngo ma chod par/ / bslab bya'i gnad 'ga' thol byung tshul du gleng / / bya ba kun la las 'bras dpang por zhog / skyid sdug cir yang mchog gsum blo gtad kyes/ / gzhung lugs kun las byang chub lam rim dang / / nyams len kun las tshul khrims gtso bor zungs/ / 'di nyid bstan pa spyi la slob tshul te/ / 'di ni brjed med snying la bcing bar 'os/ / tho rangs snga bar lang tshe mdang gi dus/ / ma shi lang rgyu byung ba mchog gsum drin/ / da tsam dmyal bar gnas na ci tshugs byed/ / de ring chos kyis don ldan bya'o snyam/ / 'di ni dang por 'phen pa gtong tshul yin/ / de yang brjed med snying la bcing bar 'os/ / dkor zasaspyod tshe ldan grol gdeng med na/ / lcags gong 'bar ba 'dra bar rgyal bas gsungs/ / dge sbyor byin pa'i tshul dang 'du shes bcu/ / sems dpa'igazhan don sngags kyi sbyin sreg tshul/ / 'di ni bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor yin/ / de yang ma gos ni bzang ngan mtha' ru ma lhung zhing / / rgyu sogs rung ba bgo lugs tshul dang mthun/ / nang gi bla ma lha la mchod rdzas su/ / bsngos na rang gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang / / 'di ni gos dang 274
