༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabs/gnas sogs spyod tshul yin/ / de yang za gcig pu yin kyang lus kyi bag med spongs/ / mang po'i nang du ngag gi skyon yon rtog / rnam pa kun tu rang sems zhu dag byed/ / sgo gsum spyod pa mtha' dag chos dang bstun/ / 'di ni rgyun du dran shes bsten tshul yin/ / de yang za gnyen la ha cang chags pa mi bya zhing / / dgra la ha cang khon 'dzin mi bya ste/ / gsar 'grogs mi che phyi thag bsring ba dang / / phog thug mi mang sna thag ma shor bya/ / 'di ni 'jig rten ya rabs spyod tshul yin/ / de yang ma don med sdig can gnas su mi 'gro zhing / / 'gro tshe zhi dul bag yod 'dul bar bstun/ / bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing khams su/ / 'gro'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa goms par bya/ / 'di ni 'phral yun dgos pa'i don dang ldan/ / de yang ma skyid kyang mi rlom dkon mchog drin du lta/ / sdug kyang mi 'khang rang gi las su bsam/ / bstod la mi dga' bsod nams nyams byed dang / / smad la mi khro sdeg pa'i phyags mar bsgom/ / 'di ni chos brgyad mgo snyoms gdams pa yin/ /de yang ma nyal kha nyin der dge sdug gang byung ba/ / brtags te dgeb mang na dga' ba sgom/ / sdig pa mang na rang la spyod brdal te/ /phyirabacos brgyas nas zhag tu 'grogs mi bya/ / 'di ni nyes lhung sbyong ba'i thabs mchog yin/ / de yang ma mtshan ldan bshes gnyen gtsug gi rgyan du bsten/ /chos mthun grogs bzang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ / mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs po ni/ / srin mo'i 'dzum dang ha la'i dug bzhin spongs/ /'di ni nyams len kun gyi mgo 'don yin/ / de yang ma chos tshulaspan gyi ming tsam shes pa yis/ / nyon mongs gdung pa'i nad rims mi sel bas/ / gang shes rang gi rgyud la sbyar byas te/ / byang chub lam du 'gyur nges mdzod cig ces/ / gsol 'di snyan rgyab bser bu ma mdzad 275

༄khya/ /gung thangabastanaba'icanas gsang 'a gabar/ /ji bzhin lag tu longs shig skal ldan rnams/ /zhesapa 'di ni hal hakhu re chen mo'i grwa rigasadad brtson ldan pa blo bzang rigs grol gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /bde dge legs tshogs yon tan dus gsum du/ / ji snyed byung pa thams cad bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ /rnam dkar smon pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / sdug bsngal srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal ba'i rten/ / dal 'byor gru gzings rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ /don ldan snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgan gzhon nges med 'chi ba mthong ba na/ /rang la bag zon skyes ba bla ma'i drin/ /slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ / bskul ma nang nas thebs par byin gyis rlobs/ / dkon mchog las 'bras bslu ba med pa la/ / yid ches cung zad rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ /blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag sdug bsngal las/ / thar 'dod bag tsam skyes pa bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ / nges 'byung rnal ma skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /so so thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ / sdom gsum tshang bar thob pa bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs/ / rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzhi rten sems bskyed la/ /yid smon 'dun pa skyes pa bla ma'i drin/ /slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ theg mchog rtsa ba tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ / srid rtsa gcod byed zab mo'i lta ba la/ / sgra spyi'i 276

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababya/brda tsam 'jags pa bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ / chos kun de nyid rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ / byin rlabs gter gyur lha sngags du ma dang / / mjal ba'i skal bzang thob pa bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ / zab lam mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bzang ngan rkyen gyi snang ba ci shar yang / /lam gyi grogs su bsgyur 'dod bla ma'i drin/ / slar 0 nga bka' drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ / nyams len mtha' ru thon par byin gyis rlobs/ / ma 'ongs dus na sa lam spangs rtogs kyi/ / yon tan skyes tshe de yang bla ma'i drin/ / slar yang bkal drin dran pas gsol 'debs na/ /'gro kun mgon du 'gyur bar byin gyes zlobs/ / zhe4pa 'di ni hal ha ja sag thu rgyal po'i shog nas lhag bsam dang rnamadapyod phul du byung pa rab 'byamasapa dkon mchog smon lam gyiyobaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyosbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /blo bzang rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / dgyes bzhad kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i sde'i/ / bzhed dgongs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i sgron me mchog / skal ba ji bzhin gang 'dul skur ston pa'i/ /'dren pa mtshungs med gtan gye skyabs gcig pu/ / khyod las gzhan nas med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar ba'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung snying po'i don/ / tshang la ma nor mdo sngags lam bzang kun/ / ji bzhin gdams shing rjes su ston pa yi/ / dpal ldan bla ma thar pa'i sa mkhan mchog / khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs 277

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'isgronace' gas 'chagalas bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar pa'i gnas der drang du gsol/ /'od gsal mkha' la bde chen 'od lnga'i mdangs/ / dag pa rab 'byams brtan g.yo'i sgyu 'phrul gyes/ / las bzhi grub chen brgyad dang zung 'jug gi / dngos grub rin chen 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin la/ / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po yi dam lha/ /khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ /phra rags 'khor pa'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar pa'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus nas/ /'gro blor gang 'tsham gzugs kyi skur bstan te/ / zab rgyas chosakyi snying po kun stsol pa'i/ / theg gsum thar 'dod yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar pa'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / khyad par mi 'gyur lhan skyes dga' ba mchog / spros bral de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig pas/ /skad cig nyid la srid rtsa drungs phyung nas/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gur khang du/ / nye bar 'khrid mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar ba'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / gang gi byin rlabs dbang po'i rdo rje yis/ / nag phyogs sde dang bcas pa'i sa 'dzin rkang / /phye mar 'thag byed bstan srung tshogs kyi rje/ /mi phyed dam tshig rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis/ / dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur ba/ / khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar pa'i gnas der drang du gsol/ / mdor na deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ / gang gi 278

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabaphya/zhabs pad gtsug gis gus mchod nas/ / lam gyi bar chad mtha' dag sel ba dang / / mthun rkyen legs tshogs ma lus grub pa yi/ / mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen re ba'i gnas/ / khyod las gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / bde chen thar pa'i gnas der drang du dasol/ / zhe4pa 'di ni ucu mu chin shog nasadad brtson blo dang ldan pabaka' bcu dkon mchog skal ldan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabris pa'o/ / / /dbyings spros dang bral ba'i lha lam ngos/ / yul kun rdzob snang ba'i 'ja' tshon dbus/ / gdan pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng / / pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med pa rdo rje 'jigs mdzad che/ / steng zhal dgu 'bar bas khams gsum za/ / phyag so bzhis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ / zhabs bcu drug bgrad pas sa gsum g.yo/ / g.yang srid zhi'i mtha' las sgrol ba yi/ / mgon khyod min re sa gzhan med do/ / thugs brtse bas bdag gi mgon mdzod la/ / dgra phyi nang gshin rje'i g.yul las skyob/ / rgyal kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / khro rgyal gyi skur bstan gshin rje'i gshed/ / ngur smrig gi gar mkhan tsong kha ba/ / gsum 'dus kyi ngo bo drin can rje/ / khyod bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang / /dpal chos srung kun gyi ngo bo ru/ / yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ / sprang skyabs med bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig / stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor kyang / / rmi lam gyi dga' ston rol pa 'dra/ /thabs brgya yis bsgrubs kyang 'dor dgos pa'i/ / tshe 'di snang byis pa'i rtsed 'jo yis/ / gtan 'dun la bslu ba'i blo ngan gye/ / gdon khong na gnas 'di drungs phyung ste/ / chos rnam dag bslab gsum bsrung nus 279

༄/ /yo bamab ཿ tsha ༅mapar/ / rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lha/ / rang srog las 'phang ba'i gces sprayokyes/ / lan grangs med bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ / sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i ngang tshul la/ / shas mi bzod snying rjes yid drangs te/ / yongs 'gro ba'i don gyi khur bzung nas/ / skyabs bla med byang chub sgrub pa yi/ / sems bcos min myur du skye ba ru/ / rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lha/ / dus ya mtha' med pa'i 'khor pa 'dir/ / bzod med kyi sdug bsngal myong gyur kyang / / da dung yang rang grol mi 'ong bas/ / de'i rtsa bar gyur pa ngar 'dzin gdon/ / yul stong pa'i dngos la tshugs thub kyi/ /bdagagazhan du phye ba'i phung khrol gzhi/ / blo 'khrul ba'i rang mtshang rtogs nus par/ /rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lha/ / tha mal gyi skye shi lcags kyi khams/ / sku gsum gyi gser 'gyur rtsis bran te / / rten brten pa dag pa'i 'khor lo'i mdangs/ / dmigs med kyi dbyings su bkra ba yis/ / lhan skyes kyi bde bas rab myos te/ / dpal zung 'jug mdzes ma'i lang tshol /dus rtag tu dga' bas spyor pa ru/ / rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lha/ /dusagasum gyi dge tshogs mchod par 'bul/ / rang gzhan gyi sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ / lar bskal ba rgya mtshor rtag bzhugs nas/ / chos zab rgyas kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stsol/ / 'dis mtshon gyi dge ba'i dngos po kun/ / dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / rjebla mas 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ / zhesapa 'di ni sunyid shog nasarnam dpyod yangasapa rab 'byamasapa ngag dbang bsod namayokyisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /213

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslababyu/lta ba'imaguram denyidalta ba'imig 'byed tsesaphya ba bzhugs/ /dpa' bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid de/ / dbyings spros bral ngang du rol ba yis/ / ma nyam thag 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin pa/ / rje bla ma'i zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod/ / gnas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yod do cog / dgra bdag 'dzin gdon gyis bskyed pas na/ / de drungs nas 'byin pa'i thabs tshul la/ / bu thar 'dod yongs kyis 'bad par rigs/ /da 'on kyang phra la ches zab pa/ / don de nyid rig pa'i snga rol na/ /ches rags pa'i mi rtag sdug bsngal dang / / stong bdag med rtogs dgos rim pa mang / / na rgan gzhon med par glo bur gyi/ / rkyen du mas 'chi ba mthong bzhin du/ / rang 'chi snyam blo yang mi skye na/ / lam zab mo'i rtogs pa ga la skye/ / rten gcig la lo zla re rer yang / / skyid sdug dang 'byor rgud nges med tshul/ / shes bzhin du zhen pa a 'thas la/ / blo nges 'byung rnal ma'i re ba dka'/ / khong bye mdo sems tsam rang rgyud pa'i/ /chos lta ba'i skas la mas rim bzhin/ / yar ma 'dzeg dang po kho na nas/ /chos mthon pa'i sbar 'dzin stong 'ud yin/ / lar bdag cag rang rang snang ba 'dir/ /zo ma reg bden pa sor bzhag gi / blos bcos pa'i dgag bya 'gog pa 'dis/ / kho lhan skyes sku mkharabartan du gtong / /ming dbu mar btags kyang rang cag rnams/ / blo'i ngo na bden stong mthar thug gi /mtshams 'di las phra zhing zab pa zhig / khong don smra rnams kyang dgongs te mchi/ / gcig du bral la sogs gtan tshigs kyis/ / chos bden med kha yis sgrub na yang / / sems gtad so rtag gcig rang dbang ba'i/ / bdag 281

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'itshanasa'i ga ཿmaphyogs tsam khegs kyang mtshar du che/ / khong don smra don gye sa le sbram/ /bdag rags pa'i g.ya' dang bral shul na/ / don bden grub dngos po'i rang mdangs shig / tshur rnam pa gtod byed yod do zer/ / de bkag ste rnam rig smra ba rnams/ / nang 'dzin pa'i pir gye ngos 'di na/ / yul sna tshogs mdangs bkra bag chags kyi/ / tshon bden pa'i shas cig yod par smra/ /khong rang rgyud pa rnams bden pa'i dngos/ /yul yul can gang la mi dmigs kyang / / lcags rdo dang phrad pa'i rten 'byung las/ / me 'byung ba sreg byed rang mtshan zer/ / dpal klu sgrub dgongs pa mthar thug ni/ /byad me long ngos la shar ba bzhin/ / snang tsam bo ma gtogs phyi nang na/ /don ngo bos grub pa 'gar yang med/ / sa'i dum bur dbu dang phyag go zhes/ /ming btags kyin bcos pa tshogs tsam na/ / phar btags nyams med par rang ngos nas/ / tshur grub grub 'dra yang ga la bden/ / de yin kyang tshogs pa'i rten 'byung gis/ / las bsod nams gsog pa'i gzhir 'gyur te/ /rkyen tshogs bas khang khyim cha byad sogs/ /kun dgos ba sgrub la bsnyon du med/ / mgon sangs rgyas nas bzung rang cag bar/ / kun bden med brjod pa'i tshig 'dra yang / / blo'i 'char tshul shar nub bzhin gyur pas/ /lam so so rang rigaspyod yul gsungs/ /gang rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ / der skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ / rkyen gzhan la ltos phyir stong pa zhes/ / gsung de las lhag pa'i ston tshul med/ / rgyu tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gnad smin la/ / de tsam gyes lta ba rtogs nus te/ /mi phalacher skyes phyir mi skyes zhes/ / tshig dngos zin 'gal ba lta bur go /blos stong phyogs bsam bas stong tshul re/ / 'char sla yang nyen dang gol sa che/ /lugs 'og ma kun kyang rtag pa yi/ /mtha' stong pas sel bar mgrin 282

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabaphya/gcig smra/ / snang tsam gyi rten 'byung 'di bsam pas/ / don stong pa shar na ya mtshan te/ / kun bden par zhen pa'i rkyen de yis/ / phyir bden 'dzin gzhom nus skal ba bzang / / 'bras rgyu la ltos pa'i rten 'byung tsam/ /yongs dngos bor smra ba kun 'dod kyang / / rgyu 'bras bur ltos shing dgra gnyen sogs/ / kun phan tshun ltos pa'i btags yod 'di/ / yul dus gsum bya byed thams cad la/ / sgo kun nas sbyar te dpyad ba yis/ / dus deng sang snang tshad bden zhen 'di/ / go bzlog bas gang snang stong par 'char/ / dus de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs/ / dpal klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa rnyed/ / g.yang rtag chad mtha' las grol ba yi/ / mgon rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam du zhugs/ / don de ltar sgrub pa'i rgyu yi gtso/ / gzhi dad dang tshul khrims zhing sa la/ / lha bla ma'i byin rlabs drod phebs shing / / rgyu nges don dpyod pa'i sa bon btab/ / rkyen tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong chu lud bkye/ /lam gol ba'i rtsa dang ldum bsal na/ / gnad mthar thug lta ba'i lo tog 'khrungs/ / rang nyams myong med pa'i kha bshad glus/ / gzhan chos la 'khul ba dka' mod kyang / / pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung zlos pa'i/ / dge 'di yis 'gro kun rgyal gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni bstan ba'i gsal byed rgyal mkhan po gragasapa rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabri4pa'o/ / / /bslab byazlogasgom gyi tshul duzas bskyanaphan gsal ba'ime long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /'brug pa kun legs bzhin bshad na/ / mthos rgyag dmas rgyag la 283

༄/ /yo cabastanapa'isgronas ga lam/gtod de/ / ge ser sgrung glu la nyan bzhin/ / dga' mdog sdug mdog re gyesadang / / nyams len gnad 'dril zhig byed na/ / rtsa ba kun slong nas tshugs dgos/ /gtad so med pa zhig byed na/ /kha zin sna zin nas sgoms shig / sgrub pa mthar thon zhig byed na/ / mdun ma sna gcig la gtod dgos/ / sna sun phug med du skyur na/ / 'phral la tsha drag rang thongs shig / ri khrod dben nges shig byed par/ / 'du 'dzi gtan chod rang dgos kyi/ / bsam sbyor grong yul du gtad na/ / ri kha'i spyang ki dang 'dra 'o/ / lus bde sems bde ru 'dug na/ / rang shong spyil bu ru bsdad chog /ngal dub zin med cig byed na/ / khang rgan zhig 'chos la rems shig /mtho ris thar ba'i lam tshol na/ / lam ston bshes gnyen la rag las/ /phyi ldir nang stong gis chog na/ / grags skam bla chen rer 'jus shig / mgon skyabs bslu med cig bsten na/ / skyid sdug dkon mchog rang mkhyen gyis/ / mgo zhwas gnya' gnon zhig dgos na/ / khrel med rje dpon la sten cig /sos bde gu yangs shig 'dod na/ / sna thag rang mgo la dkri dgos/ / mi khom stong 'ur la gzan na/ / che che mtho mtho'i rtsar rgyug cig / gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe kun bzlog na/ / skyabs 'gro las 'bras la phugs gtod/ / bar chad rkyen dbang du gtong na/ / rnam rtog tsab tsub rang gyis shig /re ba don ldan zhig bya na/ /dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson dgos/ /tshegs che don chung zhig byed na/ /phyug po'i ngo 'dzin la 'bod cig / nam phugs legs pa zhig 'dod na/ / las 'bras lag rten du byed dgos/ / rang gi rang sma zhig 'bebs na/ / ha cang blo rgod po gyes shig / 'phral yun kun skyid cig 'dod na/ / dge ba bre phul gyes gsog dgos/ /'di sdug phyi sdug la gtong na/ /khe tshong bun log la rems yam

༄/ /slobaganyerab4phya/shig / bstan 'dzin gral mjug tu sdod na/ / rang rgyud bslab gsum la tshag gyis/ / mi 'dzin bshig pa rang dga' na/ / dus dang tshul bstan la khag zhog / nyes ltung mtshon non gyis 'jigs na/ / dran shes go cha rang sten dgos/ / mtho ris srog 'chad la mi 'dzem/ / khrel med gcer rgyug rang gyis shig /phyi btsun nang btsun zhig byed na/ / dgag sgrub 'dul ba dang bstun dgos/ / mig sngar mdzes chos kyis chog na/ / sgur sgur zhum zhum rang gyis shig / dad pa gting khul zhig skyes na/ / brtson pa lhod med cig sleb yong / / ri bong cal rgyug gi dad pas/ / phyag 'tshal rdul gtsub rang yin no/ / don ldan rnam dkar gyi las la/ / spro pa brtson 'grus kyi don yin/ /don med sdug las la phod btsugs/ glang rgan sa gsheg rang yin no/ / rnam 'byed shes rab rang yin na/ / gsung rab dgongs don la 'jug dgos/ / 'phral la shes mdog gi blo yang / zla 'od don rtsa na mi gsal/ /'chad nyan rnam dag tu 'gro ba/ / bla slob mtshan ldan zhig 'dzom dgos/ / chos med dad med gnyis 'tshogs na/ / nyin kha'i kha bdal rang yin no/ / thos pa don ldan cig bgyid na/ / gang shes rgyud thog tu sbyor dgos/ / mkhas pa don med cig byed na/ / tha snyad tshig skam rang sgrugs shig / chos pa tshad ldan rang yin min/ / rang sems dpang po ru 'jog dgos/ / gzhan mgo skor thabs kyis chog na/ / mig btsum kha 'jam rang gyes shig / gsang sngags tshul bzhin du sgrub na/ / dam tshig sdom pa la gzab dgos/ / mi phung bdag brlag cig bya na/ / grub rdzu'i spyo spyod rang ston cig / nyin mtshan don ldan du byed na/ / rgyun du rang sems la blta dgos/ /mi tshe stong zad du gtong na/ / don med ngag 'khyal rang shod cig /zhag gcig sdod nges kyang med pas/ / 'chi khar phan nges shig bya 20

༄/ /gung cabastan༅ ཿ tsha ཿma/dgos/ / yang na gtad yod bzhin gyes la/ / lo brgya'i sa bcad rang khroms shig / phyir 'byon rang dbang zhig yod na/ / phar 'gro de las kyang yod dgos/ /min na 'byon mdog gi shom ra/ / shes bzhin rang gis rang slus shig / rigs drug gang rung gi gnas su/ / skye zhig nges par ni skye bas/ / de dus phan nges kyi chos shig / da lta bsgrubs na rang e dga'/ /sku skye bstan don du byon na/ / bshad sgrub lag rjes shig yod dgos/ /'khor ba'i zong rten zhig byed rgyur/ / btsan phyug bu pho res los chog /mnan gyin mtho ba zhig byed na/ / yon tan slob pa la sgur dgos/ /btegs kyin dma' ba zhig byed na/ / brgyag ches mgo rgyal la thongs shig / gzhan phan rnal ma zhig sgrub na/ / sngon la rang gi rgyud dul dgos/ /tshong zong dbang bskur la byed rgyur/ / chos la dred kyin rang kham che/ /mngon shes ting 'dzin las 'byung zhing / / de rgyu tshul khrims la rag las/ rgyu med 'dre mthong gi cal col/ / sdom pa'i phyags ma rang yin no/ / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sman spyor/ / nyon mongs gnyen po ru 'gro dgos/ / chags sdang nga rgyal gyi sman log / nad kyi kha snon las med do/ /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan zhig byed na/ / 'gro drug spyi bo ru 'khur dgos/ / kun gyis zhen log cig nyo na/ / gzhan la brnyas smod rang thongs shig / bya ba 'chug med cig sgrub na/ / rang dpe gzhan dpe gnyis spyor dgos/ / min log rgyab 'gal rang gtong na/ / rang 'dod gcig pu la gcus shig /gzhan gyi rtsis thog tu sdod na/ / don nyung khog drang zhig byed dgos/ / kun gyis brnyas pa zhig bya na/ / kha mang rdzun shob rang shod cig / mi rung mi rung rang byas na/ / rung ba'i don steng nas mi 'dzur/ / ci skyon ci skyon rang byas na/ / 'di skyon dmyal ba nas bstan yong / / pham pas mnar med ༅6

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabaphya/du 'phen pas/ / ma byin len sogs la 'dzem dgos/ / min na zho gang gi don du/ / sdom pa gtor rgyag rang gyis thongs/ / phyug po blo bde zhig dga' na/ / chog shes bang mdzod la brten dgos/ / dbul po gang med cig byed na/ / mkho che'i sgye ral de zed cig / nor rdzas don ldan du byed na/ /rlom med chos phyogs su gtong dgos/ / tsi tsi'i rnam thar la mos na/ / mug bsog sdug bsog rang gyis shig / bu lon med pa zhig 'dod na/ / dad gshin dkor rdzas la 'dzem dgos/ / lan chags gang che zhig 'gran na/ /gangatsho gang zhim la rgyug cig / kun yid zin pa zhig 'dod na/ / 'dris med dben pa ru sba dgos/ / gcig bzung gnyis shor rang dgos na/ dus ngan mi ngan gye ngo zungs/ / nyams dga' gu yangs su sdod na/ / dgra med gnyen med cig bya dgos/ / re dogs tsher mal du nyal na/ / la rgya phyogs ris la sgrims shig / rgyal po nga che zhig 'dod na/ / ltos med chig thub kye rir sdod/ / yang na khas pher dang lag yong / / kun gyis mngag bde yi g.yog gyis/ / mdun ma stabs bde zhig dgos na/ / bya ba rang tshod la dpag dgos/ /mi theg sdug 'og tu 'dzul na/ / dran tshad de ma thag rtsoms shig / dgras kyang zon byed cig yong bar/ / tshig gcig don steng du sdod dgos/ / gnyen yang kho chad cig byed na/ / rga log stan log rang gyis shig / gnod byed khyi mang gis gtses kyang / / kha rog tsog 'dug la skyon med/ / dal med rub pa zhig byed na/ / sprang dbyug dgu skor du gyis shig / chen po phugs brtan zhig byed na/ / ya rabs srol bzang gi 'phro skyongs/ / mdzo sprel g.yang stung zhig byed na/ / ma rabs grogs ngan la snying gtod/ / nyal bzhin dge chen zhig byed na/ / gzhan la yi rang rang sgom dgos/ / chags sdang rgyal pham la mnyan na/ / sdeg ltung nam mkha' nas 287

༄/ /yo cabastanaba'isgronama'i ga 'gagababaphang / / chos srid ji 'dra zhig byed kyang / / ngo tsha khrel yod 'di gal che/ / khrel med pho rgod du rlom na/ / nam phugs rgyal khams la bstan yong / /go na 'jig rten gyi snang ba/ / kun kyang blo sbyong du shar yong / /min na gsung rab kyi po ti/ / brgya phrag phyag mdzod du rtsig cig / kun rdzob bshad bshad kyis mi tshar/ / shing sna rdo bsgul gyis ri 'dzad/ / go rim nges can gyi khrig med/ / sha zin sru zin nas bshad yod/ / blo skyed 'dug na ni longs shig / kha brgyag dpe 'then yang byas chog / bsam bzang yin khul du yod pas/ / ngag 'khyal du mi 'gro las che ang / / 'di ni 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa lags/ de'ang 'brug pa kun legasakyi mgur ma phal cher zlog sgom gyi tshul rtsabazang ngan gnyisare sbrags te nyamasadod po zhig 'dugapa'i lad mo bya4pa yin/ lad mo zhes pa'ang bshad lugasadabyibs mtshung4byas pa yin gyi/ 'ga' zhig ltar tshog brkusapa dang / don g.yar ba ni min no/ / / /sa stag zla 11tshes 7la thun gseng du/ rnam rtog rlung gis mgo bo 'khor/ / snyigs dus kyi spyod par zhen kha log / kha 'khyal skyug pa 'chor nye bas/ / rang rang gi na bza' phar la then/ / shes rab kyi ral gri so gnyis ma/ / shes bya'i gnas la gdengs ches pas/ / rang mgo smas ba a tsa ma/ /rno phyogs gcig yin na chog pa la/ / 'bad rtsol gyi rta rgod kha yan po/ / bya ba'i thang la rgyug ches na/ / g.yang du stung ba a tsa ma/ / srab mthur zhig yod na chog pa la/ / rgyu nor gyi go re cung rdog de/ / brnab semasasgyur rtsis gsob ches na/ / tshal bar 'gas pa a tsa ma za bde zhig byung na chog pa la/ / smra mkhas kyi dkar nag lce gnyis po/ gang 'grig la glog bzhin 'khyug ches na/ rtse mo 'chag pa a tsa ma/ / lce gcig rang yin ༅8

༄/ /slobaganyerab4phya/na chog pa la/ / mdza' gcug gi grogs mched 'phar 'gro zung / / tshod med kyi mthun tshab che drag na/ / mnyam du rul ba a tsa ma/ / 'grogs lugs shig byas bas chog pa la/ / ming go sa skam po'i shing sdong la/ / je mtho je mthor 'dzeg ches na/ / phra sa nas 'chag pa a tsa ma/ / rked pa ru bsdad na chog pa la/ / grags skam gye bon po'i rnga khog de/ / tshod med du shed kyis brdung nyes na/ / gzhung ral du 'gro ba a tsa ma/ / sgra lhod por byas na chog pa la/ / mtshan snyan po'i ram gyes bskyabs pa'i wa/ / khyad 'phags kyi che ba 'don nyes na/ / than skad kyis brgyal ba a tsa ma/ / 'dzum dmol le bzhugs na chog pa la/ / chos srid kyi 'byor ba'i nyi zla gnyis/ / gnam gang la lhan cig 'dzom ches na/ / mun nag tu 'gro ba a tsa ma/ / ran pa zhig byung bas chog pa la/ / bya bzhag gi mdun gros gtsub shing zung / / sa mtshams med par brdar chos na/ / gnyi ga 'tshig pa a tsa ma/ / dros thog nas bzhag na chog pa la/ / bsod chung gi mi ngan dre'u mo/ / kha drag dbang che'i mngal sbrum na/ / rang gshed du 'gro ba a tsa ma/ / sha yang du bsdas na chogapa la/ / bstan 'gro'i don gyi 'o ma zhig / bsrub pa'i snying po btsal ches na/ / bshang dri kha ba a tsa ma/ / dkar yin thog tu bzhag na chog pa la/ /'o dod 'bod pa'i glang bu de/ / skyon gyi sa rlog 'phen ches pa/ /rang thog tu bab pa a tsa ma/ / kha rog bsdad na chog pa la/ / gtam 'di kun la 'phog gyur cig / phog nas go blo skye gyur cig / phyi ma cung zad bsam gyur cig / blang dor lag tu len gyur cig / cesab lngagasartsom mdzad/ / / /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po dang / / dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ / deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / 'bral med rjes su 'dzin gyur 21

༄/ /ca cabalopa'i yo sa ཿmacig /phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / / chos ldan 'dod don 'grub pa'i phyir/ /snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ / 'bral med thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /ma 'ongs tshe rabs kun tu yang / /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las sgol phyir/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan mi mtshol bas/ / 'bral med thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / mdor na legs tshogs kun gyi sgo/ / khyod zhabs gus pas bsnyen pa las/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa/ /bde blag nyid du 'grub gyur cig /bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas/ /'gro kun dge la spyod pa yis/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod gyur cig /cesapa 'di'ang su nyid shog nas dad ldan rab 'byamasapa blo bzang shesarab dang bstan 'phel gnyisakyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar ba'i yege pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o// // bdag dang pha ma rigs drug sems can ma lus pa/ / dkon mchog gsum 'dus bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / bstan pa'i bdag po rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i sgron me dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /theg gsum 'phags tshogs dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /yidam mkha' 'gro chos srung kun la skyabs su mchi/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ / gsol pa 'debs so byin rlabs lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /mi bzad las dang nyon mongs 'ching pa bcad du gsol/ /'di dang bar do phyi ma'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /khyad par 'chi tshe 'di snang zhen chags bzlog tu gsol/ / dad gus dge sems stobs ldan skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal tshor ba drag po bsal du gsol/ /'byung ba log pa'i sgra bzhi'i 'jigs las bskyab tu 2ga

༄/ /slobaganyerabaslabs/gsol/ / dug gsum rang mdangs g.yang sa gsum las bsgral du gsol/ / 'od gsal sems nyid rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyus med par do'i 'phrang las bde bar drang du gsol/ / 'jigs rung gshin rje'i pho nya'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / srid par 'dren pa'i chags sdang kun rtog bsal du gsol/ / 'khrul snang bden med gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / de tshe bla ma lha yi zhal bzang mngon gyur cing / / snyan pa'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung dga' dad shugs drag skyes/ / de yis sa mkhan mdzad nas bde ba can sogs su/ / 'dab stong padma'isnying por rdzus te skye bar shog / mdor na tshe rabs kun tu dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / / phyin ci log gi blo sna ngan pa mi skye zhing / / tshang la ma nor rgyal pa'i bstan la legs bslabs te/ / 'gro kun don du bla med byang chubasbrar thob shog / cesabar do 'phrang sgrolagyi gsol 'debasamador bsdusapa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong ngag dbang don grub gyesabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabrisapa'o/ /291

ro / /gung thangabaston pa'izla dza' gsang 'bum/༄༅/ / zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/'odagasal spros dang bral ba nam mkha'i dbyings/ / bde chen thugs rje'i chu 'dzin rnam rol las/ / gang 'dul gzugs skur snang ba'i bla ma lha/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i tshogs bcas 'dir gshegs shig / gdong lngas nyer btegs 'od 'bar nor bu'i khrir/ / zhi dul chos 'chad mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ / zhing gi mchog rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / dmu rgod gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la/ / skal bar 'tsham pa'i legs bshad mchog sbyin gyes/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bde la sbyor mdzad pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'i/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sbrin phung sogs/ / rab 'byams phyi nang gsang pa'i mchod tshogs kun/ / bde stong dbyer med ngang du dbul bar bgyi/ / thog ma med nas rmongs pa'i bran gyur mthus/ / rang bde 'joms shing sdug bsngal kun 'dren pa'i/ / phung khrol sbyod pa ji snyed bgyis pa kun/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ / 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas slob mar bcas/ / kun gyi rnam dkar mdzad pa mtha' dag la/ / mchog tu gus pa'i yidakyis rjes yi rang / / thar pa'i sa mkhan ston pa 'khor dang bcas/ /292

༄/ /zab lam blama'i3la 'byorabazhugasapha/rmongs pa'i skye bo ldongs bar mi mdzad par/ / zab rgyas chos kyi sgron me legs sbar nas/ / bde chen thar pa'i grong der 'khrid du gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge pa ci mchis pa/ / mtha' dag rgyal pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin cing / /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgrol ba yi/ / ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / zhes yan lag bdun ba byasal/ / 4gzhi sposabyugasam ṭwāṃbye rte sdiX bhesnye sde rte/ niX/ ༷/kṣiṃ hūṃbye kṣiṃ llī/ga ༷/ ༷ shaṃ ṭwāṃ ༷ /rig// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / zheyosogasakyisarang gi snying gar spyan drangasate/ skye zhing skye bar rje btsun bla ma yis/ / 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med myong pa yis/ /skal bzang mchog la 'dod dgur spyod gyur cig / de yi mthu las rgyu 'bras theg pa yi/ / lam bzang skas kyi gdang bu rim bgrod de/ / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma lha'i/ / go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob gyur cig / cesatshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon pas mtshamasaspyor ba sogasabya'o/ / zhesapa 'di yang lolag shā ho sho'u nas dad brtson ldan pa ngag dbang dkon mchog gisabaskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyosbyar ba'o/ /293

༄/ /yo ca napa'i sa gsang lam/༄7/ / mi rtag pa sgom tshul gyi bslab bya chigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ /dpal bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings ngos/ / sku gang 'dul bkod pa'i sprin dkrigs te/ / chos zab cing rgya che'i char 'bebs pa/ / rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus lan gcig rnyed pa'i dal 'byor 'di/ /donam grub lag nas 'tshor nyen gda'/ / da thar pa'i lam sna bsnyegs re ran/ / don de phyir skul ma'i lcag 'di zungs/ / lo zla ba 'di la 'di snang gi /las bya byed tshags su tshud byas nas/ / slar gtsang ma'i chos shig byed snyam pa/ / 'di thams cad bsru ba'i phung 'dre yin/ / tshe 'di snang bya ba chu gnyer 'dra/ / gcig 'das rjes gcig gis mnan nas 'ongs/ / de bsgrub kyin bsgrub kyin mang du 'gro / da btsan thabs su bcad na mi legs sam/ / chos byed kyi sang nyin 'char gyi bar/ / 'chi dus kyi de ring slebs nyen che/ / da rang mgo rang gis ma bskor bar/ / chos byed na de ring nyid nas gyes/ / sngon byon gye rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ / mdzad 'phrin gyes sa gsumakhyab na yang / / sku mi bzhugs mtshan tsam lhag mar lus/ / de kun kyang mi rtag slob dpon yin/ / stobs 'byor gyis dregs pa'i rgyal blon tshogs/ /lo rgyus kyi phreng ba ngoms che yang / / ma brtag na yod yod 'dra ba la/ / khams gsum du 'thor te shul na med/ / rang nyid dang sngar nas 294

༄/ /mitagapasgom yo gyib4byu tshigs subacadapa/'dris pa'i grogs/ /tshe srog dang stobs mtshungs phal cher yang / /glo bur du 'chi bdag dgras khyer na/ / da rang la mi 'jigs gdengs ci yod/ /ches shin tu glen pa lug gis kyang / / rang rigs rnams bshan pas gsod mthong tshe/ / snying 'dar na gzhan dpe rang steng du/ / spyor mi shes pa de phyugs las blun/ / nges med du 'chi ba gzugs grub 'di/ / dngos stobs dang lung la ma ltos par/ / mngon sum du mthong yang mi shes pa/ / de'i ming la ce re long zhes gsungs/ / gnyen nye du g.yog 'khor 'dus pa yang / /rlung chen pos shing lo spungs pa 'dra/ / dar cig nas ri klung kun tu 'thor/ / slar mi 'dzom 'dus pa'i tha ma yin/ / phyogs nges med 'dus pa'i khrom tshogs kyang / / ston nam mjug 'chad kha'i sbrang bu 'dra/ / 'dus tsam nas gyes shing yal te 'gro/ / bsam shes na mi rtag slob dpon yin/ /phyi 'byung ba'i snod la mtshon na yang / / dbyar dgun gyi ming btags bsru brid kyis/ / zhag bcu grangs tsam nas ri klung kun/ / mdog 'gyur zhing 'gro de mi rtag pa/ /chu sngon mo rlabs kyi gar mkhan ma/ / sgra lhung lhung sgrog pa de yang ni/ / dgun 'khyag rom spubs su tshud pa na/ / sgra shub bus smre sngags 'don pa bzhin/ /tshal yangs po skye dgu dga' ba na/ /rkang drug gi phrengaldan 'dab rgya'i tshogs/ / ston ba mos bcom pa'i mya ngam thang / skyi ser gyes gdung bas shugs glu len/ / nyin mtshan gye byi ba dkar nag gnyis/ / tshe 'ching thag gi rtsa phung res kyis za/ / der ma zad skad cig re rakhyang / / dgra 'chi bdag gi drung du bsnyegs nas 'gro/ / skra dkar zhing gzhu ltar gug pa yis/ / rgas 'khogs kyi pha mas 'dar bzhin du/ / bu lang tsho can gyi dur 'deb na/ / rgan gzhon gyi rim pa su yis rtsi/ / nor longs spyod snye ma'i gang bu yang / / rkyen ngan gyi ser bas brdung ba na/ / sngar rang 295

༄/ /yo cabalo ཿzla ma' ga gas/gi gsos pa'i g.yog gi sgor/ / sprang zhu bas yang lan khug par dka'/ /dus de ring yid gcug grogs po yang / /tshig legs nyes gcig la rnam rtog gis/ /sgo btags nas sangs nyin dngas ma'i dgra/ /nye rang gi 'dzin pa de nas chod/ / byur dpal du rlom pa'i srid 'byor kun/ / bye leb la mar me khang bzang bzhin/ / mdzes mdzes ltar snang ba'i bslu brid kyis/ /gtan bde ba'i srog rtsa gcod byed yin/ / don dril na myur du 'ong nges shing / /dus nam zhig 'ong ba cha med la/ / nam slebs tshe zlog tu med pa yin/ /dgra 'chi bdag bdud kyi khar chud tshe/ / dus yun ring 'grogs pa'i lus 'di yang / / mal dron mor bzhag nas 'gro dgos na/ / nor longasaspyod gnyen dang 'khor g.yog la/ / phyi mig kyang blta ba'i go skabs med/ /tshe hril por ngal med bsgrub bsgrub pa'i/ / dgra 'dul dang gnyen skyongakhya ba kun/ / 'phro bshal le bzhag ste dge sdig gi / khur bkur nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /lam rgyus med bgrod dka' bar do'i 'phrang / /dgra gshin rje'i dmag gi bkag pa'i tshe/ / srid 'byor pas dgos dus bslu ba yi/ mtshang ston par shes te 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ / lam rgyus med kyi sa mkhanatshos yin zhing / /lam bshul rang gi lam rgyag chos yin la/ /lam bgrod dka'i ded dpon chos yin pas/ / dus da nas sgo gsum chos la sbyor/ /dbang rang la yod pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ / gtan bde ba'i btsan sa ma zin na/ / dbugs 'gro 'ong rgyu ba chad pa'i tshe/ / rang ci bya gtol med dus shig 'ong / / don de phyir mi rtag sems pa 'di/ / dus thog ma bar dang tha ma ru/ /blo chos la bskul bar byed pa yi/ /lam dbu ma snang sel chen por gsungs/ / sems de ltar chos la 'khul ba na/ / chos zab mo'i sgra can mang na yang / / mgon dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 296

༄/ /migagapasgom tshulagyi bslababya tshigs subacadapa/bcud/ / rje blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs mchog / chos mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi/ /lam ngo bo grangs dang go rim sogs/ / gnad tshang la ma nor yongs rdzogs la/ / dus nyin bzhin bag chags ci thebs kyis/ / bshar sgom la nyams len dngos gzhir byas/ / de'i spyor dang mjugagi rim pa yang / / rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin legs bsgrub ste/ / dal 'byor la snying po len par 'tshal/ tshul de ltar bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ / bdag rtag par 'dzin pa'i chom rkun dang / / yul bden 'dzin gyi phyi dpung bcom byas te/ dpal 'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob shog / cesapa 'di ni sngon bzang po'i bag chagasakyi mthu brtas pa'i zhabs drung ngag dbang gragasapasa'aphagasapa bcu gcig zhal gyi dkyil 'khor stegasabu mchod cha dang bcasacha 'grig /bkra shis pa'i lhamasasogayokyi skyes dang bcasami rtag pa sgom tshul gyi bslab bya tshigasasu bcad pa zhig dgosatshul 'azin yig gi lam nasabaskul ma byung bar brten/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyomachog dman kun gyis go bde ba'i phyir snyan ngag mngon brjod sog4kyisam bcing bar dam pa gong ma'i gsung sgros la gzhi byas te 'bol rtsom du bgyis pa 'di yang skye dgu rnamasablo kha chosal phyogasapa'i rgyur gyur cig / / /snang shas rab rib sel ba'i mig sman mchog / mi rtags gnas tshul 'doms pa'i man ngag 'di/ / bar du bkod pa'i dge bas bdag sogs kun/ /blo sna chos la gcig tu gzhol gyur cig / cesapa 'di'ang dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog seng gesa'adi'i par bskrun skabs/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /297

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / grub dbang mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i zhal gdams kyi 'grel pa nyams len snying po'i don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhu rje btsun dam pa mkhas pa dang grub pa zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mtshan dang don mthun pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa sprul sku dkon mchog dam chos yar 'phel la gdams pa'i tha ma zhal chem du stsal pa ni/ dman pa'i sa zungs/ hrul po'i gos spyon/ zas gos srog 'tsho tsam la brten/rang gi 'og na 'gro ba chu las med pa gyis/ yang so thar 'di bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'di la gces spras nan tan zhig mdzod/ byang chub kyi sems 'di thugs dam gyi snying por zungs/ sngags kyi sdom pa 'di khe nyen che bas bsgrim pa gal che/ snga sor bde skabs nga rang gnyis yang yang phrad tshe gdams ngag mtshang la rgol pa mang du smras yod pas dus dang dus su dran par mdzod mdzod ces pa ste/ zhal gdams 'di ni shin tu skabs dang 'byor cing don che ba zhig go / de 'ang rang cag thar pa don du gnyer bar khas 'che ba la/ thar pa'i phyogs su blo 'khor ba dgos te/ don du gnyer bya 'khor bas bsdus pa kho na la mngon du bltas na thar pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin no/ / 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'obs ltar mthong ste/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi dpal la ma 298

༄/ /mkhas grubabastan 'dzin pa'i zhalagadams kyi 'grelapadonagasal/chags pa bya ba ni/ rtswa rtse'i zil ba lta bu 'di snang gi bde 'byor mnog chung 'di tsam la zhen pa las 'das pa blo gong mar gyur pa zhig gi gtam yin pas/rang cag lta bu de la ma chags pa lta ci/ chags pa'i rnam dbye'ang cher mi 'byung ngo / / des na sbrang bus dri dang / phye ma leb kyis gzugs lta bu gang zhigagang la gnas skabs su chags pa de nas brtsams te bzlog dgos pas/rang cag las dang po pa rnams chos sgrub pa'i thog ma nyid du zas gos gnas mal la zhen pa 'di nyid gcod dgos te/ de'e phyir tshul 'di sems pa la thog mar blo spyong ba chos kyi sgo 'byed ces gsungs so/ / de ltar 'thad pa gang las shes she na/ blang dor gyi tshul la tshad ma'i skyes bu nyag cig pur gyur pa bcom ldan 'das nyid yin la/ des rjes su bstan pa sde snod gsum las shes te/ 'dul ba'i skabs su bsnyen par rdzogs nas bslab pa brjod pa'i thog ma nyid du/ gzhi dang mdo rtsa bar/ gnas rnams brjod par bya'o zhes gos phyag dar khrod dang / zas bsod snyoms tsam la brten pa sogs ni bslabapa mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i gzhi dang rten du gyur pas na gnas zhes gsungs te/ de la gnas na legs par gsung ba'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur bar bshad do/ / zas gos don du gnyer bas rim pas 'dod pa che zhing chog mi shes pa dang / des bslab pa lhod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gos dang sman gyi byin rlabs dang rnam brtag gi cho ga la sogs pa thabs du mas 'gog par mdzad do/'dod pa bsod nyams dang / ngal zhing dub pa gnyis ga'i mtha' spangs pa'i phyir rtsol ba med par rang gi ngang gis byung ba la gos 'bum ri ba sogs gnang yang / dregs par mi 'gyur pa'i phyir mi rtag pa dang skyo ba'i 'du shes kho nas spyod par longs pa gzhir gtogs kyi tshe bshad pa bzhin yin pas rje bla 2༅

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gsung 'bum/ma'i rnam thar las kyang 'byung ba ltar ro/ / sman gyi gzhi las 'byung ba dang 'dra ba la sogs pa rnam pa bcus sems par gsungs pa'ang gtso bor sred pa 'gog pa'i phyir yin la/ de'i stobs kyis rgyag pa la sogs pas chos kyi lam lasagayeng bar 'gyur pa sdom pa'i phyir yang yin te bshes pa'i springs yig bzhinano/ / der ma zad lhakhru zhes pa drang thad du slong mo pa'i ming yin la/dge slong la gces pa'i mdor/ dge ba slong dang zas slong dang / / zhes sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs par brten nas lo tsā ba rnams kyis dge zhes pa bla thabs su bsnan nas dge slong du bsgyur bar bu ston gyes gsungs te/yang dag pa'i dge slong du 'gyur ba la srog 'tsho tsam gyi 'tsho bas chog shes pa de lta bu zhig dgos so/ / chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ dge slong sred pa skye ba na chos gos kyi phyir dang / bsod snyoms kyi phyir dang / mal cha dang stan gyi phyir skye'o/ / gnas pa na gnas so/ / mngon par zhen pa na mngon par zhen to/ /zhes dang / rang gi tshul dang las kyi mtha' yongs su spangs shing thar padon du gnyer bar khas 'che ba'i slob ma rnams la tshul dang las gnyis bcas te/ 'phags pa'i rigs gsum gyis ni tshul bcas so/ / bzhi pas ni las bcas te/ khyed tshul 'dis las 'di byed na ring por mi thogs par thar pa thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes chos gos dang bsod snyoms dang /gnasasal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i ma chags pa 'phags pa'i rigs su bshad pa ni/ dhā tu dbyings su bsgyur bas sems kyi chos nyid la 'dod pa dbu ma lta bu min gye/ rgyu la rigs su byas pa ste/ mdzod 'grel las/ 'di dag las 'phags pa rnams skye bas na 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi dag ste/ zhes 'dod chung chog shes med par thar ba don du gnyer ba mi 'byung bas/ thar pa'i lam sna zin pa de la ltos so/ / de nas mi nyams par 'phel pa'ang 330

༄/ /mkhasakhrubabastan 'dzinaba'i zhalagadams kyi 'grelapadonagasal/sbyangs pa'i yon tan la rag las shing / sbyangs pa'i yon tan bsdus pa'i sdom yang rigs 'di dag yin te/ gang spel las/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pas sgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur la/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams kyang 'phags pa'i rigs kyis bsdus so/ / zhes dang / 'dod zhen chung ba dang / chog shes pa ni sbyangs pa'i yonatan la gnas pa kho na la yod kyi/gzhan la ma yin pas/ de gnyis kyis rab tu phye ba 'phags pa'i rigs rnams kyi sgo nas bstan to/ / gang gis 'tsho ba de ni tshul te/ zas dang skom dang bgo ba la sogs pa'o/ / las kyi mtha' ni de'i ched kyi bzo la sogs pa'i bya ba'o/ / rnam pa gcig tu na/ tshul ni rgyal po la brten pa la sogs pa yin la/ las kyi mtha' ni rmo rko la sogs pa'o/ / zhes rgyal po la brten pa sogs kyi thabs du mas zas nor sgrub pa 'khor ba ba'i tshul dang las kyi mtha' yin pas/ thar pa 'dod na de las bzlog ste 'dod chung chog shes kyi sgo nas yang dag pa'i don sems pas/ tshul dang las kyi mtha' snga ma las rnam pa gzhan du gyur pa dgos so/ / thos sogs thar pa'i las kyi mthar 'gyur ba'ang 'dod chung chog shes kyi tshul la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ rtsa bar/tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa/ / zhes pa'i don/ slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis/ tshul gnas zhes bya ba rgyas par 'byung ba la/ tshul ni tshul khrims te/ de ni 'du 'dzi med pa'i rgyu dang / rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu dang / cho ga phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu yin no/ / bden pa mthong ba dang mthun pa'i zhes bya ba ni/ thos pa gang zhig bden pa mthong ba la phan 'dogs pas thos pa de 'dzin cing 'don par byed do/ / zhes rnyed bkur sgrub pa'i don kyi thos pa lta bu'ikhor ba'i phyogs su bslan zhing bden pa mthong ba la mi phan pas bkol nas gsungs te/ mdor na chos mngon pa'i rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyang zas ༅1

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/gos sogs kyi zhen pa spong ba la thug go / mdo sde rnams su phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing bya ba lta bu shin tu mang la/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed 'chad pa'i skabs nyid du/ nyi khri las/ 'dod chen chog mi shes pa sogs kyi gnyen por skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog bdun nam brgyad gsungs pa'i dgos pa 'phags grol gyis/ sems bskyed pa yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos can nyid shes par bya ba'i don du yin no/ / de yongs su nyams pa'i rkyen ni rnam pa dgu ste/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags dang / 'dod pa che ba dang / chog mi shes pa dang / 'du 'dzi la mngon par dga' ba dang /zhes sogs gsungs la/ de'i rkyen gyes kha gsag gzhog slong thob kyis 'jal ba sogs log pa'i 'tsho ba sna tshogs 'byung tshul kyang rgyas par gsungs so/ /der drangs pa'i mdo las kyang / chos 'di ni 'dod pa chung ba rnams kyi yin gyi/ 'dod pa che ba rnams kyi ma yin pa dang / chog shes pa dang rab tu dben pa dang / zhes pa nas/ shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi yin gyi/ shes rab 'chal ba rnams kyi ma yin/ zhes 'dod chung chog shes kho na chos kyi gzhir gsungs la/ bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong du/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang / /sbyang ba yang dag sdom bsten dang / /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'ang rgyan snang du theg pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa la spyor tshul zhig mdzad kyang dngos zin ltar dgon par gnas shing / 'dod chung chog shes kyi sgo nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan la slob pa'ang sdud dgos par gsungs la/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi nges tshig kyang gser phreng las/ bal ma bshig ma mel ba na skud pa mi rung la/ de las bzlog na rung ba bzhin du/ bsod stoms chos gos gnas mal la chags pa na sems las su mi rung la/ yon tan 'di dag gis tshangs spyod la gnas par bya ba'i phyir sems las rung du spyong bas sbyangs pa'i 302

༄/ /mkhasaspubabastan 'dzin pa'i zhalagadams kyi 'grelapadon gsal/yon tan zhes bya'o/ / zhes gsungs te/ tshul khrims la brten nas mdo sde'i don gyi ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'i 'brel ba'ang 'di yin pas sde snod gsum gyi dgongs pa'i mthil du grub po/ chos kyi rtsa bar gyur pa de dag la nges pa gtingatshugs shing goms pa ngang du gyur ba na/ 'og na 'gro ba chu las med par byas te khengs pa dor nas dman pa'i sa bzung bas gshong dma' bar chu bo 'du ba bzhin chos kyi snod du 'gro bas/ yon tan gyi tshogs la brten nas kun gyi bla mar 'gyur ba chos nyid de/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum du grags so/ / de nas gang la slob pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid ni sdom pa gsum ste/ gang zhigasrid par 'khyams pa dang thar par 'gro pa po ni yid kho na yin la/ de nyes pa'i lam las bzlog ste 'dzin pa nges pa'i tshig gi tshul gyis dharma ste chos ni 'di las gud na med do/ / de las dang po so thar ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba ste rnam 'byed las bstan pa dang ston pa gnyis ga'i bdag nyid du gsungs la/gzhir bstan pa gnas mi gnas las dang nan tan byed pa yod med kyis 'jog par gsungs so/ / gzhung rang las che ba'i kha zin dbyung ba kho na ma yin gye/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs las bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib so thar kho na la ltos par gsungs pa dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud las sngags pa khyim pas kyang rtags dang cho ga tsam ma gtogs so thar bzhin slob dgos par gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas so/ / de ltar yon tan mthong na cha phra mo tsam yang ris su mi 'bor bar legs par sbyangs nas blang dor la gces spras su bya ba 'byung bas ltung ba'i sgo dang po gnyis khegs la/ de nas spyir dran shes rgyun du bsten cing / bye brag nyon mongs gang che ba'i gnyen po bsten pa nan tan du byas pas phyi ma gnyis khegs te tshul khrims rnam par dag pas thar pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par 'gyur ro/ / de lta na'ang drin can gyi ma rnams yal bar ༅3

༄/ /yo4 b.lo lo ryā ga ཿma/'dor mi rigs pas/ de'i don mtha' dag pa bsgrub pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gzhol ba byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos te/ des yongs su bzung ba'i dge ba rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / nam du'ang mi zad par 'gyur ba blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang zhi ba lha'i gzhung bzhin yin pas/ gang las mi 'da' bar bya ba dge ba'i spyod pa ma lus pa'i snying po dam par gyur pa yin no/ / 'brom ston 'da' khar po to pa la sems bzang po gyisakhya ba bzlas te gsungs la/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams thugs dam 'phel mi 'phel kyang 'di'i sgo nas bzhag go /sems 'di dang ldan na nyon mongs pa'ang lam gyi grogs su 'gyur bas 'khor ba mi 'dor ba'i rang bzhin zhes bshad la/ spyod pa la g.yel kyang nyan rang zil gyis gnon pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las 'byung bas/ thams cad kha bsgyur ba po ni rten dam pa zhes sems rin po che 'di kho na yin par theg bsdus las bshad do/ / snying stobs dang brtse ba ches lhag pa/ rang gi ngos nas ci yang bzod kyang /sems can sgrol ba la shin tu rings pas tshe gcig nyid du sangs rgyas 'dod pas ni sngags la slob par bya dgos la/ 'on kyang lcags spug tu sbrul bcug pa 'dra bar zang thal gnyis 'byung ste/ dam tshig nyams pa rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'tshedapas ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi dus las kyang brgal par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig rnam par dag na de nyid kho na sgrub pa yin pas skye ba 'di'am bcu drug las mi 'gyang bar mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de lta mod kyang chos 'di la gsang sngags zhes bya la/ da lta tshong 'dus kyi zong bzhin gyur te chos kyis rnyed pa bsgrub pa ni legs par ma rnyed pa yin pas/ gtan gyi khe nyen bsams te bsgrim par bya'o/ de dag thams cad mthar 'don pa bla ma'i gdams ngag ma brjed par sems pa la rag las shing /3la

༄/ /mkhas grubabastan 'dzinapa'i zhalagadams kyi 'grelapadonagasal/jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams bshes gnyen dang gdams pa'i mchog mtshang la rgod zhing mtshang thog tu 'bab par gsungs te/ thub pas khyod kyis rgyu las nyon la zhugs pas sdug bsngal 'di byung zhes pa'ang mtshang la rgol ba yin pas/nyan pa pos kyang rgyal bu zla ba'i skyes rabs bzhin/ rang gi rgyud steng nas go ba rnyed pa dgos so/ /'byor pa'am/ rgud pa'am/ bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba'i tshe nyon mongs ci rigs su 'byung bas/ thams cad kyi tshe bla ma'i gdams ngag dran pa'i gnyen pos sleb par bya dgos pa ni bshad pa mtha' dag gi snying po mdor bsdus pa yin no/ /gdams pa'i mchod yon sdeb legs tshig gi rnga yab rtses/ /mngon par 'thor bas 'phral la sim pa mchog ster yang / /gzhung brgya'i bcud dang lhan cig lhug par btung ba yis/ /blogros lus rgyas thar lam bgrod pa'i mthu ldan shog /zhal gdamasade nyid tshigasabacad du spel pa'i bslab bya rgyasapa zhig dgosatshul sprulapa'i sku rang nasabaskul mabyung yang / go babog4chod du ster ba zhig dka' bar mthong ste/ 7btsun padakon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesatshig spyor spangasate don 'grelagyi tshuladu dran tshod kyi tho tsam 'phral la sug bri4sabagyisapa'o/ / 305

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i ryā gsung stem/༄/ / rje btsun mi la'i zhal gdams kyi 'grel ba grub pa'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /nges 'byung mtshon gyis snangashas dra ba bcad/ / gnas lugs lta bas srid pa'i btson ra bshigs/ / rin chen sems kyis 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa/ / grub pa'i dpa' bo bzhad pa'i rdo rje rgyal/ / 'dren pa gang gis stsal pa yi/ / man ngag stong thun re res kyang / srid pa'i nad brgya sel ba //// /sde// //// bye/ste/ / // //// / ste/ spyo riga' / / cung zad 'a la la ba sa/ / yang byang gas kha ba ba' ljongs 'dir grub pa'i skyes mchog ji snyed cig byon pa rnams kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa/ tshe gcig nyid la zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid kyis rang gi thugs sras zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa la zhal chems kyi tshul du gnang ba nyams len gyi gnad ma tshang ba med pa'i gdams pa'i tha ma 'di'i don 'chad pa la/ bu snying dang 'dra ba'i ras chung ba/ / kha chems gdams ngag glu 'di nyon/ / zhes pa bshad pa'i sngon 'gro yin zhing go sla'o/ /gzhung dngos kyi don la gnyis/ srid pa'i snang shas ldog pa'i tshul dang / de ji ltar bzlog pa'i thabs bstan pa'o/ / dang po la spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na/ / sgyu lus kyi phung po sdig po che/ / lto gos kyi zhen pa bsgrubs 306

༄/ /rjebatsunami la'i zhal gdams 'grelab grubapa'idagongs rgyan/bsgrubs nas/ / 'jig rten bya ba thongs dus med/ / 'jig rten bya ba thongs shig ras chung ba/ / zhes 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa 'dir thog ma med pa nas 'khyams shing / de yang byed pa po gzhan yod pa ma yin par/ rang sems nyon mongs pa ma rig pa dang sred sogs kyi dbang du gyur te/ nye bar blangs pa'i sgyu lus kyi phung po la nga'o snyam du zhen pas bdag tu bzung zhing / de'i steng nas rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs lasdang ba sogs nyes pa mtha' dag skyed pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i sdeg po che de nyid 'tsho skyong gi don du lto gos sogs kyis mtshon pa'i zag bcas kyi bde ba sna tshogs pa zhig zhen pa drag po'i sgo nas bsgrubs bsgrubs kyang / blang dor gyiganas la rmongs pa'i dbang gis thabs phyin ci log tu gol te/ bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba las/ rang gi 'dod pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub pa zhig nam yang mi 'byung bar 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos thongs dus med pa 'di byung ba yin/ des na nges par gtan gyi bde ba zhig 'dod na/ khams gsum 'khor bar gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba mtha' dag sog ma'i khres po phon thag chad pa bzhin gang la yang zhen pa med par blos thongs shig / ces ras chung rdo rje grags pa sogs skal ldan gye slob ma rnams la rjes su gdams pa yin no/ / gnyis pa snang shas ldog tshul so sor bshad pa la/ tshe 'di'i dbang du byas pa/ 'chi kha'i dbang du byas pa/bar do'i dbang du byas pa/ / 'jig rten phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa bzhi/dang po ni/ sgyu ma lus kyi grong khyer na/ rang sems dngos med sdig po che/lus sha khrag gi rjes su 'brangs 'brangs nas/ / chos nyid don la rtogs dus med/ / sems nyid brdar sha chod cig ras chung ba/ / zhes gsungs/ de ༅7

༄/ /yo ca bayomi'i ma'i g.yo ༅ma/yangasgyu ma lus kyi grong khyer tshong 'dus kyi mgron khang lta bu 'dir rang sems kyi khye'u gar 'gro gtol med cing / las kyi rlung gis 'das te yud tsam zhig gnas pa'i skabs 'dir/ sems rang nyid dbyibs gzugs sogs kyi dngos por med pas/ tsha grang bkres skom sogs kyis phan gnod gang yang mi 'byung yang / gnas skabs kyi lus g.yar po lta bu la gtan par 'khrul ba'i sdig po che 'dis/ lus sha khrag gi phung po mi ring bar 'dor dgos pa 'di nyid la zhen pas rjes su 'brangs 'brangs nas/ de'i 'tsho skyong gis g.yeng ste/sems rang gi chos nyid gnyug ma'i don la rtogs dus nam yang med pa zhig 'byung bas/ phyi lus kyi gad dar la mi g.yeng bar/ nang sems kyi brdar sha chod cig / ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa 'chi kha'i dbang du byas pa ni/ zam rig gnyis kyi so mtshams na/ / rang byung ye shes sdig po che/ / glo bur gyi rkyen kha 'grims 'grims nas/ / skye med kyi don la rtogs dus med/ / skye med btsan sa zungs shig ras chung pa/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang nam zhig las kye 'phen pa rdzogs te/ beem rig gnyis kyi rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba 'chad par nye ba'i so mtshams 'chi srid phra mo'i dus na rang byung ye shes gnyug ma 'odagasal gyi sems nyid mngon du gyur kyang / de'i ngo bo ngos ma zin par srid pa'i bag chags yang nas yang du goms pa'i sdig po che de nyid/ slar yang kun rtog g.yo ba'i rlung gis bskul te/ glo bur gye rkyen kha phyin ci log gi 'khrul snang sna tshogs pa zhig 'grims 'grims nas/ srid pa gzhan du mtshams sbyor ba ma gtogs skye med 'od gsal gye don la rtogs dus med pas/des na skye med 'od gsal chos kyi sku de nyid la chos skur ngo shes pa'i sgo nas/ma dag pa'i srid pa gzhan du mtshams mi spyor ba'i btsan sa zungs shig /ces pa'o/ / gsum pa bar do'i dbang du byas pa ni/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi so mtsha

༄/ /rjebatsunami la'i zhal gdams 'grelabathabapa'idagongs rgyan/mtshams na/ / bar do'i rnam shes sdig po che/ / lus med lus dang 'grogs 'grogs nas/ gnas lugs don la rtogs dus med/ / gnas lugs gtan la phob cig ras chung pa/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gab/sa shing / phyi ma ma rnyed pas/ de gnyis kyi so mtshams na bar do'i rnam par shes pa 'khrul snang sna tshogs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sdigapo che/ rags pa'i lus med cing phra ba rlung gi rang bzhin gyi lus dang 'grogs 'grogs nas/skye ba'i srid pa tshol ba'i phyir kun tu 'khyams te gnas lugs kyi don la rtogs dus med pas/ des na bar do la bar dor ngo shes par byas te/ / 'khrul snang za zi'i rjes su mi 'brang bar gang snang thams cad bar do dang rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bur bltas nas gnas lugs kye don gtan la phob cig / ces pa'o/ / bzhi ba 'jig rten phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa ni/ rigs drug 'khrul ba'i grong khyer na/ / las ngan sdig sgrib tshan po che/ / chags sdang rjes su 'brangs 'brangs nas/ / mnyam pa nyid la rtogs dus med/ / chags sdang spongs shig ras chung pa/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang rigs drug gi skyes gnas tsha grang bkres skom gcig la gcig za/ skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa brgyud ma nas brgyud mar 'bab pa 'khrul ba'i grong khyer gshin rje'i btson ra lta bur shin tu nyam thag pa yang / rgyu med dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba ma yin par/ rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su las ngan sdig sgrib tshan po che bsags pa de'i rang mdangs kho na yin zhing / de yang rtsa ba chags sdang gi rtog pa ngan pa'i rjes su 'brangs 'brangs pa de nyid kyis lan pa yin pas/slan chad kyang srid pa'i sdug bsngal drungs 'byin pa la/ rang gzhan 'khor 'das mtha' dag chos kyi dbyings su mnyam pa nyid du rtogs dgos la/chags sdang gi rtog pa kha yan du btang na mnyam pa nyid kyi don de rtogs dus mi

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'itshonasa'i gsung ཿma/med pas chags sdang spongs shig / ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa snang shas bzlog pa'i thabs bstan pa la/ mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba dang / de ji ltar lag tu lenapa'i tshul/ don bsdus te nyamalosu len par gdams pa gsum/ dang po ni/ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shig na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan/ / drang don gyi bslu brid gsungs gsungs nas/ / nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med/ /tha snyad spongs shig ras chung pa/ /zhes gsungs/de yang da lta'i gdul bya phal pa rnams kyis mthong ba'i yul du mi mngon par/nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kyi sku'i dbyings su zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dgongs pa mthar thug spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i gnad kho nar 'bab kyang / zhal nas rdzun pa ste drang don gyi mdo sde sna tshogs ston mkhan thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis gdul bya so so'i skal ba'i dbang gis gang zag gi bdag yod pa sogs drang don gyi rnam bzhag dngos zin gyi don brjod pa ltar du ma grub pa'i bslu brid lta bu mang po zhig gsungs gsungs pa de dag kyang / dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa'i dbang gis yin tshul ma shes par gsungs tshad sgra ji bzhin du bzung na nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med pas/ shing rta chen po rnams dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug gong ma rnams kyis rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji ltar bkral ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/thub pa'i dbang po'i dgongs pa mthar thug tu ma son pa'i tha snyad dam/ drang donagyi bshad tshul rnams la mchog tu zhen pa spong bar gyis la gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po sgoms shig / ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa de nyid ji ltar lag tu len pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ / gcig tu dril la gsol ba thob/ /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ / gcig tu dril la nyams su longs/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ / gcig tu dril la 'dris su 310

༄/ /rjebatsunami la'i zhal gdams 'grelabakhrubapa'idagongs rgyan/chugs/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang sgos bral de bzhin nyid kyi don bsgom pa na/rgyutshogs gzhan rnams ma tshang bar lta ba gcig pu bskyangs pas gar yang mi phyin pas/ rgyu tshogs bsags sgrib spyong dang / dngos gzhi'i tshe na thabs shes khyad par can phan tshun gcig gis gcig rtsis zin pa'i tshogs gnyis ya ma bral ba/ khyad par du gdul bya blo mchog tu gyur pa rnams zab mo'i lta ba de nyid dang / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung du 'jug par byas te nyams su len shes pa dgos so/ /tshogs bsags pa'i zhing mang du yod kyang gong na med pa ni mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma yin pas/ de las logs su skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bar/ de nyid bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum ga gcig tu dril ba'i ngo bor bltas te mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ tshogs gsog pa dang byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ dngos gzhi lta ba skyong ba'i tshe na yang gnas lugs kyi don la dri ma med pa'i rigs pas dpyod pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa'i sgom pa gnyisatsha grang lta bur ma song bar/ lta thog nas sgom tshol zhing / sgom thog nas lta ba tshol ba dang / khyad par du lta ba'i go ba de nyid kyis las 'bras bcings grol gyi rnam bzhag sogs la nges pa je brtan du 'gro bas/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum ga'i gcig nyams su blangs pa'i khongs su gsum ga tshang bar 'du ba de lta bu'i tshul gyis gcig tu dril la nyams su longs shig / ces pa yin no/ / khyad par du gsang sngags kyi thabs mkhas dang 'brel ba'i tshul ni/lta ba skyong ba na mdo lugs kyi skyong tshul de tsam ma yin par/ ma dag pa'i sgod bcud kyi snang ba mtha' dag bsdus te/ 'od gsal gnyug ma'i sems mngon dubyas pa de'i steng nas lta ba bsgoms te 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer dang /de'i ngang nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus bar do longs sku dang skye ba sprul skur 311

༄/ /ca bang bayo pa'i sa'i gas ཿma/bzhengs pa sogs sku gsum lam 'khyer bskyed rim pa'i mos ngo tsam dang /rdzogs rim gye tshe dpe dang don gyi 'od gsal las dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i skur dngos su bzhengs pa dang / mthar thug gi tshe na dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings las kha spyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs te sprul sku bye ba ther 'bum 'gyed pa 'byung la/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byung 'gyur de thams cad 'bras bu lam byed gyi tshul du tshe 'di rang nas sad mi kun dang sbyar te sgom tshul bsre ba skor dgu'i man ngag bzhin yin pas/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum gcig tu dril te gzhi'i sku gsum lam gyi sku gsum du sgyur ba'i dmigs pa skyong tshul gyi gnad zab mo 'di la da lta nas blo legs par 'dris su chugs shig / ce4pa'o/ / gsum pa mjug bsdus te nyams su len par gdams pa ni/ de gdams ngag kun gyi tha ma yin/ / kha chems kun gyi mjugam yin/ / don de las med do ras chung ba/ / de nyams su longs shig pha yi bu/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang 'dir smos pa'i zhal gdams kyi rim pa de dag ni/ rje btsun nyid kyis slob ma snod ldan mang po la sku tshe hril por zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag mang du stsal ba kun gyi tha ma yin la/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar bu chen so so la 'jig rten lugs kyi kha chems lta bu mang du stsal pa kun gyi yang mjug ma yin zhing / mdo rgyud kyi bshad pa'i rnam grangs mang na yang / don gyi gnad 'bab sa de las lhag pa pha rgan mi la ras pa bdag la ston rgyu med do/ / bu ras chung pa khyod kyis kyang de nyams su longs la pha rjes bu yis zin pa gyis shig ces nye ba'i tshig gis gdams pa yin no/ / smras pa/ don zab sbrang rtsi'i bcud ldan pa ku la/ /rnam 'grel bdud rtsi'i gzeg mas phye ba 'di/ / skal bzang lha rgya'i zur phud dang 'grogs te/ / grub pa'i dga' tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur cig / / /312

༄/ /rjebatsunami la'i zhalagadams 'grelabagrub pa'idagongasaspyan/ ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog rab rgyasagyisabaskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dben gnasayid dga' chosa'adzin du sbyar ba'o/ / / /313

༄/ /ca ca bam lo sgronace' gotshi ཿma/༄༅/ / che gcig gi nyams len bya tshul rnams khrig chags su bsdebs pa chos spyod gsal ba'i sgon me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mu ni yimi ya/ mtha' yas 'gro 'di ji ltar drangs bya zhes/ / bskal ba du mar rab dgongs phan pa'i lam/ / brtse bas 'doms mdzad lha mi'i ston pa mchog / shāka seng brgyud par bcas la spyi bos 'dud/ / rgyal bstan ming gi lhag mar gyur pa na/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang ma lus pa/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras gtsug na mdzes/ / gang gi thugs rje'i zla zer gyis/ / bdag blo'i ku mud kha 'byed pa/ / yab rje 'jigs med dbang po yis/ / 'bral med byang chub bar du skyongs/ / gang dag thos pa'i blo mig rab gsal zhing / / nges 'byung brtson pa'i lcag gi bskul ma can/ / rnam grol don gnyer skal bzang skye bo yis/ / chos spyod bya ba'i rim pa 'dir bshadakhya/ / de yang skye dgu'i phan bde'i rtsa ba ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyag cig yin kyang / da lta ches nyag phra bar gyur te/ gsung rab kyi don la tshig spyi tsam gyi go ba chags pa'ang shin tu dkon la/ / thos don sgrub la gzhol ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar gyur cing / / cung zad sgrub pa la 'jug par 'dod pa dag kyang gdams pa'i gnad ngos ma zin par rang gi nad gdon zhi ba dang 314

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenas tshulacosaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/gzhanagyis nus ldan du mthong ba tsam zhig gi phyir sngags kyi grangs gsog pa tsam la nyams len zab mor 'khrul nas shes rgyud la lta ba'i go yul tsam yang med pa dang / la la yul phyogs mang po zhig bskor ba la tshe blos btang bar rlom pa lta bu'i dbang gis mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang mthun pa'i nyams len snagacig kyang med la/ nyes ltung gi sgo re re tsam yang mi khegs par chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min kho na'i ngang la mi tshe 'da' pa mang bar snang bas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis de lta bu'i skyon mtha' dag ring du dor te tshe gcig gi nyams len/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la bsdus pa 'di ltar nyams su blangs par bya'o/ / de yang gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len skyong ba rnams dang por bzhengs pa'i tshe yang zhu ba glu sa bskul te chos sku bde pa chen po'i ngang las gzugs skur bzhengs pa sogs kyi rnal 'byor rang gi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bya la/ rgyun par yang nam gyi sum cha lus pa'i tshod tsam la bzhengs te/ nyal stabs su mi gnas par rig pa hur bskyed de gnyid legs par dwangs su bcug / ga re mdang ma shi bar da nang lang rgyu byung ba 'di bla ma lha'i bka' drin yin/ da spyir ma shi tshun dang khyad par de ring gi nyi ma 'di chud zos su mi gtong bar bcas rang gi nyes pas ma gos pa'i ngang nas zab rgyasakyi nyams len la 'bad de dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan pa zhig bya dgos snyam du 'phen pa gtong / oṃ sasta ra sastar/ bi ma na sa ra ma hā dza ba hūṃ/ oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na ska ra mahā dza ba hūṃ/ zhes pa'i 'gyur sngags lan bdun bajod/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūṃ/ zhes phreng sngags lan bdun bzlas te phreng ba la btab/ de nas ngag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ rang gi lce'i steng du ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du oṃ yig dkar po zhig 315

༄༅/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/thol gyes byung / de'i mtha' skor du mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/oṃ a ā zhes pa nas yi a swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gye ā li tshar gcig gis bskor ba kha dog dkar po/ de'i phyir ka kha ga snya nga / zhes pa nas kka swā hā'i bar gyi kā li kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du gnas pa/ sngags phreng de gnyis kyi phyi rol tu/ ye dharmā he tu zhes pa nas shra ma ṇa ma swāhā/ zhes pas g.yas skor du bskor ba/ kha dog sngon po dwangs shing gsal ba 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gsal gdab/ de nas rang gi yi dam gyi lha gang yin de'i snying po dang / rten 'brel dbyangs gsal dang bcas pa lan bdun nam/ gsum mam/ nyer gcig gang rung brjod pa dang dus mnyam du/ sngags phreng gsum oṃ dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad ā li kā li dang rten 'brel snying po'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa bkug nas oṃ sngags phreng dang bcas pa la bstem/ de bzhin du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang / gzhan yang drang srong bden tshigs grub pa dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ngag nus byin rlabs thams cad dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po'i rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng 'od dang bcas pa la thim pas/byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid can du mos pa'i mthar/ oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ rten 'brel snying po dbyangs gsal dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de rnams 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du ltem gyis zhu ba oṃ la zim/ oṃ yang 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid 'od du zhu ba ar gyur/ a de yang bdud rtsi dkar dmar gye rnam par rang gi lce la thim pas/316

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenabya tshul chosaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur cing / rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang drang srong grub pa thob pa rnams kyi ngag nus thams cad rang gi ngag la zhugs pas/ngag nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par gyur bar bsam/ de rjes dal 'byor don che rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las dang 'bras bu'i gnas tshul/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal drag tu bsams nas/ rang nyams la dpag ste mar gyur sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par rang rgyud dang 'dres nges rgyun ring la shugs drag pa bsgom bzhin pas skyabs 'gro bya/denas tshig don rnams dran bzhin du bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byas pas thun drug gi rnal 'byor kyang der 'thus shing lam gye lus yongs rdzogs la shar sgom kyangade'i sgo nas nan tan tu bya/ de nas rang gi bla ma'am bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams zhabs pad brtan pa'i phyir du tshe lha ci rigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zadabyas na rang gi tshe sgrub la yang de las lhag med par gsungs/ de nas nam langs pa dang lha la dbang bskur ba ltar khrus chab blangs la/ 'bral spangs thub dbang gi sku'i mdun du phyag gsum byas nas 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ de ring gi gnas skabs su/ chos ldan gyi bya ba dang gzhan gyi don du glu gar dang rol mo la sogs pa byed dam byed du gzhug pa dang / me la reg pa dang / reg tu gzhug pa dang / rin po che la reg pa dang / reg tu gzhug pa dang / sa bon bcom pa dang / bcom du gzhug pa dang / skyes pa gcod pa dang / gcod du gzhug pa dang / lag nya dang / mtshams btsos dang / zhag lon dang / rjen btsos dang / gsog 'jog byas pa za ba dang / byin len ma 317

༄/ /yo thang bam pa'i me'i khrung ༅ma/byas par za ba dang / bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu 'don pa la sogs pa/ mdor na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum las/dus dran bsten du rung ba rnams la ston pa thugs rje can gyis gnang ba mdzad dugasol/ zhes dus dran bsten/ ltung bshagags kyi lha so lnga sogs sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying bo sogs rgyal sras kyi tshogs/ gzhan yang skyabs yul dpag tu med pa rnams yid kyis bsams te/ oṃ na mo matsi thi ye/ nam su thi ye/ na mo utta ma shi ye swāhā/ zhes phyag stong 'gyur gyi sngags dang sbrags pas brkyang phyag gsum gyis thog drangs stung bshags gcig gam/ gsum la sogs pa'i sgos phyag 'tshal/ de nas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra snga marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te samyakle bud dhā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ mahā badzre/ mahā te dza badzra/mahā bi bya badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ mahā bo dhi mazlo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/sarba garma ā lba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swāhā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod bzhin du/ chu gtsang sogs kyis mchod pa dbul/ me tog 'bul rgyu yod na/ oṃ na mo bha ga lba te puṅge ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myakre bud dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ puṣpe pu ṣpe srahā/ pukhye su puṣpe/ su puྈud bha we/ pukhre a lba ka ri ṇi swā hā/ zhes pa brjod cing sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas te maṇḍal gyi 'bru la btab na yang bye bar 'gyur bar gsungs/ de nas stan la 'khod de thun drug gi rnal 'byor skyong ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyes pa'i bsod nams kyis/ / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces skyabs 'gro/ sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang / / bral nas khyad par 'phags pa'i bde ba thob/ /318

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenas tshulachosaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/bzod dka'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ / thar pa dam pa'i bde dang 'bral ma gyur/ / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ byams pa dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'ang des 'grub/ 'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las sgrol phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i sems/ / deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob par/ / srog gi phyir yang mi btang bzung par bgyi/ / dzi ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ / byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ / de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdagakyang 'gro la phan don du/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed bgye zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ / rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes smon 'jug gnyis cho ga'i sgos blangs/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ / mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ / de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ / da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rig dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ / skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ / rnyog par mi 'gyur de lta bya/ / long pas phyag dar phung po las ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/ / de bzhin ci zhig ltar stes ni/ / byang chub sems 'di bdag la skyes/ / bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ / bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyes/ / lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ / zhes sems bskyed rgyas pa'i phyir mjug gi cho ga dga' ba bsgom pa rnams byas la/ de nas/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog rin chen khri/ / chu skyes nyi zla rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / / sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ / rdor dril bzung nas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud/ / mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ / yid 319

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'itshonasa'i gsung stem/'phrog lha rdzas gos kyi na bza' can/ / dran pa tsam gyis gdung ba kun sel cing / /skyabs mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du/ / skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du/ / yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /ma rtu baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ / rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung dang / / dngos bshams yid kyi sprul ba las/ / byung ba phyi nang gsang ba yi/ / sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ / bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / rin chen maṇḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ / blo yis blangs nas bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs ma lus pa/ / gang 'dul jibazhin ngur sprig rnam rol gyis/ / grangs med zhing du rgyal ba'i mdzad pa can/ /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ / rdo rje 'chang gis blo dman bsam pa'i ngor/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lo mtha' dag las/ /lhag pa'i zhing gi dam par legs bsngags pa'i/ / bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus kun/ / mgon khyod tshul bzhin bsten pa'i rjes 'gro bar/ / mthong nas lus dang srog kyang yongs btang ste/ / khyod mnyes kho na sgrub par byin gyes rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bla ma mchog / rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu sa ma dza / /slar yang dgyes bzhin rang dang ro gcig gyur/ / ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor bskyangs/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi don cung zad bsgom zhing / / de'i ngang 320

༄/ /tshegacig nyamasayenabya tshulachosaspyodagasalaba'isgoname/las lha'i skur ldang ba ni/ / snod bcud mtha' dag sgyu ma mi lam dang / / chu zla bzhin du ngo bo nyid kyis stong / / bden par med kyang ming brdas phar btags kyi/ / snang ba chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin/ / bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhengs te/ / lhan skyes bde chen gsang ba'i rdo rje dang / / rang bzhin spros bral gsang ba'i ghaṇḍa yi/ / mtshon byed bzung nas bcom ldan 'das mar 'khyud/ / ces rdor dril phyag rgya'i dam tshig dran par bya/ bdag gi lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / / dus gsum dge tshogs phung po ci mchis pa/ / mar gyur sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /denganas 'phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ / zhes chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong / / de nas sdom pa gsum la bsngo bgrangs bya ba ni/ / bla ma lha yi spyan snga ru/ / sdom gsum bsrung par khas blangs pa'i/ / dang po so sor thar pa yi/ / bslab pa'i mi mthun phyogs gyur pa/ / pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma ni/ / bcu gsum spang ltung sum cu dang / / ltung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu dang / / sor bshags bzhi dang nyes byas ni/ / brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsdoms pa yis/ / nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang / / gzhan yang gzhis bsdus ltung ba sogs/ / bshags shing slan chad sdom par bgye/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs gyur pa/ / rtsa ba'i ltung ba bco brgyad dang / / nyes byas zhe drug la sogs pa/ / tshul khrims gsum dang phyin drug gi / mi mthun phyogs gyur nyes pa kun/ / bshags shing slan chad sdom par bgyi/ / rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba las/ / rnam snang rigs kyi dam tshig drug / mi bskyod rin 'byung bzhi bzhi dang / / 'od dpag med gsum don grub kyi/ / gnyis te so so'i bcu dgu dang / / rigs lnga spyi yi dam tshig ni/ / rtsa ltung bcu bzhi bsrung ba dang / / spong bsten 321

༄khya/ /gung thang bstanapa'itshanas gsung 'bum/bza' ba'i dam tshig las/ / 'das dang sbom po brgyad la sogs/ /bshags shing slan chad sdom par bgyi/ / so thar byang sems rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rnam dag bcas pa'i bslab pa phra mo las/ / rmi lam du yang 'da' bar mi byed par/ / rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /shin tu bsdus pa bya ba'i tshe tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di gcig pus chog /theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos ma lus pa/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin legs bzung ste/ / gang 'tsham thabs kyis 'gro ba yongs su sgrol/ /zhes dam chos 'dzin pa dang sems can don byed la bslab po/ de dag gis sdom pa so so'i skabs sogs su thun drug dang gsum la sogs pa bya dgos pa mang po zhig yod pa thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung du blta bar bya'o/ / de nas khridayig rgyas bsdus ci rigs sam/ ma mtha' yang byin rlabs spung zhus lta bu'i steng nas lam rim yongs rdzogs la shar sgom dang / skabs thob kyi dmigs skor re re rgyas par skyongs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs kyang byed na thun 'di'i mthar bya/ de nas dros kyi tsha bzhes grub nas gnas khang byi dor legs par byas/ mchod pa gtsang ma phul/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor dang lam rim gyes dmigs rnam sngar bzhin bskyangs/ 'jigs byed sogs kyi cho ga yang spro na skabs 'dir bya/ chos ston gyi tshe/ dkon mchog rjes su dran bzhin pas/kha zas sman dang 'dra par rig pa yis/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang med par bsten bgyi ste/ /rgyags phyir ma lags snyems pa'i phyir ma legs/ /'tshag phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/ / zhes brjod cing / de'i don sems pa 'dul ba dang / yang lus kyi srin bu da lta zang zing gis bsdus nas ma 'ongs pa na chos kyis bsdu/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i 322

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenabya tshulachosastodagasalaba'isgroname/sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs bsgrubs/ de'i phyir du bza' btung la longs spyod paraco'o snyam pa phar phyin theg pa dang / sngags bla med ltar na nang mchod dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ltar na gtong ma byin rlabs ltar ram/ o 〉 rtu gis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ gu ru badzra nee khrirya wa rtu gis bla ma dang /oṃ sarba bud dhā bo rnyi satā spyo badzra nee wi rya ā ཿ gis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang / oṃ de wa ḍā ki dī shrīdharma bā la sa ba ri wā ra badzā nee wi byu ā ྅gis yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang bcas pa la 'bul/ oṃ a gra biṇḍa a shi rgya swāhā/ zhes pas phud la dbang ba'i 'byung po la chadma bu gcig dang / oṃ ha ri te swāhā/ oṃ ha ri te mahā badzra yakṣi ṇi ha ra ha ra sarba pā baṃ mkhro swāhā/ zhes pas 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la chadma bu gnyis byas nas nang gi sbyinasreg gi sgo nas longs spyad de zas kyi tshod rig par bya/ 'jug tu lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po la madma bu gcig / oṃ usgyu gri biṇḍa a shi byu swāhā/zhes pas bsngo/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od kye rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nam samanta pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakre bud dhā ya/ na mo ma dzi thi ye/ ku mā rasgru tā ya bo dhi sa tāya mahā sa tā ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ ne ra la ste ni rā bhā se dza ye dza ya la snye ma hā ma te dakshi dakṣi tram̐ me ba ri sho ṅgāya swāhā/ gzungs 'dis dkor gyi phung bo ri rab tsamayang 'byong bar gsung so/ / de nas mdo bton pa dang smon lam gyes rgyasagadab/ nyin snga ma nas sta gon byas pa'i 'jim pa las sātstsha gsum mam bdun sogs gdab/ skor rten dngos sam bsgom pa ci rigs gsal btab la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / na mo bha ga 323
