༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sa'i ga4 ཿma/lwa te/ ratāke tu rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sa myagla bud dhā ya/ tabya thā/oṃ rasne rasnem hār sne ratna bidza ye swāhā/ 'di bskor par ma zad phyag stong 'gyur du yang gsungs so/ / yang skor ba'i sngags/ na mo da sha dakṣi kā la sarba ra tna tra yā ya/ na ma bra dakṣa su bra dakṣa sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa 'di yang phan yon che bas brjod/ de ltar skor pa mang nyung 'tsham pa zhig byas nas/ mdo sde mdzangs blun/ las brgya ba/ 'dul ba lung / rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma sogs dam pa'i rnam thar dang / rgyal sras kyi spyod pa ston pa sdong po bkod pa sogs ci tsam ran pa re bklag / slar yang thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs skabs dang bstun pa'i dge spyor mos pa ltar ci rigs byas la/ thun mtshams su lam rim che chung / rtsa ltung rnam bshad/ bla ma lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ byang chub gzhung lam/ gnam rtse ldeng ma sogs sdom gsum gyi bslab bya rgyas bsdus ci rigs la nan tan tu blta/ bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bde blag tu gsog pa'i thabs zags pa rgyun gtor la yang brtson par bya ste/ 'di ltar mchil ma la/ yo.ā shīṣṭha ā ha re bhya sā hā/ lud pa la/o.ā khre ta ā ha re bhya swāhā/ snabs la/ oṃ ā tpasnyi na ā ha re rgya swāhā/lus kyi dri ma la/ oṃ ā ma la ā ha re bhya swāhā/ dri chen la/ oṃ ya biṭa ā ha re lha swāhā/ dri chu la/ oṃ ā stu drawā ha re bhya swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis bsngo'o/ / dro'i thun la thun drug gi rnal 'byor sngar bzhin byas la/ sdom gsum bsngo bgrangs kyi tshe paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi sdom tshig sam/ de las cung bsdus pa byed na 'di lta ste/ gang gi bka' bzhin bsgrub byas na/ / 'di phyi'i don rnams ma lus pa/ / bde blag nyid du stsol mdzad pa'i/ / thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ / rnyed dka' dal ba'i rten thob cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs nas/ / dge slong sdom pa thob rnams 324

/ /tshegacig nyams lenaphyatshulatshasaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/kyis/ / bslab pa bsrung ba'i thabs 'ga' zhig / lung las gsungs pa bzhin du bri/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba zla med pa/ / bla ma mchog la brten byas nas/ /bya ba thams cad zhu byed cing / / chos mthun bka' las 'da' mi bya/ / dran dang shes bzhin bag yod dang / / ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa yis/ / bslab la yid ches dad gus bya/ / so thar bcas mtshams ston pa yi/ /'dul ba'i gzhung la tshul bzhin sbyangs/ / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la/ / phan yon bsam las 'das pa dang / /tshul khrims nyams par gyur na ni/ / mnar med 'gro zhing kun nas phongs/ / de phyir phan yon nyes dmigs la/ / nges pa drangs te yang yang bsam/ / mi mthun phyogs rnams ma shes na/ / bslab pa srung tshul mi shes pas/ / rang gis ji ltar khas blangs las/ /'das pa'i lhung ba mtha' yas kyang / / sdom gyis bsdus pa sde lnga ste/ / pham pa dang ni lhag ma dang / / ltung byed dang ni sor bshags dang / /nyes byas kyi ni sde rnams so/ / dang po pham pa'i sde tshan ni / / mi tshangasastsod dang gzhan nor brku/ /mi 'am mir chags gsod pa dang / / mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ste/ / pham pa bzhi ru rgyal bas gsungs/ / gnyis pa lhagama'i sde tshan ni/ / khu ba 'byin par byed pa dang / / bud med dag la reg pa dang / / yul der 'khrig tshig smra ba dang / / 'khrig pa'i bsnyen bkur bsngags pa dang / / pho mo gnyis sprad spyan byed dang / / ma gsol tshad 'das ma dag gzhir/ / khang ba rtsig par byed pa dang / / gnas der khang chen rtsigs pa dang / / dge slong rnam par dag pa la/ / pham pas skur ba 'debs pa dang / / de la bag tsam skur 'debs dang / / dge 'dun dbyen ni byed pa dang / / de 'dra'i rjes su phyogs pa dang / / bag med spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ / khyim sun 'byin par byed pa dang / / bka' blo mi 3cha

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/bde'i lhag ma ste/ / lhag ma'i ltung ba bcu gsum mo/ / gsum pa ltung byed sde tshan la/ / chad las dang 'brel spang ltung dang / / ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa gnyis so/ / dang po spang pa'i stung ba ni/ / byin gyis ma brlabs chos gos sogs/ / zhag bcu las 'das 'chang ba dang / / chos gos rnam gsum byin rlabs can/ / zhag tu 'bral bar byed pa dang / / kha skong re ba dang bcasapa'i/ / gos ni zla gcig 'jog pa dang / / tha snyad brgyad ldan dge slong mar/ / gos rnying 'khru ru 'jug pa dang / / gos kyis phongs pa ma yin par/ / dge slong ma las gos len dang / / phongs pa min par khyim pa las/ / gos ni slong bar byed pa dang / / chos gos med tshe sgong rigs kyang / /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zung las lhag / 'dod bas slong bar byedapa dang / / khyim pas rang la bsngos pa'i gos/ / 'bul long med par len pa dang / / sbyin bdag pho mo so so nas/ / rang la ster par bsngags pa'igos/ / 'bul long med par len pa dang / / bskur ba yi ni spang pa dang / / yul der dkon zhing rin che ba'i/ / srin bal las ni stan byed dang / / bal nag 'ba' zhig las byed dang / / de cha gnyis bsres stan byed dang / / stan bshams spyad bzod yod bzhin du/ / lo drug nang du gnyisakhyed dang / / gding ba gsar pa byed pa'i tshe/ / gding ba rnying pa de nyid nas/ / bde gshegs mtho gang ma glan dang / / bal khur rgyang grags lhagakhyer dang / / mtshan nyid brgyad ldan dge slong mar/ / bal ni rmel du 'jug pa dang / / byin rlabs ma byas rin po cher/ / reg gam reg tu 'jug pa dang / / skyed khe 'dod nas bun byed dang / / de 'dod nyo tshong byed pa dang / / lhung bzed byin gyis ma brlabs par/ / zhag bcu las 'das 'chang ba dang / / lhung bzed spyad bzod yod bzhin du/ / lhung 326

༄/ /tshegacig nyamasabanabyatshulachosaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/bzed gnyis pa btsal pa dang / / gla rngan mi ster 'thag 'jug dang / /'dod pas 'thag pa bskyed pa dang / / gos sogs byin pa 'phrog pa dang / / dgon pa 'jigs pa che ba'i sar/ / snam spyar zhag drug 'bral gnang bar/ / snyad nas zhag bdun 'bral ba dang / / dbyar gyi char khebs ras chen ni/ / btsal sngas sped pa 'phyis pa dang / / dbyar rnyed bdag gir byed 'dod nas/ / bgo sngas sped pa 'phyis pa dang / / dge 'dun rnams la bsngos pa'i rdzas/ / gang zag bdag nyid la bsgyur dang / / sman bzhi byin len ma bshig par/ / thun mtshams 'das pa gsog 'jog ste/ / spang pa'i ltung pa sum cu'o/ / gnyis pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig ni/ / rdzun gye tshig ni smra ba dang / / dge slong gzhan la skyon brjod dang / / dbye phyir phra ma byed pa dang / / rtsod pa slong 'dod skyo sngogs dang / / nye du min pa'i bud med la/ /khrims grogs med par chos ston dang / / ma rdzogs lhan cig 'don pa dang / / gzhan gyi pham lhag gnas ngan len/ / ma rdzogs pa la bajod pa dang / / mi chos bla ma dgos med du/ / ma rdzogs 'phags min smra ba dang / / zhal ta pa la dge 'dun gyis/ / rnyed pa rigs par bsngos pa la/ /bshes ngor byas zhes skur 'debs dang / / so sor thar pa'i bcas mtshams la/ / brnyas thabs kyis ni khyad gsod dang / / sa bon skye ba 'joms pa dang / / drang po'i dge 'dun zhal ta bar/ / nye ring byas zhes 'phyab dang / / bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / / chud 'dza'i gnas su mal bshams dang / / rtswa dang lo ma'i gdan bting ba/ / ma bsdus ma bcol 'gro bdang / / sngar gnas dge slong skrod pa dang / / de la phyis gnon byed pa dang / /rtsa ba 'byung la 'dug pa dang / / srog chags dang bcas chur spyod dang / /rim gsum las lhag khang byed dang / / nye du min pa'i dge slong 327

༄/ /gung ca ba pa'i sa'i ga 'bum/mar/ / ma bskos dam chos ston pa dang / / bskos kyang nub bar ston pa dang / / dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa la/ / zas phyir ston ces smra ba dang / /dge slong ma yi gos bzo dang / / de la chos gos ster pa dang / /dge slong ma dang lhan cig tu/ / grogs med rgyang grags 'gro ba dang / /dge slong ma dang lhan cig tu/ / grur zhugs rgyang grags 'da' ba dang / /dben par 'dom gang nang nyid du/ / dge slong ma dang lhan cig tu/ /'dug pa dang ni 'greng ba dang / / dge slong ma yis bsngags brjod nas/ /sbyor bcug zas ni za ba dang / / dgos med yang yang za ba dang / / mu stegs khyim du zhag gcig tu/ / 'dug ste zas gnyis za ba dang / / ci bderabastab pa ma yin par/ / lhung bzed do lhag phyed len dang / / dus rung zas spangs yang za dang / / spangs la bza' bca' stob pa dang / /dge slong bzhir long 'dus za dang / / dus min kha zas za ba dang / /gsog 'jog byas pa za ba dang / / byin len ma byas mid pa dang / / nye dang ci bder min pa la/ / kha zas bsod pa slong ba dang / / srog chags bcas par spyod pa dang / / khyim pa pho mo nyal gshom sar/ / shes bzhin 'dug par byed pa dang / / de bzhin gnas der 'greng ba dang / / gcer bu pho mor zas byin dang / / dmag la lta bar byed pa dang / / dmag nang zhag gnyis 'dug pa dang / / g.yul gshoms dkrug par byed pa dang / / dge slong gzhan la bdeg pa dang / / de la bdeg par gzas pa dang / / gzhan gyi pham lhag gnas ngan len/ / shes bzhin dgos med bcas pa dang / /dge slong gzhan gyi zas gcod dang / / mer reg reg tu 'jug pa dang / /'dun pa phul ba slar len dang / / ma rdzogs lhan cig nyal ba dang / / sdig lta gtong bar mi byed dang / / de 'dra bskrad la gtam smra dang / / dge tshul 328

༄/ /tshegacig nyamasayenabyatshulachosatsudagasalaba'isgroname/bsnyil ba sdud pa dang / / kha dog ma bskyar gos gyon dang / / rin po che yi rigs sogs la/ / reg cing reg tu 'jug pa dang / / zla phyed nang du khrus byed dang / / bsam bzhin dud 'gro gsod pa dang / / gzhan la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / / g.ya' 'dod ga ga tshil byed dang / / chu la rtse bar byed pa dang / / khrims grogs med par bud med dang / / lhan cig nyal bar byed pa dang / / dge slong dngangs par byed pa dang / / gzhan gyi gos sogs sbed pa dang / / dge slong gzhan la byin pa'i gos/ / gdeng med rang gis longasaspyod dang / / gzhi med lhag ma'i skur 'debs dang / / khrims grogs med par bud med dang / / 'grogs nas 'gro bar byed pa dang / / rkun ma la sogs ngan pa dang / / bsdebs nas 'gro bar byed pa dang / / lo grangs nyi shu ma lon pa'i/ / bsgrub byar bsnyen rdzogs byed pa dang / / sa brko brko ru 'jug pa dang / / mgron du gnyer las rang 'dug dang / / bslab phyir bgo ba bzlog pa dang / / rtsod sems nyan rna byed pa dang / / dge 'dun las la 'dus byas nas/ / ma rdzogs ma smras 'gro ba dang / / dge 'dun sogs kyi chos ldan bkar/ / ma gus bsam bas 'gal byed dang / / myos par 'gyur ba 'thung ba dang / / dus min grong du 'gro ba dang / /mngags bzhin dge 'dun spyan drangs pa/ / dus las ma yol brims shig ces/ / ma brjod grong gzhan rgyu ba dang / / rgyal po'i pho brang mtshan 'gro dang / / bslab gzhi khyad du gsod pa dang / / ba so rus pa rwa rnams kyi/ /khab ral byas sam byed 'jug dang / / tshad lhag khri rkang byed pa dang / /dge 'dun dbang ba'i gnas mal la/ / shing bal gyis ni bdal ba dang / /gding ba tshad las lhag byed dang / / g.yan pa dgab pa tshad lhag dang / /de bzhin dbyar gye gos ras chen/ / tshad las lhag pa byed pa dang / / bde 329

༄/ /yo bas7 pa'i ngalo ga ཿma/gshegs chos gos byed pa ste/ / ltung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu'o/ / so sor bshags pa'i sde tshan ni/ / skye bo'i rgyun lugs grong lam du/ / dge slong ma las zas len dang / / bsko bshams log byed dge slong ma/ / ma bzlog grong der zas za dang / / dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs brtse bas/ / bsdams pa'i khyim las zas len dang / / 'jigs bcas ma bsal khyim pa las/ / blangs te 'jigs sar za ba ste/ / so sor bshags pa bzhi dag go / bslab bya nyes byas sde tshan ni/ / mthang gos skum por ma bgos dang / / stengs dang 'jol dang nar pa dang / / ltebs dang phur dang 'phyang ba dang / / stod g.yogs glum por ma bgos dang / / ha cing rtsengs dang 'jol ba dang / / khyim pa'i khyimadu 'gro ba'i tshe/ / lus ngag legs par ma bsdams dang / / chos gos tshul bzhin ma bgos dang / / ca co dang ni g.yang lta dang / / 'dom gang las lhag lta ba'am/ / 'dom gang tsam du'ang mi lta dang / / ras la sogs pas mgo g.yogs dang / / 'doms ni snang bar gos bsdes dang / / phrag pa gnyis gar gos gzar dang / / lag gnyis gnya' gong bsnol ba dang / /lag gnyis ltag par bsnol ba dang / / mchong ba dang ni brkyang bskums dang / / tsog bus 'gro dang brang 'gro dang / / gru mo brgyangs te 'gro ba dang / / lus ni gcu zhing 'gro ba dang / / lag pa g.yug cing 'gro ba dang / / mgo bo bsgyur zhing 'gro ba dang / / phrag pa sprad de 'gro ba dang / /lag pa sbrel te 'gro ba dang / / khyim bas ma bskos stan 'dug dang / / ma brtags 'dug dang lced phab dang / / rkang ba bsnol dang brla bsnol dang / / long steng long bu bzhag pa dang / / khri 'og rkang pa dgug pa dang / /rkang pa so sor brkyangs pa dang / / 'doms ni snang bar 'dug pa dang / / zas ni legs par ma blangs dang / / kha da chad du blangs pa 330

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenaphya tshulachosaspyodagasalaba'itsāname/dang / / 'bras chan dang ni tshod ma dag / mnyam po nyid du blangs pa dang / / thar chags su ni ma blangs dang / / yid ma gtad par blangs pa dang / /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba rnams/ / ma 'ongs lhung bzed bzed pa dang / /'bras chan tshod ma ci rigs pa/ / lhag 'dod phan tshun 'gebs pa dang / /zas steng lhung bzed bzed pa dang / / kha zas tshul mthun ma zos dang / / kham ni ha cang chung ba dang / / kham ni shin tu che ba dang / / kham ni ran par ma zos dang / / zas ma 'ongs par kha gdangs dang / / kha ni bkang ste smra ba dang / / tsug tsug dang ni cag cag dang / / hu hu dang ni phu phu dang / / lce phyir phyung ste za ba dang / / 'bru ni re rer bza' ba dang / /kha zas la ni 'phya ba dang / / mkhur ba g.ya sa g.yon spo ba dang / / rkan sgra gtogs par byed pa dang / / kham 'phro bcad nas za ba dang / / lag pa ldag par byed pa dang / / lhung bzed ser mos 'byog pa dang / / lag par zas zos sprug pa dang / / zas bcas lhung bzed skyom pa dang / / zas la mchod rten gzugs byas te/ / gzhom par byed cing za ba dang / / gzhan gyi lhung bzed la 'phya dang / / lag pa zas kyis gos pa yis/ / chu snod dag la reg pa dang / / 'bag chus dge slong la 'thor dang / / khyim bdag ngag la ma dris par/ / 'bag chu ci bder 'dor ba dang / / zas lhag lhung bzed nang ldugs dang / / lhung bzed gzhi med 'jog pa dang / / lhung bzed gad khar 'jog pa dang / / lhung bzed g.yang sar 'jog pa dang / / lhung bzed dkan gzar 'jog pa dang / / 'greng ste lhung bzed bkru ba dang / / lhung bzed gad khar bkru ba dang / / lhung bzed g.yang sar bkru ba dang / /lhung bzed dkan gzar bkru ba dang / / lhung bzed kyis ni 'bab chu'i rgyun/ / bzlog ste chu ni bcu pa dang / / nyan pa po ni 'dug pa la/ / 'greng 331

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i lo ga stem/ste chos ni 'chad pa dang / / nyal la 'dug ste 'chad pa dang / / nyan po stan ni mthon po'am/ / bzang po dag la 'dug pa la/ / stan ni dma' ba'am ngan pa la/ /'dug ste chos ni 'chad pa dang / / nyan po mdun nas 'gro ba la/ / phyi nas 'gro zhing chos 'chad dang / / nyan po lam nas 'gro ba la/ /lam gyi 'gram nas chos 'chad dang / / mgo g.yogs pa la chos 'chad dang / /gos ni brjes te 'dug pa dang / / phrag pa gnyis gar gos gzar dang / / lag gnyis gnya' bar bsnol ba dang / / lag gnyis ltag par bsnol ba dang / / do ker can dang zhwa gyon dang / / mgo la cod pan bcings pa dang / / phreng ba bcing dang thod dkris dang / / glang po che la zhon pa dang / / rta la zhon zhing nyan pa dang / / khyogs kyi nang na 'dug pa dang / /bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa dang / / mtshol lham gyon te 'dug pa dang / /lag na mkhar ba thogs pa dang / / lag na gdugs ni thogs pa dang / / lag na mtshon cha thogs pa dang / / lag na ral gri thogs pa dang / /lag na dgra cha thogs pa dang / / go cha gyon zhing nyan pa ste/ / de dag rnams la chos bshad dang / / 'greng ste bshang gci byed pa dang / /bshang gci mchil snabs skyugs pa sogs/ / chu yi nang du 'dor ba dang / /rtswa sngon skyes pa'i sa dag tu/ / bshang gci la sogs 'dor ba dang / /dgos med 'dom gang las mtho ba'i/ / shing la 'dzeg par byed pa ste/ /nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis so/ / de ltar bslab pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /thams cad legs par shes byas nas/ / bag yod pa dang gus pa dang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang / / dran dang shes bzhin bsten pa dang / /don nyung ba dang bya ba nyung / / rtse gcig dben pa bsten pa yi/ / srog bzhin gces par bsrung bar bya/ / zhesasothar gyi sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs332

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenaphyatholachosatsudagasalaba'isgoname/rnamasadran shing sdom semasabya/ de nas/ gzhan yang rgyal ba sras bcas kye/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ / rgyal sras sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ / rtsa ba'i ltung pa bco brgyad ni/ / rnyed dang bkur stes chags pa yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / / sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ / ser sna'i chos nor mi ster dang / / gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ /khros nas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang / / theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o/ / dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog dang / /dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang / / ngur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang / / btson rar 'jug parabyed pa dang / / rab tu byung las phab pa dang / / mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang / /log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang / / grong la sogs pa 'jig pa dang / /blo sbyang ma byas sems can la/ / stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang / /sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzlog pa dang / /so sor thar pa yongs spangs te/ / theg pa che la spyor ba dang / / slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs/ /spong bar 'gyur pa min zhega'adzin/ / pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang / / rang gi yon tan bajod pa dang / / rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste dang / / tshigs bcad rgyu yi gzhan smod dang / / bdag ni zab mo bzod pa'o zhes/ /log pa nyid ni smra ba dang / / dge sbyong chad pas gcod 'jug dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi sbyin byed dang / /sbyin pa len par byed pa dang / / zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang / / yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams/ / kha ton byed la sbyin pa dang / / byang chub sems gnyis spangs pa sogs/ /rtsa ltung kun dang nyes byas kyang / / dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ / 'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug / rgan pa 333

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 0 rsā gsung stem/rnams la gus mi byed/ / dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs/ / mgron bos bdag gir mi byed dang / / gser la sogs pa len mi byed/ / chos 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ / tshul khrims 'chal rnams yal ba 'dod/ / pha rol dad phyir slob mi byed/ / sems can don la bya ba chung / / snying brtser bcas par ma byas dang / / 'tsho ba log pa dang du len/ / 'phyar nas rab tu rgod la sogs/ /'khor bar gcig pu bgrod par sems/ / grags pa ma yin mi spongadang / / nyon mongs bcas kyang 'chos mi byed/ / gshe la lan du gshe la sogs/ / khros pa rnams ni yal bar 'dor/ / pha rol shad kyis chags pa spong / /khro ba'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug / rnyed bkur 'dod phyir 'khor rnams sdud/ / le lo la sogs sel mi byed/ / chags pas bre mo'i gtam la brten/ / ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi 'tshol/ / bsam gtan sgrib pa spong mi byed/ / bsam gtan ro la yon tan lta/ / nyan thos theg pa spong bar byed/ / rang tshul yod bzhin de la brtson/ / brtson min phyi rol bstan bcos brtson/ / brtson par byas kyang de la dga'/ / theg pa chen po spong bar byed/ / bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod/ / chos kyi don du 'gro mi byed/ /de la smod dang yi ge rten/ / dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed/ /na pa'i rim gro bya ba spong / / sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed dang / / bag med rnams la rigs mi ston/ / byas la lan du phan mi 'dogs/ / gzhan gyi mya ngan sel mi byed/ / nor 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ / 'khor rnams kye ni don mi byed/ / gzhan gyi blo dang mthun mi 'jug / yon tan bsngags pa smra mi byed/ / rkyen du 'tsham par tshar mi gcod/ / rdzu 'phrul sdigs sogs ma byas dang / / gzhan la chos dang zang zing gis/ / skyong bar 'os pa ma bskyangs dang / / gzhan gyis gnod pa khon 'dzin zhing / / ris su bcad 334

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenabya satshasaspyodagasalaba'isgroname/nas chags sdang byed/ dam pa ma bsten thos bsam dor/ / zas gos sogs laspyod pa'i tshe/ / gzhan don bsam pas ma zin dang / / chos spyod kun la semasabaskyed kyis/ / ma zin nag chos ma spang zhing / / dkar chos bzhi la ma bslab dang / / gzhan don brtson par ma byas sogs/ / 'gro kun mgron du gnyer pa las/ / bslus pa'i nyes ltung mtha' yas pa/ / sngon byas mtha' dag mthol zhing bshags/ / da ni srog dang bsdos te bsrung / / zhes byang sems dang / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan snga ru/ / khas blang dam tshig sdom pa zhes/ / dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ / de dang 'gal byas ltung ba ni/ / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la/ / nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /maṇḍal me tog bcas phul nas/ / phyag ni 'tshal bar ma byas dang / / dpon slob 'brel ba ma brtags par/ / chos la nyan bshad byas pa dang / / bla ma la brnyas smad pa dang / / bla ma'i thugs ni dkrugs pa dang / / yid 'ong yon ni ma phul dang / / rtag tu dam tshig ma bsrungs dang / / rtag tu bde gshegs ma mchod dang / / rtag tu bla ma mayachod dang / / bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ / tha dad par ni bsam pa dang / / bla ma'i grib ma lham dang stan/ / bzhon pa sogs la 'goms pa dang / / bka' bsgo gus pas ma nyan dang / /mi nus shad sbyang 'os pa la/ / shad sbyang dag ni ma byas dang / / bla ma'i rdzas la srog bzhin dang / / 'khor la gnyen bzhin ma bsam dang / /drung du mal stan la 'dug dang / / bsgo ba ma thob sngon 'gro dang / / bla ma las sngar stan gyi steng / / rkang ba 'jog dang gru rgyangs byed/ / bla ma bzhengs tshe nyal dang 'dug / bzhugs pa dag na nyal ba dang / / bla ma'i drung du mchil ma sogs/ / dor dang rkang ba kyong ba sogs/ /'chag dang kha stebs 'gyed pa dang / / yan lag mnye dang gar dag dang / / glu dang rol 335

༄/ /yo ca bam ba yo ga ཿma/mo byas pa dang / / bre mo'i gtam rnams smras pa dang / / ldang 'dug gus par ma byas dang / / bla ma'i drung du lus gcu dang / / ka ba sogs la brten pa dang / / sor mo'i tshigs ni 'then pa dang / / dril phyi sku mnye la sogs la/ / thog mtha' phyag ni ma byas dang / / zhal sngar ldan pa ma sbyar bar/ /bla ma'i mtshan nas smos pa dang / / gzhan dag gus par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad par can gyi tshig ma brjod/ / rgod dang lud pa la sogs la/ / lag pas kha ni ma bkab dang / / bya ba zin nas 'jam pa yi/ / tshig gi brda ni ma sbyar dang / / mdun du dul bas mi 'dug dang / / gos sogs tshul ni ma bsdams dang / / gsang sngags dam chos nyan pa'i tshe/ / bus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas/ / gsol ba lan gsum ma btab dang / / nga rgyal sgeg chos kun spangs nas/ / dul zhing bag yod ma bsten dang / / bla mas gnang ba ma thob par/ / bla ma gnas pa'i sa phyogs der/ / rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyinasreg dang / / slob ma sdud dang 'chad pa dang / / bla ma'i slob ma slob mar byas/ / spyan 'byed sogs la ci thob pa/ / de kun bla mar ma phul dang / / de yis bstabs pa blangs nas ni/ / gzhan la ci bder ma byas dang / / slob dpon la ni gang phul dang / / bla mas kyang ni gang stsal ba/ /de la btud de lag gnyis kyis/ / len pa sogs ni ma byas dang / / bla ma'i drung du gzhan dag gis/ / phyag sogs byed pa ma bzlog dang / / rang gi kun spyod la brtson pas/ / spun gyi rang spyod las 'das pa/ / dga' bas phan tshun ma bzlog dang / / bde gshegs bla ma'i bka' 'das dang / / srun la khros nas skyon smras dang / / spun gyi chos ldan ngag bcag dang / / sems can rnams la byams pa spangs/ / sems can la ni khros pa dang / / byang chub sems gnyis sbangs pa dang / / rang gzhan grub mtha' la smad dang / /336

༄/ /tshegacig nyams lenabya 0chosaspyodagasalaba'isgoname/ma smin pa la gsang ba bsgrags/ / phung po la brnyas smad pa dang / / stong pa nyid ni spangs pa dang / / gdug pa can la byams par byas/ / sgyu yis byams pa bsten pa dang / / rgyun par stong nyid ma bsgoms dang / / bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag dang / / stong nyid tshal bar ma byas dang / / dad ldan sun par byas pa dang / / rnal 'byor pa yi skyon smras dang / / dam rdzas tshul bzhin ma bsten dang / / bud med la ni smod pa sogs/ / rtsa ltung bcu bzhi bsdus pa dang / / shes rab stobs kyis len pa dang / / de yi bdud rtsi stobs kyis len/ / snod min la ni mi gsang dang / / tshogs kyi nang du rtsod pa dang / / dad ldan la gzhan chos ston dang / / nyan thos nang du zhag bdun gnas/ / rdzun gyis rnal 'byor nga rgyal byed/ / dad pa med la chos stonadang / / sbyor ba legs par ma byas par/ / skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ / dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa las/ / dgos pa med par 'das pa dang / / rtsa ltung sbom po'i ltung pa la/ / sdom sems dus drug ma btang dang / / tshul khrims gsum dang 'gal ba dang / / skyabs 'gro dus drug ma grub dang / / rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yi/ / dam tshig bsten par ma byas dang / / slob dpon dus drug ma mchod dang / / zang zing mi 'jigs chos dngabums/ / sbyin pa dus drug ma byin dang / / phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ / dam chos 'dzin 'dod ma bskyed dang / / sdom pa dang ni mchod pa la/ / dus drug brtson par ma byas dang / / sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs par/ / bya ba ma yin ma spangs dang / / rnal 'byor ba rnams ma mchod dang / / dge bcu sgrub la mi brtson dang / / theg pa dman la 'dod byas dang / / sems can don la rgyab phyogs dang / / 'khor ba dag kyang 337

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i me'i go stem/spangs pa dang / / rtag tu mya ngan 'das chags dang / / lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ / de dag rnams la brnyas pa dang / / phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'goms dang zos pa dang / / de bzhin dman ma lha yi grib/ /rkang pa dag gis badzis pa sogs/ / sbom po'i gzhi las gyur pa dang / /rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig las/ / 'das par gyur pa la sogs pa/ /mdor na rdo rje theg pa yi/ / 'dul ba dang 'gal nyes pa kun/ /khong bar song ba'i dug bzhin du/ / 'gyod pa drag pos bshags par bgye/ / bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ / thugs rje byin rlabs chu rgyun gyis/ / bdag gi sgo gsum nyes ltung kun/ / byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sngags sdom gyi ltung ba'i bsngo bgrang rnams dal bus byed cing /rang la nyin der byung ma byung brtags nas/ byung 'dug na phyir bcos dang ltungab spyi bshags sogs bya la sngags kyi rtsa ltung sbyang ba'i phyir bdag 'jug blang ba sogs kyang nan tan du bya/ khyad par du da lta bstan pa'i gzugs brnyanakho nar song ba'i dbang gis dge slong du khas 'che ba phal mo che zhig chos gos dang ma bral ba tsam las lhag pa'i bsrung bya gzhan med pa lta bur go snang la/ mthang gos sogs dang 'bral spangs yod pa'i gtam tsam yang ma tshor 'dug pas/ de'i shan la brten nas bla gos kyi byin rlabs kyang rmeg med du song ste/ spang ltung 'ba' zhig gi phung por 'gyur zhing / 'chang spang sogs la yang yid zon byed pa mi snang mod/ spyir ltung ba dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa gal che la/ khyad par du dus nges pa'i mtha' can rnams la gzab par byas na/ ltung ba dngos dang de'i shan yang 'phel kha sogs rim gyis nags la me mched pa ltar bzlog dka' bas/ nyin der rang la yo byad gsar ba byung ma byung brtag te/ mkho ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dngos 338

༄/ /tshegacig nyamasa'anabya yotshasatsudagasalaba'isgoname/po ni/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang lhag pa'i yo byad gnyis las gzhan pa zong gos su nges pa dang / ma nges pa gnyis gang yang rung ba/ chos ldan gyi dgos pa'i phyir yin pa/ khru gang yan chad du longs pa sogs bzung ste/ cho ga ni lha dgongs su gsol/ gos 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la mkhoba'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab po/ zheyolan gsum/ 'di ni dkar po dang / kha tshar can la sogs pa la yang byin rlabs 'chags so/'tshoba'i yo byad phran tshegs ni/ zhwa dang ska rags dang stan la sogs pa khru gang du longs pa rnams/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di zhwar byin gyis brlab po/ zhes lan gsum brjod gzhan rnams la yang 'dis rigs bsgrebar bya'o/ / khru gang du ma longs pa rnams la rang rang gi ming du lan gcig sems bskyed cing / zhen pa med par bcang ngo / / lhag pa'i yo byad gdongaphyis la sogs pa khrur ma longs pa rnams ni yid kyis brtag te bcang ngo / / mkho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs ni rang gzhan gye chos ldan gyi dgos pa'i ched du 'chang ba'i khru gang du ma longs pa'i gos zong gos su nges pa dang / ma nges pa rnams yin pas yid kyis brtag pa byas la bcang ngo / bsam pa ni 'tsho ba'i yo byad la rang gi dang / lhag pa'i yo byad la gzhan gyi dang / mkho ba'i yo byad la rang gzhan gnyis ga'i blos bcang ngo / mi rung pa'i dngos po la/ lha dgongs su gsol/ / bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di rnyed de/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di byin gyis brlab bo/ / dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'dis dngos po rung ba bsgrub par bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ sman dang shes pa chung ngu'i rung khang byin rlabs sogs kyang gal che la 'dir ma bris pas/ 'dul 'dzin gyi gzhi gsum cho ga dang / rje btsun ye 339

༄/ /yo ca bam yo yo ga stem/shes rgyal mtshan gyi gzhi gsum gsal byed sogs su blta'o/ / gal te 'di dag gis gos na yo byad rnams spangs te ltung ba ming rigs mthun pas ma gos pa'i dge slong gi mdun du phyir bcos byas nas slar yang byin rlabs bya/ de nas thun gyi mthar bzang po spyod pa sogs smon lam rgyas pa'am/ de'i don bsdus pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis dang / lam rim smon lam dang bstan 'bar ma'am/ bsdu na/ rgyal sras smon lam gago'i klung rnams ni/ / dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ /gsungs phyir dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa rnams/ / kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / zhes dang / shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rnyed dang bkur ste'i rgyur/ / skad cig tsam yang nam yang mi smin par/ / bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig / ces sogs dang / bde ba can nam dga' ldan lta bur 'phen pa byed na yang de'i smon tshig ci rigs sbyor/ sngar gyi dge sbyor la sdong grogs mdzad pa'i gtang rag dang / sang phan chad kyi 'phrin las bcol ba'i phyir skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye chos skyong sogs la gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ nam gung gi thun la ldang nus na legs kyang / ma lcogs na de'i dod du nyal khar slar yang thun drug gi rnal 'byor shin tu bsdus pa tshar gcig bya/ de nas sang 'di tsam gyi dus su langs la dge spyor la brtson par byed snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas/rab gnyid dus kyi bsre ba dang / gzhan dge ba'i dran shes dang ldan pas nyal bar bya ste/ mgon po klu'i zhabs kyis/ rigs pa'i bdag nyid nyin par mtha' dag dang / /mtshan mo'ang thun gye stod smad 'das nas ni/ / mnal tshe'ang 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar/ /dran dang ldan par de dag bar du mnol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / smras pa/ tshul khrims rnam par dag 3khu

༄/ /tshegacig nyamasayenas tshulachosaspyodagasalaba'isgoname/pa'i lus mdzes shing / / thos bsam 'dab zung g.yo ba'i bhra ma ra / / rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis dben pa'i skyed tshal du/ / nges 'byung glu dbyangs len de skyid pa'i mchog / de lta'i bsod nams bsags pa'i skal bzang gis/ /chosaspyod ji ltar bya ba drang po'i lam/ / gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad sgron me 'dis/ / lam grol rmongs pa'i mun pa sangs par gyes/ / snyigs dus skye bo'i tshe la long med cing / / srid pa'i phun tshogs nyes mang mnog chung bas/ / grogs dag 'bras med spun ba ma 'phyar bar/ / gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrubs na mi legs sam/ / sdug bsngal chu gter che las sgol ba'i gru/ / dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i rten thob nas/ / bag med gnyid dang le los dus 'da' ba/ / ngan song gnas su lhung tshe mi 'gyod dam/ /zas nor bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing / / gnyen mang du ma 'dus kyang so sor 'bral/ / mthon po'i mtha' rgud skyes pa kun 'chi na/ / zon med bde bar sdod pa khyod khom mam/ / de bas nam mjug 'chad ga'i bung pa dang / /long med dgun nyi lta bu'i tshe thung 'di/ / bde dang sdug bsngal ji ltar gyur kyang sla/ / brtson pas byang chub dam pa bsgrubs na legs/ /'dir 'bad dge bas thub bstan mkha' dbyings su/ / sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i nyi ma rab gsal zhing / / theg gsum rigs can rigs kyi 'dab brgya pa/ / rnam grol ge sar snying pos mdzes gyur cig / ces tshe gcig gi nyams len rnams nyin zhag phrugs gcig la sbyar te lag tu bstang ba'i tshul chos spyod gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam tshul bzhin du byas pa rdo ram pa tshangs dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyes thos don sgrub ba la sbyar ba'i ched du dben pa'i ri khrod du 'gro bar chas pa'i tshe 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan tan du bskul bar brten thun drug gi rnal 'byor dang sdom pa ma1

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/gsum gyi bsngo bgrang sogs la nyams len gyi mthil du byed pa ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa dang mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin pas de rnams gtso bor bzung byin rlabs kyi khyad nas rje yab sras dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi tshig ris rnams rang so bzhag par mtshams su tshig sbyor cung zad snon dgos pa rnams bsnan te/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'du khang chen mo'i yang rtser spyar ba 'dis kyang 'jam mgon bstan pa'i snying po phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par gyur cig / rnyed dka' dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang po/ / don ldan bgyid pa'i thabs kyi rtser son pa/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthil/ / nyams len zab mo'i gnad bsdus thun drugagi / rnal 'byor gzhir byas chos spyod rim pa 'di/ / mi zad bar du bsgrun pa'i legs byas mthus/ / tshang la ma nor bstan pa'i snying po 'di/ /phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / yang dag lam bzang bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni dad brtson lhag bsam mchog tu dge ba rab 'byamasapa dkon mchog 'byung gnayokyi4'di nyid bar du bsgrubs pa'i tshe smon tshig cig dgosatshul ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabrisapa'o/ /342

/ /thugasaganyeraganangatshulabaspababyubadorabasdus/༄7/ / thugs gnyer gnang tshul bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs so/oṃ su ste/ / thugs gnyer gnang tshul bslab bya dgos gsungs pa kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung dang nged kyis kyang sngar bris pa des 'thus pas/tshigs bcad du 'bri long ma byung / don gyi snying po yig cha dang gzhung rang rangagi rtsa ba thugs 'dzin gnang / de'i steng nas tshig 'khri phra mo tshun chad kyang khegs pa'i rtsod pa brdar sha chod dgos/ yig cha 'ga' zhig bltas tsam namador 'du zhing go bde ba lta bu yod kyang de la dang por go ba de las lhag par skyed thon pas zab rgyas su 'gro rgyu med/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i yig cha 'dir tshig dum chod dang don la la skabs der ma 'brel ba lta bu yod kyang shing rta chen po'i gzhung mang por bltas nas phyir 'khor na 'di'i rtsa ba de la thug 'dug snyam de dag gi sgo nas yig char yid ches skyes rgyu yig cha'i steng nas de thams cad kyi khog 'grig rgyu sogs rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig tu 'gro rgyu zhig yod/ phar phyin lta bu'i skabs 'grel ba don gsal la bltas na dang por grangs 'dren lta bu zhig tu yod kyang yun du dpyad na mtha' dpyod thams cad rnam bshad gser 'phreng gnyis la ma thug pa med/de 'grel pa'i tshig la ma 'khris pa med pas mchod brjod skor cung zad 'phros che ba ma gtogs phar phyin skor thams cad 'grel ba skyor thang gcig gi khongs ma3

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung 'bum/su dran gso thub pa zhig gal che/ dbu ma'ang dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sa bcad steng nas 'jug pa'i steng du 'dril ba zhig byung na dbu ma'i rigs pa gnad che ba rags rim gye ngo bo tsam des chog / de rjes de'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i dbu ma rtsa shes yin la/ klu sgrub blo mtsho shin tu rgya che'i kha dog gis 'jigs gsung don rtsa she'i rnam grangs re re la mang po zhig gsung ba dang por bltas tshe zlos pa lta bur yod kyang rgyus lon na tshig re re bzhin gyi rigs pa'i zuraja no dang je zab kyis gtugs pa med par 'gro bas stong nyid la zab paragasungs pa der nang nas nges pa rnyed pa zhig byung na zab pa'i sgo nas 'jug tshul zer ba de byung ba yin/ rtsa shes la rigs pa'i zur rno byed rigs tshogs gzhan rnams dgos shing / rjes 'jug gi khrod na bzhi brgya pa las lhag pa med/ mdzod 'dul gnyis la dbu phar lta bu'i gting zab tu gtong rgyu med/rnam grangs nges pa'i 'dris cha gal che/ mdzod gnas dang po lta bur 'gro gleng byed tshe khas len shor ba la gnas dang po'i lung 'dren rgyu yod pas go mi chod/gnas brgyad ga'i nang du lhu ma 'grigs pa zhig nges par byas yod pas de thams cad nas gnod byed ston rgyu yod pa dang / gang la'ang rtsa tshig gi lung re med mi srid pas mgo 'jug thams cad bsdeb shes dus mdzod la goms cha song ba yin/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'ang dang por 'grel ba don gsal bzhin rtsod rgyu dang gnyis ka mi gcig pa lta bu zhig 'char yong / mtsho ṭīka lta bu'i steng nas gong 'og gnang bkag dang yan lag tshang ma tshang gi zhib cha sogs thams cadabyed thub tshe mtha' dpyod kyi de thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i nang der khrig ge 'dus yod pas rang rang gi rtsa ba dang mtha' dpyod ya ma bral ba gal che/rnam 'grel da lta kun la gzugs brnyan du song yod pas rigs pa'i zur phyin pa dka' 'ang le'u gnyis pa'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub tshul rma

༄/ /thugasaganyeraganang 4bslababyamadorabasdus/sogasaspyi khogs shig thugs la 'jags pa med mi rung yin/ de ltar bka' pod lnga la thugs gnyer rdo rus thug pa zhig gnang na gsungs rab thams cad kyi dgongs 'grel byang chub lam gyi rim pa yin zhing / de'i don skyes bu chung 'bring gi nges 'byung chen po'i byang sems dang yang dag pa'i lta ba las ma 'das/ dang pos khams gsum 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal la yid 'byung ba la khams gsum 'khor ba rang shes dgos shing / de mngon pa'i snod bcudakyi 'jig rten phung khams skye mched bshad pa de shes pa la thug / de las nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims la slob tshul 'dul ba rang yin/ de rtsom byed kyi skyabs 'gro mos mno tsam ma yin par rnam dag cig 'ong ba rnam 'grel la thug / bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog kyang bka' 'khor lo dang po'i dgongs 'grel mngon pa mdzod yin pas de'i steng nas mtha' chod par shes dgos/chenapo'i byang chub kyi sems sogs rgya che ba'i lam rim thams cad kyi 'byung khungs lta bu phar phyin yin zhing sher mdo tsam ma yin par theg chen gyi mdo sde thams cad de'i yan lag tu 'khyer tshul mdo sde rgyan na gsal bas rgyan gnyis gzung du 'jug pa zhig gnad che/ zab mo lta ba'i lam rim dbu mar rag las pa rlung ltar grags che bas zhu mi dgos bka' pod lnga la thos bsam byas pa'i gnad don thams cad mdo phyogs kyi lam gyi rim pa'i lus gcig tu 'dril ba byung tshe 'o ma'i nang nas mar len pa bzhin mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ sgyu lus 'od gsal gnyis/ de gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i zung 'jug dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gnad la nges pa khyad par can snying po dang yang snying gi tshul du zab rgyas kyi lam rim gnyis po de'i khong nas cha tshang ba bde blag tu rnyed pa zhig 'byung bas/ tshul de thugs la bzhag nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' ༅5

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgonasa'i gsung 'bum/bdag gcig pur gyur te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas thub bstan mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs mthar bsgrengs shing / skal ldan gdul bya mtha' dag rnam grol nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon bla na med par 'gyur ba zhig ci nas kyang bka' drin skyong ba zhu zhu/ 7'di ni lcagasasprul lor skyabasamagon tho'u bkwan mchog sprul rin po che dbusasugasan spyong la phebasaskabs thugasaganyer gnang tshul gyi bslab bya zhig dgos tshul zhusapa bzhin/ 7rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gung thang rin po chesa'aphral du stsal ba'o/ / / / sarna mgoli/༅6

༄/ /'dulaba'ibaslabasamadorabasdus/༄༅/ / 'dul ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs so/gang la brten na nam yang mi bslu zhing / / bka' bzhin sgrub na 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol ba/ / pad dkar ltar bsngags thub pa'i dbang po la/ /dad ba'i dngos po kun gyis phyag bgyi'o/ / rgyal bstan snying po zab dang rgya che ba'i/ / gnad kun tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzhir/ / legs par bskrun pa'i lam gyi srog 'dzin pa/ / 'jam mgon yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ / dug gsum nad gye gdung sel a mṛ ta/ / mngon mtho nges legs yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ / bstan pa'i rtsa ba ston pa'i gdung 'tshob mchog / nyes ltung rnyog mas dben pa'i khrims 'di yin/ / de slad tshul khrims yang dag srungs shig ces/ / 'doms pa 'di ni gdams pa'i yang rtse dang / / rang sems chos 'dul srol du btsud pa ni/ / bstan pa'i bya ba kun gyi rab dang phul/ / mi shes ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgor gsung yang / / da lta lung gi le'u'i mthar son pas/ / shas cher ma gus pa dang bag med pas/ / bsam bzhin bstan la rang dgar spyod pa mthong / / dgag sgrub gnang gsum ltung ba na smad sogs/ / sdom dang gzhis bsdus bcas mtshams ma lus pa/ / lhug lhug bshad pa'i rlabs phreng cher gsal yang /gting mtha' nyes stung 'dam gyis gang 'dis skyo/ / sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa yi/ / bslab bya glang chen rgyab khal long na yang / / snyigs 347

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgon yo ga4 4ma/dus skye bo'i don du mi 'gyur ba/ / slob pa'i 'dun pa gzhi nas stor bas nongs/ /gleng gzhi 'di yis 'di ltar bkag go zhes/ / gsal bar sgogs bzhin rang gi spyod pa ni/ /snyigs ma bdo ba'i dmag gi ru 'dren rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la ngo rgol byed pa 'dra/ /shes bzhin khyad du gsod pas rab zhugs na/ / bcas rkyang phra mor 'gal ba'i gzhi las kyang / / bde gshegs bka' 'das rtsa ltung bskyed pa yis/ / bzod dka' rdo rje dmyal ba'i sgo 'phar 'byed/ /de phyir dam pa'i gsung rab snga ma la/ /bri bsnan spyor bas rtsom gyi khur 'dzin pa/ / rang nyid ngal ba 'bras bur zad pa'i phyir/ / de bas bslab bya sna gcig bsrung ba gces/ / nam zhig 'di snang bslu ba'i mtshang rig cing / / ngan song sdug bsngal tshul la snying nas 'jigs/ las 'bras bslu ba med par yid ches na/ / rgyal dang de yi bcas par gus pa skye/ /de ltar bskul ma nang nas thebs pa yis/ / nges 'byung shugs kyi slob 'dun skyes pa na/ / 'dul ba'i gzhung kun gdams par nges 'char bas/ / bslab byas nam yang phongs par mi 'gyur ro/ / des na thog ma kho nar 'di snyam du/ / rgyal ba sras bcas dpang du legs bzhag ste/ / mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa'i spyan snga ru/ / bslab bya'i gnas kun bsrung bar dam bcas kyang / / rang gi sgo gsum bag med gyur pa 'dis/ / theg gsum thar pa'i go 'phang smos ci dgos/ / mngon mtho'i sgra yang thos par mi 'gyur snyam/ /sngar byas las la 'gyod pa shugs drag bskyed/ / da ni tshe lhag ci tsam yod pa 'dir/ / bdud kyi g.yab mo'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ / nyams lenasnying po khrims kyi blang dor la/ / chig dril 'bad snyam dam bca' yang yang bya/ /thos bsam la sogs sgo gsum bya ba kun/ /'khyag steng chu bzhin 'khor ba'i kha 'dzin du/ / mi gtong rang rgyud 'dul phyir sbyor ba ni/ /34

༄/ /'dulaba'ibaslabasamador bsdus/gtan 'dun 'phyug med gros kyi yang rtse yin/ / de ltar sgrub na thar pa'i go 'phang zhes/ / pha rol rgyang ring lta bur grags de yang / / rang gi lag pa'i rtse mor gnas pa'i phyir/ / de 'dra de la dal 'byor don ldan zer/ / gsal zhing rno ba'i blo dang brtson pa'i dpung / / 'jigs med snying stobs la sogs skyes bu'i rtsal/ / gang yod chos kyi phyogs su bkol nus na/ / de ni mkhas mdzangs rtul phod dpa' bo yin/ / dam chos ma byung sdug skad 'don pa'i mi/ / mang du snang yang rtsa ba rang rang gis/ / ma byas pa la 'byung ba'i thabs med kyi/ / byas nas ma byung ba ni 'ga' yang med/ / mdor na mang du smos lta ci zhig 'tshal/ / rang gi rgyud la skor nas legs brtags tshe/ /snying nas chos la don gnyer blo skyes na/ / de yi legs tshogs rtsa ba tshugs pa yin/ / de slad bslab bya'i snying po mdor bsdus pa/ / slob pa'i mdun pa bskyed pa 'di yin pas/ / skyid sdug 'dam ga'i dbang yod gnas skabs 'dir/ / rang gis rang la brtse ba ma dor zhig / 'di ltar bsnyad pa las byung rnam dkar dge / ston zla'i mdzes pa dman par byed pa des/ / lus canayid kyi mun pa kun bsal nas/ / rnam grol kun da'i dga' tshal rgyas gyur cig / / / cesapa 'di ni mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mngon par mtho ba har chen wang gi tho yon dharma kertisa'adul ba'i bslab bya zhig dgosatshul byung yang /spyir rje bdag nyid chen po/ 'dul 'dzin/ spyan snga pa/ pa chen/ yongasa'adzin yoshes rgyal mtshan sogs kyiyomadzad pa'i bslab bya rgya4bsdugaci 'dra zhig dgosakyang 'dug gshisagasar du bri mi dgos la/ lhag par deng dus bslab bya la ltab rnamayokyi4kyang 'di na 'di ltar bgrang 'dug go zhes bshad pa'i yan lag tsam du khyer te/ bsrung rgyu'i 'dun pa zhig gzhi nas ma skyesapayolan 'dug stabs/ sde lnga'i ngos 'dzin sogasam sprosapar/ slob 'dod rnal ma zhig skyed dgosatshul mdor bsdusate/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes briyopa'o/ / / / dge'o/ /slob

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / kun mkhyen bla ma'i 'khrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i/ / ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra bar bzhengs pa las/ / gdul bya'i mos par 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ / 'jug pa dus las mi yol thugs rje'i bdag / gang gi bden stobs gzungs rig mos pa'i mthus/ / mdun gye mkha' la dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser/ / pad zla nyi ma'i gdan bcas seng ge'i khri/ / yid 'phrog tshar du dngar ba'i dbus ma la/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / g.yas su rgyal sras dri med grags pa'i zhabs/ / dpal ldan sangs rgyas bskyangs dang phyogs kyi glang / / zla ba'i zhabs dang grub chen dze tā ri/ / g.yon du bdag nyid chen po rin chen gsal/ / rje btsun dbu ma pa dang zhwa lu ba/ / rgyud chen rnam gnyis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /gzhan yang mkha' khyab gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin/ / gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlosagar mtha' yas dang / / skyabs yul zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i mgon du brtan par bzhugs/ / ji ltar dwangs pa'i mtsho la zla gzugs bzhin/ / gang la gang 'dul gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyes/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgrol ba'i gnyen/ / skyabs mgon thugs 350

༄/ /kunamayo blama'i 'khrungasarabasadang chul ba'i blama'irnal 'byor/rje'i gter la gus phyag 'tshal/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gye phung po ni/ /bden tshig mos pa'i yid mkhar g.yo ba yang / / lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang du rol ba yis/ / bdag gi bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par mdzod/ / legs byas mtha' dag rang lus bcas 'bul na/ / sngon bsags dge tshogs chud mi za ba dang / / sgo gsum spyod pa bla ma'i dbang gyur te/ / rtag tu don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ / mnog chung srid 'byor sbrang rtsi la chags te/ /mi bzad sdig ltung mtshon rnon bldag pa yi/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal bzod dka'i yid kyi rma/ / gso bar mdzod cig thugs rje'i sman gyi bla/ / khyod zhabs padmo gus pas bsten byas te/ / zab cing rgya che gdams pa'i a mṛ ta/ / 'dod dgur spyad pas dug gsum sa bon bcas/ / drung nas 'byin pa'i dga' ston myong bar shog / gang gang skye ba'i phreng ba de dang der/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la zhen pa'i blo/ / byin rlabs thugs rje'i phyag gis yongs bzung ste/ / mi gnas zhi ba'i lam der drang du gsol/ / dus gsum rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ / zab lam lta bas rgyas btab rdo rje'i zeg / dbang bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i grong mchog tu/ / rim gnyis 'byor ba'i dpal la spyod par shog / mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde bas rab myos shing / / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar mdzes sdug lang tshos sgeg / dmigs med snying rje'i 'dzum dkar spro ba yi/ / zung 'jug dang po'i mgon por bdag grub mdzad/ / mdor na skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i dngos/ / 'dren pa khyod min skyabs gzhan mi tshol bas /'di phyi'i bar do'i 'jigs las sgrol ba dang / / rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul kun/ /rim gyis bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ / de nyid dgyes bzhin rang 351

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonace' gsung 'bum/gi tshang bug nas/ / zhugs te gnyug ma'i sems dang dbyer med gyur/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi snying khar padma'i gdan bzhugs la/ / bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / gangs can mkhas grub du mas rjes bzung zhing / / zab rgyas gdams pa bye ba'i bang mdzod 'dzin/ / skal ldan smin cing grol mdzad chos kyi rje/ / 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhesaci 'grub bzlas la/ mjug tu dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ zhes sogasadang / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma zhesasogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zheyokun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi 'khrungs rab4dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ dad brtson dang ldan pa dkon mchog yar 'phel)sa 'di ltabu zhig dgolozheyobaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabrisapa'o/ oṃ suste/ thub bstan 'dzin mar skal bzang zhing ba'i tshogs/ phan bde'i lo tog longs su spyod pa'i phyir/ bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i tshogs grwa las/ chos sbyin bdud rtsi'i gru char 'di phab bo/ / sarba marga lam̐/ /352

༄/ /yid la brnagapa'igatam dukhyabasatshana.o'i 'khrul 'khor selaba'ichog༄7/ / yid la brnag pa'i gtam du bya ba mtshan mo'i 'khrul 'khor sel ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/na mo gu ru mu ni yisduya/ yid la brnag pa'i gtam du bya ba mtshan mo'i 'khrul 'khor sel ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po dang ldan pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jig rten gsum gye mig gcig nyi ma'i gnyen/ / mi mngon chos dbyings nub ri'i phag tu 'chel/ / de tshe lung rtogs 'od dmar ches gsal yang / / mkhas rnams bstan pa nyams zhes mya ngan byed/ / 'on kyang blo bzang smra ba'i zla ba des/ / rmongs pa'i mun sel bdud rtsi'i mchod sbyin spros/ / da ni zla ba'i 'od kyang srod du 'grib/ / nges don mun pa'i smag gi gung la slebs/ / lhag bsam dkar pa'i mdangs ldan rgyu skar tshogs/ / dbang med snyigs ma'i chu 'dzin stug pos bsgribs/ /sprin gye gseb nas mthu chen re re tsam/ / rang nyid ston par nus pa'ang mtshar du rtsi/ / thar pa'i srog la rgol ba 'byung po'i gtso/ / mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams kyis stong gsum bskor/ / rnam dag bslab gsum 'phags pa'i nor 'phrog pa'i/ / rkun po'i tshogs kyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nyul/ /chos brgyad lang tshor g.yem la rjes chags pa'i/ / skyes bu rnams ni bag med dga' mgur spyod/ / nag po'i phyogs la mngon dga' srin bya'i tshogs/ /353

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i ma'i ga 4ma/ltas ngan gad mo dga' ba'i dbyangs su sgrogs/ / phrag dog khong khro'i gdon gyis brgyal ba yi/ / wa skyes skad kyis ngan pa'i rnam rtog slong / / sdang zhing gdug pa'i skye bo mi bsrun pa'i/ / dmod pa'i tshig mda' stag mo'i ngar skad sgrogs/ /don med chu rlung 'thab pa'i sgra skad kyang / / 'ur 'ur ldang bas 'jigs skrag skyo ba skyed/ / srid la brkam pa'i rkyen ngan nags khrod du/ /nom zhing nyul bas tshul khrims gos dang bral/ / gnod sems tsher ma'i dong du lhung ba yis/ / skad cig tsam yang bde ba'i go skabs med/ / snying la gnas bcas snyigs ma'i lta ba bzhin/ / phyi rol rgud pa'i mun pa phyi phyir 'thibs/ /nad dang gnod pa'i rlan gyi grang ngad kyang / / skad cig re re bzhinadu stobs rgyas shing / / rnam rtog gdon gye mdangs su shar ba yi/ /bya dang bye'us than skad sna tshogs sgrogs/ / lha 'dre'i gcan gzan du mar 'khrulabyed pa'i/ / mo lung rdzun ma'i tsheg sgra thig sgra mang / / skad cig bde ba'i glog phran 'gyu ba yang / / mod la yal bas shin tu mun par byed/ /sdod par mi nus shu ba mi yi gzugs/ / phrag dog khong khro'i char rlung drag pos gtse/ / 'gro ba'i mthu med ser sna'i sgrog gis bcings/ / sred pa'i 'dam du 'dred cing brdeg 'cha' la/ / gang du lhung na thar pa'i gnas med pa/ / ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa 'jigs su rung / / 'bros pa'i 'dod kyang zhi ba'i lam mi mthong / / 'o dod bos kyang skyob pa'i mgon ma mchis/ / gtol med ri klung kun tu 'khyams na yang / / las kyis mi gtong khong ba'i nad bu bzhin/ / gang gang dbang po'i sgo nas zhugs pa'i sbrul/ /kun yid gdung ba'i dug gis khyab par byed/ / nyes pa'i mun can ma la phrag dog gis/ / dge dang legs pa'i cha kun bros pa bzhin/ / 'phral yun gnod pa'i dpung gi tshogs bsgril te/ / nyam chung yid kyi dga' ba 'phrog 354

༄/ /yida'i brnag pa'igatam dus bamatshan mo'i 'khrul 'khor sel ba'icho gabyed cing / / mthun 'jug brag gi gseb tu zhugs pa yis/ / sgo gsum dge ba'i yan lag thams cad smas/ / 'dod pa'i 'khri shing rtsa bar rten bcas pas/ / rga dang na bcas 'chi 'pho thigs pas gdungs/ / dge dang mi dge'ilas kyi stangs stabs gar/ / bsgyur ba rang gi lus kyang mthong min na/ /rigs mthun long pas long pa 'khrid byed pa/ / bde 'gro'i sgra yang rna bar mi snyan nam/ / rang dgar spyod pa'i bdud kyi pho nya ba/ / me khyer rnamasani snang ba'i mdzod du rlom/ / sdug bsngal grang reg rgyas pa'i 'gro ba dang / / lhan cig rgyal rnams snying rje'i spu long 'dzin/ / snyigs ma bdo ba'i smag chen 'dres pa yis/ / srid pa'i 'khor lo bla 'og bsgyur ba bzhin/ / kye ma mi bzad rgud pa'i mtshan mo 'di/ / thun tshod brgya dang ldan bzhin zad pa med/ / ma 'ongs dus na byams mgon nyin byed kyis/ / theg gsum padmo'i dga' tshal byed do zhes/ / tshad mar gyur pa'i lung las gsungs mod kyang / /bdag cag lta bu'i don du nam zhig 'gyur/ / rigs ldan rigs las drag po 'khor lo ches/ / kla klo'i lta ba mtshan mo'i phra men ma/ / dum bur bcad pa'i dmar 'od chags pa yi/ / skya rengs snang ba de yang shin tu ring / /rmongs pa mun pa'i srin mo chags ldang gnam sa lta bur gdangasapa'i kha/ / skye rga na 'chi mche ba'i brag ri sdug bsngal khrag gi klung 'bab par/ /ji srid las kyi ro nus ma zad de srid myong zhing ldang byed de/ / rang sems mi dge'i rtsa ba las thon 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor su yis shes/ / ka ye spyang grung 'dzom pa'i snying stobs can/ / blang dor shes shing spyod pa 'ga' mchis na/ / don med g.yeng ba'i spros pa kun bsnyal te/ /'di las 'byung tshul kho na bsam par rigs/ / dang po gnod pa'i phul ster dgra de gang / / de yis badzi ba med pa'i gnas de gang / / der ni gegs med bgrod pa'i lam 355

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i me'i g.yo 4ma/de gang / /de nyid gsal bar byed pa'i thabs de gang / /de de tshul bzhin rab bsam na/ /skyob pa gzhan du mi tshol te/ / rang dang nye bar gnas pa yi/ / thabs mkhas 'phrul zhig mchis so snyam/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i man ngag rno ba'i lcags/ / rang sems rdo yi khams dang brdar ba yis/ /sngon goms sa bon smin pa'i me stag gis/ / dang po thos pa'i sgron me spar bar mdzod/ /rab gsal thos pa'i sgron ma yal gyur na/ /kun rmongs mun pa lhag par 'thib 'gyur bas/ /yang yang sems pa'i shel gyi khang bu ru/ /bcug ste mi nyams snang ba'i dga' ston mdzod/ / sna tshogs theg pa'i lam srang brgya mthong yang / /ma nor lam bzang mthar thug rnyed dka' bas/ /lam mkhan mtshungs bral bshes gnyen dam pa zhig / btsal nas mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten par byos/ /longs su spyad pas mi zad lam gyi rgyags/ /nyes spyod rdul dang ma 'dres sbyin pa'i phye/ /dman mchog gtong pa'i yul gyi sgye'u chung / / yongs su bkang ba'i nyer bsdogs 'grub par gyes/ / sgo gsumanyes spyod tsha grang reg pa kun/ / srung byed tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gos/ / bag yod dran dang shes bzhin sgrog zung can/ / yar ba dam pa'i lugs bzhin legs par bgos/ /khyad par snyigs ma'i skye bo mi bsrun pa'i/ /dug gi tsher ma dog pa'i lam 'phrang du/ /'dus pa'i gnod pa cig car sel ba'i thabs/ / sra mkhregs bzod pa'i mchil lham bgo bar rigs/ /legs byas 'dun pa lhod par mi 'gyur zhing / / yon tan gos bzang nam yang mi gtong bar/ / dran 'dzin snying stobs shugs kyis bsdams pa yi/ / rlabs chen brtson pa'i ska rags 'ching bar mdzod/ /gar btsugs dmigs pa'i rten las mi g.yo zhing / / drang la ldem pa'i ngang tshul ting nge 'dzin/ /srid lam dub la ngal gso'i bde ster ba/ /nyer zhi'i 356

༄/ /yid lab gapa'igatamadubya bamatshanalo'i 'khrul 'khor selaba'ichogabasamagatan mkhar ba lag tu chongs/ / srid zhi'i grong dang dgon pa'i so mtshams na/ / zhi ba'i mgron la rgod pa'i gdug pa can/ / bdag tu 'dzin pa'i chom rkun mang mchis pas/ / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon rnon bsrel/ / de ltar thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ / 'jug pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa na/ / phyi bshol dbang du ma btang bar/ / myur ba myur bar lam du chos/ /'di snang thal bas g.yogs pa'i me 'obs dang / / rang don yid byed phub ma'i chu dong sogs/ /lam gyi gol sa mtha' dag ring spangs te/ /byang chub gzhung lam drang por 'jug 'tshal lo/ / pha rol byun dka'i lam ring bgrod pa na/ / skyo ngal skom pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i phyir/ / dad mos byams dang snying rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ / gang ba'i bum bzang mchan khung g.yon ducugs/ / zab cing rgya che byang chub spyod pa'i thang / / grangs med bskal par pha mtha' mi mngon pas/ / blo chung byis pa'i byin pa 'dar byed kyang / /skal bzang ri skyes bag yangs rtsed 'jos rol/ / de na rin chen sems mchog cang shes rta/ / rnam dag smon lam nor bu'i sga srab can/ /bsdu bzhi'i gom 'gros lam lam bgrod pa zhig / mchis te zin na bde nas bde bar 'gro / dran pa nyer bzhag sngon pa'i phreng ldan yang dag srung ba'i 'obs kyis bskor/ / rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i rta bab dang ldan dbang stobs rtsig pa mngon par mtho/ / rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen bzhi ldan byang chub yan lag dpal 'byor rgyas/ / 'phags pa'i lam yangs yan lag brgyad ldan theg mchog chos kyi pho brang che/ / 'grib med thabs shes nor bu'i rang 'od gsal/ / sdom bzhi'i chos kyi dril chen gdangs snyan 'khrol/ / bde stong ting 'dzin bye ba'i dri bsung 'thul/ / mngon shes nor bu'i do shal dra bas 'brel/ / brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs yon tan gyi/ / 'byor pas dgyes 357

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/dgur rtsen pa'i rgyal sras rnams/ / rgyal ba'i bka' sgrub spyor ba rnam bzhi yis/ / theg gsum skye dgu'i re ba tshim par mdzad/ / sa bcu'i khor yug gser ri'i phreng ba ltar/ / rim gyis mtho bas yongs bskor lte ba na/ /'phags bzhi'i spangs rtogs rin chen khams bzhi las/ / grub pa'i pho brang lhun po'i mched zla yod/ / 'gro lding sngags kyi sbyor bas sa bcu'i khyon/ /yun ring bskor ba'i ngal ba med par yang / / pho brang mchog der bde blag 'jugacus pas/ /rnam dpyod ldan rnams snying gi dpal be'ur chongs/ /de na mi 'jigs bzhi ldan nor bu'i khrir/ / gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gye longasastod la/ /dbang 'byor stobs bcu'i lang tsho rgyas pa yis/ / bcom ldan rgyal dbang 'khor los sgyur ba bzhugs/ / de yang dang po'i dus nas rang nyid la/ /lam ston de nyid yin par ngo shes na/ /des kyang ye shes lnga yi thod bcings te/ /rgya chen chos kyi rgyal srid gtod par 'gyur/ /de nas 'phrin las shing rta nyer bdun gyis/ /srid pa'i btson rar lus pa'i gnyen bshes kun/ /rang gnas 'chi med rgyal khab der blangs nas/ /zag med dga' bde'i dpal gyis tshim par gyis/ /de ltar 'khor ba mtshan mo'i smag rum nas/ / rnam grol thar pa'i gling du bgrod pa'i tshul/ /dpe yi rim pa gcig gis bstan pa yi/ /legs byas rten 'brel dus su smin pa las/ /thos bsam 'char ga'i 'od dmar gdangs pa'i kha/ / nyams myong nyin byed g.yo ba'i ro 'dzin gyis/ /kun rmongs mun pa'i dri ma bldag pa yis/ /sgrib bral chos sku'i mkha' dbyings khyab gyur cig / cesayid la brnag pa'i gtam du byab mtshan mo'i 'khrul 'khor sel pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesachoyogrwa chen po dgon lung byamasapa gling du sbyar ba'i yege pa ni rnam dpyod yangasapa dkon mchog bstan pa'o/ /358

༄/ /phama'i drinagazotshuladangagashinaporam ṇibaskulaba'i guradabyangs/༄༅/ / pha ma'i drin gzo tshul dang gshin por ma ṇi bskul ba'i mgur dbyangs bzhugs so/pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags lam bzang gis/ / pha ma rigs drug sems can ma lus pa/ / pha mtha' mi mngon 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yi/ / pha rol 'dren mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la 'dud/ / ma lus spangs rtogs mthar son rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / ma rig mun sel sgron me dam pa'i chos/ /ma nor lam gyi grogs mchog dge 'dun bcas/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs mdzod cig / ya mtha' gtugs pa med pa'i dus shig nas/ /sridapa'i gnas 'dir zo chun bzhin du 'khor/ / pha ma ma byas sems can 'ga' yang med/ / de tshe rang srog las kyang gces par byas/ / phan pa tshad med drin lan ji ltar 'jal/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ /dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / zla ngo bcu yi bar du lus la bzung / / btsas nas nyin mtshan sha yi drod la sbyar/ / snyan par bos shing brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ / sor bcu'i rtse la g.yengs te nu zhos gsos/ / gnyid dang lto bcag yid bzhin nor ltar bsrungs/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog 359

༄/ /yo ca bayo ༅ sgronama'i g.yo las/mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /na na bdag las kho rang na ba 'dam/ / 'chi na bdag las kho rang 'chi ba 'dam/ / dpral pa'i mig dang khong ba'i snying bzhin du/ /gces pa tshad med bzod pa'i glags ma mchis/ /bu phrug rgyag pas gces ngo ga la shes/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ /'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / nyam chung srin 'bu 'dra ba mi ru byas/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i dal 'byor rten bzang byin/ / mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du bskyal/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i sgo ru bcug /'di phyi'i bde legs kun gyi rtsa ba btsugs/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ /dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /sdig dang sdug bsngal gzhan gyi gtam ngan sogs/ /khyad du bsad nas 'bad pas sha thang du/ /bsgrubs ba'i rgyu nor longs spyod yod do cog / lhag ma med par bdag la gtad pa na/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub bzhin dga' ba skyes/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bsru med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas bdag cag la bzhag kyang / /bsags pa'i sdig ltung pha ma rang gis khur/ / de lta rigs drug 360

༄/ /phasa'i drin 'a tshugadangagashinaporas ṇibaskulaba'i guradabyangs/bar do'i gnas gang na/ / skyid sdug ji 'dra myong ba su yis shes/ / zas nor skal bzang brjes su skyel lugs med/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / lhan cig 'tshogs nas rtse rgod longs spyod rgyas/ / gtan du 'grogs shing phan par re ba la/ / glo bur 'chi bdag gshin rjes kha bral nas/ / rgyus med par do'i 'phrang du gcig pur khrid/ / dkar po dge ba ma gtogs ra mda' med/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / lan du phan 'dogs nus pa dkon na yang / /srid par yang yang 'khyams pa'i bag chags kyis/ / bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan tshun chad kyang / / rang gi bu la byams pa ngang gis skye/ / tshul des lan grangs dpag med drin gyis bskyangs/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / skye shi thog mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ / sems can re res rang gi ma byas te/ / nu zho 'thung pa lhan cig bsags byas na/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu las lhagasho zhes/ / kun mkhyen thub pas gzigs nas bden par gsungs/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od 361

༄༅/ /yo thang bam pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / rnyed dka' dal 'byor mi lus thob na yang / /bdag cag don du mi tshe sdig la gzad/ / rgyu nor spyod pa'i bde ba ma myong zhing / /dam chos sgrub pa'i go skabs ma rnyed de/ / phan lan sgrub pa'i re mos bdag la babs/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ /'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ /dmigs yul thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs shing mchod pa phul/ /bla ma dge 'dun sde la bsnyen bkur zhus/ / cho ga bzlas brjod mdo sde klog pa dang / / phyag skor srog blu dbul por sbyin gtong sogs/ /dge ba gang byas de yi don du bsngo/ / de yi drin lan chos kyi 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /tshul khrims rnam dag mang thos zhing sa bzang / / sdeg dang ma 'dres sa bon dngos po gtsang / / ming dang grags 'dod min par phanasems kyis/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'khor gsum rnam dag dge ba'i 'bras/ /pha ma rigs drug 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ / 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ / dmigs yul thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / khams gsum 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang la yang / /snying po ma mchis rmi lam dga' ston bzhin/ / mchog gsum thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i mthus/ / ngan yo2

༄/ /phasa'i drinagazo tshul dang gshin poram ṇi bskul ba'imaguradabyangs/song 'khor ba'i skye sgo gcad du gsol/ / dmigs yul nyam thag 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ / de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog / skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mkhyen/ /'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs mgon mkhyen/ /dmigs yul thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /zhesapa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bsam 'grub kyis pha ma'i drin lan gzo tshul zhig dgosazer ba/ spyir rang gisachosarnam dag cig bsgrubs na lus bskyed pa'i pha ma la drin gzo'i mchog de yin kyang / de'i rnam pa dran ched dang / gshin por ma ṇi bskul ba sogasakyi tshe blo 'khul byed 'di lta zhig byung na phan par mthong nas 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstanapa'i sgron mes 'phral du smrasapa'i yoge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / / 363

༄/ /yo ca ༄na pa'i ma'i ga ༅ma/༄༅/ / byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom tshul theg pa mchog gi 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / zab rgyas gdams pa'i bka' babs byams 'jam dbyangs/ / kun gye zhal skyin bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ / btud nas theg pa mchog la 'jug pa spro/ / de'ang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dka' ba du mas byang chub mngon du mdzad de 'jig rten du byon pa ni rang cag rjes su gzung ba kho na'i phyir yin/ rang cag kyang srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting dang mtha' med par 'khyams pa las da res stabs legs kyis dal 'byor lan cig thob ste bstan pa dang mjal ba 'di don ldan du byed na ston pa'i rjes su slob dgos/ de la ston pa rang nyid gang nas gshegs pa'i lam thabs shes kye spyod pa zung du 'jug pa de nyid nas zhugs te sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod dgos/ nyan rang rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug tu bzhag pa ni/ 'khor ba las rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i thar par rigs mtshungs pa tsam yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes dngos la 'jug na de'i lam mam theg par bgrod dgos la/ dman pa'i byang chub thob zin pa'i rjes su gzod/sangs rgyas theg pa 'di ni btsal bar gyis/ / zhes de'i lam la 'jug par bskul dgos so/ / de dag gis dang po nas don du ma gnyer bas gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas med la/ rang don yang mthar ma phyin te/ mo'u mtha

༄/ /byang chubakyi sems gnyisasgomatshul thegapamachogagi 'jugarogs/'gal gyi bu chen po lta bu'ang las kyis non pas kun tu rgyu rnams kyis phyag zhabs 'dam bu ltar bcom ste 'das pa dang / legs 'ong mu ges grong ba lta buganas ngan len gyi lhag mas mnar ba'i lo rgyus mang ngo / de'i phyir rgyan las/ lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang zhing ched du bya ba log par gsungs pas/ skye bo blo gros dang ldan pa 'khor ba phra rags kyi pha rol tu brgal bar 'dod pa dag gis sku gnyis 'grub byed kyi sgrub pa'i ngo bo kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang /de kho na nyid don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi gshog yangs dkar po rgyas pa la brten nas rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i klong du phyin par byed dgos so/ des na 'di la gsum/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul/ don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/de'ang sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa tsam gyis theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed du mi 'gyur te/ rang don du de 'dod na rang sangs rgyas kyi sems bskyed du 'gyur bas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ / yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ / ces dgos pa'i gtso bo skom pa sel ba'i chu lta bu ni gzhanadon yin la/ de 'thung ba'i thabs su phor ba 'tshol ba bzhin sangs rgyasasgrub pa de'i yan lag tu dgos pa yin no/ / gzhan don yang phyogs re ba tsam gyis mi chog pas/ dmyal ba btso bsreg gis sdug bsngal ba nas bzung / sa bcu bar shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo las ma grol ba'i bar thams cad kyi don la tshang bar dmigs pa yum las gsungs pa lta bu dang / nang gses kyisadagra gnyen bar ma lta bu'i khyad ma dod pas nye ring snyoms pa zhig gal che'o/ /da lta sems la nye ring gi khyad 'byung pa ni da lta'i dgra gnyen 'di la gtan du bar bzung pa'i stobs yin zhing / de ni 'khor ba gting mtha' med par 'khyams tshul ma bsam pas lan pa yin te/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs 365

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'i sgroname'i ga4 stem/brjod ltar da lta gnyen du snang ba 'di dag gis dgra byas te mgo bcad pa'ang stong gsum du mi shong / da lta dgrar snang ba 'di dag gis ma byas te nu zho 'thungs pa'ang rgya mtsho'i chu las lhag / da dung yang 'di snang yud kyis 'gagasanas dgra gnyen go log pa ji ltar 'gro mi shes/ des na gang la ni chags par bya/ gang la ni sdang bar bya/ de 'dra byed don med par ma zad/chagasasnang 'dis sdeg pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba byas/ sems bskyedabasgom pa'i thog ma sems snyoms pa tsam skye ba'i go skabs mi ster bas/thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i sgo 'gag byed du shes par byas la dmigs yul sru ris phye ste sgom rim mkhas pas mthar sems can thams cad kyibar du bsgom/ de goms pa na rigs pa'i ya mtha' thug pa med pas skye ba'i ya mtha' thug pa med pa dang / de'i rtags kyis sems can thams cad la mar ma gyur pa med cing / gyur pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod tshul rigs pa'i 'phrul gyis bsgoms te/ mtshan mo rgyang ring por khyi ngu ba lta bu'i tshe'ang ma rgan gyis bos byung snyam pa lta bu tshun chad byed/ ma nam byas pa na mngal dang btsas pa'i gnas skabs kun tu nor bu rin po che rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' tshor gyis rang srog las kyang gces par bskyangs te 'khos ka gang yod kyis phan pa thams cad la sbyar/ gnod pa thams cad las bskyabs/ khyad par tshe 'di'i ma lta bur mtshon na byis pa rlon pa na bun gyi 'bu lta bu zhig dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi gral du btsud pa'i drin bsam gyis mi khyab/ 'on kyang de dag ni dngos su drin gyis bskyang tshul tsam yin/ brgyud nas zhib tu bsams na legs tshogs thams cad ma rgan sems can gyi bka' drin kho na yin te/ dal 'byor gyi rten thob pa 'di'ang rgyu tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu yin zhing / de ni/sdom pa sems can thams cad las/ / zhes pa ltar/ zhing sa sems can 366

༄/ /byangatpalakyi semasaganyisasgomarol thegapamachogagi 'jugangogs/gzhirabyas te de la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba las skye ba yin/ zas kham gcig yan cad kyi longs spyod thams cad sbyin 'bras yin pas sbyin yul gyis sems can la brten nas 'byung dgos/ lus dang spyod pa gzhan gyi yid du 'ongabs rang la dga' ba sogs bzod pa'i stobs yin la/ de bzod pa'i yul la ltos pa sogs sems can la ma brten par byung ba gcig kyang med/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'ang / de'i gzhung lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa sems can la ltos te/sangs rgyas kye chos 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gro ba rgyal ba rnams dang sems can khyad med par gsungs so/ drin che bar shes kyang drin gzo mi byed pa shin tu smad pa'i gnas khrel med kyi spyod pa yin/ rang cag dang thub pa'i dbang po gnyis ma rgan 'di dag gis sngon tshad med pa'i drin gyis bskyangs par 'dra ba la/thub pas dka' ba brgya phrag gis drin gzo ji tsam zhig mdzad 'dug / rang ni de thams cad yal bar dor nas bsdad pa'i la yog gis da lta thub pa sangs rgyas la/ rang cag sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lus pa 'di byung bar snang /da ni ya rabs kyi spyod pas khrel ngo tsha bsrung ste drin gzo zhig byed dgos/de'ang zag bcas kyi bde ba phran tshegs re la sbyar yang skom ba la tshwa chu blud pa bzhin phan chung la gnod pa'i rgyur 'gro nyen che/ ma rgan 'dis rang gnod pa kun dang bral ba/ bde ba kun dang ldan pa zhig byed 'dod nas shes tshod dang nus tshod kyis 'bad pa yin mod kyang / phugs kyi phan gnod mo rang gis ma shes par snang / bdag gis kun byang gi skyon yon mthong ba yin pas gnas skabs kyi bslu brid byis pa'i mgo skor lta bu ma yin par gtan du phan thogs nges pa'i drin gzo zhig byed dgos snyam du bsam ste/ gzhan don don du gnyer ba'i gol sa 'gog byed btang snyoms dang / skul ma 'deb byed yid 367

༄/ /༅ ca bayo yosoryā ga 4ma/'ong gi rnam par sgrub pa gnyis kyis gzhi brtan par bya/ de nas don du gnyerabya'i ngo bo gzhan don ni bde ba la 'god pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba gnyis las ma 'das te/ rang nyams la dpag na rmi lam tshun chad du bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i ngang tshul 'di sems can thams cad la'ang mtshungs so/ / 'on kyang 'di dag bde ba mtshan nyi da pas shin tu phongs te/ zag med kyi bde ba cung zad kyang med/ da lta khong rang rnams la yod pa'i bde bar rlom pa 'di dag ni yun bsrings te 'phel na sdug bsngal gye rang mtshang ston pa'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal lam/ sdug bsngal gyi tshang 'cha' ba'ikhyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho nar snang / des na 'di dag thams cad zag med kyi bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung / ldan par gyur cig /rang gi bde dge thams cad 'di dag la btang nas kyang 'di dag bde ba dang ldan par bya'o snyam du bsams/ rang gi dge ba rang la dgos mod snyam na/ sngon yang rang gces par bzung legs pa thams cad rang la dgos snyam pa byas pas rgud pa thams cad byung / ston pas rang yal bar dor te gzhan gces par bzung bas don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa byung / 'dam ga ma nor ba khong gi de yin par snang bas/ blo ngan bdag 'dzin 'gong po 'di'i dbang du mi gtong bar lus srog yal bar dor nas sems can la phan bde bsgrub par bya'o zhes byams pa bsgom/ de lta na'ang nad drag pos gzer bzhin pa dang /yanalag mes bsreg bzhin pas zas kyi zhim mngar mi myong ba bzhin/ yun ring la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag du mas non pa 'di dang ma bral bar bde ba'i go skabs skad cig kyang ga la yod/ sgo gsum nyon mongs kyi dbang du shor bas ci byas thams cad ngan song du ltung ba'i rgyu las ma 'das/ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa gting zab/ der lhung na sdug bsngal drag po skad 368

༄/ /byangarol kyi sems gnyisasgomatshul thegapamachogagi 'jugangogs/cig ma gcig la'ang bzod glags med rung mi bzod bzhin du tha na brgyal ba dang 'chi pa'i dbang yang med par bskal pa chen po sa'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i par du las ma zad na ngan skad tsir re nyam thag bzhin du sdod dgos/ ma rgan drin mo che dmyal ba'i me nang du bskyur nas/ bdag sos bder sdod thabs ji ltar yod/ ma rgan gyi lus sems la sdug bsngal gang yod rangagi thog tu spos te/ ma rgan sdug bsngal med par lhod cham gyis 'gro ba zhig byung na ci ma rung / sdug balngal phra rags thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal gyi khur bdag gi phrag par blangs nas ma rgan sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o/ / de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad kyi sdig sdug mtha' dag lhag med du phral nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bkug la rang gi dbugs tshur rngub pas drangs te gces 'dzin gyi thog tu phab/ dbugs phyir gtong ba na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis sna drangs te rang gi bde dge thams cad rgyal ba'i byin rlabs zad mi shes pa dang ro mnyam du 'dres pasamakha' khyab kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag bde ba ma tshang ba med pa la bkod pa'i dmigs pa sogs gtong len spel mar bya/ de ltar byams snying rje yun du bsgom pas shugs rdzogs te sems can gyi don mtha' dag rang gcig pu'i steng du lhung ba lta bur song ba na/ stobs bcu mnga' ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob par ma byas pa'i thabs rang mi 'dug snyam du sangs rgyas thob 'dod ni gzhan don don gnyer de'i shugs kyis drangs nas 'ong ba zhig dgos kyi/ byang chub don gnyer de las logs su dmigs kyis bkar nas sgom dgos pa byung na sems skyed sgom tshul ma mkhas pa yin no/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan shes par byas nas bsgom dgos mod 369

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ryā ga4 lngom/kyang / gzhan don bde blag tu sgrub pa la kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer de lta bu zhig dgos par mthong nas de'i yan lag tu btsal ba yin gyi/ ngo mtshar che ba gtso bor bzung ste rang la de 'dra zhig byung na snyam du bsam pa min no/ /sems bskyed pa tsam la'ang sdig pa spyong ba dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i nus pa mtha' yas pa rdo rje rin po che'i dpe ltar nyan rang gi dge tshogs zil gyis gnon nus pa ni/ dmigs yul byang chub dang sems can gnyi ga zad mi shes pa'idabang yin la/ de'i sdom pa bzung ste 'jug sems bskyed na dus dang spyod pa'ang mi zad pa la dmigs pas dpag tu med pa bzhi tshang ste phan yon lhag par che'o/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis smon sems 'phel ba'i thabs la 'jug sems las lhag pa med par gsungs te/ 'phen pa'i dbang gis dus nam gyi tshe'ang bsod nams rgyun chad med par 'phel la/ de nas bzung mgron po lam du chas pa dang 'dra bas grangs med gsum gyi mgo brtsams pa yin no/gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul ni/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i sa bon lta bu sems bskyed yin mod kyang / blo sngon du gtong ba rnams ni de la sangs rgyas thob dgos pa dang / thob nus pa gnyis nges dgos so/ dang po ni/ rang ma grol par gzhan dgrol mi nus shing /rang nyid grol ba la 'ching byed rtsa ba mthar thug de chod dgos/ grub mtha' thams cad kyang rtsa ba 'di ngos 'dzin pa la thag nye ring gis mchog dman byung ste/ sher phyin gyi dgongs pa ji lta ba klu sgrub yab sras kyis zhi sgo gnyis pa med par bkral ba 'di yin pas/ rgud pa kun gyi rtsa ba bden par 'dzin pa yin/dedrungs 'byin pa la dngos kyi 'gal zla bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba 'di kho na dgos/ nyes pa'i tshogs kyis mi badzi zhing phar zil gyis gnonapa la dge ba gzhan las 'di'i char gtogs tsam yang stobs che ba ni 370

༄/ /byangathobakyi semasaganyisasgom tshul thegasamachog gi 'jugarags/gser sogs kyi 'od dang me 'od ltar grogs stobs dang rang stobs kyi khyad par yin/ theg pa gsum ga'i thun mong yin kyang bag chags kyi dri ma phra mo lta ba'i dpyad pa mtha' yas pas gos kyi dri ma phra mo sbyong ba lta bu yin pas/ theg chen las de lhag par tshang zhing rgyas par bstan la bstan pa bzhin bsgom dgos/ gnyis pa 'thob nus pa ni lam shes kyi yan lag gsungs pas kyang shes te/ rkyen sems bskyed kyi chus bran pa med mi rung du dgos la/ de byas na rgyu rigs kyis khyab yod pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas nges par 'thob pa rnam 'grel las rtag pa ma yin pa sogs kyi gtan tshigs kyis theg pa gcig tu bsgrubs pa'ang mthar gtugs na sems bden par med pa la thug ste/ rang bzhin la slad pa ma zhugs pas bcos su rung ba 'di la dgongs nas/ rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa zhes gsungs so/ de ltar gsungs pa'i chos kyi nang na kun nyon phyogs kyang yod rung de rnam dag gi chos su 'gyur mi dgos te/ gser gyi g.ya' bzhin sbyangs pa na med 'gro ba glo bur ba'i dri ma yin pa de nyid de rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i don yin no/ / de ltar dgos nus gnyi ga mthong ba na kun rdzob sems bskyed la spro ba 'phel zhing / don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa la 'bad pas 'jug par 'gyur ro/ / don dam sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa khyad par gsum dang ldan pa ni sa rab tu dga' ba nas 'ongs kyang / de'i rigs 'dra las dang bo pa'i skabs nas btsal te skyong dgos so/ / skyong tshul la 'gal zla dmigs pa dang 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i sgrub tshul mang yang / gong ma rnams gcig tu bral gyi sgrub tshul 'di 'char sla bas gtso bor mdzad pa bzhin byed na/ sgrub byed la gnad bzhi ste/ dgag bya nges pa'i gnad/ khyab pa nges pa'i gnad/gcig bral nges pa'i gnad/ du bral nges pa'i gnad do/ / mda' bdeg pa 371

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/la 'ben mthong dgos pa bzhin/ thog mar dgag bya ngos zin pa shin tu gal che ste/ dgag bya rags pa'am phyogs re tsam las ma zin na/ de 'bad pas khegs kyang dgag bya'i lhag ma lus pas bden 'dzin drungs 'byin mi nus/dgag bya thal ches te tha snyad pa'i don rnams kyang dgag byar bzung na de bkag pa chad ltar 'gro bas nyen shin tu che'o/ / phung po las don gzhan dang / phung po'i dbyibs tshogs pa sogs ngar 'dzin pa grub mtha'i sgro btags kho na las lhan skyes su mi 'byung la/ lus kyi khong na gnas pa sogs kyang nyams kyi 'char sgo tsam yin no/ / res 'ga' rkyen dbang gis lus sems re re ba bdag tu snang ba lta bu 'byung yang / rgyun chags su yod pa'i lhan skyes kyi nga'i snang tshul mtshan nyid pa ni lus sems tshogs tsam gye steng 'di na ming gis phar btags tsam ma yin pa'i nga zhig tshugs thub tu yod par snang ba yin te/ dper na rang la gzhan gyis bstod pa dang / gzhi med pa'i skyon bkal ba lta bu'i tshe mtho dman du byed rgyu'i nga zhig ling nge yod yod lta bur 'char ba ngos zin sla'o/ /de'i snang tshul de shugs ma yal ba'i ngang nas blo'i zur gcig gis des nga ji ltar bzung 'dug pa blta dgos/ sems can rnams ni rnam par shes pa rgyud re re bar gsungs kyang 'dzin stangs mi mthun pa'i blo stobs mtshungs la dgongs kyi/ lam du 'gro ba lta bu'i tshe'ang lam dang 'groba'i bya ba/ gzhan la bya ra byed pa gtam smra ba sogs kyi rnam rig du ma lhan cig 'byung bar mi 'gal bar myong bas grub bo/ / mang po zhig 'di la sems ngo mthong ba zhes zer ba yin du chug kyang / sems dang chos nyid gnyis don gcig tu byas te bden pa mthong ba dang chos sku'i rang zhal mthong ba zhes zer zhing de tsam gyis chog shes byas te/ gnad phyi ma'i dpyad pa rnams ched du dor nas tsom 'jog byas pas 'du shes rags pa'i rnam rtog 372
