༄ / /byangacubakyisemasaganyisasgom tshul thegapabachogagi 'jugangogs/cung zad khegs te mi rtogs par song ba la sgom gyi yang rtse byed kyang de tsam gyis gar yang mi phyin no/ / de ltar dgag bya ngos bzung ste de nyid gcig tu bral gyi rigs pas 'gog pa la/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub na bden par grub lugs med pa'i khyab mtha' zin pa dgos kyi/ de gang rungam yin pa'i grub lugs shig yod na de gnyis tsam bkab/ pas mtha' mi chod pas don med pa'i phyir ro/ / des na khyab pa nges pa'i gnad 'di bsam dgos la/ de'ang spyir chos de yod na gcig dang du ma gang rung du yod dgos te/ so so ba yin na tha dad dang min na gcig tu 'gyur bas yin min gnyis kha tshon chod pa'i phyir/ spyi la de ltar khyab pa grub na bye brag bden par yodana'ang bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du yod dgos pa'i khyab pa 'grub bo/ / de ltar khyab pa nges pa na bdag phung po'i steng du bden par yod yod 'dra ba 'di phung po dang bden pa'i gcig tu yod dam/ de dang bden pa'i tha dad du yod ces dpyad dgos so/ / de la dang po gcig bral du sgrub pa ni/ bdag phung gnyis bden pa'i gcig yin na bdag gcig yin pas phung po lnga'ang gcig tu 'gyur ba'am/ yang na phung po lnga so sor yod pas bdag kyang lngar 'gyur ba dang / phung po 'dor ba na bdag kyang chad de skye ba phyi ma med pa'am/ yang na phung po'ang phyi mar 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang /phung po blang bya yin pas bdag kyang blang byar 'gyur ba'am/ bdag len pa po yin pas phung po'ang len pa por 'gyur ba dang / de ltar na lus len pa po dang rnam smin myong ba po zhig las 'bras kyi rten gzhir dgos par bsam nas bdag khas blangs pa don med par 'gyur pa dang / bdag gi bdag gam phung po'i phung po zhes pa dang khyad med pa'i bdag gi phung po zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang 'brel med du 'gyur ro/ / bdag phung bden par ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa tha 373

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i me'i g.yo 4ma/dad pas skyon de dag med do snyam na/ rdzun pa'i rnam gzhag la ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag byas chog kyang / bden grub kyi gcig ni dpyad bzod kyi gcig yin pas bum pa dang bum pa gnyis sgo gang nas tshul ji ltar dpyad kyang gcig ma gtogs so sor 'byed rgyu med pa bzhin/ bden grub la ngo bo gcig na ldog pa'ang gcig / rdzas dang nus pa ming don thams cad gcig dgos te/ ngo bo gcig tu snang la ldog pa tha dad du gnas pa ni snang tshul dang gnas tshul ma mthun pa yin zhing / de rdzun pa'i rdzun tshul yin pa'i phyir ro/ / rigs pa'i 'phul 'di dbu ma'i rigs pas sgrub tshul gyi skabasakun tu shes dgos/ gnyis pa bden pa'i du bral sgrub pa ni/ de la gcig ni med pas kyang / /zhes sogs gcig med pa'i rtags kyis du ma med par sgrub pa ya gyal bkag pas tshogs pa khegs lugs ni dgag bya thabs cad la 'dra bas/ des 'di'i gting mi dpog cing skabs 'dir sgrub lugs dang mi mtshungs te/ 'dir du bral sgrub pa ni gang zag phung po dang bden pa'i tha dad du grub pa bkag pa yin la/ gang zag chos can/ phung po dang bden pa'i tha dad du med de/ bden pa'i gcig tu med pa'i phyir byas na khyab pa 'gal bar 'gro'o/ /des na bden pa'i tha dad med tshul ni/ bden pa'i tha dad yin na dpyad bzod kyi tha dad yin dgos la/ de lta na ngo bo dang rdzas dang byed las sogs sgo thams cad nas tha dad pa'i 'brel med don gzhan du 'gyur te/ sgo gcig nas tha dad kyang gcig nas tha mi dad pa ni sna tshogs su smra ba'i mi bzhin rdzun pa'i rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar 'brel med kyi tha dad yin na phung po na rgas dor ba sogs kyis bdag na ba sogs su mi 'gyur bas bdag la phung po'i mtshan nyid skye 'chi sogs med par thal ba dang /de 'dod na gzhan gyi phung po dang 'dra bas phan gnod kyis bde sdug tu mi 374

/ /byangatpalakyi semasaganyisasgom tshul thegapasachogagi 'jugangogs/'gyur par thal ba dang / rta glang lug gsum tshogs nas rta glang gnyis song yang lug shul du yod pa bzhin phung po lnga so sor bsal ba'i shul na bdag ston rgyu yod dgos/ gzhan dang gzhan min gyi ldan tshul sogs kyang gcig tha dad kyi rigs pa 'dis khegs so/ tshogs pa'i steng nas dpyad tshul 'di rgyun la sbyar na'ang tshe snga phyi rgan gzhon sogs bden pa'i gcig tu grub na gcig gi tshe kun yod pa grangs can bzhin rtswa rtser glang chen brgya gnas pa'i skyon sogs su 'gyur/ tha dad na byams pa dang nye sbas bzhin 'brel med pas las chud zaba'am/ ma byas pa dang phrad pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du lus yan lag lnga ga dang gcig gam tha dad/ shes pa skad cig snga phyi/ ldan min lo lta bu zla ba bcu gnyis/ nam mkha' shar nub kyi cha lta bu la sbyar te cha can gang yin de cha mang por thal ba'am/ cha shas re re bzhin cha can tshang ba rer thal ba dang / yang na cha dang cha can 'brel med par thal ba sogs snga ma dang 'dra ste/ stong nyid ni zab ches pa las chos thams cad kyi steng du dgag byas stong tshul mi 'dra ba ci yang med par ro gcig pas/ lta ba'i dpyad lugs kyang dmigs yul kha spo ba tsam las gzhan mi 'dra ba med do/ / de ltar bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang du'ang ma grub par rtogs pa de bdag med rtogs pa yin par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de gtan tshigs rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir ro/ / kha cig de gang du'ang ma grub par rtogs pa ni de rgyu mtshan du bkod de gzodadagag bya'i snang tshul gsal btab nas 'di ma grub bo snyam du rtogs zer ba mi 'thad de/ de byas na kun rdzob kyi snang ba dang 'dres te dgag bya bcad tsam du mi 'char ba'i phyir/ dper na 'gro sa lung pa gnyis las med sa zhig tu ba lang bor ba btsal te/ lung pa snga mar med rjes mar yang med pa mthong tsam nas btsal rgyu'i ba yid la bzhag yod pa de mi 'dug go snyam pa 375

༄/ /yo ca bam lo 0sa'i gas 4ma/lhang gis skye ba bzhin/ dgag bya'i snang tshul sngar nas zhe la bzhag bzhin par gcig tu bral gyes dpyad pa yin pas du bral rtogs ma thag zhe la bzhag pa'i dgag bya de gzhir byas/ de mi 'dug snyam stong cham gyis 'gro ba byung na lta ba rnyed pa yin no/ /de'i tshe dbang non goms pa che ba la gces nor rnyed pa lta bu dang / rtul po la gces nor stor ba lta bu'i 'jigs skrag 'byung yang skyon minasho/ / mnyam gzhag de las langs pa na rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba 'char te/ da lta yul gang snang yang kho rang gi ngos nas tshur grub pa'i nyams nges can du 'char ba bzhin de'i tshe phyi'i yul snang tsam nas ming dang rtog pas phar btags pa'i tha snyad tsam du 'char ro/ /lhag mar lus rgyu ming tsam las med kyang de la bya byed sogs bsnyon med du 'grub pa'i rten 'byung gi snang ba ches ngo mtshar bar mthong nas blang dor la lhag par brtson pa byung na stong pa rten 'byung gi don du mthong bas ches rmad du byung ba yin no/ / rten 'byung gi rnam bzhag 'bras bu rgyu la ltos pa tsam zhig ni dngos smra rnams kyang shes pas/ 'dir snam bu'i snal ma zhes pa lta bu rgyu'ang 'bras bu la ltos pa brten nas btags pa'i tha snyad phra mo rtogs dgos so/ /dang por lta thog tu 'jog yun ring na ma yin dgag tu 'chor nyen che bas/ bskyar nas gnad bzhis bsgoms pas lang la ma shor ba bya/ dbang non gyis lta ba rigs pas gtan la phab ste nges pa brtan pa na dran shes kyis bying rgod bkag nas zhi gnas sgrub pa lta thog nas sgom tshol lugs yin la/ rtul po dang rnam rtog khug dka' ba rnams kyis dang por rigs pa'i dpyad pa mang po mi dgos par nang du phyogs pa sems lta bu la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas bsgrubs te grub pa na lta ba tshol ba phyag chen gyi khrid sogs ni sgom thog nas lta ba tshol lugs yin no/ /gang ltar yang dpyad 'jog stobs mtshungs su song ste dpyad stobs kyis g.yo 376

༄/ /byangarolakyi sems gnyisasgomatpal thegs chogagi 'jugangogs/ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin lhag par brtan pa 'grub pa na zhi lhag zung 'brel du 'gyur zhing sbyor lam drod du slebs pa yin te/ 'on kyang don spyi'i gnyis snangami khegs pas yun du goms par byas te gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rim par nyams smad pas gnyis snang je phra je phrar song / mthar gnyis snang ma lus par 'gag snye chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i sgo nas chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes snying rje'i snying po can ni don dam byang chub kyi sems dngos yin la/ de nam skyes pa nas don dam pa'i sa la gleb cing / gru bo che rgya mtshor zhugs pa bzhin yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs kyi sgo nas sa gong ma gong ma bde blag tu gnon par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ thob bya'i 'bras bu chos gzugasakyi sku gnyis su nges la/ de gnyis 'grub byed bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis las ma 'das shing / tshogs gnyi ga'ang byang chub kyi semasaganyis kyi lag len du 'du'o/ / de nyams su len pa'i tshe so so bar song na bogs mi phyin pas phan tshun gcig gis gcig zin par byas pas srid zhiganyi ga'i mtha' 'gog cing shin tu nus ldan du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sbyin la sogs pa'i bsod nams 'di dag ni/ / shes rab mgon bcas lhag par mthu ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dpa' bos gsungs te/ phar phyin gang la slob kyang desnub tshul dang phan yon dang nyes dmigs mtha' dag la mkhas pas de'i nyams len gnad tshang zhing mthar phyin pa zhig 'byung / tshad med bzhi'ang shes rab kyis zin pas 'dod chags dang sgyid lug g.yeng ba sogs kyi skyon dang ma 'dres pa'i rnam dag tu 'gyur la/ thabs kyi spyod pa de dag nyon mongs pa'i phyogs kyis badzi mi nus pa'ang shes rab kyi mthu kho na yin pas/rgyan las sbyin pa nas bsam gtan gyi bar lnga po re re'i mthar/ ye shes kyis 3tha

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsang 'bum/yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag / ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems gnyis gcig gis gcig zin pa'i zung du 'jug tshul 'di ltar goms pa yongs su smin pa na mar me dang de'i 'od bzhin blo gcig gi ngo bo la de gnyis dbyer mi phyed par sgrub tshul rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtogs pa skye bas/ des ring por mi thogs par byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhes bya ba zung 'jug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag chad mtha' bral bden pa gnyis kye gzhir/ /byang chub sems gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lam/ / yongs su goms pas sku thugs zung 'jug 'bras/ /lhun grub mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dpal gyur cig /cesabyang chub kyi sem4gnyi4sgom pa'i tshul theg pa mchog gi 'jug ngogasazhes bya ba 'di ni/ or du su o thog shog nasamang du thos shing sgrub pa lhur byed pa sman pa gzur bka' 'gyur ba dkon mchog rab rgyasakyi4bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /lam gtso'i zin bris gsang pa'i lde mig ni/ mchod brjod kyis rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang sbyor ba'i chos drug bstan/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don/ /zhes sogs lam gye gtso bo gsum la so sor spyor tshul dang thun mong du sbyor tshul gnyis/ bshad tshe go rim yod kyang bsgom tshe gcig gis gcig zin dgos pa rjes ma gnyi ga'i mtshams sbyar gyis shes te/ de ma byas na dang po'i nges 'byung de theg chen gyi lam du mi 'gro /chos sgrub 'dod tsam re kun la yod kyang phyi bshol gyis bslus pas dal 'byor dang mi rtog pa sbrel nas gsungs/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las mi dge ba las byung ba'i 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang las 'bras sprel nas gsungs/ jo bo'i lugs dang zhi lha'i lugs bsres pa'i sems sgom tshul gsungs te/ ma 378

༄/ /byang0bkyi sems gnyisasgom tshul thegapasachogagi 'jugangogs/rnams zhes pa'i rnams kye sgras sems snyoms pa dang / ma zhes pas mar shes tshig snga ma'i snying rje dang / ngang tshul la sngar phan btags pa'i ngang tshul mar shes kyi drin bsam lugs dang / slar phan 'dogs pa mnyam brje drin dran lugasaganyis kyi phyi ma 'khrul che ste/ zhing bzang po la nas btab ma thub kyi semasayil ma gtogs 'di la mang po btab ces drin du rtsi ba med pa ltar sems can gyi don bsgrub kyang yus mi 'byung ba yin/ rgyu las byung ba'i rten 'bres las kyang / lugs 'dir mdung khyim gyi tshul du rgyu ming 'bras bu la brten pas ltos nas btags pa'i rten 'brel gtso bor mdzad de btags pa'i tshul yang / sngar bkra shis mi zer ba'i mi gcig la rang gis bkra shis zhes btags nas zhag shas song ba na de la phar btags pa'i blo med par de'i ngos nas bkra shis grub pa 'dra zhig skye ba'i ngang tshul phra mo 'di rtogs dka' ste/ glegs bam las nges nges 'dra ba na grub mtha' 'og ma tsho'i bdag med bshad pa'i don blo ngor e 'dug mas nas bltas te mi 'dug na lta ba'i phyogs na med do/ / don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab med na gzhan gnyis kyis mi thar pa bshad nas dngos la rten 'brel gsungs pa 'di go na go la/ min na gnas lugs rtogs pa'i skabs med pa la dgongs shing snang bas yod mtha' sel bas kyang yin te/ des med mtha' sel ba mthong ba la mi skur ba'i rgyang 'phen yang 'dod na 'di ni thun mong ma yin no/ / tshig nyung yang yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gsung gi nying khu bsdus pa yin pas gces par zungs shig / / /379

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i 0sa'i ga4 stem/༄7/ / bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom tshul bzhugs so/na mo gu ru rgya bdag gzhan mnyam brje bsgom pa la/ mnyam pa bsgom pa/ brje ba bsgom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gces par bzung /gzhan yal bar dor te rang gzhan gnyis gces mi gces mi mnyam pa 'di mi rigs te/ rang dang sems can thams cad mi lam tshun chad du bde ba 'dod par mnyam/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mnyam pa'i phyir/ bdag 'dzin na re/deltar 'dod pa mnyam na'ang so so'i bde ba rang rang gis bsgrub dgos kyi/rgyud tha dad yin pas rang gis sems can thams cad la phan pa byed don med zeran/ rgyud tha dad yin kyang gzhan gyi gnod pa sel ba dang bde ba sgrub dgos pa yod de/ ma bu gnyis rgyud tha dad yin kyang gcig gi don gcig shos kyis sgrub dgos pa bzhin no/ / bdag 'dzin na re/ de gnyis phan tshun gces pa'i dbang gis yin pas/ sems can gzhan la de ltar byed don med zer na/ sems can thams cad kyis sngon 'khor ba thog ma med par skye ba'i ya mtha' thug pa med pa blangs pa'i dus su ma lan grangs dpag tu med pa zhig byas te/ da lta'i mas ji ltar drin gyis bskyangs pa bzhin du phan pa thams cad la sbyar/ gnod pa thams cad las bskyabs/ rang srog las kyang gces par byas te/ tha na nu zho 'thungs pa'ang rgya mtsho'i chu las lhag pa zhig btung yod pas da lta'i ma bzhin du gces par byed dgos so/ / bdag 380

༄/ /bdagagazhanamanyamabarjesgomatshul/'dzin na re/ de'i dus su gces yod kyang da lta phan tshun ngo mi shes la/ der ma zad 'ga' zhig gis dgrar bzung nas gnod pa ci 'khyol byed pas gces pa'i 'os med do zer na/ sngon gyi dus ring po mu mtha' yas pa zhig tu gces par bskyangs pa'i rtsis med par da lta'i yud tsam zhig gi dga' mi dga'i rkyen phran tshegs la khon du 'dzin pa ma rabs kye spyod pa yin te/ ma bu tshe hril por phan tshul shin tu gces kyang / rgas dus nyin gcig nad dang gdon gyis 'khrul te tshig ngan sogs gnod 'tshe byed na'ang bu des lhag par gces spras byed dgos kyi/ de ring bdag la mi gces par 'dug ces yal bar bor na 'jigarten thams cad kyis gal che ba'i dus phan mi thogs pa'i bu ngan zhes khrel med du brtsi ba bzhin no/ / bdag 'dzin na re/ gal te gces pa'i dbang du btang yang des pha rol la phan thogs rgyu med pas rang gi sems ngal ba tsam du zad do zer na/ phan sems bskyed pa tsam gyes chus skom sod pa bzhin 'phral du ngoms rgyu med kyang spyir mi phan pa min te/ sngar phan sems kyisgo ma dod pas su la'ang phan ma thogs pa yin/ phan sems sbyong thub na legs nyes thams cad sems kye rjes su 'brang yod pas/ sems de'i stobs kyis nus pa'ang je cher 'gro/ bsam sbyor gnyis gcig grogs su gcig song nas stobs rgyas te nam zhig dus skad cig ma gcig la sku'i 'od zer re res kyang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan 'dogs nus pa zhig 'byung / da lta 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang sngon rang cag dang skal ba mnyam pa 'ching ba kun ldan nus pa ci yang med pa res blo sbyangs nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa 'di lta bur gyur pa yin no/ / bdag 'dzin na re/ de ltar sbyangs na mtha' zhig tu phan rgyu yod srid kyang de'i bar du 'gro thub pa'i gdeng med/ gnas skabs phan sems 381

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ma'i ga4 stem/byas pa tsam gyis pha rol po'i lus sems gang la'ang phan thogs rgyu med pas byed mi spro zer na/ gnas skabs su'ang phan rgyu yod de/ rang la dpal 'byoraphun sum tshogs pa byung bar mi gzhan zhig dga' bar byas na rang gi sems la phan pa bzhin/ sems can thams cad bde ba la rang gis dga' ba bsgom na des sems can thams cad mgu bar 'gyur zhing / sems dga' ba de'ang phan btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdag 'dzin na re/ rang gis phan semasabyas kyang sems can gyis de mi shes pas dga' ba'ang mi skye'o zer na/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha sogs de shes mkhan yang grangs med pa zhig yod la/dngos su ma shes kyang rten 'brel gye che bas byams pa bsgoms pa'i gang zag de mthong tsam nyid nas mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams kyang dga' ba skye ba'i lo rgyus mang la/ sbrul gdug pas gnod pa ma byas kyang mthong tsam nas mi dga' ba nang gi khong khro'i stobs yin pa bzhin no/ / yang bdag 'dzin na re khyod kyis phan sems des lus sems gang la'ang phan rgyu med pas byed don med zer ba bden na/ tshig tsub la sogs pas lus la gnod rgyu med cing /sems gzugs tsam ma yin pa la de las kyang gnod rgyu med pas de la khong khro bya don mi 'dug snyam du sngon la bsam dgos so/ / bdag 'dzin na re/phan sems kyis lus sems gang la'ang gnas skabs phan rgyu med pa dang /tshig tsub kyis gnod rgyu med pa gnyi ga mgo mtshungs pas gnyi ga btang snyoms subyos shig zer na/ de gnyis mi mtshungs te/ gnod pa la khon du bzung ba'i rnam spin dang rgyu mthun gyes sdug bsngal kho na 'dren la/ phan sems kyis dga' ba brgyud mar 'phel bas bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod na rang gces pa bzhin du gzhan la gces par bzung ste phan sems sbyong dgos so/ /382

༄/ /bdagagazhanamanyamabarjesgom tshul/gnyis pa brje ba bsgom pa ni/ rang gzhan gnyis gces par mnyam pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ sngar rang kho na gces par bzung / gzhan yal bar dor bas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'di thams cad byung ba yin/ gzod 'khor ba phra rags kyi nyes dmigs zad par spangs pa'i bla med byang chub 'thob pa la srang mda'i mgo mjug gnyis mtho dman go bzlog pa bzhin/sngar gces par 'dzin rgyu dang yal bar 'dor rgyu'i bsam tshul de gnyis go sa brjes nas/ rang yal bar dor zhing gzhan kho na gces par 'dzin dgos so/ / rang gces par bzung nas rang bde ba'i thabs sgrub mod/ des sdug bsngal thams cad ji ltar skyed snyam na/ gces zhing phan pa'i zol gyis/gnod pa kho na sgrub pa yin te/ rang gces 'dzin gyi dbang gis rang gi lus longasaspyod/ gnyen mdza' bshes/ g.yog 'khor yul khams sogs thams cad la zhen chags skyed/ de ji tsam rgya che ba bzhin de dag la gnod pa dang gnod kyis dogs pa'i zhe sdang phrag dog g.yo sgyu sogs nyon mongs pa mtha' dag 'dren zhing / las ngan pa sna tshogs bsags te 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad skyed pa yin/ stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad dgrar langs kyang dmyal ba'i me nang du 'phen mi nus/ dmyal ba'i me nang du 'khrid mkhan yang rang gces 'dzin 'di nyid yin te/ dang por de'i dbang gis las bsags par ma zad/ 'chi kha'i tshe'ang grang ba'i snang ba byung ste rang gces 'dzin gyis drobar 'dod nas dmyal ba'i me nang du 'jug tshul mdo sde las gsungs pa bzhin no/ / der ma zad rang gces 'dzin mngon gyur shugs drag po zhig skyesaphyin phung khrol chen po zhig nges par skyed pas/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams rang gces 'dzin la phung byed 'ug pa'i mgo can zhes ltas ngan gyi mthar thug tu rtsi zhing / blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las kyang / phung byed 383

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i me'i g.yo stem/rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ / dgra bdag gshed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /zhes phan bde'i srog la rgol ba'i gshed ma rang gces 'dzin yin par gsungs so/ / gzhan gces 'dzin gyi yon tan bsam pa la sngon du las 'bras la yid ches rnyed dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /zhes sogs lta bu'i lung gis kyang sgrub tu yod mod/ lung tsam ma gtogs dpyad pas nges pa ma rnyed na yid ches brtan po mi 'byung bas/da lta mthong ba mngon gyur la'ang dpyid sa bon phar ma btab na ston lo tog tshur sdud rgyu mi yong ba dang / sa bon ma tshig ma rul ba dgos la/ de'ang nas btab pa las nas/ gro btab pa las gro 'byung ba ma gtogs 'chol nas mi skye ba bzhin du/ gzhan la sbyin pa btang ba las longs spyod 'byung ba dang /tshul khrims bsrungs te rang gi sgo gsum gtsang mar byas pas bde 'gro'i rten gtsang ma thob pa dang / bzod pa bsgoms te sems can la gnod 'tshe spangs pas sems can gyi yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs mdzes pa 'grub pa sogs rgyu sngon song las de dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ste/ 'di rang sde thams cad dang / chad smra rgyang 'phen pa ma gtogs pa'i gzhan sde rnams kyang kha mthun no/ /de ltar na sbyin pa'i sa bon 'deb pa la zhing sa lta bu gtong yul gyi sems can la ltos shing / de bzhin du tshul khrims kyis gzhan gnod gzhi bcasalas ldog pa dang / bzod pas dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang du len pa sogs phyin drug dang tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa thams cad gzhi sems can la brten nas 'grub dgos pas/ 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis kyang sems can gyi bka' drin la brten nas 'thob dgos par shes so/ / mdor na ston pa shākya'i rgyal po dang rang cag rnams gdong ma nas mchog dman du grub pa zhig ma yin par/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas khyad med 3yo

༄/ /bdagagazhanamanyamabarjesgom tshul/du 'khor bar 'khyams te/ res 'ga' rang cag rnams rgyal po dang khong de'i branabazhon pa tshun chad du gyur/ res 'ga' de las go bzlog ste chu khol ba bzhinabla 'og yang yang brjes pa'i mtshams shig nas khong theg pa chen po'i rigs sad de gzhan gces 'dzin gyi blo skyes/ khyad par du rang gi zla bos dmyal bar me'i shing rta 'dren ma nus par yod pa de brtse bas ma bzod par rangagi steng du len par brtsams pas sdig pa zad de mtho ris su skyes/ de nas bzung bde nas bde bar 'gro ba'i mgo tshugs te da lta don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs gcig pur gyur pa 'di byung ba yin/rang cag rnams rang gces 'dzin gyi dbang du gyur te 'jig rten khams nas zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags sogs phun sum tshogs pa mig gis mthong tshad dang rna bas thos tshad thams cad rang gcig pus thob na snyam ste de kho na 'dod kyang / bde skyid thams cad 'ja' tshon bsnyegs pa bzhin je ring du song / sdig sdug thams cad nyi rgas kyi grib so bzhin tshur 'dus/sdug bsngal mngon gyur pa dang sdug bsngal gyi bag la nyal sna tshogs pa'i khur gyis non cing gar 'gro'i gtol med pa 'khor ba'i gting rdor gyur nas shin tu nyam thag pa 'di byung ba yin/ de ltar na rang gces par bzung ba dang gzhan gces par bzung ba gnyis kyi gdam ga ma nor ba gang yin dang /skyon yon gyi khyad par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang rang cag la mchog dmanagyi khyad ci tsam dod yod pa 'dis shes so/ / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes pa'ang nyi ma'i 'od dang 'ja' tshon bzhin gsal lam me ba/'od lhang nge ba zhig tu song nas nam mkha'i dkyil na 'ja' gur 'khyil le bzhugs yod pa lta bu zhig tu phal cher gyis go 'dug pa don med/ gzhan phan gye bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa rang la sangs rgyas su bzhag pa yin te/385

༄/ /ca thang bstan lo sgronatse'i g.yo 4ma/sdud pa las/ de bzhin byang chub ched du byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ / 'gro ba kun la bran gyur bzhin du gnas par bya/ / zhes 'gro ba'i don kho nar gzhol ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mthar thug pa la skad cig ma'i sbyor bar gsungs shing / bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ /sems can gzhan gyi dgos la nyin mtshan mngon par brtson/ /bu gcig pa la ma ni rim gro byed pa ltar/ / bsam pa thag pas rnam par skyo med gnas par bya/ /zhes brgyad pa chos sku'i don yang gtong len mthar phyin te 'khor ba ma stongs bar du lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don la skyo ba med par bzhugs pa gtsang bde rtag bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gsungs so/ /sdud 'grel gzhan la sna tshogs yod kyang / skabs phyi ma gnyis mtshams 'byed tshul slob dpon gyis 'di ltar mdzad pa shin tu ngo mtshar che'o/ /de ltar rang gces 'dzin rgud pa kun gyi 'byung gnas dang / gzhan gces 'dzin yon tan kun gyi gter du mthong bzhin du thar ba'i dga' tshal la rgyab kyis phyogs nas dmyal ba'i me 'obs su mchong na gdon gyis brlams te spyos pa dang snying la bdud zhugs pa yin pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa lagadung dbyangs drag pos 'o dod kyis bos te/ bdag rnams kun tu phung bar byed pa'i dgra bo gdug pa can 'di thal bar brlag par mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab pa na/ de dag gi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sprin phung 'khrigs pa las don dam pa byang chub kyi sems stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' brgyud mar spros te bdag 'dzin 'gong po thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag / yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems byams snying rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab ste rang gi shes rgyud la zhugs pas bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor lhan gyes song /386

༄/ /bdagagazhanamanyamabarjesgomatshul/dedag gi thugs rje byin rlabs dang rang gi rlung sems dbyer med du 'dres pas gtong len sogs ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin byed pa la las su rung zhing /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu spros nas sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub pa'i nus pa can du gyur te/ rang gi bde dge thams cad sems can so so la don du gang 'gyur gyis zas gos gnas mal/ grogs mdza' bshes/ chos ston pa'i slob dpon sogs rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde ba la bkod/ de dag gi sdig sdug las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa dbugs rdub pa dad lhan du tshur drangs te rang gi sems steng du spung ba'i dmigs pa sogs gtong len gnyis po spel mar bya'o/ / 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo'i grwa pa dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog sangasargya4kyi4bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom tshul zhig dgosazer bar/ spyod 'jug gi bsam gtan gyi le'u bzhin lus bya khyi'i zas la gces par byed don med pasagru'i blo bzhag ste snying po len tshul dang / rang gi phun tshogasal phrag dog 'gran sems sgom tshul sogs dmigasaskor mi 'dra ba mang zhing / sang gi sdug bsngal de ring la len pa sogasablo spyong ba'i man ngag gi skyongatshul du ma yod kyang / 'di ni shar sgom thun gcig gi skyod tshul tsam zhig gyu ru lugasasu/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /387

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i 0sa ga4 las/༄tsho/ / dge ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid kyi zin bris zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs breng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣa ha sa badzā ya/ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya ste/ / de dang dbyer med ye shes phyag rgya che/ / de yi rang mdangs smin legasaphyag rgya ste/ / de dang mnyam spyor bde chen phyag rgya che/ / rnam mang ming gi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang / nges don dam pa'i ngang du ro gcig par/ / ston mdzad bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la/ / btud nas zhal lung nor bu'i phreng ba spel/ / de'ang 'di skad ces bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyis dang por thugs bskyed pa nas bzung slob pa'i spyod pa mtha' dag dang / sangs rgyas nas kyang sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad gzhan don kho na las/ rang don gyi 'khri ba cung zad kyang med la/gzhan don sgrub pa'i sgo mchog tu gyur pa ni rje bla mas gsungs pa ltar gsung gi mdzad pa yin zhing / de'ang mtha' yas pa'i nang nas yang rtse ni 'khor lo par ba sher phyin gye mdo sde 'di nyid yin par gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang /dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa rigs pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas ston pas brjod bya'i dbang gis yin zhing / sngags lugs la de nyid 'dzin stangs su byas pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes ston pa'i cha nas yin no/ / gang ltar yang tshogs gnyis kyi nang nas ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba dang /388

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya phopo'i khridakyizinabres/thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba yin pas/ rje bla mas kyang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la brten nas dris lan mang du mdzad cing / dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad nas gsar du rtogs pa'i tshul bstan te lhag mthong che chung dgongs pa rab gsal rtsa shes ṭīka chen sogs su gsal par mdzad pa las/ sngon chad bod 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug rtogs pa thugs su 'khrungs pa yod kyang de nyid ji lta ba bzhin tshig gi lam nas ston shes pa ma byung ba lta bu yin la/ rje rang gi sku dus su/ dbu ma chen po bya ba las/ phyag chen gyi tha snyad dngos su ma mdzad kyang / red mda' pa'i dris lan du/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zhig yod kyang da dung skabs su ma bab pas ma bkod gsung ba de dge ldan phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid yin par yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs so/ / des na 'di'i brgyud pa'ang nye brgyud de'i dbang du byas te rdo rje 'chang nas 'jam dbyangs/ rje bla ma sogs dben sa snyan brgyud kyi go rim ltar la/ ba so ba'i slob mar grub chen chos rdo rje 'di nyid dang / dpal ldan rdo rje/ kham pa rin chen rdo rje ste/rdo rje mched gsum zhes dge lugs pa'i grub thob chen po gsum byung bar gsung zhing / 'di mdo smad nas gza' mi gnyis dbus su song ba'i lam khar skyes pa byis pa'i dus nas skal ldan du dgongs te bskyangs shing / slar snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa'i bdag por gyur pa/ da lta'ang sku lus ma spangs par jo mo lha rir bzhugs pa las dag rnams kyis mjal du yod par gsung / /gnas bcu pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan ni phyag chen bskul ba po'ang yin la/gtso bor rwa sgreng du sgrub pa mdzad/ 'og gi blo bzang 'phrin las bya ba 'di lha ba zhabs drung zhes thugs rus che zhing zhal tsha bas rgyal dbang rnam thar na zur mang du yod pa de nyid kyi dpon po mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi mkhas pa zhig 389

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i ngas g.yo 4ma/yin zhing grub dbang blo bzang rnam rgyal kyang phyag chen gyi bka' bab mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi skyes chen khyad par can yin te/ rnam thar rgyas pa yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gsung du yod pa ltar yin/ yongs grags kyi mtshan la bka' chen mi zhes zer/ yongs 'dzin rin po che ni byis pa chung ngu nas nges 'byung dang skyo shas kyis bskul te dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/deng sang bstan pa'i rtsa ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ya mtshan can du 'dug pa dang chos 'di'i bka' bab yin pa'i gnad kyis bdag gis kyang zhus nas bla mchodadang sbrags ma 'di nyid gnang ba yin gyi/ sngar dbon slob byams pa rin po che dang / skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis las phyag chen gyi khrid thob kyang bla mchod dang sprags ma min pas/ 'di bla ma yongs 'dzin pa'i phyag len ltar la/ rtsa tshig las/ na mo mahā mu tā ya/ zhes na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba/ mahā chen po/ mu tā phyag rgya ste bgegs zhi ba sogs kye phyir du phyag rgya chen po la phyag 'tshal ba yin/ de nas sho lo ka dang po mchod par brjod pa'i rkang pa dang po/ kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ / zhes 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kun la khyab cing / de thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs mthar thug tu grub pa/ rgyal ba'i yum chen mo rang bzhin gyi sher phyin te yul phyag rgya chen po dang / rkang pa gnyis pas yul can gyi phyag rgya chen po bstan te/ de yang dbyer med ces gang dang dbyer med pa yin na yul phyag rgya chen po de dang dbyer med pa chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin ro gcig tu gyur pa dang / bajod bral ni spyir chos nyid brjod bya yin kyang / bu ram gyi ro mngar ba lce shes kyes ji ltar myong bzhin tshig gis brjod du med pa dang /lag pa mes tshig pa'i tsha reg lus kyis ji ltar myong ba ltar brjod du med pa bzhin/ 'dir yang mnyam bzhag ye shes kyis ji ltar gzigs pa bzhin tshig 3ga

/ /dge ldan byagargya rawo'ikhridakyizinabris/gi lam nas brjod du med la/ sems kyi rdo rje zhes pa'i tha snyad sngags lugs la cis kyang yod la/ mdo phyogs su'ang klu sgrub kyi bstod tshogs su sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa zhes de'i tha snyad mdzad/ dbyings zhes pa yul gyi sgo nas btags pa yin pas/ gtso bo ni phyi ma yul can phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid yin pas/ de ston pa'i bla ma mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la phyag mdzad pa yin/sho lo ka gnyis pas rtsom par dam bcas te dbon sa snyan brgyud kyi man ngag las rim par byung yang cher ma grags pa/ paṇa chen rang gis spel ba yin pas/ 'di'i khrid nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po bstan dang theg chen la/ /'jug pa'i sgo dang gzhung shing phyir/ / kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pas/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nan tan bya/ / zhes sogs dge lugs dang bka' brgyud gong ma rnams la'ang yongs su grags pa sngon 'gro'i khrid chen bzhi zhes/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro dang / theg chen gyi sgo'am gzhung shing sems bskyed gnyis bsdoms pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid/gnyis pa maṇḍal ni rtsa bar dngos su ma thon yang / sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba yang / / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la ltos pas/ / zhes gsung ba'i shugs la bstan te/ / tshogs gsog pa'i sgo maṇḍal gyi khrid/ / sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid rnams su yod pas dang po la'ang gnas khang byi dor byas te sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pas mdzes par bsham pa sogs lam rim las byung ba ltar byas/ de nas 'jam zhing 'bol ba'i stan rgyab mtho zhing mdun dma' ba de lta bu la rdo rje skyil krung ngam skyil krung phyed pas gnas la lus drang por bsrings te rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du bya dgos pas lus bsrong tshad ni/ sna rtse nas rde'u 'phang ba lte ba'i thad du 391

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i 0sa'i gsung ཿma/'bab dgos par yongs 'dzin gsung / de'i dgos pa'ang lus drang por gnasapas rtsa drang por 'ong des rlung drang por rgyu/ des rnam rtog gya gyu de 'dra med par sems rnal du gnas pa yong ba yin/ de nas rang gi sems la brtags te/ phyin ci log gi blo sna de 'dra rgyu bar 'dug na rlung ro dgu phrugs la sogs pas bsal te mno bsam legs par gtong dgos/ de'ang skyabs 'gro'ikhongs 'dir skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam rim dang / sems bskyed kyi khongs su rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun sogs skyes bu chen po'i chos skor 'gro dgos/ zhes bla ma yongs 'dzin rin po che gsung ngo / / dang po skyabs yul tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag bsam gyi shing yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa yangs shing rgya cheb/ 'dab ma 'og ma rnams thur du 'phyang zhing / gong ma gong ma rnams gyen du phyogs pa'i rtse mor seng khri'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku'i rnam pa skabs 'dir rje rin po che'i rnam par gsal 'debs dgos shing / de'i thugs gar thub dbang / de'i thugs gar rdo rje 'chang gsal 'debs pa 'di dben sa snyan brgyud kyi man ngag yin pas/ bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang rang ra ba'i rtsa ba de la thug pa yin/ de'i thugs kha nas g.yas phyogs su 'od zer gcig gnyis bzhi sogs 'phros pa'i sne mor rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / g.yon du rim pa bzhin 'phros pa'i sne mor zab mo lta brgyud/mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyun gyi sku'i rnam pa chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i mdun du rdo rje 'jigs byed/ g.yas su gsang 'dus/ rgyab tu dus 'khor ram dgyes rdor/ g.yon du 'khor lo bde mchog sogs bla med kyi lha tshogs/de'i 'og mar kun rig / dpal mchog rtse mo sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lha 3༅

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya chenawa'i khridakyizenabres/tshogs/ de'i 'og mar rnam snang mngon byang dang spyod rgyud du gtogs pa'i phyag rdor sogs spyod rgyud kyi lha tshogs/ de'i 'og tu thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod sogs bya rgyud kyi lha tshogs/ de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ de'i 'og tu nye ba'i sras chen brgyad sogs sems dpa' dang sems ma/ de'i 'og tu rang rgyal bcu gnyis sogs rang rgyal ba chen po rnams dang / de'i 'og tu gnas brtan bcu drug sogs nyan thos kyi tshogs/ de'i 'og tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro / de'i 'og tu chos srung ste rim pa bcu gcig dang / de dag gis gsungs pa'i chos rnams rang rang gi mdun na glegs bam gyi rnam par bzhugs pa gsal gdab dgos/ rtsod pa'i tshe chos dkon mchog la 'gog lam gang rung dgos zer yang / dmigs rnam skyong dus/ de ma gtogs lung gi chos rnams ja bskol ba'i ja ro lta bur snying po med par bzung na chos spong du 'gro bas/ kun rig gi cho gar yang / blo mchog rnams kye kun dga' rwa ba ste/ / zhes sogs/ lung gi chos la gtso bor gsung ba bzhin bya dgos/ de dag gi thog mar rang sdug bsngal gyes mnar tshul bsam pa la rag las pas/ de ni dpal chos kyi grags pas/sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ / zhes las nyon gye phung po 'di ka rang sdug bsngal gyi mtshan bzhir bzung nas/ de rgyu mtshan ci yin na/ 'grel rgyag pa'i skabs su/ de chos can/ sdug bsngal yin te/ las nyon gye gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir zhes las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye ba zhig blangs phyin chad gnas skabs sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mngon gyur pa yod med gang yin kyang phugs sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas 'ching ba'am/'ching thag lta bu yin/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar gyi snod bcud 'di thams cad sdug bsngal yin gsungs pa yig cha sogs 393

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i yo gsung stem/su mi gsal yang go rgyu chen po zhig yod pa 'dra/ des na nga rang tsho'ang da lta sdug bsngal gyis non yod pa la bsam blo ma thong bas yam me yom me zhig las ma shes pa yin/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi dgos/ mi'i mngal sgo 'grim pa'i skabs 'di la'ang / dang po mngal gyi gnas shin tu dog cing mun nag la dri nga ba/ lngan ljin gyis gang ba'i btson ra lta bu nyam nga ba de 'dra bar yun ring du gnas pa'i mthar las kyi rlung gis bdas de phyi rol tu btsas pa na'ang / tsher dong du bcug pa lta bu dang / 'khyag dong du bcug pa lta bu'isdug bsngal bzod glags med par yod la/ nar son nas kyang 'byor pa can rnams bsog bsrung dang / dbul 'phong rnams 'tshol sgrub kyi sdug bsngal gnyen mdza' ba dang bral gyis dogs pa dgra sdang ba dang phrad kyis dogs pa gzhan yang nad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa zhig yod la/da lta ngan song gi sdug bsngal dngos su ma myong yang der skyes pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang bar yod pas shi ma thag tu ngan 'gror 'gro ba las 'os med cing / der skyes na lo stong phrag mang po'i bar du tsha grang bkres skom glen lkug sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos tshul dang / brgya la bde 'gror skyes kyang / lha ma yin rnams lha dang phrag dog gi dbang gis 'thab pas lus bcad cing ral ba'i sdug bsngal/ khams 'og ma'i lha la 'chi ltas kyis phog pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ khams gong mar sdug bsngal dngos su med kyang dper na me lcags dang spra ba sogs la me dngos su med kyang me'i sa bon yod pas slar rkyen 'dzoms pa na me 'byung ba bzhin/ slar snyoms 'jug gi 'phen pa zad de las gzhan gyi sa bon smin pa na/ ngan song gsum la sogs par sdug bsngal 'khor med myong tshul bsam nas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las yid log pa'inges 'byung shug drag po dang / de las skyobs pa'i skyabs dkon mchog 394

༄/ /dgeldan phyagargya g.yo'ikhred kyizenabres/gsum༅ blo bkal nas slar skye srid du nying mtshams spyor mi dgos pa zhig ma byas na/ dal 'byor thob pa chud zos su song bar 'dug snyam du bsams te/rgyalasras zhi ba lhas kyang / 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ / bdag gis dge goms ma byas na/ / de las bslus pa gzhan med de/ / de las rmongs pa'angagazhan med do/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rang gis rang la rngan 'grang ba'am/ le bdas te skyabs 'gro sogs la bskul ba dang / yang na mthun phyogs kyi sgo nas bsams te tshe 'dir chos la brtson 'grus drag po byas pa yin na rab tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'am bar dor 'tshang rgya/ de ltar ma yin yang de'i rnam smin gyes phyi mar dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten rnyed cing / myong ba rgyu mthun la/ bzung na tshig zin/ bsam na don go / bsgom na rgyud la skye ba sogs chosasgrub ba'i mthun rkyen tshang ba dang / byed pa rgyu mthun chos kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis de la 'jug 'dod pa sogs sgo thams cad nas blo kha chos phyogs su 'khor 'gro bas/ rim gyis skye ba bcu drug sogs na nges par 'tshang rgya ba zhig 'byung ba yin pas/ ci nas kyang 'bad dgos/ de'ang skyabs yul rnamasal mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/skyob pa'i nus mthu sogs rgyu tshogs thams cad tshang bar yod kyang / rang res blo ma bkal par the tshom zos pa'i dbang gis/ de rnams kyis kyang skyob thabs dang bral ba yin/ des na lhan pa ser po gyon pa tshun chad la'ang dge 'dun dkon mchog gi 'du shes bzhag ste skyabs su 'dzin dgos par gsungs bas/de nyid gos dkar po gyon nas lhan pa ser po btab pa tsam la zer ba ma yin par/ don du tshul khrims dang mi ldan yang dge tshul slong gi ming bzung nas gzan dmar ser re tsam gyon pa de lta bu da lta dus dbang gis shin tu mang bas de 'dra la sbyar dgos sam snyam ste/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo 395

༄/ /yo ca bamapa'i sa g.yo ཿma/las/ dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa phyag dang bsnyen bkur sogs kyi yul yin par ma zad/ tshul khrims 'chal ba lug lta bu'i dge slong yang bsod namasakyi zhing du gsungs pa lta bu yin/ de nas skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rnam dngos gzhi la/ tshogs lta bur dkyus gcig tu byed kyang / dmigs rnam skyong tshe/ dang por bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig gcig pu 'di lan mang du bskyar te bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang byas pas/ bla ma'i sku la bsdos pa/ gsung bcags pa/ thugs dkrugs pa/ ma dad brnyas smod log ltasas pa la sogs pa'i nyes ltung thams cad byang ba'i mos pa dang / de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan mang du bajod pa'i tshe/yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba dang /de'i sku brnyan 'gom yug byas pa sogs sangs rgyas la brten pa'i nyes ltung thams cad byang ba'i mos padang / chos la skyabs su song ba'i tshe glegs bam rnams kyi gdong dar yi ge sogs nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ dam pa'i chos zong du bsgyur ba gta' mar bcug pa sa sgre mo la bzhag pa sogs chos spong gi sdig pa rnams byang ba'i mos pa byed/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba'i tshe byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dang bcas pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs dge 'dun gyi sde dkrugs pa sogs/ de la brten pa'i nyes ltung thams cad byang ba'i mos pa byed dgos shing / 'di skyabs 'gro bzhi skor gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ yi dam chos srung sogs la logs su byed na dmigs rnam yang zur du byas chog /de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes sogs kyi tshe thams cad kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi nyes ltung sbyangs/396

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya rapo'i khrid kyizenabres/mtharaskyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la thim/de rang la thim pas rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa'i dmigs pa bya/ denas sems bskyed la slob tshul la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas slob tshul dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas slob tshul gnyis yod pas phyi ma 'di yid 'ong gi byams pa'i khongs su 'du zhes yongs 'dzin rin po che gsung / dang por mar shes bsgom pa la/ 'khor ba'i ya mtha' thug med du shes dgos/ de la rig pa'i ya mtha' thug med du sgrub dgos/ de'ang de ring gi shes pa 'di kha sang gi shes pa de las byung bar rtogs dgos pas/ de'i sgrub tshul ni/ de ring gi rig pa 'dis sang gi rig pa de las byung ba yin/ kha sang bya ba 'di dang 'di byed dgos zhes bsams pa de de ring yang dran pa ni rig pa snga ma'i rgyun yin pa'i rtags yin/ /de ltar dpyad nas nges pa rnyed na shin tu shugs che/ gzhung lugs la ma sbyangs pa rnams kyis de 'dra'i sgrub tshul rtogs dka' bas/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi gsung bslu ba med pa yin snyam du blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas yid ches par bya dgos te/ rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ / de la spyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ / rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge pa/ /de la spyor ba'i dngos grub ring / / zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin/ de ltar mar shes pa nam byed res kyis drin gyis bskyangs tshul bsams te/ da res bdag gis drin lan 'jal dgos/ de'ang zag med kyi bde ba la 'god dgos kyi/ zag bcas kyi bde ba tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i go 'phang ni kho rang tshos kyang sngar lan mang po'i bar du thob mod kyi yid brtan ma byung bar slar sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa myong dgos byung 'dug / de'ang da lta 397

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/rang la/ de 'dra'i nus pa med pas de thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phong thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dge ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid snyan rgyud kyi man ngag zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ 'di'i byams pa yid 'ong gi byams pa yin la bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa snying rje'i rjes su skyes pa'ang yod pas/ de gnyis mi gcig ces bla ma rnams gsung zhing / phyi ma la'ang yid 'ong gi rnam par mthong dgos sam snyam/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa 'dir dngos su ma gsung yang /byedadagos pas de'i go rim cho ga sogs phal cher du btang snyoms tshad med rjes la byung yang / dmigs rnam skyong tshe sngon du blangasate zag med kyi bde ba la 'god pa'i bar rim gyes byed dgos/ gnyis pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ bye ba phrag brgya'i gling bzhi lhun por bcas/ zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba dang gcig la/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'am/yi dam gyi lha gzhan du bsgom pa'am/ rdor sems rang du bsgom pa sogs 'damag can du gsung bas gang byas kyang 'gal ba med pas rang gi blo dang bstun/ de'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gsal btab pa'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi byin brlab thams cang bsdus te de la thim/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi sgo gsum gye nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sne mor yang rdor sems yab yum zung re spros te sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig ltung sbyangs pa'i mos pa byas la yi ge brgya ba 'bum phrag bzla bar gsungasaste/ 'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na/ / rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes ltung ba thams cad 'dag par gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 398

/ /dge sa phyagargya rapo'i khrid kyizinabres/yin la/ / bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi dmigs rim yas 'ded mas 'ded phung 'ded sogs kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par rdzogs rim sogs las shes dgos/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dngos bzhi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'og nas byung ba der 'thus/ de dag gis sngon 'gro'i rim pa song zin nas phyag chen dngos gzhi'i dmigs rim ni/ dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i/ / bzhed tshul mang du 'dug na yang / / mdo sngags dbye bas gnyis su yod/ / phyi ma rdo rje'i lus 'di la/ /gnad du bsnun sogs thabs mkhas las/ / byung ba'i bde chen 'od gsal te/ / zhes sogs gsung ba'i mdo lugs kyi phyag chen zhes pa sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbyer mi 'thad pa'i phyogs mdzad cing / rgyal dbang gis dge lugs dge lugs rang byas pa bzang mod/bka' brgyudapa'i khrod du 'tshang nas ci bya zhes/ dge ldan bka' rgyud kyi tha snyad tsam yang mi bzhed la/paṇa chen rin po ches/ mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal por/ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ /zhes pa khungs su mdzad nas mdo lugs la'ang phyag chen gyi tha snyad zhal gyis bzhes la/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas kyang /phyag rgya chen po mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos su/ brgyad stong pa las/ brgya byin gyis rab 'byor la smras pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de/ gang la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ ko'u shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du byed pa'o/ / bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i snga ma yul phyag rgya chen po dang / phyi ma gnas lugs rjen par gzigs pa'i ye shes yul can phyag rgya chen po'i khungs su tshud la/ dus 'khor gyi skor 'ga' zhig tu lung 'di drangs nas/ 'grel tshul gzhan zhig kyang byas snang ngo / / de dag gi khungs 'god 3༅

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'ilhanas gsung 'bum/pa ni sngags lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khungs klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung rim lnga sogs dang grub pa sde bdun snying po skor gsum ste/ mgon po bde ba chen pos gsang ba grub pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes thabs shesagrub pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma yigro bhu tis ye shes grub pa mdzad/ de'i lcam la kṣi kā ras gnyis med grub pa mdzad/ ṭo snyi nye ru gas lhan cig skyes grub mdzad/ dā ri ka bas gsang ba chen po'i de kho na nyid grub pa mdzad/rnal 'byor ma tsi tos dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i de kho na nyid grub pamadzad pa yin la snying po skor gsum ni/ rgyal po do ha/ btsun mo do ha/dmangs do ha gsum yin zhing bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas dmangs do ha gzhung tshad ldan dang / snga ma gnyis brdzus mar gsungs la/ grub chen gye gzhungatshad ldan yin yang sgra ji bzhin par bzung chog mi chog ci rigs yod do/ / mdo lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khungs yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i sher mdo rnams yin te/ lta ba'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po 'di la ma brten par theg pa gsum po gang gis kyang thar pa thob mi nus pas klu sgrub kyis kyang / nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis nges bstan pa'i/ / thar pa'i lam ni gcig nyid khyod/ / ces gsungs la rje bla mas kyang dga' ldan byang rtser gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs la phyag chen gyi khrid dang / yongs grags dbu ma'i lta khrid gnyis gnang bas sgom gsar rnying gi tha snyad kyang byung la/ don lta ba la phra rags med kyang / bsgom pa'i tshe sems kyi kun rdzob pa'i ngo bo thog mar btsal te de'i steng nas don dam pa'i ngo bo btsal na rnyed sla bas sgom tshul gye khyad tsam zhig yod pa yin nam snyam/ phyag rgya chen po'i 'dod tshul gyi dbye lam

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya chenapo'i khridakyizenabres/ba'ang bod 'dir sngon chad mtha' yas pa zhig byung ste/ lhan cig skyes spyor ga 'u ma/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dang po lhan cig skyes spyor ni rje btsun mi la ras pa'i thugs sras nyi ma lta bu mnyam med sgam po pa chen po'i bzhed srol yin te/ de nyid kyis/ / sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ / rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs/ / snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ / snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'o/ / zhes don tshan bzhir bcad nas gsungs la/ / ga'u ma ni mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' srol yin la/de'ang phal cher mar ba dang dus mtshungs shing / khong gi bzhed tshul mthar thug pa'i lta ba ni mgon po'i shis bajod bka' rgya mar/ snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di yin pas/ de'i don khong rang ji ltar 'chad shes dka' 'ang / nga tsho'i lugs dang mthun par 'grel na/snang srid kyi chos 'di thams cad bden grub kyis stong pas na bden 'dzin gyi 'dzin tshul de nyid dngos po gang gi'ang / gnas lugs su ma zhugs pa rang grol gyi don dang / de ltar bden pas stong yang kun rdzob tu snang ba ni sngags rdzas tshogs pa las rta glang med kyang rta glang gi snang ba 'byung ba lta bu yin la/gnas lugs de nyid 'dzin stangs su byas ste ro rkyang gi rgyu ba byu tīr bkag nas bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyun chad med pa rkang ba gnyis pa'i don dang / des mnyam bzhag gi nges ngor kun rdzobakyi spros pa ci yang yid la mi byed par med dgag stong sang de kho na la 'jugapa gsum pa'i don yin no/ / lnga ldan ni 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon pos bzhed tshul yin zhing / de'ang nyid kyi gsung las/ byang chub sems kyi rta pho la/ / gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na/ / khrom lta mi 'or che mi 'byung bas/ / sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan mdzod/ / ces sogs kyi khu1

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i 0 dku ga4 stem/skabs nas dang po sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi lhar bsgom pa/ mos gus spyong ba/mi rtog pa bsgom pa/ mjug bsngo ba dang lngar bsdus nas gsungs/ ro snyoms spyor drug ni 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa yin la/de'ang rnam rtog lam 'khyer/ nyon mongs lam 'khyer/ na tsha lam 'khyer/ lha 'dre lam 'khyer/ sdug bsngal lam mkhyer/ 'chi ba lam 'khyer rnams so/ /yi ge bzhi pa ni/ a ma na se'i sgra las drangs te / sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa/sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ sems kyi gol sa bcad pa/ sems kyi lam 'khyerabastan pa bzhir bsdus nas ston pa yin la/ zhi byed ni dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' srol/ shes rab snying por/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags zhes pa la brten nas/ mtshan yang dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed du btags te/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dang khong rnam gnyis mjal ba'i tshe nyams mgur bzhes pa las kyang / dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di/ /gnod sbyin pho mo byung tsa na/ brtul zhugs 'khrul 'khor 'cha' ba yin/ / zhes sogs nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lags/ / zhes bsngags brjod dang zhal pho mdzad pa de yin/ gcod yul ni ma cig lab sgron nas brgyud pa zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di yin zhing / de'i gtso bo ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas tshe 'di'i snang shas dang rang gces 'dzinagacod pa/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin stangs gcod pa'am/ 'gog par byed pa yin/ rdzogs chen zhes pa dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i sems ma bcos gsal la hrig ge ba 'di yin zhing / snang sred 'khor 'das thams cad 'di'i nang du rdzogs pas nardzogs pa dang 'di las gzhan du grol byed kyi thabs med pas na chen po zhes bshad 'dug kyang dri ma thams cad dang bral lugs sogs ji ltar yin ma khu2

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya popo'i khridakyizenabres/shes/ 'di'i gdams pa slob dpon padma'i man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba zhigaphad la/ rgyal dbang gi'ang gsung gi gtso bo zhal lung rnam gnyis zer ba'i 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / gcig shos rdzogs chen gyi lta sgom gtso bor ston pa rig 'dzin zhal lung yin/ de dag gi steng du rang lugs dbu ma'i lta khrid dang bcas pa 'dod tshul mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gis bsgom song ba yin na don la tsha grang ltar 'gal ba de 'dra ma yin par dgongs pa gcig tu 'gro zhes/ dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ dzi ltar sa la rin chen mang / /dbye ba tha dad tha dad ni/ /yul dang yul gyis dbang gis brjod/ / rin chen dbye ba 'gar yang med/ / ces dper na yul so so nas byung ba'i byu ru las de dang de'i byu ru zhes so sor byed kyang / don byu ru yin par mtshungs pa dang 'dra bar gsung ba tsam las rtsa 'grel gang du'ang dgongs pa gcig lugs 'di yin zhes ma gsung bas dag snang sbyangs nas gsung ba yin nam dngos gnas la de dag bsgom ste rlung dbu mar bcug nas bde stong sbyar te lam gong mar bgrod tshul zhig yod pa yin dpyad dka' bas/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang pos sku 'bum du gnang skabs kyang /ku re'i tshul du/ paṇa chen da skabs mi bzhugs pa ma gtogs/ bzhugs na dgongs pa gcig lugs 'di gcig 'dri dgos par 'dug / gzhan phyogs pa tshos stong nyid ma yin dgag tu 'dod/ rang lugs la med dgag yin pas ma yin dgag dang med dgag gnyis ji ltar gcig ces gsungs so/ / 'o na 'dir ji 'dra zhig 'chad rgyu yin na/ spyir lta ba tshol lugs la gnyis yod de/thog mar yid dpyod/ de nas gtan tshigs yang dag la brten pa'i rjes dpag sogs thos bsam gyi sgo nas rim gyis bsgom pa la 'jug pa lta thog nas ༅3

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i po ga4 4ma/sgom tshol ba dang / spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ dang por zhi gnas bsgrubs te/ de rjes mtshan nyid so rig kyis dpyad nas lta ba tshol ba sgom thog nas lta ba tshol ba'i lugs gnyis yod pa las 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ bsam gtan bde ba'i stegs bu la/ /lus gnad bdun dang ldan byas la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan 'di phal cher la shin tu gal che zhing / ba lang bdag lta bu gang zag gi rigs 'ga' zhig la 'di 'dra mi dgos pa'ang yod/ rlung ro dgu phrugs ni g.yon nas jubs te g.yas nas 'bud pa gsum/ g.yas nas rngubs te g.yon nas 'bud pa gsum/ mnyam du rngubs te mnyam du 'bud pa gsum dang bcas pa rnams yin la/ rig pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i man ngag mthar thug pa rdzogs rim yin zhes yongs 'dzin gsung / de nas skyabs sems sngon du btang ste bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos la de'ang 'grel par/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni lam gyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor te zur du bkod pa ltar yin/ zhes zhal 'phang mdzad pa ni yongs su grags pa'i bla mchod 'di nyid yin pas bla ma mchod pa zhes pa dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes pa phal cher don gcig la/bka' rgyud pa rnams bla sgrub dang / rnying ma pa rnams rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi tha snyad kyang btags snang / 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid byed pa la rang la tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyong ba'i phyir lha'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa/ snod bcud la tha mal gyi snang zhen spyong pa'i phyir/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa/ mchod rdzas la tha mal gye snang zhen spyong ba'i phyir ngo bo bde stong gi ye shes la rnam pa mchod rdzas su mos pa rnams sngon du btang ste/ tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ bde 4la

༄/ /dge ldan byagargya phopo'i khridakyizenabres/stong dbyer med lha lam yangs par zhes sogs te/ bde stong gi don la e waṃ gyi bshad pa sogs mang du byar yod kyang bsdu na/ bde ba don dam la zhugs pa'i ye shes dang / stong pa stong gzugs kyi sku gnyis ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa yin zhing / lha lam la nges don gyi lha lam bde stong gi ye shes dang / drang don gye lha lam mngon brjod sogs nas 'byung ba ltar nam ca/kha' la bya tshul gnyis su yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs la/ dpon slob byams pa rin po ches lha lam zhes pa 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams rgyu ba'i lam yin par ma zad/tshogs zhing gi lha rnams gang du gsal 'debs pa'i gzhi dang / 'byon bzhud kyi gnas yin pas de ltar bzhag ces gsungs/ kun bzang la rgyal sras kun bzang dang / byang chub kyi sems la kun tu bzang po zhes bshad pa gnyis yodagung 'dir bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes kyis zin pa'i mchod sprin la kun bzang mchod sprin du bshad pa yin/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po'ang ze'u 'bru mig gis mthong tshad tsam byed dgos kyi ha cang mthon po mi bya zhes yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs/ gdong lnga ni rkang lag bzhi kha dang lnga char gyi ri dwags 'dzin pa sogs gdong gi bya ba byed nus pa'i cha nas bshad tshul gcig dang / gdong gi sha tshugs la 'bur po lnga yod pas de ltar bshad pa ste gnyis yod la/ gang ltar yang / serge ni rang nyid gcan gzan gang la'ang mi 'jigs shing / de la thams cad skrag dgos pa ltar bla ma'ang bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa thams cad las rgyal zhing / de dag gis badzi bar mi nus pas stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i mtshon byed du seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri gsal 'debs pa yin/ seng ge'ang 'bur du dod pa dang / ri mor bris pa lta bu ma yin par mig ser lhog lhog pa/dbugs lteb lteb pa de 'dra byed dgos zhes bla ma byams pa rin po ches ༅5

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/gsungs/ tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul sngar dang 'dra la/ gtso bo ni rje rin po che'i sku'i rnam pa dang / der ma zad rje bla ma gang du sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas dang mthun pa phyag na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa de 'dradagos zhes paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs so/ / phung po rnam dag bde gshegasalnga/ / zhes sogs kyi don ni sbyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla'i rtsa bar don yod grubs nas bzung ste/ rkang mthil gnyis la gnod mdzes kyi bar lha rnams gsang 'dus nas 'byung ba ltar cha so sor me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal 'debs pa'am cha rnams de dang de'i ngo bor mos dgos pa yin/ba spu dgra bcom nyi khri chig ltong zhes pa'i dgra bcom theg chen dgra bcom dang / 'od zer phyogs skyong zhes pa shar phyogs su 'phros de yongs su gyur pa las brgya byin dang / lho phyogs su 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje sogs su mos pa yin zhes yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs/ 'dab ma 'og ma rnams kyang sngar bshad pa dang 'dra la/ go rim de kho na ltar ma byas kyang chog /deng sang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha las 'jig rten pa la zhen che ba'i stabs kyis de 'dra tshogs zhing gi grangs su 'jog nyen yod pas gtan nas mi rung / de nas tshogs zhing de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te rang bzhin gye gnas nas ye shes pa rnams spyan 'dren dgos pa yin la/rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes pa longs sku'i gnas la byed pa dang / chos sku'i gnas la byed pa gnyis yod cing / rnam mkhyen gyis chos nyid la khyab yod pa'igand kyis 'od zer rgyang ring por spro mi dgos par gnas 'di lta bu la mtshon na/ rgyab ri mdun ri sogs kyi ngos la 'phros tsam byas pas chog ste/nam mkha' la sprin glo bur du thol gyis byung pa na rgyu rkyen med par byung ba lta bu 406

/ /dge ldan phyagargya chenapo'i khridakyizenabres/yong yang / der rkyen phra mo zhig yod pa yin/ de bzhin du ye shes chos sku dang / de'i steng gi stong pa ngo bo nyid sku sogs kyis khyab yod cing / de las gzugs sku'i rnam pa 'char bas thag ring por de 'dra byed mi dgos/ de nas/dza 4 ho zhes pa'i skabs su dam ye so sor mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du gnas pa dang / dam tshig pa la bstems kyang ma 'dres par gnas pa dang /'o chu 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med du gyur pa dang / de'ang mi dgyes pa med par dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa'i mos pa byed pa 'di rnams cho ga thams cad mthun/ de nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/gang gi thugs rjes bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ / zhes sogs te/ gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin kyang thugs rjes zhes byed tshig gi nus pas de la brten nas lhan skyesakyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba zhes bla ma la go dgos pa yin/ sho lo ka gnyis pa ni/ mtshan zur la brtags na chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la gtso bor phyag 'tshal ba yin nam snyam/ lhar bcas ston pa zhes sogs dkon mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor bltas nas phyag 'tshal pa 'di gnad che ste/ sangs rgyas la dkon mchog gsum ga'i ngo bor mos pa gang du'ang ma bshad/ chos dang dge 'dun la'ang ma bshad cing / bla ma dkon mchog gsum ga'i rtsa bar gsung ba dang / bla ma'i sku dge 'dun dkon mchog / gsung chos dkon mchog /thugs sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin par gsung ba'ang yod/ der ma zad bla ma las logs su dkon mchog gsum yod na bla ma la dad pa zhan du 'gro nyen yod pas de ltar 'dzin mi rung / gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ spyir yan lag bdun ka dang / der ma zad thos bsam sgom gsum sogs bla ma mnyes byed thams cad sgrub pa'i mchod pa yin yang / 'dir yongs grags kyi mchod rku7

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i sa ga4 4ma/pa'i rim pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/bkod legs rin chen 'od 'bar snod yangs las/ / zhes sogs te/dbyibs sogs bkod pa legs shing byi dor byas pas 'od 'bar ba/ rgyu rin po che las grub pa de lta bu'i snod du mchod yon sogs zad pa med par 'bul ba yin zhing rgyas par byed na/ tshig gnyis po 'di'i mjug tu'ang / dwangs pa'i sems kyis phul byung zhing gi mchog / skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter la dbul bar bgyi/ / yi gu ru burnya bornyi satwa sarba dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra a pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ añdza ma ḍi sogs bcug pas chu bzhi dang /rjes ma so so'i mgo mjug tu'ang / skyabs mgon rje btsun bla ma 'khor bcas la/ / sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul ba ni/ / sdong po sil ma 'phreng ba spel legs pa'i/ / mdzes pa'i me tog sa dang bar snang gang / / dwangs pa'i sems kyis phul byung zhing gi mchog / skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter la dbul bar bgyi/ / oṃ gu ru burnya bornyi satwa sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra pukhye pra tī tsā hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mtshon te spyor dgos par yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs/ dmigs pa ni me tog gi sdong po dang / de las btog pa'i sil ma phreng bar brgyus pa dkar po/ sngon po/ dmar po/ ser po sogs 'ja' tshon gyi mdangs ltar spel ba/ gzhan yang me tog gi gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / bla re la sogs pa gnas skabs de na me tog ma yin pa gang yang med tshod lta bu blos sprul dgos la/ snang gsal gye thad du rtse dga' rgod ces pa'i don/ byis pa rtsed mo rtse ba bzhin/ mar me'i tshogs kyang gcig gi 'od gcig la phog ste/ phan tshun 'dzings pa'i don yin par yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs/ sna tshogs rol mo zhes pa 'bul brdung rgyud dkrol gyi rol mo'i rigs mtha' yas pa yin zhing / phyi'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo ni/ me long dang pi khu8

༄/ /dge ldan byagargya powa'i khridakyizinabres/wang la sogs pa bzung nas mchod pa byed pa rnams dang / nang gi 'dod yon gyi lha mo ni/ lus kyi cha shas sam rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'dod yon lnga'i sgo nas mchod par byed pa rnams yin/ bye ba phrag brgya'i zhes sogs 'di'i maṇḍal yin zhing / dben sa snyan brgyud kyi chos 'di dag zhu ba'i tshe'ang maṇḍal nyer gsum ma 'di rang 'bul ba phyag len yin gsungs/ dngos gshams yid sprul yid bzhin rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ zhes sogs phal cher/ 'gro mgon 'phag pas/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil/ / zhes sogs dang cha mtshungs par/ rang gzhan gyi dge tshogs dang / mdo'i dbang du byas pa'i bslab pa gsum/ sngags kyi dbang du byas pa'i rim pa gnyis la sogs pa mtsho dang me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas mdzes pa'i dga' tshal gyi gzugs su bkod nas phul ba yin la/ yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho zhes pa rgya mtsho chen po dngos gzhi ma yin par/ gling bar gyi mtsho chung shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba de 'dra ba zhig yin par bshad cing ngogs zhes pa de'i go sa'am gzhi dang 'gram la bshad pa gnyis 'byung / ja'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni rgya gar na med kyang jo bo bod du phebs skabs ja drang bas bod kyi rab byung tsho bsod nams che zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa bzhin 'dir yang bzhag go / dngos grub 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu lnga dang / dngos grub gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma lnga zhes sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po oṃ ā ཿ gis sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum byas nas 'bul ba nang gi mchod pa dang / gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ dben pa gsum la gnas pa'i zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bskyed rim la gnas pa sngags skyes/ 'od gsal sogs la gnas pa'i lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'grel pa bzhi sbrags nas 'byung ba ltar gyi sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la mkhas pa de lta bu'i phyag rgya phul la de 4khu

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ce' ga4 ཿma/las rang 'dra chad de bla ma'i thugs ga'i rdo rje 'chang gi yum la thim/ de dang snyomasapar zhugs pa'i zag med kyi bde ba phyong ba na gtso 'khor thams cad thugs rgyud gcig pa'i gnad kyis gzhan rnams kyang des tshim par 'gyur zhesagasung / de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab cing de dag kun gyi rang bzhin nam sdod lugs su grub pa rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings stong nyid dang dbyer med du zhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin no/ / de nas sman 'bul ba dang lus bran du 'bul ba ni/ nyon mongs bzhi rgya rtsa bzhi zhes sogs byung /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas zhes sogs te/ 'di la yongs 'dzin rin po ches/ dper na chang 'thung mkhan zhig gis snga ma la 'gyod sems kyis bshags pa byed kyang sdoms sems med na gtan nas 'dag mi thub pas sdom sems gal che la/ de'ang zhe phugs su slar gcod mi thub snyam pa yod kyang gnas skabs de lazla bcos nas thag rbad kyis bcad de sdom sems byas na slar rdzun du'ang mi 'gro la/ rdo rje 'chang gi bcas dbang yin pas/ de ltar byed kyang byed dgos te/ dge 'dun gyi las byed pa'i tshe na'ang ltung mthun gyi byin rlabs byas pas ltung ba des las la mi sgrib par 'gyur ba lta bu yin zhes gsungs pa gzhan la ji ltar yin rung / nga rang la blo skyedache bar byung / rjes su yi rang gi yan lag ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin zhes sogs te/ rjes su yi rang byas pas byed pa po dang dge rtsa cha mnyam du thob pa sngon bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po zhig gis bsod snyoms drangs pa dang /de la dbul po zhig gis rjes su yi rang byas pa gnyis gas bsod nams mtshungs par thob par gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ 'grel pa don gsal las/rjes su yi rang yid la byed pas ni rang gzhan gyi dge ba byas pa mnyam pa nyid 410

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya chen po'i khridakyizenabres/'thob bo zhes gsungs/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe 'khor lo lta bu dngos su yod na phul kyang legs/ lhag ma go sla/ de nas sa gsum pa dang phyag chen gsol 'debs sogs long skabs dang sbyar nas 'don la/ lhag paralang / dngos grub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag / gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ / sangs rgyas kun dngos blo bzang grags pa la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / zhes dbon sa snyan brgyud nas 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid nanatan du bzla/ de nas yon tan 'byung gnas zhes sogs shākya 'od kyis 'dul ba sum brgya par/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa dang don mthun par so thar dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs/ gang dang ldan na zhes sogs mdo sde rgyan bzhin byang sems dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs/ sgo gsum legs bsdams zhes sogs sdom 'byung dang bla ma lnga bcu pa ltar rdo rje theg pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ de'i 'og tu phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyiyon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa la dang po ni/ sangs rgyas grangs med sogs dang / gnyis pa ni khyod kyi phung khams skye mched sogs byung la/ bde bshegs sku gsum zhes sogs sho lo ka 'di phyi'i yon tan la sbyar ba dang nang gi yon tan la sbyor lugs gnyis yod/ kun mkhyen ye shes zhes sogs gsang ba dang / sgrib med lhan skyes zhes sogs de kho na nyid kyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa yin la/ mtshams 'dir tshogs zhing gzhan thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdus te/ de la phur tshugs 411

༄/ /yo thang bam pa'i me'i g.yo 'bum/gsol 'debs byed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ khrid rgyun 'dir 'og nas sdud pa yin/ phur tshugs gsol 'debs ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid la bla ma'ang khyed rang yin/ yi dam yang khyed rang yin/ mkha' 'gro chos bsrung sogs kyang khyed rang yin pas/ re sa gzhan na med do snyam du blo bkal nas gsol ba 'debs pa yin la/ de ltar byas pa'i tshe bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ/ mgrin pa'i 〉 thugs ga'i hūṃ rnams las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ga so so dang cig car byung bas/ lus ngag yid gsum so so dang bsdom pa'i nyes ltung sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs so so dang gsum char gye byin rlabs zhugs/ bum dbangagasang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dbang bzhi pa rnams thob cing /mthar bla ma las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang la thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas lam gyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa la gshar sbyang byed cing / byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ zhing mchog dam pa zhes sogs te/ 'di dag so so'i skabs su bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang byas kyang chog la/ skyes bu chung 'bring sogs kyi chos skor so sor bcad nas byas kyang chog pas rang gi blo dang bstun/ don ni mdor bsdus na/ yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'dir rnyed bkur snyan grags 'du long tshong khe spog 'gro bsdad sogs don med kyi bya ba mang pos mi g.yeng bar don ldan chos kyi sgo nas snying po len dgos pa dang / da lta ngan song du skyes med kyang de'i las bsags yod pas/ dper na rkus byas pa'i mi de gnas skabs khrims la phog med kyang slar gcod pa dang 'dra zhing / de lasaskyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog gsum kho na la yod la/ de'ang rang gis skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las 'bras kyi spang blang sogs tshul bzhin ma byas na/de dag gis kyang skyob thabs med tshul bsam pa sogs chung ngu dang thun mongs 412

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya rapo'i khrid kyizinabres/pa'i lam rnams rgyud la skye bar byin gyes rlobs zhes gsol ba 'debs/de'ang byin ni bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin nam nus pa yin zhing /rlobs zhes pa rang rgyud kyi phyin ci log gi blo sna sogs de las gzhan du bsgyur ba'am zil gyes mnan pa'i don yin la/ des 'og ma thams cad la'ang 'dra/de nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa'i nges 'byung skyes te lam bslab pagasum la slob pa 'bring gi chos skor yin zhing / de la'ang tshul khrims ni gtso bo yin te/ tshul khrims rnam dag cig bsrung ba la dran shes bzhin brtan po rgyun chags su brten dgos shing / de lta bu'i dran pa brtan po zhig yod na/de nas ting nge 'dzin la kha spos kyang bsgrub sla ba yin zhes yongs 'dzin gsung la/ ting nge 'dzin yod na/ shes rab 'byung tshul rlung gis ma bskyod pa'i mar me gsal cha dang ldan pa lta bu yin tshul lam rim sogs nas 'byung ba ltar yin/ de nas chen po'i chos skor ni/ nyam thag 'gro ba 'di kun bdag gi ma/ / zhes sogs te/ snying rje chen po ni theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba yin par mdo rgyud thams cad nas gsung zhing / dpal ldan zla bas kyang / zog mtha' bar gsum du gal che tshul gye sgo nas 'di la mchod brjod mdzad pa yin/de nas sems bskyed tshul la lugs gnyis yod pas/ 'dir bdag gzhan mnyamabarje'i sgo nas sems bskyed tshul gtso bor gsungs te/ de ni rim pa mang po byed mi dgos shing / gtong len gyi dmigs pa sogs 'char bde la shugs che ba yin/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches spyod 'jug tu/ bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ / gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ / zhes pa'i don bdag gzhan mnyam brje 'di nyan rang dang der ma zad sems dpa' dbang rtul rnams la'ang gsang dgos pa yin gsung zhes 'ga' zhig zer yang /yig cha tshor bltas na byang sems yin na bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub 413

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i ce' ga4 ཿma/kyi sems kyang rgyud la skyes pas khyab pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas snga ma nyams myong gi gsung khyad par can zhig yin nam dpyad dgos/ de'ang rang cag rnams bde ba ji tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa med la sdug bsngal cung zad tsam yang mi 'dodapar 'dra ba la/ rang gces par 'dzin pa'i gcong nad shug drag la gsor med pa 'dis zin pa'i dbang gis ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa mi 'dod pa thams cad sna drangs yong tshul dang / gzhan gces par bzung ba'i stobs kyis yon tan thams cad 'byung ste rang cag rnams thog med nas rang don kho na byas pas rang don cung zad tsam yang ma grub la/sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das kyis slob pa lam du rang don yal bar dor te gzhan don 'ba' zhig mdzad pas mthar rang don phun sum tshogs pa'ang de nyid kyis brnyes 'dug pa sogs rang gces 'dzin gyi nyes dmigs dang gzhan gces 'dzin gyi phan yon sgo du ma nas bsam ste gtong len spyong dgos la/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sdug ma lus pasna bug g.yon pa nas tshur bsdus te/ rang gi sems steng du nag phung nge gnas nas rang la smin pa dang / rang gi bde dge thams cad sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros te sems can thams cad kyi sems la zhugs pas de dag thams cad bde bas tshim par bsgom dgos/ spyir rang cag rnams rgyun du rang gces par 'dzin cing / gzhan yal bar 'dor ba yin pa la 'dir blo de gnyis go sa brjes nas rang yal bar 'dor zhing gzhan gces par 'dzin pas bdag gzhan mnyam brje zhes bshad pa yin gyi/ bdag gzhan yin snyam pa dang gzhan bdag yin snyam du bsgom pa gtan min/ 'di yan chad kyi bdagagazhan mnyam brje'i skor phal cher song zhing / de nas/ snod bcud sdigapa'i 'bras bus yongs gang ste/ / zhes sogs kyi don mi dge'i las kyi 414

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya chen po'i khrid kyizenabres/rnamaspen snod bcud thams cad la smin te char chu dus su mi 'babs shing lo tog mi smin pa 'thab rtsod 'khrugs long mang ba gcan gzan gdug pas gtses pa/ nad rims sna tshogs 'byung ba sogs mi 'dod pa sna dgu 'dzings pa'ang zhum pa med par de thams cad sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ da lan myong nas dag song na bzang snyam du rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba dang / mdor na bzang ngan gye snang ba ci zhig byung yang 'phen pa'i stobs dang dkar po sa bon gyi stobs sogs stobs lnga dang sbyor ba bzhi'i sgo nas de thams cad byang chub kyi grogs su bsgyur te/ blo spyong don bdun ma sogs nas byung ba ltar blo sbyong gi dam tshig bcu bdun la sogs pa thams cad tshul bzhin du bsrung nus par byin gyis rlobs zhes pa'o/ / de nas smon sems ni/gtong len rlung la zhes sogs dang / dus gsum rgyal ba zhes sogs ni 'jug sems yin la/ 'di yan chad kyis spyod pa spyi bslab kyi rim pa song zin nas/so sor 'chad pa la/ lus dang longs spyod zhes sogs byung bas shes rab kyi phar phyin mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs la sbyar te/ mtshan nyid so sor rig pa yid byed kye dpyad stobs kyis drangs pa'i shin sbyang gi bde bas zin pa'i lhag mthong thob nas mnyam bzhag gi tshe dgag bya bden grub bcad tsam gyi stong pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor skyong zhing / de las langs pa'i rjes thob tu snod bcud kyi chos 'di thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam dang chu zla lta bur blo la snang ba tsam zhig ma gtogs rang ngos nas ma grub par lta ba sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor dang / mdor na chos 'di thams cad ming dang rtog pas phar btags tsam zhig bsnyon med du yod pas las rgyu 'bras sogs rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad ldan du bzhag chog la/ de dag gangalang rigs pas dpyad na don dam par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pas 415

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 7 ga4 ཿma/stong pa dang rten 'byung gnyis po 'di phan tshun gcig grogs su gcig 'gro bas snang ba stong pa'i grogs su 'char ba dang stong pa snang ba'i grogs su 'char pa zhig dgos kyi/ de gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar bzung na klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs par gtan mi 'gro bas/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag 'di thams cad 'khrul ngo tsam du skyel mi dgos par dngos gnas la'ang tshad grub tu bzhag chog ste/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'ang tshad ma yin pa'i phyir gsungs/ de la stag tshang lo tsā bas grub mtha' kun shes su/ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba tshad grub tu/ /rigs pa du mas brtags nas khas len pa/ / de la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ / ces sogs skyon brjod mang du byas la/ de'i blo rtse ni dbu ma 'jug par/ ma brtags grags par gti mug las yin no/ / zhes 'jig rten rang dga' ba'i rgyud kyi ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i tha snyad pa'i tshad ma thams cad gti mug yin par bshad 'dug snyam du dgongs par snang yang / rang lugs ni de dag gis yul de'iganas lugs mthong mi nus pa'i cha nas gti mug tu bshad pa yin gyi/gti mug mtshan nyid pa min no/ / de ltar thun mong ba'i lam sngon du btang nas/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lam la/ dang po 'jug sgo dbang dang de'i dam tshig bsrung ba ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhes sogs byung / skye shi bar do zhes sogs bskyed rim yin zhing 'di'i skabs kyi lha sku thams cad yid ngo'i lha sku yin gye dngos gnas par ldang mi nus la/ spyir lha skur bskyed rgyu de'ang da lta'i lus rten sha khrag gdos bcas 'di stong par sbyangs nas 'od khru gang ba lta bu zhig tu gyur te/ de'i ngang nas lha sku gsal 'debs dgos par mkhas grub rin po ches gsungs la/ go ram pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ rnam smin gyi phung po 'di ga lha skur sgom mi rung na/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag 416

༄/ /dgoldan phyagargya ra po'i khridakyizenabres/nyid/ / de la smod pa brgyad pa yin/ / zhes rtsa ltung du bshad pa dang 'gal zhes zer/ dang po nas gdos bcas kyi lus 'di lhar bsgom pa min yang /rjes su sangs rgyas pa na dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku de/ tha mal gyis mthong mi nus pas/ rags pa'i za ma tog la 'dren dgos shing / de'i snod lta bu yin pas de'ang sangs rgyas par 'dod dgos sam snyam/ rdzogs rim ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid snying gar bsams te ro rkyang gi rgyu ba dru tīr bkag nas rlung dbu mar zhugasaganas thim gsum byas pa las don dam 'od gsal dang kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba dang / gal te sngags kyi tshogs lam tsam yang tshe 'dir rgyud la skyed par ma nus na sngar bshad pa'i stobs lnga dang 'pho ba'i gdams pa sbyar nas dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can lta bur skye ba'i 'dun pa bya dgos/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni gtso bor sam zu ṭa sogs bla med ma gtogs rnal 'byor rgyud man chad las bshad pa med kyang da ltar 'od dpag med rje btsun byams mgon sogs kyi 'pho ba byed pa 'di bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bla med kyi man ngag gis rgyas bkab pa yin zhes lcang skya rin po ches gsungs/ lhag ma ni tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam yin zhing / mthar tshogs zhing gzhan thams cad bsdus te/dbus kyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / g.yas kyi byams pa/ g.yon gyi 'jam dbyangs/rgyab kyi rdo rje 'chang / mdun gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis pa dang / lnga po der bsdus nas re zhig gi bar du de la dmigs pa gtod/ mthar gzhan bzhi po dbus kyi bla ma la bstem seng khri gdan la bstem/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dbu ma'i lam nas mar bstems te nu ma gnyis kyi bar snying gi dkyil mi shigs pa'i thig le'i dbus su/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang ngo bo dbyer med du bsgom pa yin la/ 'di'i rlung ni srog 'dzin yin zhing / de'i rang mdangs dkar po yin 417

༄/ /yo ca ba pa'isgronasa'i gsung stem/pas/ bla ma'ang sku mdog dkar por bsgom dgos/ de ltar bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur cing / de'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i snang ba ban bun zarazir ngos gzung du med la 'di 'dra zhig e 'grub snyam pa'i re ba dang /gnod pa sogs kyis 'jigs pa'i dogs pa med cing / 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu bar blo ma bcos gsal la hrig ge ba de ga'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog dgos la/ de'ang brgyal ba dang gnyid mthug po log pa lta bu'i yid byed bkag pa tsam zhig bskyangs na hwa shang gi lta ba rje yab sras sogs kyis gtso bor 'gog rgyu de yin pas/ 'dir sems dmigs pa la gnas mi gnas lta ba'i dran pa rgyun chags brang nge ba dang / ma brtags na mi shesal brtags na mi 'char dgu 'char sna tshogs byed pa'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu sogs kyi bar chad yod med lta ba'i shes bzhin brten dgos te/ 'dir/'gyu ba rig pa'i shes bzhin bsdogs/ / zhes nyer bsdogs kyi de dang 'dra bar ba 'phul can yin pas grab bam sta gon byed pa'i don yin/ dran pa'i don mngon pa kun btus sogs su 'dris pa'i dngos po la dmigs pa sogs khyad par gsum gsungs kyang / yul gsar rtogs kyi sems kyi 'khor du 'byung pa'i dran pa la zhib cha dgos sam snyam/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo gsal zhing rig pa de la bsgrims te bltas pa na rnam rtog glo bur ba thol gyes byung ba'i tshe rnam rtog de nyid mi 'gog par de'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas de nyid sems kyi ngo bor 'gro bas bla ma zhang gis/ sems las rnam rtog 'phro ba 'di chos sku las chos sku 'phro ba dang / stong nyid las stong nyid 'phro ba yin gsungs shing / rje btsun mi la ras pa'i drung du lcam sa le 'od kyis rtogs pa phul ba las kyang / ang ge bla ma rin po che/ nam mkha' bsgom du bde lags te/ /lho sprin bsgom du cung ma bde/ / lho sprin bsgom pa'i gdam pa zhu/ /418
