༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya chenawa'i khrid kyizenabres/zhes zhus par rje btsun gyis/ nam mkha' bsgom du bde lags na/ / lho sprin nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/ / nam mkha' rang gi ngang du zhog / ces nam mkha'alas byung ba'i sprin de nam mkha'i ngang du 'gro ba bzhin rnam rtog kyang sems kye rang mdangs yin pas rnam rtog zur du mi 'gog par rtsa ba'i sems lhanaskyes ma bcos pa de'i ngang du bzhag nas bsgom dgos gsungs pa ltar ram/ yang na ral skor mkhan bzhin du/ / rnam rtog ci skyes rbad rbad gcod/ / ces gsungs te/ 'dul ba lung las 'byung ba bzhin ral skor mkhan bya ba gzhan gyis mtshon cha ci 'phang yang ral gri bskor nas gcod nus pa bzhin/ rnam rtog gang skyes de ma thag ngos bzung nas 'gog thub pa zhig dgos/ ral skor mkhan de rgya gar na yod kyang bod du med la rgya nag na'ang yodapar lcang skya rin po cheyogasungs/ de ltar rnam rtog bkag pa'i mthar ting nge 'dzin ji ltar skyong tshul ni lab sgron gyis/ hrim gyis bsgrim la lhod kyis glod/ / sems kyi 'jog sa de na gda'/ / zhes gsungs te/ de'ang dang por gcig bsgrim/ de nas yang lhod pa lta bu ma yin par gnas skabs gcig po de la grim lhod kyi cha gnyis ka tshang dgos pa yin te/ ha cang bsgrim drag na sems 'phros te rgod pa'i dbang du 'gro zhing / ha cang lhod na bying ba skye ste/ tsand+ra go mi'i bshags bstod las/ brtson pa brten na rgod pa skye 'gyur zhing / / de spangs na ni zhum pa skye 'gyur bas/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas dran shes kyi shugs ma yal bar khong nas grim cha dang ldan yang phyi lhod pa de 'dra zhig dgos so/ / rgyu mtshan 'di dag gi gnad kyes snga rabs pa rnams glod rab la sgom rab ces bshad pa de rje yab sras kun gyis rtsal du bton nas dgag pa mdzad pa yin la/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i gsung la lar yang de ltar bshad pa 'byung ste/ zhi gnas gsar sgrub sogs kyi 419

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sa'i ga4 ༅ma/skabs su yin na mi rung yang / sngags kyi rtogs pa mthon por song ba'i skabs su de 'dra'i dus shig kyang yod dam snyam/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ / glod na grol bar the tshom med/ / ces pa 'di sa ra ha'i gsung yin zhing / dper na skud pa lta bu ha cang grim drag pas mdud pa byung ba de glod na rang babs su zhig 'gro ba bzhin/ sems rnam rtog gis bcings pa'ang ma bcos par bzhag na sems kyi ngo bor rang yal du 'gro ste don snga ma dngagand gcig / de ltar khong nas grim cha ma shor yang ha cang bsgrim ma drag par sems rang babs su lhod cham gyis bzhag na rnam rtog thams cad rang zhir 'gro la/ sngar bshad pa bzhin rnam rtog chos skur bltas nas mi 'gog pa dang / ral skor mkhan bzhin du rnam rtog gang skyes de ma thag rbad kyisagacod pa gang gi sgo nas yin kyang / rnam rtog rang yul du song ste sems kyi ngo bo stong sang de gsal le hrig ge ba rgyun chags su mthong ba de'i tshe/ rtog paganas 'gyu 'dres pa zhes bka' brgyud kyi sgom chen rnams la grags shing gnas 'gyu rigs gsum gyi tha snyad kyang mdzad do/ /yang skyong tshul gcig la/rnam rtog ci skyes kyang mi 'gog par rnam rtog de ga'i ngo bo de gang du 'phro gang las 'phro bltas te rang babs su bzhag nas bsgom na mtshams shig nas rnam rtogade nyid kyang rang so mi zin par rtsa ba'i sems de'i steng du tshur 'khor nasamang ste/ dper na tshong ba rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i tshe chu srin la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa yod med blta ba'i ched du phug ron bzung song ba de rgya mtsho'i khar btang na 'khor 'khor nas 'bab sa ma rnyed par sngar gyi gru nang der log 'ong ba lta bu yin te/ ji ltar gzings nas 'phur ba'i bya rog ni/ / phyogs rnams bskor nas slar yang der 'bab bzhin/ / zhes do ha las gsungs/gzhan yang sems kyi bzhag thabs gtso bo drug gsungs te/ sprin dang bral 420

/ /dgeldan phyagargya gapo'ikhridakyizenabres/ba'i nyi bzhin bzhag / mkha' la khyung chen lding bzhin bzhag / rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jing bzhin bzhag / bu chung lha khang bltas bzhin bzhag /mkha' la bya 'phur rjes bzhin bzhag / ras bal brdal ba bzhin du bzhag /ces sems kyi ngo bo 'od gsal ba de nyid bying rgod sogs rnam rtog gis mi sgrib par 'jog pa dang / khyung chen nam mkha' lding des mkha' la nam 'phang bcad nas 'gro ba'i tshe gshog pa lteb lteb ltebami byed par lhod ding nge 'gro'ang khong du grim cha'i shugs dang ldan pa bzhin grim lhod 'tsham zhing gsal ngar dang ldan par 'jog pa dang / gsum pa ni/ chu ci tsam che ba tsam gyis rlabs 'byung ba yun ring la byung ba'i tshe thag ring por 'gro ba yin pas rgya mtsho chen por nyi ma bdun bdun na rlabs re re 'byung / de'ang kha nas rlung gis cung zad bskyod pa ma gtogs gting g.yo mi nus pa bzhin/sems rnam rtog phra mos cung zad g.yos kyang / rags pas mi g.yo bar 'jog pa dang / byis pa chung ngu lha khang du song ba na che ba rags rim tsam zhig mthong ba las ri mo'i zhib cha sogs kyi rtog dpyod mi 'jug pabazhin sems sgo lnga'i dbang shes kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar 'jog pa dang / nam mkha' la bya 'phur ban rjes bstan rgyu med pa ltar sems la re dogs mang pos 'ching ba med par 'jog pa dang / ras bal brdal ba na lhod lhod por 'dug pa ltar sems ma g.yos pa'i ngang la lhod cham gyes mnyam par 'jog pa rnams yin zhing / las dang po pa'i skabs 'dir de'i nang nas kyang bu chung lha khang blta ba lta bu'i bsgom tshul de gnad che/ snga rabs pa'i sgom chen phal cher la sems kyi bzhag thabs gtso bo 'di dag ma gtogs/ sems gnas dgu dang /nyesapa lnga spong ba'i gnyen por 'du byed brgyad bsten pa/ stobs drug dang yid byed bzhi'i 'grub tshul sogs kyi rnam bzhag cher ma mdzad kyang sngar 421

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'isgronasa'i g.yo stem/bshad pa rnams nyams myong gi sgo nas gsungs pa yin 'dug / de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu la ji 'dra ba zhig 'byung rgyu yin na/ mnyam bzhag ngo bo gang gis kyang / / ma bsgribs dwangs shing gsal ba dang / / zhes sogs gsungs te/ sems kyi ngo bo gang gis ma bsgribs pa/ rtsig ngos kyi rdul phra rab tshun chod kyang 'char ba'i tshod lta bu'i dwangs shing gsal la/ yul gyi rnam pa 'di 'char la 'di mi 'char bya rgyu med par sna tshogs su 'char ba'i hrig ge ba/ dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i dbyibs gzugs can gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong sang ngos bzung med pa de lta bu mngon sum du mthong ba na/sems ngo 'phrod pa dang / sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba yin pas/ 'di ni dper na gzhan la zan chang ster ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang spar bcang du gtod pa'i gdams pa bla na med pa yin dgos zer/ rang lugs la/des sems kyi kun rdzob pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig mthong ba dang / sems gnas sgrub pa'i thabs tsam zhig yin la/ sems gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig grub na'ang / dngos gzhi dang nyer bsdogs sogs zhi lhag gi yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas shin tu gal che/ des na 'dir de lta bu'i zhi gnas sgrub tshul gsungs pa'ang gzhan lugs shes pa tsam gye phyir min gye/ 'og tu 'chad rgyu'i sems kyi don dam pa'i ngo bo de nyid la 'jug sla ba dang / de 'dra'i lhag mthong 'grub pa'i gzhi'i zhi gnas khyad par can sngon du bsgrub pa'i phyir yin no/ /de'ang bka' rgyud pa snga ma rnams dbang rnon dang po nas phyag rgya chen po 'di la khrid chog pa gcig car ba dang / dmigs rim 'og ma nas go rim bzhinakhyas te mthar phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bstan chog pa la rim gyes pa zhes pa'i tha snyad btags la/ 'on kyang lam gong ma skye ba'i sngon 'gror thun mong lam sbyang 'og ma la blo sbyong dgos par rje btsun mi las kyang mgur 'bum 422

༄/ /dge ldan phyagargya phopo'i khridakyizenabres/sogs su gsungs pas/ spyir dbang po rno rtul su yin yang lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du 'gro dgos la/ tshe rabs snga mar sbyangs pa sngon du song ba yin na tshe 'di rang la thos bsam sogs cher ma byas kyang snga ma'i bag chags sad nas rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba yod de/ dper na sngon 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa de nyid dang por gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa mdzad pa'i tshe/'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'di gang la thug pa yin snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe thag chod pa zhig ma byung bar/ cha ba chos kyi seṅge'i drung du phebs nas dris par/ thog ma'i ma rig pa yin gsung yang sgro 'dogs ma chod/ sa chen gyi drung du zhus pasablung sems ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa 'di yin gsungs te/ des kyang sgro 'dogs ma chod/ de nas dwags lha sgam por mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i drung du phebs pas khong gis khyed rang la thag ma chod pa ci yod dris shig gsung bas/ 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa mthar thug pa de gang yin zhus pa na de la mi shes rgyu ci yod/ da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa 'di ga yin gsung bas/ thugs la gting nas 'phrod pa zhig byung ste sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i byin rlabs dang dga' spro mos gus smra mi shes pa lta bus yid g.yos te dran med du brgyal zhing / de ka rang la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs par bshad pa lta bu yin/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i bla ma dbu ma pa chen po de nyid kyis kyang sngar bka' rgyud pa'i bla ma 'ba' ra ba bya ba'i drung nas sems kyi ngo sprod phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid kyi khrid cig gsan la/ zhib tu brtag na sems gnas sgrub tshul tsam zhig tu 'dug ces rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las zur tsam gsungs/ sems gnas sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir mdo lugs kyis rnam rtog phra mo mi 'gog kyang / sngags lugs la de 'gog pa'i gnad kyis zhi gnas sgrub pa sogs la nus pa che ba yin zhes yongs 'dzin gsung / gnyis pa rang 423

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonasa'i gsung 'bum/lugs kyi phyag chen gtso bo sems kyi don dam pa'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa la/ rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ da ni sems kyi chos nyid la/ /ngo sprod ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ / zhes pa nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal gdams 'god/ /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kye zhal las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gsal bar 'god par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas dngos gzhi la/ nges dka' sla'i dbang gis bdag med gnyis la 'jug rim spyir bshad pa dang mthun par dang bor gang zag gi steng du gtan la 'beb tshul dang / de nas sems kyi steng du gtan la 'beb tshul gnyis yod pas/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi mnyam bzhag ngang nyid las/ / ma g.yos dwangs pa'i chu nang du/ / ji ltar nya chung 'khyug pa ltar/ phra mo'i shes pas sgom pa po'i/ / skyes bu'i rang bzhin mdzangs par brtag / ces sogs gsungs te/ dper na chu bo chen po'i gting nas nya chung 'khyug kyang / des chu g.yo mi nus pa bzhin/ sngar bshad pa'i zhi gnas kyi sgom de las ma g.yos par mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang de nas shes pa'i zur gcig gis nga rang bzhin gyis grub ma grub dang / grub na ji ltar grub dgos tshul dang / de la gnod byed ji ltar 'jug pa sogs dpyad pa byed dgos la/ dpyad tshul ni/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ / me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ / de las gzhan na skyes bu gang / / zhes ṭwāṃX dhiX ddhidīs podi/ yorje dī swā snaX tt+waṃdhi ༵byeng la ya ༷'am nghruX dī ༷༵ rdo ༈ ṭwāṃ~X sogs kyi sa khams tsho'ang nga min/ lus kyi khrag chu ser sogs dang / drod dang dbugs dang / nam mkha'i khams su gtogs pa lus kyi bu ga la sogs 424

༄/ /dgeldan ༅rgya rayo'ikhredakyizinabre /pa 'di dag gang yang nga min la/ 'di thams cad bsal ba'i shul na 'di nga yin zer ba'i lus rgyu zhig kyang med pas/ des na skyes bu zhes pa sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams kyi khams drug 'dus pa la ming dang rtog pas phar btags pa ma gtogs/ kho rang gi ngos nas tshur grub rgyu cung zad tsam yang mi 'dug snyam du bsgom zhing shugasazhan du song ba na'ang sngar gye rgyu mtshan dran tsam byas te/ de la 'jog pa mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i bsgom tshul yin zhing /skyesabu khams drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ / yang dag ma yin zhes pa 'dis rjes thob kyi sgom tshul bstan zhes 'grel par gsungs la/ de'i tshul ni sngar bshad pa bzhin khams drug so so'ang nga min/ 'dus pa'ang nga min/ de las logs su'ang nga med la/ 'on kyang las gsog pa po dang / rnam smin myong ba po'i nga tsam zhig yod dgos pas/ de ni dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma sprul pa'i tshe rde'u shing rang gi ngos nas rta glang med kyang mig bslad pa dang sngags rdzas kyi dbang gis rta glang gi snang ba tsam zhig 'byung ba bzhin/ gdags gzhi khams drug po de la/ 'dog byed ming dang rtog pas phar btags tsam pa/ blo la snang tsam pa de ka tsam zhig nga'o snyam du sgyu ma dang rmi lam dang chu zla lta bur bsgom pas rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor skyong tshul yin no/ / gnyis pa skabs 'di'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo sems kyi steng du gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/ yang na mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang / / gzugs su ma grub stong sang nge / / zhes sogs gsungs te/ sems 'di lus kyi stod smad sogs cha 'di na yod/dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i khyad par 'di 'dra zhig yin zhes pa lta bu'i ngos bzung gang yang med pa/ dngos gnas la stong nyid min yang phar brtag na stong sang nge ba zhig las med pas bka' rgyud gong ma rnams rgyar ma chad pa/phyogs su ma lhung ba zhes zer lugs phal cher nam mkha' dang phyogs mtshungs 425

༄༅/ /gung thang bsnyan pa'i sgonace' gsung 'bum/lta bu zhig mdzad la/ de ltar ngos bzung med pa zhig yin yang / rang dgar ma brtags ma dpyad bar bzhag na mi 'char dgu 'char ba/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar gye bde sdug legs nyes thams cad byed pa po yin pas/sngon chad rang cag phar sems kyi dbang du song ba yin/ da ni sems de tshur rang gi dbang du 'dus pa zhig byed dgos pas/ sems ngo sprod pa dang sems la dmigs pa zhes 'di nyid gtso bor rtsal du 'don pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/sems dmigs rten du byed pa de'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo rags rim tsam zhig shar ban/ de tsam gyes chog shes byas te de la dmigs nas bsgom na gsal cha rim gyis 'byung bas de ltar byed dgos kyi/ dang po nas/ gsal cha can zhig la gtsor 'don byas na dmigs rten mi rnyed pas de 'dra mi rung zhes yongs 'dzin rin po che gsung / de'ang sems la dmigs pa 'di spyir zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa la khyab pa'i dmigs pa/ nyon mongs rnam spyong gi dmigs pa/ spyad pa rnam spyong gi dmigs pa/ mkhas pa'i dmigs pa rnams su yod cing / dang po la'ang rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan/ rnam rtog med pa'i gzugs brnyan/ dngos po'i mtha'/ dgos pa yongs grub dang bzhi/ dngos po'i mtha' la'ang / ji lta ba la ltos pa'i dngos po'i mtha' dang / ji snyed pa la ltos pa'i dngos po'i mtha' gnyis yod pa'i nang nas ji snyed pa la ltos pa'i dngos po'i mtha' yin zhes yongs 'dzin gsung /de'ang sems kyes sems la dmigs pa yin na/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyis rang rig 'gog pa'i skabs su/ skyes bu yang zor ci tsam che'ang rang gis rang gi phrag pa la zhon mi nus pa dang / sor mos rang gi rtse mo la reg mi nus pa dang / mar mes rang nyid gsal mi nus pa sogs kyi dpe'i sgo nas bya byed gcig tu thal pa'i skyon brjod pa de 'di la'ang 'dra bas ji ltar yin dpyad 426

/ /dgeldan phyagargya chenapo'i khridakyizenabres /gzhi che/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches sems kyi don spyi la dmigs pa yin gsungs pa sngar gyi skyon de khegs tsam 'dug la/ lcang skya rin po ches kyang 'di skor yongs 'dzin rin po che la dri ba zhig mdzad snang / nga rang gis bsam tshod la dang por sems kyi spyi tsam zhig 'char bcug nas/ de phyin skad cig phyi ma phyi mas snga ma la dmigs par byas na go rgyu cung zhig dga' 'am snyam/deltar sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong hrig ge ba rigs 'dra'i rgyun chad pa med cing yul sna tshogs su 'phro ba de nyid ngos zin par byas te/ de'i steng du gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pas sgrub tshul ni/rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ rgyud dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ / phreng ba dmag sogs bzhin du rdzun/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la dpe ni skud pa gcig la phreng rdog brgya dang brgyad brgyus pa'i tshe phreng ba'o zhes de'i steng nas tshur grub grub 'dra bal/ phreng rdog so sor bsal na phreng ba ngos 'dzin rgyu med pa dang / go mtshon thogs pa'i mi brgya tsam zhig 'dus pa na dmag ces rang ngos nas grub bsdad pa'i dmag yod yod 'dra ba la/ dmag mi rnams so sor song ba'i shul na dmag cig lus rgyu med pa ltar sems zhes bya ba 'di'ang rgyud dam rgyun skad cig snga phyi mang po zhig tshogs tsam gyi steng de la blos phar bzhag pa tsam zhig las skad cig so sor bsal pa'i shul na lus rgyu med la/ 'di la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas rigs pa 'di nyid bsnan nas gsungs te/ dper na khang pa ka ba bzhi ma zhig gi nang na khang pa de'i ka ba spyi tsam pa zhig yod dgos te/ de ka ba bzhi ga'i dbye gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang ka ba bzhi po de re re nas phye na dbye gzhi'i ka ba min te dbye chos yin la/ dbye chos su 'gro ba'ang dbye gzhi zhig yod pa la ltos dgos pas ming gis btags tsam gyi steng na4'jog dgos la/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis kyang / mtshan nyid 427

༄/ /yo ca bayo yo 7 sa ཿma/pa'i rdzas spyi ma zer ba 'di stong nyid go ba la phan shin tu che gsung / dben sa pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhalagadams nyams mgur las kyang / gang shar rnam rtog 'dzin par yongs rig na/ /don dam chos dbyings gzhan la ltos med 'char/ /zhes sogs tshig nyung zhing don rgya che ba sho lo ka 'di'i nang du phyag chen gyi gnad yongayosu rdzogs par 'dus la/ tshig don ni/ da lta nga rang tsho lagang snang ba 'di thams cad bden 'dzin gyis bslad pa'i 'khrul snang sha stag yin te/ rang re la snang ba'i tshe yul gang dang gang yin kyang kho rang gi ngos nas tshur snang ba lta bu zhig ma gtogs blos phar btags pa'i nyams med la/ don du bzhi brgya pas 'grel par/ rtog pa yod pa kho nas yod pa nyid dang / rtog pa med par yod pa nyid med pa zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/rtog pas phar btags tsam ma gtogs 'jog rgyu med la/ rtog pasaphar btags pa tsam de yod pas yod par 'jog yang dgos te/ burta pā li tar gsungs pa bzhin/ byis pa gnyis kyis lha khang bltas pa na gcig gis 'khor lo thogs pa 'di ni sred med kyi bu'o/ / rtse gsum thogs pa 'di ni dbang phyug go zer ba la/ gcig shos kyis de ma yin te/ 'khor lo thogs pa 'di ni dbang phyug go /rtse gsum thogs pa 'di ni sred med kyi bu'o zhes gnyis ka ma mthun par kun tu rgyu zhig la dris pa na/ des 'khor lo thogs pa 'di ni khyab 'jug gamasred med kyi bu yin/ rtse gsum thogs pa 'di dbang phyug yin zhes lan btab pas de gnyis kyi dogs pa sel nus la lan yang don mthun du 'gro bas/ de ltar 'debs dgos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa 'di khyab 'jug min khyab 'jugagi ri mo yin zhes khyad par 'byed mi dgos pa bzhin du/ ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i blo lhan skyes 'dis phar btags tsam des tshim par byas nas tha snyad pa'i rnam bzhag thams cad bsnyon med du 'jog dgos kyi/ kun rdzob kye 4༅

༄/ /dge ldan byagargya gapo'ikhredakyizenabres/chosarnams kyi 'jog mtshams la don dam gyi dpyad pa byas na cung zad kyang rnyed rgyu med pas 'jog mi thub tshe de la mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mgur 'di'i gsung zin ltar na rtog pas btags tsam sngon la rtogs nas/de'i shugs kyis stong nyid rtogs 'gro ba lta bu zhig 'dug kyang spyir bden gnyis kyi rtogs rim la/ don dam bden pa sngar rtogs dgos pas 'di gsaratogs kyi dus la spyor ram/ rjes su bsgom pa'i skabs la spyor dpyad dgos/ pha dam pas/ stong nyid ngang du rig pa'i mdung skor bya/ / zhes sogasagasungs pa'ang 'di dang gnad gcig / gsum pa rjes su bsngo bas mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rjes ni phyag chen bsgom pa las/ / zhes sogs sla/ de ltar mnyam bzhag gis bsgoms nas rjes thob tu langs pa na/ de'i rnal 'byoraskyong tshul ni/ de ltar goms nas tshogs drug gi / zhes gsungs te/'jug shes drug la yul gang snang ba na'ang dgag bya'i snang tshul dang ma 'dres pa zhig gtan med pas/ rtsod pa'i tshe 'di la snang ba'i bum pa yod la snang ba ltar gyi bum pa med ces zhib cha 'byed kyang / zhe phugs su bum pa kho rang gi ngos nas tshur grub grub 'dra ba'i snang ba ling nge de gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i steng du bum pa yod la bden grub bam rang mtshan zer ba'e zur du 'gog rgyu zhig yod par bzung na dgag bya gtan nas mi khegs pas da lta'i snang ba 'di ga rang dgag bya'i snang ba yin gsung la/ 'bras spungs gtsang pa dge bshes kyis kyang tha snyad pa'i tshad ma rnams snang ba log shes dang 'dzin stangs la tshad mayin gsungs zhes 'ga' zhig zer/ 'on kyang tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i ngor yod pas yod go chod dgos te/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis kyang rje bla ma la snang phyogs dang stong phyogs gnyis kyi nang nas snang phyogs la rtsis su byed dgos gsungs pa dang / rje bla mas kyang stong nyid la ci tsam nges pa rnyed pa de 429

ro༅/ /gud thang bstan pa'i sgonachu'i gsung 'bum/tsam gyis snang ba rten 'byung gi rnam bzhag la nges pa brtan du 'gro pas snang bas stong pa mi 'gog cing stong pas snang ba mi 'gog par snang stong gnyis phan tshun gcig gcig gi grogs su 'char ba zhig byung na klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs don rnyed pa yin par gsungs te/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i mchod brjod sogs su'ang / stong pa dang rten 'byung don gcig tu gsungs pa 'di ni bstod pa'i sgo bla na med pa dang shin tu ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas yin pas/ de'i sgo nas bsngags pa mdzad pa yin la/rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag 'di la brten nas btags pa'i rten 'brel dang /brten nas byung ba'i rten 'brel gnyis yod pas thal 'gyur ba rang lugs kyi rten 'brel 'jog mtshams phra shos snga ma yin zhes yongs 'dzin gsung /mdor bsdu na/ rje bdag nyid chen pos lam gye gtso bo rnam gsum du/ snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ las dge sdig las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung ba sogs rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i snang phyogs dang / bden grub rnam par bcad pa'i stong pa gnyis po gcig gis gcig la mi gnod par snang bas yod mtha' sel zhing / stong pas med mtha' sel ba snang bzhin du stong la stong bzhin du snang bas snang stong zung 'jug rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam bzang 'di ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin la/ rje bla ma tsong kha ba chen po de nyid kyis kyang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yun ring du bsten te gsol ba shugs drag tu btab/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad/ sngon rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar yang lugs bzang 'di nyid spel ba'i smon lam rlabs po che'i mthu grub pa la brten nas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa 'di nyid ches cher gsal bar mdzad/ 'on 430

/ /dge ldan phyagargya phowa'i khrid kyizinabres/kyangaphyag rgya chen po'i 'khrid tshul 'di ni snyan brgyud kho na las ches cher ma grags pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas rtsa 'grel gnyis ka gsungs te dar rgyas su mdzad cing / de rjes skyid shod zhabs drung ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrinags mdo smad du phebs te/ khong gis kyang spel bar mdzad pas dar rgyas che la/ bar skabs nas phyogs 'dir nyam chag tu song yang / deng sang yongs 'dzin rin po ches 'di'i khrid yang yang gnang ba'i bka' drin gyis thams cad la nyams len ji ltar yin rung / phyag chen zhes don gnyer byed pa 'di byung ba yin/ bdag gis kyang khong chos 'di'i bka' bab yin pa'i rgyu mtshanagyis zhus nas nyams len cher ma thub kyang gshar sbyang tsam re byas pa yin pas ri khrod du sgrub pa nyams len gnang mkhan rnams kyis gtso mdzad tshang mas rgyun par thugs nyams su bzhes te lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa la bag chags ci zebs kyi sgo nas dal 'byor thob pa don ldan du mdzad dgos zhes 'dom par mdzad do/ / phyag chen gyi rim pa'ang / chos thun lngar gnang bas/ dang po la bshad pa tshar gnyis dang phyi ma'i mgor re re ste gsum gsum mdzad/ chos thun gyi mgor sher snying dang bdud bzlog / de nas phyag chen gsol 'debs lhun 'grub sku gsum ma dang maṇḍal/ mjug gi maṇḍal gyi rjes su phyag chen smon lam dang lam rim smon lam/ chos thun gnyis pa'i mgor 'jigs byed kyi gtor mgron bskyed nas/ gtor ma 'bul zhing de rjes chos rgyal gtor 'bul byed/ chos thun tha ma'i rjes su/ tshogs mang nas bla mchod gsung zhing yon tan 'byung gnas kyi mgor/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsungs pa'i tshogs 'khor bkras lhun sngags pod du gsal ba ltar byas te/ de rjes chos rgyal la gtor ma phul/ de nas yon tan 'byung gnas zhes sogs dkyus ltar 'don dgos pas phyag len gyi rim pa 431

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/'di'ang ma 'chol bar byed pa shin tu gal che'o/ / smras pa/ zhal lung byin rlabs nyi ma 'od po che/ / brjed ngas chu 'dzin dra bas bsgrib gyur kyang / /rang bzo'i zin bris me 'od kyis bstod pa/ / thub bstan legs bshad padmo'i dgra ru che/ / de slad dbri bsnan ngal ba ring spangs te/ / ji ltar gsung bzhin lhug par bkod pa yi/ / dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / lam bzang 'di yis myur du grol gyur cig / ces phyag chen gyi khrid rim zin brigasubatab pa 'di ni yongasardzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabasakhrung du khal kha che chen hān gyi bla ma mkha4pa'i dbang po yoshes rgya mtsho pa4'di'i khrid zhusaskabasabadag gisakyang mnosapa lasagasung bshad rags rim dran tshod rnamasarang gi dran pa gsophyir dang / khal kha bla mas kyang zin brisashig ci nas kyang bri dgosazhes bskul ma byung bar brten/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shi4'khyil du bris pa 'digakyang snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa phyog4dusakun tu rgyas par gyur cig / / / bkra shis/ / / /rgyas par na bla ma mchod pa'i mjug tu zhabs sen 'od chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/dngos grub gter chen bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / snying khar sin pas dga' bdes myos pa'i sems/ / gsal stong 'dzin med ma bcos gnyug ma yis/ / kun rtogs gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / skad cig rgyun gye phreng bar rang sems zhes/ / ming brdas phar btags tsam las don steng nas/ / grub pa'i bden dngos cha tsam ma dmigs pas/ / stong pa'i ngang tshul rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / dbyings rig dbyer med don gyi phyag rgya'i mdangs/ / smin legs dga' mar rol ba'i bde ba ches/ /432

༄/ /dge ldan byagargya chenapo'ikhredakyizenabris/bzhin legs rol gar gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'bum/ / 'gyed pas 'gro kunasrid las sgrol par shog / 7bsdu na/ dga' ldan ltabargya ma ltabu'i rjesal/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma nasabastsal du gsol zhe4pa'i mthar/ 7dngos grub gter chen zhe4sbyor/ zhe4pa 'di ni cha har nas lam 'di la mosapa'i phun tshogs dpa' ldan zhes pa'i bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesachosagrwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ / dge'o/ /sarba marga li/ /433

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje bla ma dbyer med kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / / bka' drin gsum ldan rje btsun bla ma mchog / dgyes 'dzum chos 'khor phyag rgyas glegs ral bsnams/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ / dga' ldan lha brgya'i mgon gyi thugs ka nas/ / rab dkar zho gsar spungs 'dra'i chu 'dzin rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ / sras dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshags su gsol/ / mkha' dbyings bzhugs pa'i rje btsun bla ma dang / / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul ngo bo dbyer med par/ / bdag blo dad pa'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ / bstan pa rgyas phyir bskal brgyar bzhugs su gsol/ / shes bya'i khyon kun yangs pa'i blo gros thugs/ / skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur legs bshad gsung / / grags pa'i dpal gyis lham mer mdzes pa'i sku/ / mthong thos dran pa don ldan la phyag 'tshal/ / yid 'ong mchod yon sna tshogs me tog dang / / dri zhim bdug spos snang gsal dri chab sogs/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di/ / bsod nams zhing mchog khyed la mchod pa 'bul/ / gang zhig thog med dus nas bsags pa yi/ / lus ngag yid kyi mi dge bcu bgyis dang / / khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs/ / snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos so sor 434

༄/ /rtsaba'i blam dngarje blam dbyer med kyi blama'irnal 'byor/bshags/ / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang thos sgrub la brtson/ / chos brgyad spangs pas dal 'byor don yod byed/ / mgon po khyod kyi rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ / bdag cag bsam pa thag pas yi rang ngo / / rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ / chos sku'i mkha' la mkhyin brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ / lhun grub chos kyi char ba dbab du gsol/ / bdag gis ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / / khyad par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ / bstan pa'i snying po ring du gsal byed shog / sa gzhi spos kyis ma ra 〉spyod par shog / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /khyod min re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas/ / srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing / / don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas dmigs brtse ma dang / dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje me shel khams/ / mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / thar 'dod snying gi mun sel sgron me mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ zhesapa lta bu grangs bsags te rje bdag nyid chen po dang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med du byas te gsol ba 'debs/ de nas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi snying gar/ zhes sogs dang / mi rtag 'chi ba dran pas rgyud bskul te/ / skyabs 'gro las 'bras bden bzhi'i blang dor dang / / theg mchog sems bskyed spyod dang bcas pa la/ / gegs med tshul bzhin slob par byin gyis rlobs/ / yang dag lta dang nyer 'brel sngags kyi lam/ / rim pa gnyis kyi bgrod pa mthar phyin cing / / mdor na khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyalokyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan 435

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sgron mesabris pa'o/ / / /bla ma mchog gsum chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus/ / 'dis mtshon sde 'dir rnam dkar ci bgyis dang / / dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bsdom byas nas/ / mkha' mnyam bstan 'gro'i dpal du 'gyur ba dang / / khyad par dkom mchog gsum la skyabs 'tshol ba'i/ / dmigs yul de nyid rtag tu dal 'byor thob/ / rnam dag bslab gsum rab brtan 'dzin pa'i gzhir/ / nges legs thar pa'i 'bras bzang smin gyur cig / cesapa 'di ni dgon 'dir drin shin tu che ba dpon po dkon mchog rab brtan gyi ched du dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyasakyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ / / /rgyal kun yab gcig mkhyen gter dkar po dang / / dbyer med thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma mchog / byang chub bar du bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol/ / sdig ltung rmongs pa'i dri ma kun byang zhing / / zab gsal myur pa'i shes rab rgyas pa dang / / sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa mthar son de/ / bla med byang chub thob par byin gyis zlobs/ / skyes pa kun tu zhesasogs bya/ / zhes pa 'di yang dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog dar rgyas kyi bskul ngor/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /436

༄/ /4 rimabade lam gyisargyud 'debs/༄༅/ /lam rim bde lam gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ / mkhas grub bstan pa'i nyi ma dge legs dpal/ / snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin ba so rje/ /zla med bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug sku brnyes chos kyi rdo rje dang / /sku gsum mngon gyur rgyal ba dben sa pa/ /lung rtogs mnga' bdag sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /mkhas grub dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ /de yi thugs sras drung pa rta phug pa/ /lam bzang gsal mdzad dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal/ / bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /mdo sngags legs bshad chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /byams pas 'gro la spel ba'i snying stobs can/ /bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba mtha' yas blo bzang ye shes sogs/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs bshes gnyen du ma yis/ /rjes bzung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs mtha' dag spel slad du/ /rlabs chen smon lam mchog gis bskrun pa'i sku/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /gang la gang 437
༄//yo ca bam pa'i sa'i ga4 stem/'dul bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs / /438

/ /bde lamazinabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/༄༅/ / yongs 'dzin rin po che ye shes rgyal mtshan nas bde lam gyi khrid gnang ba rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dpal bzang pos zin bris su gnang ba gdung sel bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ / brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ / ye shes zhugs kyis srid pa'i tshang tshing bsregs/ / brtse chen bser bus skye ba'i mkha' la rol/ / stobs ldan 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod/ / gang gsung legs bshad rlabs 'phyur thub bstan kun gsal 'gengs ba yis/ /ma dag dri ma rab bkrus skal bzang lha rnams ngoms par mdzad/ / der ni bdagakyang bsod nams skal par blo chung snyim pas ni/ / tshig gi bdud rtsi thob gang brten slad rin chen bum bzang bgyid/ / de yang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ / skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/ / gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ / phyis 'di yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag 439

༄/ /yo ca bayo lo dku g.yo ཿma/rnams res 'ga' yar srid pa'i rtse mo dang / res 'ga' mar dmyal ba'i gting du lhung ste rnam par shes pa 'di 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'dir thog ma med pa nas 'khyams shing / da lam bla ma'i thugs rje las mi'i rten lan cig thob ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yar la khrid pa'i tshe dal 'byora'i snying po mi len par/ tshe 'di'i che thabs 'khor g.yog snyan grags sogs bsgrub par dka' zhing / tha mar 'dor dgos pa'i don med kyi las la 'bad pa ni/ rdo brdar ba'i gtam rgyud dang 'dra ste/ nor bu len pa'i tshong ba rgya mtsho'i gling nas chas pa'i tshe mi zhig rjes su sdod pa la/ grogs rnams kyis khyod nged cag dang 'grogs te ma song na khyod kyis slar grogs mi rnyed pas khyodalha ngam gyi thang 'dir sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro zer ba la/ nga mi 'gro b.rardo brdar rgyu yin zer/ brdar nas ci byed dris pas gru bzhi byed zer/des ci byed dris pas 'di bskyur gyi yin zer ba ltar don med kyi las la chagasanas gtan gyi 'dun ma stor ba yin pas de ltar ma song bar snying po zhig len dgos te/ da lta rang cag yar mngon mtho ye bsgrub/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa e bsgrub/ mar dmyal bar ltung du e 'jug / gang byed kyang 'dam kha rang la yod pa'i dus yin pas/ 'dam kha ma nor ba zhig dgos/ de la yang rgya gar du 'gro ba la rgya gar bya ba gang na yod/ kha gang du bltasanas 'gro / gom pa gang du 'dor shes dgos pa ltar/ 'dir yang dal 'byor la snying po len tshul shes dgos/ de yang lam du 'gro ba la mig yod pas mi chog par/ ston mkhan dgos pa bzhin du bla ma'i man ngag la nges par bsten dgos te/ dpe yod pa tsam gyis shes mi nus shing / thos pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ po ti lnga la bslabs kyang rang la ma bskor ba dang bskor kyangasho rim sogs kyi gnad mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bla ma'i man ngag nyan 44

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/pa nges par gal che ste/ chos grwar blo 'khul ba lta bu gcig pur lo brgyar bsdad kyang mi yong / sngon 'phan yul du phar phyin la mkhas pa'i dge bshes zhig yod pas khong la chos nyan mkhan med/ po to pas bya sgrung gsungs pa tshun chad kun gyis nyan pas/ dge bshes des yang na nga'i phar phyin 'di po to pas bshad chog pa/ yang na nga la nyan chog pa gsungs pa/ po to pas gsan nas khong bden te ngas kha nang du bskor bas yin gsung ba ltar/ kha phyir bltas kye thos pa tsam gyis mi chog pas bsgom tshul gyi man ngag bla ma'i zhal nas thos dgos/ bla mas bshad bya'i chos de yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang mi 'gal/ shing rta chen po'i gzhung dang mi 'gal/ dam pa gong ma'i man ngag dang mi 'gal/ sgro ma btags skur pa ma btab par 'chad dgos te/ dgun dus kyi sngo tshos mdog legs kyang khar zar mi nyan pas gzhan dang mi mthun pa de 'drar ma song ba gal che la/'dir bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i gzhung lam/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi lam srol/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod pa'i skye bo mchog gi chos lugs/ dpal a ti sha dang chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba'i man ngag byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di ni rje bdag nyid chen pos/ rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig / skal bzang thar par bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog / ces gsungs pa ltar/mig chung yang nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad mthong nus pa bzhin du byang chub lam rim 'di la brten nas sde snod gsum dang gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams kyang bde blag tu mthong nus shing skal ldan gyi gdul bya sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs kyang 'di kho na yin te/ stod lung pa'i zhal pha1

༄/ /yo ca bayo lo sa'i ga stem/nas/ ngas lam rim skyo sang sang ba zhig bshad pa na stong gsum gyi glegs bamarnams nged kyi snying du zhugs song snyam du 'dar yong gsungs te/ don 'di la dgongs nas/ gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdu bsdu ba/ /zhes dper na 'o ma yang yang bskol te bskol thag chad pa la bskol bskol zer ba ltar/rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don rje btsun byams mgon gyis rnal 'byor pa gcig gi nyams len gyi rim par bsdus shing / de'i rjes su 'phags pa thogs med dang mnyam med jo po chen po gnyis kyis bsdus la/ de nas slar rje bdag nyid chen pos byang chub lam gyi rim par bsdus te gsung rab rab 'byams kyi gnad ma tshang ba med par 'dus shing de las lhag pa bsdu rgyu med pas/ chos 'di 'dra dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir cis kyang nyan bsam byed dgos te/ da snga yan chad kyi bya ba thams cad las rol song ba yin pas/dani slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag tu gar 'khrab pa sogs la yang ltad mo blta na/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams gshegs pa'i lam 'di la ltad mo'i tshul gyes yang ci'i phyir mi nyan gsung ba ltar sgo du ma nas bsam te nyan dgos/ nyan tshul yang mdo las bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas zhes sogs gsungs kyang / pus mo'i lha nga sa la 'dzugs mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan nged cag bod rnams kyi lus gyong bo las su mi rung ba yin pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gnang ba byin pa yin la/mig bla ma'i bzhugs khri'am zhal gang rung la bltas te/ nad pa nyam thag pas sman pas ci gsung yong snyam du de'i gdong la hrig ge blta ba ltar gus pa dang bcas te nyan pa las/ dpe cha zhu dag byed pa'i tshe tha na ba'i sngon 'jug dang /ga'i sngon 'jug tsam re ma dag pa yang 'phral du bcos pa ltar/ bla ma'i gsung la 'di gzhung dang mthun par 'dug / 'di gzhung dang mi mthun yo2

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/par 'dug zer ba lta bu'i skyon rtog gi rigs gtan mi rung bas skyon de dag dang bral ba'i sgo nas nyan dgos la/ nyan par bya ba'i chos 'di'i thog mar rje btsun bla ma zhes smos la/ 'di la go rgyu bzang po zhig yod de/ rang cag rnams lta ci smos/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa la mnga' 'byor pa 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob pa de dag la yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gdams ngag bstan te kun mkhyen ye shes mngon du byed dgos pas/ legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bla ma sngas mgor yod pa la rag las pa go ba'i ched yin no/ / 'di la 'ga' zhig mdo phyogs su de ltar yin kyang / gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs bsgoms nas 'tshang rgya ba la bla ma mi dgos snyam na/ de 'dra gtan ma yin te/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i rim pa gsum pa las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ / bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ / de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ / ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/sngags kyi rtogs pa mthon po'i skabs su yang bla ma 'bral med du bsten dgos la/ der ma zad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbur 'od dpag med bsgoms pa dang / rje btsun byams pa rang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba shākya thub pa mchod rten gye rnam par spyi bor bkur ba yin zhing / de'i 'og tu thub dbang rdo rje 'chang zhes smos pa ni/ 'dir mdo sngags gnyis ga'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad cha tshang la ma nor bar ston pa go ba'i ched du yin no/ / de nas 'dir skal ldan gyi skyes bu zhes snod ldan gyi gdul bya ngos bzung ba yin la/ 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa'i tshad ni/ dper na rgyung grwar zhugs te de'i chos dang zang zing gi skal ba thob pa la thog mar der 'jug pa'i 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing / mthun rkyen cha tshang bar 'dzoms dgos pa pha3

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i ཿ gotshi stem/ltar/ chos nyan pa'i skal ba thob pa la yang nyan pa po'i snod kyi khyad par thams cad tshang dgos la/ de yang bsdus na snod kyi skyon gsum spangs pa dang mtshan nyid gsum du 'du ba ni/ bon po 'dre mchod pa'i gtam rgyud dang 'dra ste/ sngon bon po rnams tshogs nas 'dre mchod pa na/ grangs bgrangs nas mi tshang ma bgrangs na chad 'gro zer nas kha ma 'cham par/ bon po lha mo thar bya bas/ yar dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ mar 'gro ba rigs drug mchod/bar gyi yul lha gzhi bdag mchod/ der ma 'dus pa yod dam zer te/gtor yul thams cad der 'dus pa bzhin/ snod kyi skyon yon thams cad de drug tu 'dus shing / de la dang po snod kyi skyon gsum las/ snod kha spub pa lta bur ma song bar chos nyan 'dod yod pa yod kyang sgod dri ma can du ma song ba shin tu dkon te/ byang chub lam rim nyan pa gnad du song ste blo skyed cig nges par byung ba yin na ga re ngas nyi ma de ring yan chad chos byed khul byas kyang chos rnam dag tu song ba gcig kyang mi 'dug / da ni rang gi rang ma bslusapar chos byed tshul ma 'chug pa zhig byed dgos par 'dug snyam du blo gting nas 'gyur ba zhig yong / de byung na blo skyed byung ba yin/ de 'dra ma yin par rgyal ba gong mas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gnang skabs 'phan po zhig la/ 'ga' zhig gis khyod la blo skyed byung ngam dris pas tshad med byung zer/ gang byung zhes dris pas/ rma'i bya mkhar zer ba de nga tsho'i lhun grub rdzongs yin pa red ngo mtshar la zer/ de yin yang yin du chug / min na'ang min du chug khyad ci yod/ don med pa de 'drar ma song bar blo skyed len shes pa dmas/ de'i 'og tu snod kyi mtshan nyid gsum ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ / nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/ /cesagasungs pa ltar yin/ de yang gzu bor gnas pa ni/ blo phyogs su ma 444

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/lhung ba la zer zhing / de yang go dka' ste ji ltar yin na da lta rang 'dod 'ba' zhig bsgrubs shing bsgrub kyang nus pa dang / bla mas bkod pa rnams bsgrub yang mi 'dod la/ sgrub dka' ba ltar 'dug pa 'di blo rang gi phyogs su btang bas lan pa yin pas/ de las bzlog ste rang phyogs su mi gtong bar/ bla ma'i phyogs su gtong ba zhig dgos pa yin/ de nas mtshan nyid gnyisapa legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa yang nges par dgos te/de med na ci byas kyang phyin ci log tu 'gro ba sngon glen pa zhig la phas bslabs nas sgo la be to red kyes byas pas shing mthong tshad la de zer te lhag tu glen rtags bstan pa lta bu yin/ gsum pa chos la don gnyer yod pa yang dka' ste/ kha nas chos la don gnyer yod/ drag zer mod kyang / de tsam gyis mi yong / mtsho 'khyag pa na ngang ba phyi mig tsam yang mi blta bar 'gro ba bzhin/'khor ba la phyi mig mi blta bar rgyab kyis phyogs te thar ba don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa zhig dgos/ de la 'ga' zhig gis da lta bstan pa nyams pa'i tha mar bsgom byas kyang de 'dra mi yong / des na sgom byed pa las bskor ba dang kha ton gyis zer ba shin tu mi rung ste/ bstan pa'i tha ma cung zad tsam la thug pa'i skabs 'di la mi byed na/ bstan pa nub nas ci byed/ des na da lta lhag tu 'bad dgos pa'i dus yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la ko'u dī n+ya'i skye ba'i dge slong gcig dang bcas pa'i dge slong bcu drug ri bo ril ba'i dbyibs su song ste bsam gtan dang klog pa la brtson par gnas pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis 'od srung mya ngan las 'das nas zhag bdun lon te bstan pa'ang nub na/ khyed cag 'bras bu med pa'i spun pa 'phyar bas ci rung zhes sbran pas/ lnga de ma thag tu grong du babs/ drug gi rang byung chub mngon dukhyas/ phyis lnga yang grong du chas pas lam gar tshong pa zhig gi glang nyam chung la5

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/bas 'gro mi nus par res dbyug pas bsnun/ res sna nas khrid 'gro ba la/de dag gis khyod de 'dra byas na glang shi yong / dal bus rjes nas song zhig byas pas/ khyed rnams de skad ma zer/ nga mgron pos bor song zer/ khong rnams kyi thugs la 'dis kyang bskul ma btab par 'dug / nged rnams sangs rgyas 'od srung nyan thos dang bcas pas bor bar snang bas da ni rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das kyang / tshul khrims mya ngan las ma 'das pas brtson 'grus brtsams par bya'o snyam ste smras pa/ thub pa chen po 'od srung gi / gal te chos ni nub gyur kyang / / yang dag sangs rgyas kyes bshad pa'i/ / brtson 'grus dor bar mi bya'o/ / zhes slar yang ri la bsgom pa na bzhi shi nas ko'u dī n+ya gcig pur lus pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam du/ kye ma sangs rgyas 'od srung dge slong nyi khri dang bcas pa mthong na/ da 'dzam gling na snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bdag gcig pur lus pa ltar bdag gis tshe 'dir yon tan cung zad kyang ma thob kyi/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la dgra bcom mngon du byasate snam sbyar gye rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog tu lung ston par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa'i don bzhin du 'grub pa lta bu yin pas bstan pa'i tha ma 'di 'dra la lhag par snying stobs bskyed de bsgom pa la don gnyer byed pa gal che'o/ / de lta bu'i mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i gdul bya de nyid sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa'i thabs zab mo byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid la gnyis/ lam gye rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang / bsten nas blo spyangs pa'i rim pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ thun gye ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba dang /thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la/ spyor dngos 'jug gsum/ dang po spyor ba la yang spyor ba'i chos drug las/dang po ni/ gnas khang byi dor byas shing sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram 446

/ /bde lamazinabresabadudabyu'i thigasapa/pa ste/ 'di la kun slong gi khyad par yang bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi zhing ltar lngan ljin med pa gsal zhing yid du 'ong bar gyur cig snyam du bsam na sangs rgyas kyi zhingaspyong du 'gro ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs rnam par dag pa la bkod pa'i 'azin las kyi skabs su 'grel bshad tshig gsal du dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo drangs te sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su spyongs par 'dod pas ni/ rang gi sems yongs su sbyang par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/der ma zad 'dul ba lung las/ phyag dar gyi phan yon lnga gsung zhing / de'i sgo nas grub pa thob pa yang lam chung pa lta bu yin te/ sngon bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs pa'i 'phags pa gnas brtan lam brtan la nu bo lam chung pa'am lam phran brtan bya ba zhig byung ste/ bram ze'i lugs la thog mar/ oṃ bhu ru zu ba swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags slob pa'i srol yod pa ltar bslab ba na khong ha cang rtul bas oṃ brjod dus thu brjed/ zu brjod dus oṃ brjed pas bram ze3mas kyis phu bo'i drung du bskyal/ phu bos klog sogs bslabs pas gang yang ma lob pas khyod 'dra bas dge 'dun gyi dad rdzas mi 'ju zhes phyir bton pa na khong yid skyo nas/ da nga dge sbyong dge spyong ma yin/ bram ze bram ze ma yin zhes ngus pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen yang ma mkhyen pa ltar mdzad nas khyod ci la ngus dris pas/ bdag phu bos phud de bdag khyim pa yang ma lags/rab tu byung ba yang ma lags zhus pas/ khyod kyi phu bos bstan pa 'di sgrub pa yang ma yin/ grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa yang ma yin pas/ nga'i rjes la 'gro gsung bar bdag tshig gcig kyang mi zin lags zhus pas/phyags ma rgyag shes sam gsung / shes lags zhus pas rdul spong dri ma spong bya ba 'bad bas slob tu bcug ste/ de 'don bzhin du dge 'dun gyi rkun dga' pha7

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i me'i ga4 ཿma/ra bar gad rgyag tu bcug go / de'i tshe shar ngos phyag pa na nub rdul gyis gang / nub ngos phyag pa na shar rdul gyis gang ste mi zad bar byin gyis brlabs kyang ston pa'i bka' yin snyam du 'bad pas phyed phyag pa'i tshod tsam na sgrib pa dag pa'i dbang gis 'di snyam du ston pas don med pa zhig mi gsungs pas 'di la dgongs gzhi zhig yod 'gro snyam du dpyad pas/ rdul 'di sa rdul ma yin 'dod chags rdul/ / rdul 'di sa rdul ma yin zhe sdang rdul/ / rdul 'di sa rdul ma lags gti mug rdul/ / zhes sogs kyi don du go nas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba dug gsum dang / de'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin du shes shing / de'i zhen yul drungs phyung ste gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyedanas phyags ma lag par thogs bzhin du bden pa mthong ba lta bu yin pas thog mar gnas khang byi dor byas/ de'i rjes su sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams legs par bkram zhing 'di la sangs rgyas kyi sku re 'bral spang gi tshul du nges par dgos te/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang shākya'i btsun pa gsungs pa ltar rang cag sangs rgyas kyi mi yin pa'i brda mtshon byed yang yin/ dper na cun gar hong the ji'i dmag mi rnams kyis gzhan la mgo mi 'dogs/ hong the ji'i mi yin zer ba'i brdar des gnang ba'i mda'i dar tshon can re 'dzin pa yin zer ba'i dpe dang 'dra/ de ltar thub pa'i sku re 'chang na mi ma yin sogs kyis glags mi rnyed pas bsrung ba'ang de las zab pa med de/ bsrung ba zab zab 'dra ba gzhan la nges pa mi yongs a na le'i dpe la 'gro nyen yod de/sngon mi zhig gi nga'i lug la skyon mi 'ong / a na le btags yod zer/ rjes nas spyang kis lug bsad pasagazhan zhig gis a na le gang byas dris pas/a na le rang yang chom chom du zos nas mi 'dug zer ba lta bu 'ong bas bsrung bgang byung gis mi chog / mtshams tho bya ba yang bar chad bsrung ba'i ched 448

༄/ /bde lamazinabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/yin pas 'di 'dra'i skabs su phyogs bzhir mtshams tho re re nges par btsug / de yang rgyal po chen po bzhir bskyed de/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gis byang chub lam rim bsgom pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad rnams 'di'i nang du mgatong zhig / de'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad sgrubs shig ces 'azin las bcol/ rab byung na rgyal sras dngul chu chos rdzong pa'i mtshams tho 'dra ba dgos te/ khong gis rim pa gsum bzhag nas phyi ma 'di tshun chad du tshe 'di'i snang shas skad cig tsam yang mngon du gyur te shi gyur na chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyis nga de ma thag tshar chod cig / de bzhin du bar ma tshun chad du bdag 'dzin 'gong bo/ nang ma tshun chad du rang don yid byed kyi blo mngon du gyur te shi gyur na dam can chos srung rnams kyis tshar chod cig ces 'azin las bcol ba yin/ nga rang tshos mtshams tho 'jog lugs ni/ bla ma byams pa'i gsung las/ rang res nang du bsam ngan 'ba' zhig bsam ste/nang 'dir byams snying rje sogs yod na mi 'grig go zhes don gyis chos la mtshams tho bzhag pa 'dra bar 'dug gsungs pa lta bur ma song ba dgos/gnyis pa mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa la/ 'dir g.yo med pa zhes pa yang ku yang por byas na gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi bar 'di'i skabs kyi g.yo la yong bas gnad shin tu zab pa yin/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gis de 'dra yin na lam rim 'di ha cang rgya che bas yongs mi 'dug zer ba ni/ ang thung ba'i rtags yin te bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas/nga tshos mi tshe hril po la bsgoms kyang ma 'ong ba de/ khyed tshos chos thun gcig gnyis zhig la yongs na ltas ngan yin gsungs pa ltar yin te/ dper na ka khanas bzung ste sgra'i rnam dbye tshun chad la mkhas par sbyangs pa'i drung yig mkhasapa'i drung du/ snyu gu tsam yang 'dzin mi shes pa'i gsar du yi ge slob pha9

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ispronaba'i gsung 4ma/mkhan zhig gis de ring nga rang yig mkhan de 'dra zhig byed dgos snyam partse gang yang mi yong bas ngang bsring ste goms na 'grub pa yin/ bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas kyang / ngas lam rim tshar bdun nyan pas bsgom tshul lhu 'grig tsamabyung gsung ba lta bu yin/ ngang ma bsring na la gsum rgyab pa'i dpe la 'gro nyen yod de/ sngon bsam yas su la gsum rgyab pa zer ba zhig byung ba rtsod pa pham pas nga rgya gar paṇa chen zhig gi drung du gtugs dgos par 'dug zer te/ chos grwa de nas 'phral du thon te bsam yas mda'i mchod rten dkar chung zer ba'i bar du phyin nas phyir log pa lta bur ma song ba dgos/ de bzhin du tha na phyags ma brgyag tshul yan chad la yang nyon mongs pa'i ljan ljen nas bzung gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi bar rnams phyags rgyu'i phyag ma dang / de phyag tshul sogs bsam na de tsam la yang bstan pa'i gnad thams cad 'du bas gru bzhi lam du 'khyer shes pa zer ba'i don bzhin 'ong bas bsam pa'i khyad par de lta bu la rim gyis slob dgos/ de'i rjes su bkod pa mdzes pa ni/ gang ma che ba/ kha ma dmas pa/ ting gi kha'i ri mo'i tshod tsam zhig tu 'ong ba dgos te/ gang che na thos bsam sogs byed pa'i tshe sems mi brtan pa dang / dma' na longs spyod kyis phongs par 'gyur bas tshod ran pa dang / de yang paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis mchod ting la lag rjes babs na legs par phyis/ spos kyis bdug ste mchod pa 'bul ba'i phyag bzhes ltar gtsang sbras thon pa shin tu gal che/ 'di la ma 'byor na mtha' gcig tu li ting dgos ba'i nges pa med/ rje sgrub khang bas khong gi gsol phor yang yang bkrus te mchod pa phul/ rang la dgos pa'i tshe g.yar po'i tshul du zhus nas bzhes pa lta bu yin pas bsam pas 'grub na mchod pa'i yo byad kyis mi thogs pas/ lan grangs yang drug gam/ ma mtha' gsum re ma phul 450

༄/ /bde lamazinabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/na ri khrod pa'i rkang drang ba yin pas mchod pa legs par bsham mo/ / gsum pa bde ba'i stan la lus 'dug lugs brgyad dam/ spyod lam gang bder gnas nas rang rgyud la legs par brtags te dge sems khyad par can gyis ngang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba ni/ dper na sngon ston pa thugs rje can gyes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i tshe sa phal bas mi theg pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis de'i 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pas/ mtshan yang rdo rje gdan zhes gragasapa der ngas bdud bye ba 'bum phrag bcu btul te sangs rgyas ma thob bar du stan 'di las mi ldang ngo zhes dam bcas pa ltar rang cag rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / 'bol gdan bde ba'i 'og tu g.yung drung g.yas skor du 'brib rten 'brel gyi gnad che ste/ rgya skad la badzra zhes pa bod skad du rdo rje dngagayung drung gnyis gar 'jug kyang 'dir g.yung drung du bsgyur ba yin pas stan de lta bu la 'khod de/ 'di snyam du ga re/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ phar ltos dpon med tshur ltos g.yog med cing / / 'dul rgyu dgra med skyongs rgyu'i gnyen med par/ / dben pa'i gnas su rang sems mi 'dul na/ / khyod la bya rgyu ci yod ma ṇi pa/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten gye bya ba thams cad bzhag nas/ tshe la tshad bzung ste byang chub lam rim 'di kho na rang ye yong zhig lta dgos par 'dug /'jig rten yang gra ma chag tsam zhig dang / de'i steng nas chos zhig kyang byed dgos snyam du rkang pa gnyis 'dzugs byas pas gang yang mi yong par snang bas/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thunga'adi la chos lam rim 'di rang yong ba zhig bya ste/ dang por tshe 'di'i snang shas/ de nas bdag 'dzin 'gong po/ de nas gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i 451

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gsung 'bum/bar thams cad gzhoms par bya'o snyam du dam bcas te/ kun slong de lta bu'i sgo nas dge sbyor la 'jug pa zhig byung na/ bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas/ kun slong rang la lam rim yongs su rdzogs pa yin zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin la/'di ni rgyal ba byams pas kyang / nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi skabs nas/ dang por ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal zhi pa'i zhi ba dang / de nas nyon mongs mtha' dag zhi ba'i zhi ba dang / de nas kyang rim gyis khrid de rang don yid byed kyang spangs nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub par gsungs pa dang gnad gcig la/ dpal ldan zla bas kyang sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'dzig rten dang / / snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu sna tshogs 'god/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad sems kyi 'phrul yin pas/ thog mar kun slong bcos pa shin tu gal che la/ kun slong gi khyad par yang / sgom pa rin chen bla ma'i gsung las/ lam rim 'di khag mdog kha mo yod de/ khag rgyu mi 'dug / go rgyu tshig gsum red/ mig rgya bsring / yid rgya bskyed/ khong so glod gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar 'phen pa gtong ba'i tshe dmigs rgya bsring ste ya gi sangs rgyas kyi sa la dmigs pa yin na/ de dang mthun pa'i bshes gnyen yang nges 'byed cha mthun gyi skabs su yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par 'phags par bshad pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig dang /grogs kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi skabs nas bshad pa lta bu zhig tshol zhing mngon mtho dang thar ba sogs des zhar byung du yogrub 'gro ba yin te/ dper na bar khams dang / chab mdo dang / rgya nag tu 'gro 'dod pa'i tshong pa gsum lam grogs kyang de dang de'i bar du 'gro ba re tshol zhing / thung ngu rnamasalam ring po'i zhar la 'gro ba lta bu yin pas/ de lta bu'i dge sems khyad par can zhig gsal btab ste/ de'i ngang nas skyabs yul gsal 452

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudabyu'i thigasapa/'debs tshul yang 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs las bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba ltar byon pa'i mos pa byed par gsungs kyang / 'dir rang gi mdun gyi thad drang gi nam mkha'i gnas su seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la gtso bo rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs skyabs yul rnams tshig ris ltar mdun na bzhugs bzhin pa gsal 'debs pa yin la/ 'on kyang po ti rnams rang rang gi mdun du bzhugs par tshig zin la gsungs kyang gsal 'debs pa'i tshe g.yas phyogs su padma'i sdong bu la bdud rtsi'i zil ba khrom me ba yig 'bru rnams kyang rang sgra sgogs shing bdud rtsi 'dzag bzhin pa zhig gsal btab skyabs yul rnams kyang rang la dgyes pa'i mos pa byed/ 'di la bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams nged cag la thugs dga' nas dgyes pa min/ sdug drag nas brtse bas ma bzod par dgyes pa yin te nga sngon gtsang la song skabs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis khong lo rgas pas khyod kyis 'di tsho la lam rim yag po zhig shod gsungs nas bshad pas/ de nas paṇa chen gyis rgyun par gzims chung nas dbu tog tsam tog tsam re gzigs pa la/gzhan rnams paṇa chen zhabs 'chag gnang ba red zer yang ngas dpag pa na da ci drag nga ni na so rgas song / khong tsho ni gang byas kyang 'dren nus pa rang mi 'dug snyam du thugs kyis ma bzod par 'dug gsungs pa lta bu yin/ bla ma rin po che de skabs dgung lo bcu bdun yin zhing lam rim gsan pa'i thog mde yin kyang thugs la de las 'jag pa ma byung gsungs/ yang bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ dgyes rgyu chen po med de cung zad yod/ de ci yin na/ sngon thog ma med pa nas ngan song gsum du 'khyams te dge blo cung zad tsam yang skye rgyu ma byung ba la/ da res mi lus lan cig thob/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal nas ma mtha' bsgom khul tsam byas te bcos ma tsam 453

༄/ /yo ca bam yo ce' ga4 ཿma/gyes kyang / ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bdag gis 'god bar bya'o zhes pa'i tshig tsam zer shes pa byung ba yang ya mtshan che/ da ni blun po chu sna 'dra ba rgod pa'i kha la bltas na rgod bro/ ngu ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro ba/ blo skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur 'gro ba yin pas bcos ma 'di tsam zhig bsgom song na mthar dga' mo e yong snyam du dgyes pa yin gsungs/ de ltar skyabs yul rnams gsal btab ste/ de dag gi mdun du gtso bo rang nyid dang / g.yas g.yon du tshe 'di'i pha ma sogs dang / de dag gi mtha' bskor du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sprug shig ge yod pa'i mos pa byas te skyabs 'gro byed dgos/ skyabs 'gro byed pa yang dga' dga'i rtsed mo lta bus mi yong bas/ rnam par shes pa srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar du 'khor tshul mig mchi ma kor re sems 'jigs ye re ba zhig gi ngang nas/ bla ma'i skyabs su mchi'o zhes sogs thun mong ba'i skyabs 'gro sngon du btang ste/sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / zhes sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro byed dgos/ phyi ma 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / dper na bza' tshang gi bdag po sa gzhan la mgo 'dren zhu ba na/rang gcig pu tsam zhig ma yin par/ nged bza' tshang ltos bcas thams cad khyed kyis shes zer pa ltar/ 'dir yang rang gcig pu'i don ma yin par/ sems can thams cad kyis ched du byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su song bas skyabs 'gro thun mong ma yin pa la song ba yin/ de ltaraskyabs su song ba'i mthar thub dbang las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang la thim/ rang thub ba'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis bzhengs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa byas te/ sems 454

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/bskyed 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du bsgom pa 'di byin rlabs kyi khyad che zhing /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la bag chags 'jog pa'i dgos pa shin tu chen po'ang yod do/ / sems bskyed 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul 'di tsam zhig dbangam thob pa rnams la yang / gsang sgrogs su mi 'gro ste/ sher phyin gyi mdor yang sher mdo gsungs pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis sku las 'od zer spro bsdu byas pas snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te skad cig ma de la sdug bsngal mtha' dag rgyun chad par gsungs pa dang / rgyan las kyang / sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du/ / snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa/ / de la dag par sgrub pa yis/ / zhes snod bcud gnyis ka sbyangs par gsungs pa sogs mdo phyogs su yang tshul de tsam zhig gsungs pa mang du yod pas skyon med la/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing / de'i mthar skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing 'di la bsdu ba dang mi bsdu ba'i lugs gnyis yod kyang / byin rlabs kyi khyad kyis bsdus na legs pas bsdu tshul yang 'od kyi rnam par zhu ste smin mtshams su bsdus na der ye shes kye spyan yod pa byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas gnad shin tu che'o/ / bzhi pa tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ sngar bzhin du gser las grub pa'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa seng chen brgyad kyis btegs pa/seng ge rnams kyang ri mor bris pa lta bu min par dngos gnas pa dbugs nyem ltemakhyed pa re gsal 'debs dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan bcom ldan 'das thun mong ba ltar na rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas kyang / thun mong ma yin pa ltar na 'og min du sa sa rgyas te dang por rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpal rnams kyis seng ge'i rnams bzung ba yin la/ de lta bu'i khri de'i dbus su seng khri chung ba zhig la sngar ltar rgyal ba shākya thub pa gsal btab/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rgyab 455

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sa'i ga4 4ma/kyi steng phyogs su 'phros pa'i rtse mor rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la 'brom ston la sogs pa'i nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud dam/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ mdun du 'phros pa'i rtse mor rtsa ba'i bla ma la chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ dpung ba'i thad kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'phros pa'i rtse mor rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gral shar re re byas te zhal thub dbang la phyogs nas bzhugs pa'i spyan zur gyes rang la gzigs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / de'i phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi kha phyir phyogs te bar chad bsrung ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa gsal 'debs pa 'di la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams ma 'dus pa med pas bka' gdams pa rnams yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa yin/ tshogs zhing de rnams kyang sku 'dra dang bris sku lta bu ma yin par/ ston pa yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs gsung bzhin pa dang / byams pa yang shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni zhes sogs dang / 'jam dbyangs yang stong pa nyid kyi sgra lhang lhang gsung bzhin pa de lta bu thams cad la legs par gsal 'debs dgos pa yin la/ de dag gi phyi rol tu gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa 'ga' zhig tshur bsdu zhing 'ga' zhig phar spro ba dper na rgyal po'i mi 'ga' zhig don 'grub nas 'ong ba dang / la la phar 'gro ba lta bu sbrul pa sne 'dzing bas nam mkha'i khams gang bar spro ba/ de dag thams cadakyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po sogs gsal btab ste/ bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang 456

༄/ /bde lamazenabri bdudabyu'i thigasapa/byedatshul yang / rgyud bla ma las gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes lnga'i nang nas me long ye shes gzugs su shar ba spyi po'i oṃ dkar po yin pas de las bdud rtsi 'bebasasbyang byas pas/ rang gzhan gyi nad gdon zhi ba sogs zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub cing / sor rtogs ye shes kyi ngo bo gsung rdo rje'i sa bon mgrin pa'i ā dmar po las dbang dang / de bzhin du thugs ga'i hūṃ sngon po las drag po dang / rin 'byung gi sa bon lte ba'i swā ser po las tshe bsod rgyas pa dang / gsang ba'i hā ljang gu las las rab 'byams 'grub pa yin pas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang 'di shin tu gnad che'o/ / 'dir bdud rtsi'i skad dod amṛ ta zhes pa'i mṛ 'chi ba la 'jug cing / a dgag tshig yin pas de nyid as bkag ste 'chi ba med pa la 'jug pa yin/ bdud rtsi 'bobs sbyang gi gdams pa 'di las zab ba brgyud la yang med pas 'di legs par bskyang na dbang sdud sogs la yang lha mo rig byed ma'i me tog gi mda' gzhu las kyang 'di zab pa yin/ des na byang chub lam rim gyi nyams len 'di gnad du 'gro ba zhigabyung na/ gzhan su la yang re mi dgos te/ dper na sngon 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhing la gshegs nas bka' gdams sku mched gsum grongatshog sogs la mi pheb par dam bcas te phan tshun gcig gis gcig mi spong bar bzhugs pa'i dus lan cig po to ba'i rmi lam du/ nor bu tshong mkhan byung pas nyo dgos dgongs tsa na rang gi a 'bag tu nor bu rin thang med pa mang po 'dug pa mthong ste/ nga la 'di 'dra yod bzhin du ci la nyo snyam nas ma nyos sad nas de rang bden/ nga la 'brom gyi gdams pa mngon mtho sgrubabyed kyi thabs yang yod/ der ma zad thar pa bsgrub na yang nga la yod/thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub na yang nga la yod pas gzhan las ci btsal dgongs pa lta bu yin/ yang skabs 'dir bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka 457

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/nas 'od zer 'phros te ye shes pa rnams spyan 'dren par mdzad pa la dgos pa ci yod/ thub dbang rtag tu bzhugs pa ma yin nam/ zhe na 'di'i dgos pa ni/ mi phal cher gyis bsam pa la rgyal ba 'od dpag med de bde ba can bya ba'i thag ring po zhig na bzhugs yod snyam pa dang / byams mgon yang ya gi ri rab kyi rtse mo thag ring zhig na bzhugs pas/ 'di nas bos kyang mi gsan snyam pa lta bu'i log rtog 'char ba bzlog pa'i ched du spyan 'dren byas te badzra sa mā dza zhes sogs brjod tshe nga rang gi mdun na bzhugs yod snyam pa skye ba'i dbangagis de ltar byas pa yin gyi spyan ma drangs yang thub dbang mdun na bzhugs pa rigs pa dri ma med pas 'grub pa yin te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyang / / shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pas ma khyab pa'i shes bya med la/ des gar khyab tu ye shes de nyid sdod sa'i rten zhig dgos pas/skus khyab pa yin na rang re'i mdun na yang ci'i phyir med/ de yang sngon byung gi dpe dang sbyar na go bde bas/ de'i tshul ni/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis byams mgon lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs kyang zhal ma gzigs pas/ thugs skyo nas phyir thon pa na khyi mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng ba zhig gzigs te/ snying rje tshad med pa zhig 'khrungs nas ga re 'bu bsal na 'bu 'chi/ ma bsal na khyi 'chi bar 'dug dgongs nas rang gi brla sha sru gris bcad de der 'bu rnams gzhug bzhed de spyan btsum nas ljags kyis 'bu rnams blangs ba'i phyir btsal ba na ma rnyed/ spyan phye bas byams mgon 'od 'dom gang ba zhig bzhugs pa mthong nas/ yus kyi ngus te/ rje btsun thugs rje re chung / ngas de tsam bsgrubs kyang zhal mi ston pa zhus pas/ nga khyod dang 'bral ma myong ste khyod las sgrib che bas nga ma mthong ba yin gsungs pa lta bu dang / tsachu go mis 458

༄/ /bde lamazenabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/dbu la spyan ras gzigs bzhugs pa thams cad la bstan kyang sus ma mthong ba lta bu yin la/ de ltar spyan drangs khrus gsol ba dgos pa shin tu che ste/mi'i rigs la dad pa bzang po yod kyang / sems la mun pa babs pa ltar gang yang mi 'char ba zhig dang / dbang po rno yang dad pa med pa gnyis yod pa las snga ma dkor sgrib yin pas de sbyong ba la yang 'di las zab pa med/khrus gsol byed tshul yang re 'ga' tshogs zhing rnams khrus khang du babs nas khrus mdzad de nag nog thams cad bkrus nas rang gral du bzhugs pa dang /re 'ga' me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la rang gi thad ka nas lha mo rnams kyi 'ga' zhig gis bum pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis me long bzung ste khrus gsol ba gang byas kyang rung ngo / / lnga pa bsags sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yanalag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'bul ba la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ mdo sde las dge slong dag / dge slong gis 'di ltar yan lag thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal te sems dang bar byed pa la ltos/ dge slong dag lus 'dis ji tsam non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong na dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar phye ma ji snyed yod pa de snyed du 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid stong 'gyur du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs la/ bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas kyang / 'di 'dra la bltas na rkang lag kyang 'di las ring tsam yod na snyam pa skye bar 'dug gsungs pa dang /der ma zad phyag 'tshal ba mtshan bzang gi rgyur 'gyur zhing dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu chud pa'i rtags kyang yin te/ dper na 'jig rten na dmag 'thab pa'i tshe dmag phyag phul ba dang / pha rol pos kyang rang gi mnga' 'og turangs te kho nga'i mi yin zhes bdag tu 'dzin pa lta bu yin/ phyag 'tshal lugs kyang rje sgrub khang pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma la rdul gtsub pa 'dra ba ma byed 459

༄/ /ca ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i ga4 4ma/gsungs shing / bla ma byams pas kyang khyed tsho'i phyag 'tshal lugs de brang brdung nas da ci drag zer ba 'drar 'dug gsungs pa de ltar ma song ba phyag 'tshal lugs la mkhas par bya dgos/ rje mi la yang brag phugagazhig tu rang bsdad pa min/ phyag lta bu'i nyams la yang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yod de/ rngog chos rdor gyis/ 'chad pa po nga nyan po nga zhes sogs/ kye rdor brtagasaganyis kyi gleng gzhi 'chad pa'i tshe rje btsun mi las rgyang ring po nas brkyang phyag btsal bas/ rngog gis bod glen pa la de 'dra'i phyag mi yongs/rwa ro paṇa chen gyi phyag lta bu byung gsungs pa ltar bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyis kyang phyag thugs dam gyi mthil du bzhes pa yin/ rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang stod lung du sde snod 'dzin pa bdun brgya tsam la 'chad nyan mang du mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can 'di rnams la/ / bshad pas phan thog chen po ga la 'gyur/ / de bas bsgrub pa lhur blang dben pa bsten/ / rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ / zhes bskul ba dang mnyam du mtho mtho rlung la bskur/dma' dma' chu la bskur ste 'ol kha bsam gtan gling du phebs nas ltung bshags so lnga re la thun re mdzad de brkyang phyag 'tshal/ rdo'i maṇḍal yang mang du phul bas phyag ngar la rma mang du bton/ de nas ring bo ma lon par thog mar klu dbang rgyal po'i zhal gzigs/ de nas rim gyis sangs rgyas so lnga dang paṇa grub mang po'i zhal gzigs/ de bzhin du paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyang phyag thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad la/ bla ma byams pa'i gsung las kyang /mi tsho ni mtshan mo yang tsog pur bsdad/ de nas gnyid chung rang brgyab/ de 'dra byed kyi yod pa red/ nga ni dge spyor shi min gson min de 'dra byed kyi med/ jarkyang phyag wa mo 'khyug pa 'dra ba sum brgya re btsal te rkang lag 460

༄/ /bde lamathinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/brkyang nas nyal sdod kyi yod gsungs pa bzhin/ sku na shin tu bgres pa'i dus na'ang phyag la de tsam gyis brtson pa mdzad pa yin/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gis phyag 'tshal ba sogs dbang po rtul po'i lugs srol yin/ dbang non gyis sems kyis dge sbyor byed pa yin zer ba gtan nas mi rigs ste/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag / zhes pa nas/ 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba 'od shin tu gsal ba zhes bya ba rab tu byed de/ mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba de la sems dang po bskyed pa yan chad sa dgu pa thob pa'i bar dag gis de bzhinagashegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro byas pa brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes sogs kyis sa gong ma gong ma'i skabs su lus ngag gi dge sbyor yang ches gong 'phel du 'gro bar gsungs shing / byang sa las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' de la de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzim cha dang / gdan dang /snyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad rnams dang / gus par smra ba dang / phyag 'tshalab dang / sngon du ldang ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / zhes pa nas byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa rnams pa bdun rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ / zhes phyag dang mchod pa 'di dag rgyal sras rnams kyi nyams len du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de nas maṇḍal zhes pa bod skad du bsgyur na zhing khams la 'jug cing / de'i dmigs pa skyong ba la 'jig rten gyi tshul shes dgos pas/ de yang bskal ba 'di'i gong du bskal ba 'dzin pa zhes bya ba stong ste/ rlung spu 'gul ba tsam yang med par nam mkha' stong sang du gnas pa'i tshe gtsang ma'i gnas nas rlung byung ste rlung rnams 'khrigs te rlung gi dwakyil 'khor rdo rje pha lam gyis kyang ri mo tsam bri bar mi nus pa lta bu de'i steng 461

༄/ /༅ ca bayo lo ce' gatshi ཿma/du gnas gtsang ma'i gnas nas char gyi rgyun babs pa rgya mtshor 'khyil ba bsrub pa las khams rab las ri rab dang / 'bring las gser gyi ri bdun bre chen gyi nang du bre chung bcug pa ltar yod cing / de'i phyi rol tu ba tshwa can gye rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'thung ba tsam gyis lce 'gas par 'gyur ba yod la/ de'i mtha' bskor khams tha ma las grub pa'i 'khor yug gi lcags ris bskor ba'i nang du gling dang gling phran rnams kyis rtsa ba gser gye sa gzhi la thug pa'i rtse mo bag tsam steng du thon te/ mtha' chus bskor ba'i bar gyi skam la gling zhes grags pa yin/ tshul de ltar 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya po gser gzhi gcig gi steng du rnga'i steng na rnga yab kyis bsil ba gtor ba ltar yod cing de dag gi longs spyod kyi gtso bo rin po che'i ri bo sogs yin pas gling rang rang du 'god dgos la/ 'khor lo sogs kyang 'khor bsgyur de nyid tshes bco lnga la kha sharadu 'khor te 'dug pa'i tshe 'khor lo shar nas 'byung ba sogs yin pas phyogasade dang de'i steng gi nam mkha' la gsal 'debs pa yin/ 'di yan chad rgyud sde las gsal bar gsungs shing / kun rig gi lha mo 'ga' zhig bcug pa 'di 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas bod kyi mnga' bdag gnang pa'i tshe bcug pa yin la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi maṇḍal ni/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyes/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig po 'di yin/ 'bul tshul yang dang po gling bzhi ri rab tsam dang / de nas rim gyis stong gsum sogs 'bul ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa/ / yongs su bzung pa med pa de dag kun/ / blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog / sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / mi las kyang mar ba la dngos po cung zad yod pa phul nas de'i steng du lus ngag yid gsum maṇḍal du phul te maṇḍal de yo2

༄/ /bde lamazenabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/las lhag pa med pas de 'dra la yang rim gyis blo sbyong dgos/ 'di la thog mar maṇḍal byed tshul yang nang du ba byung lnga'am/ de ma byung na sa gtsang ma'i rtsa dang me tog sogs kyis 'tsho ba'i 'bri'i lce ba dang / chu sar ma lhung ba dang /zho 'o ma mar lnga sbyar bas byugs/ maṇḍalagyi 'bru rnams kyang dri bzang gis kha bsgyurate tshom bu 'god tshul yang / shar rang dang bla ma gang rung la bstan kyang khyad med de/ bla ma byams pas/ 'bul rog byas na de rang rtags gsungasalta bu yin la/ maṇḍal phul ba'i phan yon yang / jo bo chen pos mu stegs gdugs bcu gsum pa zhig dang brtsad pa na sgra'i dka' gnad zhig ma mkhyen pas sgol ma la zhur bzhed de bya ma bum nas chab bzhes te nang du phebs pa na/ mu stegs pas kyang khams sang la 'gro bar 'dug snyam nas btang bas nang du phebs te da lta rgyal ba'i gzims chung du bzhugs pa'i lung bstan sgrol ma bya ba 'di'i mdun du maṇḍal phul bas maṇḍal gyi phyed tsam na sgra'i dka' gnad thams cad thugs la lam gyi shar te mu stegs pham par mdzad pa lta bu yin/ drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa man ngag bzhin rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba ni/ lam mchog sgo 'byed 'di nyid lam rim gyi rtogs pa'i sgo 'byed yin pas 'di'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa la/ dang po dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig po 'di'i mjug tu/gsola'adebasalan gnyis las dang po'i tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma las bla ma gnyis pa chad de spyi bor ngo chen gyi tshul du bzhugs pa dang / gnyis pa'i tshe/ bla ma de gnyis las bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang byas pas bla ma la skyon rtog gi blo dang / tshe 'dir shi sbar 'tham pa sogs lam gyi gegs byed thams cad sbyangs rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba'i snod rung du byas par bsam/ de bzhin du yo3

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung 'bum/'dren pa mnyam med ces sogs la yang gsol 'debs gnyis gnyis bya dgosal/ 'di dag gi tshe spyi bo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma des kyang skyabs yul de rnams lasted rnams kyis nga'i bu 'di la thugs brtse bas gzigs shig ces ngo chen byed pa'i mos pa dang / rang gis kyang snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pas dang po'i tshe tshogs zhing spyi dang / khyad par sangs rgyas byang sems gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa skye ba la gegs byed sbyangs/ gnyis pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems gsum las rang 'dra gnyis par chad de rang la thim pas tshe dang bsodanams sogs yon tan thams cad rgyas/ khyad par rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing / zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la yang gsol ba btab pas/ zab mo'i lam gyi gegs byed sbyangs/ de'i rtogs pa khyad par can skyes par bsam mo/ de bzhin du yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i skabs su yang bla mas ngo chen byed pa sngar ltar la bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang gi tshe skabs thob kyi rtogs pa de dang de'i gegs byed sbyangs nas de dang de'i rtogs pakhyad par can skyes par bsam la/ de ltar lam bzang zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig po 'dir gtso bo chos skyong rnams las bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang bya/ 'di yan chad la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis gnyis byed pa sngar ltar ro/ /sho lo ka tha ma'i skabs su gal te tshe 'di la 'di ltar 'grub pa zhig ma byung na yang skye ba rjes ma la cis kyang bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas 'di ltar 'grub pa zhig bya'o snyam du smon pa bgyid/ de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di la byin rlabs dpung zhus zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dper na dmag du ma 'tshogs pa la dmag dpung du grags pa ltar byin rlabs kyi tshogs mtha' dag bsdus nas zhus pas dpung zhus su btags pa yin/ rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang rwa sgreng gi jo bo 4yo

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudabyu'i thigasapa/dbu yon ma'i mdun du zla ba gcig la gsol ba btab pas lam rim bla brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal gzigs nas mthar thams cad jo bo la thim jo bo'i zhal nas bstan pa la bya ba brgya chen po gyes gsungs pas/ rje'i thugs la bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po byed pa la lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa zhig byed dgos par 'dug dgongs nas lam rim chen mo mdzad pa yin pas/ 'di la bskul ba po gzhan yang yod kyang gtso bor jo bo'i gsungs de la brten pa lta bu yin pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di la nan tan snying por byed dgos so/ /'di la 'ga' zhig da lta chos grwa 'grim pa lta bu'i skabs su mi nus snyam na/ de 'dri'i skabs su yang blos ma btang bar mdor bsdus te/ rjes yang dgon du mdzad pa ltar bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bdag gnyis su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bar gyi phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gag pa dang / bshes gnyen la dad pa nas zung 'jug gi bar lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag skye ba dang / 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa mtha' dag zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs shing /mdoran rang la na tsha lta bu zhig byung ba'i tshe yang 'di byang chub lam rim bsgom pa'i bar chad zhig yin na myur du zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/grogs zhig yin na da dung gong du 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes blogatad de gsol ba 'deb4dgos/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas tshogs zhing rnams rim gyis bsdus te/ gtso bo rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / rdo rje 'chang dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / byams 'jam dbyangs lnga la gsal snang 'don/ de nas mthar thams cad thub dbang la thim/ de yang tshur rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid thub dbang gi rnam par gsal btab ste skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang de la dmigs 465

༄/ /yo ca bas pa'i sa'i ga4 4ma/nas/ yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus phul te/ sangs rgyas zhes kyang khyod rang / yi dam zhes kyang khyod rang / chos skyong zhes kyang khyod rang snyam du phur tshugs gsol 'debs bya'o/ / spyor ba'i chos drug 'di ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ / de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun/ /zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa yin zhing 'di lam gyi lus kyang yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig gis sbyor ba la 'di 'dra'i mang po zhig byed dgos na/ dngos gzhi la gleb dus ka la yod snyam na/ sbyor ba de legs par grub pa zhig byung na de las lhag pa dngos gzhi la yong rgyu gang yod/'di'i kun slong bcos pa'i khungs su yang lam rim rdzogs pa yin zhing / gal tetshur ba 'di dpyis phyin pa zhig ma byung na de bzhag nas sems bskyed la 'chong sa ga la yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dang por thun la 'jug dus yang tsham tshom du mi 'jug par dang po 'di nyams su len/ de nas 'di nyams su len snyam nas rim gyis bsgom pa las/ gang thug thug nas bsgom na 'phral du yong yong 'dra yang dus der sleb pa na mi yong ba phra men ma'i so nams 'dra ba yin/ yang 'ga' zhig gis lam rim de de yin na byed rgyu mang po zhig red de lasasngags re bgrangs na dga' zer ba yang mi rigs te/ / sngags de yang las sla po med/ nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /zhes sogs rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bcu dgu dang / spyi'i dam tshig bgrang las 'das pa rnams bsrung ngo zhes bla ma yi dam dpang bor bzhag ste mna' chu 'thung nas mna' bskyal dgos pa yin/ maṇḍal yang lan drug tu 'bul dgos shing / bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pas/ de bas lam rim 'di la mna' yang bskyel mi dgos/ nyams su len yang bde ba yin/ der ma zad 'jig rten na thud tshon po yong ba mar gye 4yo
