༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ce'i ga4 stem/nasangos ma zin na/ sngon sman khang pa'i gra ba zhig rje don yod mkhas grub pa'i drung du 'jal ba'i tshe/ khyod gang nas yin dris pas/ nga sman khang pa'i gra ba yin zer ba la/ sman khang pa'i gra ba gsungs nas thugs mnyes mnyes gnang bas khos zhu rin med zhus pa la/ zhu rin yod drag grub chen sman khang pa'i gra ba gsungs pas/ bdag 'khor bar ma 'khyams tsam lags zhus pa la/bla mas nga tsho ni 'khor ba'i gting du 'khyams pa la khyod zhed po red gsungs/phyis su bla ma byams pa dang khong gnyis gsung bsgros gnang skabs khos 'khor bar ma 'khyams pa de dor ma phud pa red gsungs pa lta bur ma song bar ngos zin dgos/ ngos 'dzin yang nga rang tsho sdod pa'i khang ba sogs la byed pa min/ gang la bya ba yin snyam na/ rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ / zhes dang / mdzod las/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung po de dag 'thab bcas kyang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyer len gyi phung po la yang zer zhing / de yang dper na tsan dan las byung ba'i me la tsan dan gyi me dang / nas las btsos pa'i chang la nas chang zer ba ltar/rgyu las nyon gnyis kyis nyer len byas nas blangs pa'i lus la nyer len gye phung po zhes rgyu ming 'bras la btags pa yin/ de ltar dang po 'khor ba ngos bzung nas de'i rgyu sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ sdug bsngal brgyad dang / drug dang / gsum sogs las/ 'dir nges med drug gtso bor gsungs shing /de yang mngon rtogs rgyan las/ med pa'i rnam pa zhes dang / sher mdo las/rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes zhus pa la ma mchis/ zhes pa zhe sa yin pas/ lan du bcom ldan 'das kyis rab 'byor nam mkha' med pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dang dgra gnyen sogs 'dus byas 512

༄/ /bde lamazinabre bdudabyu'i thigasapa/son mi gnas pas cung zad tsam yang mi sdod par skad cig la 'gyur nas 'gro ba yin/ ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i tshe na de ring mthong ba'i ri 'di kha sang gi ri de yin yin 'dra ba 'char yang / rnam 'grel las gsungs pa ltar/'jig pa phyis 'byung gi rgyu la ltos med kyi rigs pas bsgrub na skad cig tsam yangaldod pa'i mthu med par 'grub cing de ltar skad cig gis 'jig pa'i mi rtag pa/ skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs kyi mi rtag pa gnyis mi gcig ste/ 'di ni skad cig ma'i mi rtag pa yin la/ gcig shos rgyun gye mi rtag pa yin no/ / de ltar 'khor ba 'di na dgra gnyen sogs la yid brtan med par ma zad 'khor ba'i phun tshogs ci tsam thob kyang ngoms pa med par slar yangasang pa 'dren pa wa skyes kyi rnam thar lta bu yin te/ sngon wa zhig gis tshong ba lnga brgya shi ba'i shul du phyin nas gzhan rnams la rim gyis za dgos snyam nas ser sna byas te/thog mar gzhu zos pas gzhu rgyud chad de gzhu 'phar nas gzhu mchog gis sna la btanganas shi ba'i gtam rgyud lta bu yin/ 'khor ba'i phun sum tshogs dang lus phun sum tshogs pa ci tsam thob kyang yid brtan med pa ni/ nyi zla sogs su skyes te rang 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal nus pa yang mun khrod du rang gi lag pa brkyangs ba skums tsam yang mi mthong bar skye ba dang / rgyal po nga las nus gling bzhi la dbang bsgyur te sum cu rtsa gsum du brgya byin so drug dang lhan cig tu bsdad nas mthar 'jig rten gye gtam dpe la bsod nams zad kha bsam ngan skyes zer ba'i dpe ltar/ brgya byin la bsam ngan skyes pa'i dbangagis 'dzam gling du lhung ba lta bu yin/ mdor na mdo myang 'das las gsalabar gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i bde sdug la 'di ma myong bya ba gcig kyang med cing / sems can gcig gis rang gi ma byas nas 'o ma 'thung ba dang / yi dwags su skyes nas rnag khrag 'thung ba dang / rkun ma byas pas mgo 513

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronaces gsung 'bum/bcad pa sogs kyang bsam las 'das te/ dper na khyim bdag dpal skyes bya ba gas shing khog pa bza' mi rnams kyi mnar bas yid sun pa rab tu byung ba dang / las gzhon rim nas byed dgos shing kho bslab pa gzhon pas thams cad kyis mngag pa na yid skyo nas dbeen pa zhig tu song ste chos gos rnam gsum shing ljon pa zhig la bkal nas/ rgyal byed tshal phyogs su phyag gsum btsal te/ bdag ni sangs rgyas spong ba ma lags/ chos dang dge 'dun spong ba ma lags/ bdag lus 'dis mnar bas lus dor de skye ba phyi mgazhon nu nas bstan pa dang mjal te rab tu byung bar shog ces smon lam btab nas g.yang la mchong ba dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bu'i mngon shes kyes mkhyen nas de ma thag rdzu 'phrul gyes nam mkha' nas blangs te ci yin dris pa la rgyu mtshan gsol bas/ nga'i chos gos kyi grwa la 'jus shig gsungs nas/rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin nas rus pa'i ri chen po zhig 'dug pa'i rtsibs ma'i steng du zhag bdun 'gro dgos pa de 'dra zhig gi steng du bzhugs pa ladapa' skyes kyis 'di ci yin zhus pas/ 'di khyod kyi skye ba snga ma chu srin du skyes pa'i rus pa yin/ de yang chu srin rnams rang bzhin gyis gnyid che bas lo mang po gnyid de sad par shin tu bkres pas kha gdangs pa na dpag tshad gcig tshun chad kyi rgya mtsho khar song ba dang / so btsir te chu phyir bton nas srog chags thams cad za ba la/ lan cig chu srin de'i kha gdangs pa dang tshong pa mang po zhig der sleb pa 'dzoms pas thams cad skrag nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes bsgrags pa chu srin gyis thos te sngon gyi bag chags sad nas de ma thag kha btsums te/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe spangs pas/ chu srin de nyid mu ges shi ba dang / rgya mtshor ro zhag tu gnas mi srid pas rlung gis bdas te 'phang ba'i rus pa 'di yin zhes bstan pas las 'bras la yid 514

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/ches dang / lus longs spyod sogs la nges pa med tshul la nges shesagating nas 'drongs te 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log nas bden pa mthong zhing rdzu 'phrul kyang thob ste/ tshur lam bya ma bu bzhin du mkhan po'i rjes su 'brang ste byon pa lta bu yin/ de ltar nges med drug sogs kyis 'khor ba la yid brtan med tshul ma bsam par khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal go mi nus te/rnam 'grel las/ mi rtag las ni sdug bsngal dang / / sdug bsngal las ni bdag med gsungs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal go ba la yid brtan du mi rung na mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul go dgos pa yin/ des na mi rtag pa sgo du ma nas bsam dgos te/ jo bo rjes/ mi rtag pa chu 'gram dubasgom na chu rib rib 'gro ba 'di rang bzang bar 'dug gsungs/ rnal 'byor ba chen po thun mtshams su ri rtser phebs nas dur khrod sogs su gzigs te/ zhabs 'brang pa la su dang su shi zhes dris nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang / shing drung pas sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu skar sogs la bltas nas bsgomapa yin pas dmigs pa gang bde nas bskyangs te/ mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul mthong nas de rtog pa'i blo bcos min zhig skyes na 'khor ba 'di thams cad bcos ma dang / mgo bskor du go bas 'khor ba'i tshang tshing 'dor ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rje bla mas/ de ltar goms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ / yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / / nyin mtshan kun tu thar ba don gnyer blo/ / byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes ba lags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thar ba don gnyer gye blo rnal ma zhig skye ba la 'khor ba me 'ob ltar mthong ba'i skyo shas drag po dgos shing / de yang 'khor ba'i bde ba thobakyang yid brtan mi rung ba 'jig pa'i rang bzhin can du mthong ba'i blo 'dis 'dren dgos te/ dper na bka' bstan 'gyur rnams su rgyal ba sras 515

༄/ /yo ca gas ba ngace' ga4 ཿma/dang bcas pa thams cad mi rtag pas sna drangs nas thar ba'i grong khyer du gshegs par gsungs/ nyan thos chen po rnams dang / grub chen tsho yang de ltar gshegs pa yin la/ deltar thar ba thob pa la mi rtag pa rtogs dgos par ma zad/ nyan thos kyi thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa rgyud la skye ba la yang mi rtag pa la myong ba thon dgos shing / byang sems kyi thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa skye ba la de las kyang lhag pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ / yang dag bsgrub la mkhas pa ni/ / zhes pa ltar/ mi rtag panas bzung sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi bar la myong ba thon dgos te/ rgyal bu gzhon nu don grub yang grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu byon pa'i tshe/ rga na 'chi ba sogasagazigs pas rkyen byas te mi rtag pas sna drangs pa yin/ yang 'ga' zhigagis mi rtag pas sna 'dren pa tsam yin mod kyang lam mthon por mi dgos snyam na ma yin te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la yang dur khrod bar mtshams med pas bskor ba dang / mi mgo skam rlon gyi do shal gyis brgyan pa yang mi rtag pa'i mtshon byed yin/ der ma zad yum rnams la yang ro langs ma dang /bdag med ma dang / chos dbyings ma zhes ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin pas/ mi rtag pa 'di lam mtho dman thams cad du gal che'o/ / gnyis pa so so'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ sdug bsngal brgyad gsungs te/ de yang sa sder 'khor ba spyi la sbyar yang / 'dir mi'i dbang du byas so/ / de la dang po skyes pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo las/ mi gtsang ba rnam pa mang pos yongs su gang ba/ srin bu'i rigs stong phrag mang po'i gnas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mngal gyi gnas pho ba long ga'i bar mi gtsang ba'ikhrod du mas zas zos pa'i bcud lte ba'i bu ga nas song bas 'tsho zhing /masajas kyi tsha grang dang spyod lam ma gzab pas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong 516

/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/zhing / bcings pa lngas bcings pa lta bur sdug bsngal bzod glags med pas/rgya cher rol pa las/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis kyang 'di'i bcu drug gi char yang mi phod par gsungs so/ / mngal du zhugs nas skabs zhig na rim gyis bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ nad rigasabazhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs kyang lus la 'jug pa yin/ mdor na las kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ pha ma'i khu khrag dang rnam shes 'dres pa'i mer mer po zhig nas rim gyis gtam smra ba sogs nus pa 'di 'dra zhig byung ba 'di ya mtshan te/ shing skam zhig la mir sprul nas gtam smra zhing mi'i bya ba byed pa dang khyad med/ 'di ltar bsam na sangs rgyas kyi dzu 'phrul gyi nus pa dang / sems can gye las kyi nus pa 'dra ba yin/ rga ba'i sdug bsngal yang /kā ma pa'i zhal nas/ rgas pa khad kyis khad kyis 'ong bas drag dus gcig la 'ong na sran thabs med gsungs pa ltar da lta lang tsho dar la babs pa'i gzhon nu zhig glo bur du rgas shing 'khog pa lang mi nus pa zhig tu song na gnyen mdza' bshes thams cad mya ngan byed/ thabs sdug pa ci 'dra yong / 'jig rten na yang lha rgas pa gral gsham zer ba lta bu yin/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyes/ lang na shing rtsa gnam du bsgreng ba 'dra/ / 'dug na sa la 'bebs chen rgyag pa 'dra/ / zhes gsungs shing / mkhas grub rje'i rtogs bajod du yang de ltar gsungs pa lta bu yin/ na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ 'gal ba rnams la bde'o zhes/ / rnam pa kun tu rigs ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / bslab btus su yang / lus kyi nang du 'byung bzhi sbrul mi mthun pa bzhi ltar gnas par gsungs pa bzhin du lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa las mi 'dod pa'i dpyad sna tshogs bsten dgos la/'chi ba yang da lta phal cher dus min du 'chi ste/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi rkyen 517

༄/ /༅ thang b.lo pa'i sgronasa'i rsāng stem/yang mtshan mo rgyu ba dang / de'i nang nas nam phyed mi ma yin rgyu ba'i dus yin pas de 'dra la phrad pa sogs/ 'chi rkyen dgu po gang rung gi dbang gis/ tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor thams cad dang bral nas gcig pur 'gro ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos/ gzhan yang gnyen sdug pa mig ltar bton 'gro zhing /dgra mi sdug pa yang gang nas yong nges pa med de/ mig blta lugs tsam gyis kyang dgrar 'gyur bas de 'dra byung na 'di snyam du rten 'brel gyi chos nyid la yang dkar nag gnyis las dkar po bzang bas mig dkar pos bltas pa dga' dragabasam na phan po yong / gzhan gyis ngan smras sogs byas byung na yang kong po 'on pa lta bu zhig dgos te/ khong gi rtsar bzang ngan gang bshad kyang 'on rdzu byas nas bsdad pas mi rnams gyis 'on par 'dug snyam ste mtshan la yang kong po 'on pa zer/ khong gi yon tan rgya che zhing / shes rab bzang po zhig yod pas/ po to bas 'dis ma go na phangs ba dgongs nas chos gsungs skabs gsung mthon po gnang bas/ khong gi thugs la bla ma 'o brgyal bar 'dug dgongs te/ mi gzhan med dus zhig bla ma'i rtsar phyin nas/ bla ma lags/ nga la rna ba gsang po yod zhus pa lta bu yin la/ de ni rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i dgongs pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ gshe dang 'gyed dang bcas gyur pa/ / de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ / de tshe bdag gis shing bzhin du/ /zung thub bar ni gnas par bya/ / zhes dang / bslab btus las/'thab pa dang rtsod pa'i nang du bdag bem po lta bu dang / lug ltar lkug par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / der ma zad 'phags pa gang bos dgra bcom thob nas ston pa la zhus te/ mtha' 'khob tu phebs ba'i tshe/ ston pa'i zhal nas mtha' 'khob de'i mi rnams shin tu gdug tsub pas khyod kyis der bag yod par gyis shig gsungs pa na/ ston pa'i bka' bzhin 'tshal lo/ /'on 518

༄/ /bde lamazinabrisabadudabyu'i thigasapa/kyang bdag la nyes par mi 'gyur te/ de dag gis bdag la bsdegs pa na/'di dag gis ma brdung pa bka' drin che snyam du bsam mo/ / brdung ba na 'didag gis bdag ma bsad pa bka' drin che'o snyam du bsam mo/ / zhes zhus pa lta bu dgos/ 'dod pa'i dngos po btsal kyang mi rnyed cing mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ nor rdzas lta bu lus srog theng la bor te 'tshol dgos shing btsal nas chas ka chen po zhig bsags kyang phan mi thogs te/ dper na sngon bla ma phyug po zhig gi bca' lag thams cad sgam so sor bcuganas za brgyab/ lde mig rnams gser sgam chung ngu zhig tu bcug nas/de'i lde mig chab ril la btags yod pa las/ phyis kho rang dbugs ngar ngar chad pa'i tshe zhabs phyis sgo brgyab ste lde mig blangs nas gser dngul sogs sbas te lde mig chab ril la btags/ sgo phye nas phyir bton te gzod ngus pa la/ mi tshos de 'dra ma byed chas ka tsho blangs nas dgongs rdzogs byed dgos zer tsa na/ khyed tshos ltos/ nga ni sdug drag nas lta yang mi nus zer/ yang mi chas ka can zhig shi bar zla grogs rnams tshogs tshe chas ka cang mthong rgyu med pa dang / khong rnams mtshar nas gcig gcig la blta zhing 'dis sbas yod pa yin nam zer ba'i tshe/ gcig gis yod don med zer/ yod drag kho chas ka che ba'i dpe la byed pa yin mod byas pas/ de med pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs 'dug zer/ gang na byas pas/ khos ji ltar mi shi de yis 'gro rgyu med pa ltar zhes pa'i tshig de la bcos brgyab nas/ sdud pa na/ mi de shi na rgyu de thams cad med par 'gyur/ / zer ba lta bu yin/ shi dus lde mig sus 'khyer mi shes pas/ da lta rang la dbang yod dus dkon mchog la mchod pa sogasakhya dgos/ gzhan ma byung yang rang gis kha zas bzang po re byas nas dge spyor ci nus byed dgos/ de'i 'og tu lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa 519

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i me'i g.yo ཿma/la/ /spyir lha ma yin ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi grangs su zur du bshad kyang srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa bri ba'i tshe/ 'gro ba lngas bsdus pa mdo dang mthun te/ bsdus tshul yang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las dud 'gror bsdus shing /lhar bsdu tshul gcig kyang yod de/ sngon lha rnams kyis bdud rtsi rnyed nas longasaspyod pa'i tshe lha gshis ngan zhig gis chang 'thung nas rang gzi ste/ lha rnams la 'khrugs pa byas pas lha rnams kyis khyod lha ma yin no zhes brjod nas bskrad pas lha ma yin du grags shing / de'i rgyud pa la rab bkod/ sgra gcan/thags bzang ris sogs yod la/ de yang las kyi dbang gis lha ma yin gye rigs su skyes tsam nas lha'i dpal 'byor la phrag dog mi bzod pa skyes te 'thab tu song ba na/ klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo sogs chu mtshams na yod pas 'gror mi 'jug cing / gal te 'dzam gling na sdig pa stobs chen/ de gnyis kyis 'gog mi nus pas/ yar song nas lha dang 'thab pa na lus dral ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal drag po myong zhing / khyad par du lha'i dbang po brgya byin la glang chen sa la rab brtan bya ba mdog sprin dang 'dra zhing / mche ba so gnyis yod pa/ de re re'i rtse mor padma so gnyis re la mchod pa'i lha mo rnamayospros nas mchod pa byed cing / lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i tshe mchod pa rnams bsdus te sna rgyags kyis lha ma yin rnams la brdab pa'i tshe bye ma'i 'ching bu bzhin du 'thor ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das pa yod/ de'i tshe sgra gcan yang khros nas ngan skad brgyab pa da lta'i ri ngur zer ba 'di yin zhing /skabs 'ga' zhig tu nam mkha' nas rdul mang 'babs pa yang lha ma yin rnams kyis ri 'phang ba na/ glang chen gyis sna bshug byas pas rdul phra rab kyi rangabazhin du song ba de nam mkha' nas babs pa yin/ der ma zad nyi zla gza' 'dzin yang lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa nyi zla'i 'od kyis yar blta ma 520

༄/ /bde lamazenabresabadudabyu'i zigasapa/nus pa na sgra gcan gyi lag pas bkad pa yin gsungs/ de nas 'dod lha'i sdug bsngal bsam tshul yang / 'dod lha'i nyer len gyi phung po grub pa la brten nas lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i tshe yan lag bcad pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal mtha' yas la 'on kyang mgo bcad na 'chi ba ma gtogs rkang lag sogs bcad kyang skad cig gnyis par 'byar nus pa yin/ de yang lha la rgyun par dzi ma 'khrab pa med cing / sangs rgyas kyi sku la khrus chu mi chags pa bzhin du lus la khrus chu mi chags la/ 'chi ltas phog pa'i tshe de dag 'byung zhing lus dri mi zhim pas lha gzhan rnams kyis sna bkab nas bros 'gro zhing / lha'i ming la skabs gsum pa zer ba ltar 'chi khar ngan song sogs su skye ba mthong bar sems kyi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las kyang lhag pa yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na sdug bsngal sdug bsngal dngos med cing /gzugs khams na yang dri ro gnyis med na yang / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis ro myong ba'i lce dbang med kyang smra ba'i lce yod pa mngon pa mdzod las gsungs/mdorabasdu na nyer len gyi lus zhig grub phyin chad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba yang rang tsho la bde bar snang yang ngo bo sdug bsngal yin pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du bshad pa yin te/sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal chu'i gnyer ma ltar gcig rjes su gcig 'byung bas snga ma 'gag tsam gye cha la tshor ba bde bar btags pa yin gyi/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la bde ba yin na bza' btung sogs ji tsam spyod pa de ltar du bde ba 'phel dgos pa la des ni sdug bsngal 'dren pa yin te/ dper na gzhi ka rtse'i gnyer ba rnams kyis bzhugs gral so nam legs po ma byung ba rnamasal chang gang sdug sdug nas mang po blud de 'thung dgos pa'i sdug las gtong ba dang / sngon rgyal po zhig gis khos chos lugs ltar byed rgyu yin zer 521

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonace'i gsung 'bum/zhes mi gcod tsa na/ khyod 'gro 'dod dam 'dug 'dod dam/ za'am 'thung ngam zhes dris nas 'dug zer na nyal du bcug ste lang du mi 'jug par mal der 'chi dgos pa dang / 'gro zer na skad cig kyang sdod dbang med par song song nas 'chi dgos pa dang / za zer na 'chi ba'i bar du zar 'jug pa lta bu yin pas rnam pa bde bar snang yang / ngo bo sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa kunabatus las de la sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ sems can skye ba dang skye ba'i gnas kyis kyang rig par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i gnas dang longs spyod 'di thams cad kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin/ 'on kyang so so'i skye bo rnams kyis bde ba dang don du gnyer byar 'khrulanas sdug bsngal du mi rigs pa ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yi/ / 'du byed sdug bsngal sru mi rtogs/ / 'phags pa mig dang ldan pa ni/ / de yis shin tu yid kyang 'byung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/dper na spu nyag lag mthil du yod kyang mi shes la/ de mig tu song ba na mig gi dbang po shin tu dwangs pa yin pas mi bzod pa ltar so skyes rnams kyi khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal 'di nyid rigs dka' zhing / 'phags pa rnams kyis 'di'i nyes dmigs mngon sum du gzigs pas 'di la 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes kyang bshad pa yin/ 'on kyang rigs pa du mas dpyad nas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal 'di la go ba chags pa zhig mdzad dgos/ de ma byas na bee bum sngon po las gsungs pa ltar/ dper na khyis bya ded pa na nye 'khor du sleb pa dang bya 'phur ba'i shul der sa la bsnum nas za rgyu zhig rnyed khul byed pa ltar yod mdog kha bo byas nas khyi dzi byed dgos pa yong bas de ltar ma song bar go ba rnyed pa zhig byung na 'di shin tu gnad che bar yod/gsum pa mjug tu ji ltar bya ba dang / gnyis pa thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba 522

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/sogs phal cher sngar bzhin no/ / gnyis pa thar bar bgrod pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ thun gye ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba dang / thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la spyor dngos mjug gsum las/dang po sbyor ba ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhes sogs phal cher gong bzhin no/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de ltar nges med drug la sogs pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam nas 'khor ba spang 'dod na de'i rgyu ngos zin par byas te sun dbyung dgos pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni/ / de spong ba ni nus ma yin/ / zhes dang / yul la bdag med mthong ba ni/ / srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu bzlog dgos pa yin pas/ kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim bsam dgos shing / kun 'byung la yang las nyon gnyis yod kyang nyon mongs gtso bo yin te/ dgra bcom pa la yang 'khor bar skye byed kyi las du ma yod mod kyang lhan cig byed rkyen nyon mongs ma tshang ba'i stobs kyis nas skam ltar skye ba 'grub mi thub/ des na nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang ngo bo byed las 'didag legs par ngo shes pa zhig byas te/ de la dgrar bzung nas bya ra byas te rtag tu 'gog pa zhig dgos par/ spyod 'jug las/ khyod kyis kho bo gar brlag pa'i/ / sngon gye dus de gzhan yin te/ / ngas mthong da khyod gang du 'gro / khyod kyi dregs pa kun gzhom bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/bdag 'dzin la 'khon du bzung nas 'thab dgos pas 'thab pa'i tshe yang mi dpa' bo rnams rang gi khrag mthong ba na snying stobs cher song ste da ni 'chi bar 'dug pa la 'chi thengs gcig las mi yong zer bzhin snying stobs shugs drag bskyed dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ la la bdag gi khrag mthong na/ /dpa' brtan lhag par skye bar 'gyur/ / la la gzhan gyi khrag mthong na/ /523

༄/ /gung thang bam ba'i sgronace' gsung 'bum/bog cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba yod/ /de ni sems kyi ngang brtan dang / /sngar ma'i tshul las gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ de yang dge bshes snyug rum pa nyon mongs skye tshe drag sngags bzlas pa dang / ma mtha' ske gcu ba tshun chad kyis kyang bzlog dgos gsungs shing / bdag 'dzin shag 'debs su yang / thog mar bdag 'dzin gyis khyed rnams la zas gtam sogs yong ba nga'i drin yin/ nga med na khyed bla ma tshos yang sbyin bdag la go rim ltar gyis ja gral tsam yang gtong mi shes/ thams cad nga'i bka' drin yin/ 'on kyang thams cad kyis nga 'phud rgyu yin zer yod ste/susakhyang 'phud mi thub/ smras pa bzhin rang cag la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dka' bas nyon mongs 'go gnon dka' la gal te skyes kyang / sngon mi zhig dmag 'thab sar go mtshon thogs te song ba las 'thab par dgra 'dulab lta zhog /rmog rang gis mnar ba ltar gnyen po shugs chung zhing /nyon mongs stobs che bas bdag 'dzin dang thug na dka' yang blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las/ gnod byed gdug pa'i mgo la chems se chems/ /dgra bdagagashed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /zhes bdag 'dzin 'gong bo 'di nyid thalabar rlogs shig ces yi dam chos srung la bskul par mdzad pa ltar byas na'ang shin tu phan no/ /bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas/ de ma thag yar langs te phyag 'tshal zhing maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa sogs bya dgos gsungs/ de la nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu ni/ mdzod las/ phra rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang / /yul ni nye bar gnas pa dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las/ /nyon mongs rgyu ni tshang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu gsum du 'du ste/ nyer len phra rgyas ma spangs pa'am go sla bar byas na sa bon ma spangs pa dang / phyi'i lhan cig byed rkyen yul yid du 'ong ba sogs nye bar 5ma

/ /bde lamazenabri bdudaci'i thigasapa/gnas pa dang / nang gi lhan cig byed rkyen sdug pa sogs su lta ba'i tshul min yid byed gsum yod la/ gzhan yang bshes gnyen ngan pa dang / chos log grogs ngan sogs la brten nas 'byung zhing / rkyen de las byung ba'i nyon mongasade la yang ji lta bu yod ces na/ mdzod las/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug / ces gsungs pa ltar/ nyon mongs dang phra rgyas don gcig cing / de la gtso bo 'dod chags sogs drug yod pa las/ 'dod chags ni ras la snum phog pa ltar zag bcas kyi yul yid du 'ong ba la zhen nas 'thab pa'i byed las can zhig yin zhing 'gro ba rnams khams gsum du 'khyams pa'ang 'dis byed pa yin la/ 'dod chags dang chags pa mi gcig go / khong khro ni gzhi dgra la dmigs te kun nas mnar bar sems pa tsub pa'i rnam pa can me dang mtshungs pa zhig yin zhing / 'di la bla ma byams pa'i zhal nas/ zhe sdang 'di me rang yin/ kho rgyas tsa na thog mar lag mthil rngul nas lag pa gnyis phur yong / de nas rim gyis mched pas mchan khung dros/ de nas lus rngul zhing mgo na rlangs pa 'byung ba de nang na me dngos su 'bar ba'i rtags yin gsungs/ 'di dang khro ba mi gcig la 'tshig pa dang yang mi gcig / 'tshig pa ni 'jig rten na tshig pa zos zer ba de yin zhing deg 'tshog byed pa'i las can zhig yin/ nga rgyal ni/ sems mtho ba'i rnam pa can ri mthon po'i rtse nas mar bltas pa lta bu dang / the tshom ni/ lam gsum gyi sum mdor gang la 'gro dgos te gtol med par yid tshom pa lta bu yin zhing / ma rig pa ni/rganapo long ba lta bu blo mi gsal ba'i rnam pa can zhig yin la/ de lta bu'i rmongs tsam de dang log par rtog pa gnyis las gang 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed tshul la mi mthun pa'i lugs gnyis byung ste/ thogs med sku mched kyis rmongs tsam 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed cing / slob dpon zla ba grags pa dang /5ba

༄/ /yo ca ga ba'i me'i g.yo 4ma/dpal chos kyi grags pa sogs ni phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed de/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ dang po nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gis 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed pas/ /zhes gsungs shing / de dang mthun par bde lam 'dir yang / shes pa kho rang gi ngos nas lung ma bstan yin pa la/ dang por bdag dang bdag gi ba la dmigs nas rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i blo skye/ de bdag tu bzung ba la brten nas rang phyogs la chags pa dang / zhes sogs kyis phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa rtsa bar gsungs shing / 'dir dang po zhes gsungs pa yang nyon mongs skyes pa'i ya mtha' la zer ba min par/ bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di nyon mongs thams cadakyi gzhi rtsa byed pa la a ma lta bu yin te/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod las/ lta ba kun gyi mar gyur pa'i/ / 'jig tshogs lta ba 'byin par byed/ / ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /des na nyes tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di nyid yin pas ngos zin pa zhig bya dgos kyi/ sngon bla ma rin po che sku na phra mo'i tshe bsdus grwa 'grim skab4dge bshes grags che ba zhig la/ 'jig lta zer ba ci yin dris pas lta ba 'jig zing zing zer ba yin zhes pa lta bur ma song ba dgos pas/ 'jig lta'i don ni skad cig gis 'jig cing phung po lnga po 'di lang nyon gnyis kyis bcings nas tshogs pa 'di la dmigs nas nga'o snyam pa/dper na mar ril lta bu'i ril ril po gang gis kyang mi shigs pa lta bu zhig tu 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can zhig yin la/ mthar lta ni des bzung ba de la zhen nas rtag chad gang rung du lta ba yin zhing / 'dzig lta la yang snga ma lta bu zhig dgos pas/ bdag 'dzin thams cad 'jig lta yin mi dgos so/ /de ltar rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyis bdag tu bzung ba la brten nas rang gzhan so so bar ris su bcad pa la brten nas rtsa ba'i nyon mongs rnams skyes 526

༄/ /bde lamazinabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/shing / de las nye nyon rnams rgyas/ de'i dbang gis las bsags te rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas srid pa'i 'khor lo bskor te sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'di grub nas 'khor bar mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal sna tshogs zhig myong ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bden bzhi la rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi snon pa byed tshul yang de'i dbang gis las bsags nas/ zhes sogasagasungs pa yin te/ bde lam 'di rdo rje'i tshig yin pas don bsdus nas de tsam gsungs pa ltar yin/ de la yan lag bcu gnyis las/ dang po ma rig pa la las 'bras la rmongs pa dang / sems kyi gnas lugs la rmongs pa gnyis yod pas snga mas ngan 'gror 'gro zhing / phyi mas bde 'gror 'phen byed las kyang bsog la/ de gnyis kyi nang nas yang rtsa ba ni phyi ma yin/ de las las 'bras la rmongs pa 'byung zhing / de nyid kyi las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa la khyab yod pas/ las 'bras la rmongs pa de'i yan lag tsam yin te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ lus la lus dbang ji bzhin du/ / gti mug kun la gnas 'gyur ba/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na lus dbang gis skra rtse nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad la khyab pa lta bu yin/ mig dbang la yang lus dbang gis khyab pa yin te/ mig tu rdul song na tsha ba ste/ de la lus dbangagis khyab yod pa'i rtags yin/ yan lag gnyis pa 'du byed kyi las kyis 'khor ba'i rgyu bsog pa'am 'du byed pas na gnyis pa 'du byed kyi las yin zer/ de la bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum yod la/ de gang yin kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor ba 'di las ni ma 'das pa yin pas/ 'di dag gi sgo nas kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsgom tshul rgyas su 'gro ba yin/ gsum pa rnam shes la las kye bag chags rnam shes kyi steng du bsgom pa'i rgyu dus dang / de'i 'bras bu rnam 527

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/shes kyis phyong ba'i 'bras dus kyi rnam shes gnyis yod/ ming gzugs la ming gzhi'iphung po ni gzugs bstan du med par ming tsam yin pas ming gi rten 'brelazer/ de'i 'og tu lnga pa skye mched dang / de nas drug pa reg pa ni/yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'duyonas yul yongs su gcod pa ste/ dper na/me lta bus reg pa'i tshe tsha gar re mi 'dod pa'i rnam par gcod pa yin zhing /tshorab ni/ des yul bcad pa ltar tsha reg sogs mi 'dod pa'i rnam par pyong la/ sred pa ni 'di 'dra zhig byung na snyam pa dang / len pa ni/ ci nas kyang dgos par 'dug snyam nas tshol bar byed pa ste/ de dag gi stobs kyi las kyi nus pa mthu can du song ba sred pa yin zhing / de la brten nas skye ba dang / na tshod gzhan du 'gyur bas rga ba dang / shi ba'i rten 'brel 'byung ngo / /'di dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga dha'i lho phyogs su 'bras sa lu ljang ba'i dpes gsungs la/ der klu sgrub kyis 'grel ba'ang mdzad de/ de dag gi skabs nas/ ma rig pa zhing 'debs mkhan dang / las sa bon/rnam shes zhing sa dang / sred pa chu dang / len pa lud dang dpe sbyar te rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis po spel nas zhing dang 'dra bar gsungs so/ / yang sred len skye tshul de ltar yin na ngan 'gror skye bas de la sred pa ji ltar 'byung zhe na/de ni mdo sde mdzangs blun las/ kha na mtho ba chen po byas na shin tu 'bar ba'i sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur te/ mi de rlung ngam grang nad kyis gzir bas yid la me 'dod par bsam pa'o/ / me'i nang du 'gro bar bsam ma thag tu tshe'i dus byas nas shin tu 'bar ba'i sems can dmyal bar 'gro'o/ / zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar/ tsha dmyal du skye na grang ba'i snang ba byung ste dro na snyam pa dang / grang dmyal du skye na dro ba'i snang ba 'byung ste grang na snyam pa 'byung / gzhan yang ngan 'gror skye ba'i snga ltas su rang 528

༄/ /bde lamazinabre bdudaci'i thigasapa/bzhin 'gyur te snang ba dgrar langs shing lag pa gnam du rkyong ba dang /mig yar 'khrab pa drod smad nas bsdu ba sogs 'byung ste/ ngan 'gro'i bar do thur du 'gro ba yin pas de'i snang ba kho la shar nas sa 'og tu bying 'gro ba'i nyams 'byung ba yin/ de 'dra'i skabs pha rol po mi 'dod bzhin du dkon mchog la mchod pa phul zer ba'am/ zas zo zhig zer mi rung ste/ de'i rkyen gyis khros nas de 'dra'i ming yang mi thos pa cig tu gyur na snyam pa skye nas dud 'gro dang / yi dwags sogs su skye ba'i las la gsos 'debs pa yin te/ tshe deradage sdig gang byas kyang phyi ma'i skye ba gcig po de 'chi khar sems gang mngon gyur pa des thub pa las 'bras mi bslu ba'i chos nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'phen byed dang 'phangs 'bras ma gtogs/ 'grub byed grub 'bras kyi bar skye ba gzhan gyis chod mi srid la/ de'i phyir na bar du bskal pa brgya sogs kyis chod kyang rdzogs tshul tshe gnyis sam/ ma mtha' gsum la rdzogs pa yin/ de ltar rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas sdug bsngal du ma'i 'byungaganas su gyur pa'i srid pa'i btson ra chen po 'dir rnam par shes pa rang dbang med par 'khyams nas sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa zhig myong ba 'di thams cad rtsa ba mthar gtugs na rgyu kun 'byung gi gtso bo bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig par 'dug pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas spang ba'i 'gog padon du gnyer dgos/ 'gog pa la yang thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma ste mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ bla ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig ci nas kyang thob par bya dgos/de la yang dang por de thob nus mi nus brtags nas nus na don du gnyer ba la 'jug dgos pas/ de yang rje dge 'dun grub kyis/ dgra nang na 'dug pa'i bdag 'dzin thul/ / gsungs pa ltar/ thar ba thob pa'i bgegs kyi 529

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i me'i gsung stem/gtso bo bdag 'dzin yin pas/ de la dgrar bltas nas spang mi thub na ngal ba 'bras med yin pas thog mar spong thub mi thub lta dgos/ de yang ji ltar lta ba yin na 'khrul ma 'khrul lta dgos pa yin te/ ma 'khrul na mig shes ma 'khrul bas bltas kyin gsal du 'gro ba lta bu yin pas spong mi nus la 'khrul ba zhig yin na sel ba'i thabs byas pas sel nus pas de sbyang ba la 'bad dgos te/ dper na mkhris nad can la sa gzhi ser por snang ba dang / yang tsha ba dang mkhris pa sogs rgyas pa'i rtags su spyos pa min yang khrag rgyas pas mig rtsar song nas rtsa phra mo rnams 'khrab ste rta rgyug pa dang / ra lug sogs su snang ste 'di nor lug sogs 'dug zer ba la/ de 'dra med ces smras pa dang /yod med brtsad pa sogs kyis snang ba de ldog mi nus pas sman bsten te/nang gi mkhris nad sbyangs pas gsal du 'gro ba ltar 'dir yang kun 'byung gi nad zhi ba'i zhi ba myang 'das thob par bya ba'i phyir lam la slob dgos la/thar bar bgrod pa'i lam gyi gtso bo ni lam bslab pa gsum yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bde lam 'dir yang / de'i phyir lam bslab pa rin po che gsum la bslob par bya'o zhes lam bden bstan pa yin te/ 'di ni rdo rje tshig yin pas bden pa bzhi yang de ltar go rim bzhin du gsungs pa yin/ de las lhag pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon yang gsung rgyu med de/ sangs rgyas kyis thog mar chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe yang bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor te/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang zhi ba'i phan yon gsungs pa yina'i/ 'dul ba lung las gsungs pa ltar mchog zung yang rdzu 'phrul gyis dmyal ba'i gnas rnams su phebs nas slar mi yul du ngan song gi sdug bsngal sogs bstan te/ gdul bya rnams thar bar 'khrid par mdzad pa'i tshe/bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ thams cad du mchog 530

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/zung lta bu mi 'byung bas/ sgo khang du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa khor yug tu rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog kyang bris shig gsungs pa ltar/ srid pa'i 'khor lo yang bden bzhi ston byed yin te/dmyal ba sogs bris pas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ mi bris pas 'gyur ba'i sdugabasngal/ steng du tshon sna bzhi'i ri mo bris pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ste/ de dag gis sdug bsngal mtshon zhing / dbus su 'dod chags mtshon byed phug ron/ zhe sdang mtshon byed sbrul/ gti mug mtshon byed phag ste de dag gis kun 'byung / de'i phyi rol tu bar srid kha dog dkar ser nag po steng dang / thad ka dang / thur du 'gro ba rnams dang / phyi rim la ma rig pa rgan mo long ba lta bu/ 'du byed rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo lta bu/ rnam shes khang stong nang gi spre'u lta bu/ ming gzugs la gru lta bu zhes pa dang / mdung khyim lta bu zhes bshad pa gnyis yod pa las mdung khyem ni/ mdung gsum rtse bcings nas steng du gos sogs bkab ste sa la phub pa na gcig la gcig brten te sdod pa ltar phung po rnams phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brten te gnas pas phyi ma 'char bde/ skye mched grong stong dang 'dra ste/ grong stong der rgyang nas bltas na khra rug ge bdag po yod yod 'dra yang don la med pa ltar skye mched drug kyang las kyi dbang gis chags pa yin gyi/ de la dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag med ste/ 'di lta bu go ba la yang shin tu phan no/ / reg pa 'o byed pa/ tshor ba mig la mda' phog / sred pa chang 'thung ba/ len pa spre'u shing thog len pa/ srid pa sgrul ma btsa' ba lta bu dang skye ba rga shi rnams bri/ de thams cad mi rtag pas za bar mtshon byed du srin po'i khar chud pa 'bri dgos/'ga' zhig gis srin po'i rkang lag brkyangs pa'i lto ba'i thad du sngags pa'i bsrung 'khor lta bu zhig bris 'dug pa de 'dra mi rung / 'di la yan lag lngas 531

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gsung 'bum/bzung ba zhes rkang lag gi sor mo thams cad kyis bcum zhing khar bcug pa'i ma mchu yang mi mthong ba zhig 'bri dgos pa yin/ de'i steng du 'gog bden mtshon byed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / thub pa'i sku phyag mdzub rkyangs nas de ston pa bri zhing / 'og tu myang 'das der bgrod pa'i lam bden ston pa'i tshigs bcad brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ / zhes sogs bris nas khyim pa 'ong ba sogs la de dag ston shes pa'i sku gnyer kyang 'jog dgos te/ ri mo tsam gyis kyang bstan pa la phan gnod chen po 'byung ba yin/ de yang dperan sngon rgyal po gzugs can snying po la ma mthong ba'i grogs mched sgra sgrog gi rgyal po u tra ya nas nor bu'i khrab reg na bde ba dug 'jil bar byed pa sogs yan lag lnga ldan zhig skyes su bskur ba na blon po rnams kyis rin thang ma thebs pas/ rgya gar na rin thang mi chod pa de la gser srang bye ba ri zeraba'i srol yod pa ltar zhus pa'i tshe rgyal pos de'i dod mtshungs pa'i skyes bskur rgyu ma rnyed pa dang / sems khong du chud nas gos ngan pa gyon te mun pa'ikhang bur zhugs pa'i tshe/ bram ze dbyar byed kyis ston pa la zhus shig ces rgyal po la gros btab pas ston par zhus pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bris la bskur zhig gsungs pas lha bris pa rnams tshogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku ni gser gye gzhong bar mar me sbar ba'am/ nyi ma ltar 'od lham me pa ltar mi bzod pa yin pas bri ma nus pa na yang rgyal po yid skyo ste/ sangs rgyas kyes skyes bzang po zhig gnang na/ de yang bri mi nus pa snyam pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku las ras gzhi'i steng du 'od btang nas bar bcug cing / mthar yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog gi ri mo dang / 'og tu rten 'brel gye tshigs bcad bris te rin po che'i sgom du bcug ste sngar yi ge bskur nas/ 'jig rtenagasum na ches khyad du 'phags pa'i skyes bskur yod pas/ dpag tshad 532

༄/ /bde lamazenabresabadudabyu'i thigasapa/phyed dang gsum lam mdzes bar gyis/ bdag nyid/ dpung gi tshogs bzhi dang bcas pas bsus la/ sa phyogs yangs por bkur bste chen pos dbyer mdzod cig / ces pa yu tra ya nas mthong ste/ khros nas 'dis nga la brnyas par 'dug pas dmag shom zhig ces smras pa na/ blon po rnams kyis gzugs can snying po bdag nyid chen po yin pas/ skyes ngan ngon zhi na mi bskur bas thog mar brtags nas thugs ma dgyes na de ltar bgyi'o/ / zhes gsol nas smra ba bzhin bsus te/ zhal phye ba'i tshe yul dbus kyi tshong ba dag gis mthong nas thams cad kyis/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bsgrags pas rgyal po'i bag chags sad nas lus kyi ba sru g.yo ba'i dad pa thob cing / rten 'brel gyi ri mo dang yi ge rnams bstan pas mtshan mo de nyid la yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog tu bsam pas rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob ste ched du brjod pa/ ring na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ / shes rab mig ni rnam par sbyangs/ / gang la de 'dra'i gsos mnga' ba/ / sman pa'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes brjod pa lta bu yin/ yang ri mo tsam gyis kyang bstan pa'i gnod pa srid de/ dper na sngon rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus mkhan po bo dhi satwas bod la rab byung 'ong mi 'ong gi nyams sad pa'i phyir du mi bdun rab tu byung ba la sad mi mi bdun du grags pa de rnams kyis blang dor tshul bzhin du byas pas/ de ma thag lam la 'jug thub pa byung ste/ rab byung yong bar 'dug gsungs shing rab byung yang gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs 'di rang bzang bar 'dug gsung nas de ka btsug ste/ lta ba klu sgrub dang / spyod pa zhi 'tsho'i lugs byed dgos par bkas bcad pas jo po yang phal chen sde ba 'dzug tu ma bcug cing / de ltar dang po mkhan chen zhi 'tshos bstan pa dag ther mdzad bzhin pa'i dus tsa na mkhan chen tshe'i rig 'dzin 533

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i ce' gsung 4ma/brnyes pa yin yang bod bsod nams dman pas rta mkhras kyes bsgrong / rgyal po yang bsgrong ste glang dar mas bstan pa sgrub par 'dod de/ thog mar jo bo bye ma'i 'og tu sbas jo po bzhugs pa'i khang ba'i sgo la zhal zhal byas te steng du rab byung chang gi bum pa thogs pa bris te bkra mi shis pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pasakho rang gi 'dod pa ltar byed thub pa byung zhing / der ma zad slob dpon dbyig gnyen tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i grub thob cig yin kyang kha che 'dus bzang dang rtsod pa bshol ba'i phyir bal por phebs te/ mchod rten go ma sa la ga dha la bskor ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ bal po hang du zer ba rab byung gi rtags cha lugs 'chang ba zhig gis chang gi bum pa thogs nas 'gro ba gzigs te/thugasaskyo rang drag nas kye ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub nas bkra mi shis pa'i ltas 'di 'dra byung na da bdag bsdad pas ci bya dgongs te/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzung dbu zhabs bzlog nas gsungs pa sku tshe bsdus te mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten yang da lta der bzhugs pa lta bu yin/ des na sgo du ma nas bden bzhi'i blang dor la tshul bzhin du 'bad de/ lam bslabs pa gsumakhyad par bsrung na phan yon che zhing / ma bsrung na nyes dmigs che bas rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims 'di la ltung bas ma gos par gtsang sang nge ba zhig bsrungs dgos/ de la yang ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi yod de/dang po mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen por bslab bya rnams gzhan las legs par nyan zhing / blo'i nus pa yod na mdo rtsa ba dang /de'i rgya cher 'grel sogs la blta dgos te rje rin po ches kyang de dag thugs 'dzin gnang ba yin/ de ma byung na gleng 'bum sogs blta zhing / de yang ma byungan paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i sdom tshig dang / bla ma rin po che rang gis mdzad pa'i sdom tshig sogs la blta dgos/ der ma zad 534

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/'dulaba'i brjod bya mtha' dag sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs sogs gsum du 'dus pas 'bog chog sogs kyang gzhan gyi mkhan slob sogasasted mkhan zhig min pas blta mi dgos pa min/ rang gi dang po ci zhig khas blangs yod shes pa'i phyir du thams cad kyis blta dgos la/ de ltar brtags pa na dang po pha mas btags pa'i ming dang / gos dang sems gsum ka nyon mongs pa yin pas brje ba gsum gyis sgo nas de thams cad bor te 'khor ba la phyi mig mi blta zhing / gshe yang lan du mi gshe / khro yang lan du mi khro zhes khas blang ba de byung na phan yon che la/ ma byung yang 'gal ba med pa de 'dra min/ mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa dpang du bzhag nas khas blangs pas/ med mi rung du bsrung dgos pa yin/ bslab bya yang shin tu grangs mang pas rtag tu bsngo bgrangs byed dgos/ de nas ma gus pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ ston pa dang / de'i bcas pa'i bslab pa/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la gus par bya dgos te/ rgyud sde rnams su'ang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa yod bzhin du khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas rab gnas sogs bya mi rung bar gsungs shing / sngon gyi bkas bcad du yang rab byung mthong na stan las ldang dgos pa dang / rab byung yod par khyim pas dbang bskur sogs kyis las byed mi rung bar bkas bcad cing / der ma zadasanga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis rang gi ral bar dar yug btags pa dge 'dun gyi lam du bting ba sogs bkur bzos bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa lta bu yin la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig byung na yon tan thams cad kye mchog tu gyur pa yang de yin te/ sgom pa pas/ gshegs khar ye shes 'bar la ye 'bar khyod la mi rnams kyis khyod kyi bla ma la yon tan ci yod ces 'drir byung na/ mngon shes dang / lhag mthong sogs yod ces smras 535

༄/ /ca thang bayo ba'i ce' g.yo 4ma/nami 'grig go / las 'bras la yid ches nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba gcig yin gyis shig gsungs pa/ tshul khrim4dag pa la yon tan gyi mchog tu 'dzin pa zhig dgos kyang / da lta dus snyigs mar song bas mngon shes yod zer ba dang / lha mthong yod zer ba la mchog tu rtsi ba 'di gtan nasami rung ste/ de 'dra phal cher 'dres khyer ba'i rtags yin/ sngon jo bo yerabar bzhugs skabs jo bo dar yug pa zer ba 'dres byin gyis rlabs pa zhigagis lung bstan thogs med du brgyab pas mi rnams dad par gyur pa la/lan gcig jo bo'i drung du mjal bar phyin pas/ khu ston gyis jo bo la mi ma yin 'di bskrad par mdzad dgos zhus pa la/ jo bos khyod kyis dri ba gyis dang / ngas bskrad gsungs pas khu ston gyi zhal du btsag dang ram bzung nas dar yug pa la/ khyed mngon shes thogs med du 'dug zer ba ngas thos da jo bo rin po che 'di lo ga tsam bzhugs/ sku tshe 'di'i rjes ma gang du 'khrungs zhes sogs dris pa la/ da lo 'di rnyed cig bzhugs/ sku tshe rjes ma la dga' ldan du phebs zhes sogs dpyis byin par thogs med du bshad byung bas de ma thag jo bos mi ma yin bskrad nas khu ston la brda byas pa dang / khu ston gyis nga'i kha nang na ci 'dug dris pas gang yang shod rgyu ma byung ba na/ khyod kyes phyin chad mi rnams ma bslu zhig gsungs nas btang ba lta bu yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis mngon shes thar ba thor yod pa dang / rdo la lag rjes bzhag pa lta bus thar ba thob pa la mi phan zhing / ngan song las mi 'drongs pas ya mtshan che rgyu med/ tsa ri'i ra lug sogs kyis kyang yon tan gang yang ma thob mod/des rtsa a wa dang / klu bdud rdo rje zos pa'i stobs kyis rdo la rjes gang 'dod du yong ba yin/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yod kyang rang gar ston mi rung ste/sngon 'brom ston pa sku khams ma bde ba'i tshe rnal 'byor pa chen pos gsang phu 536

༄/ /bde lamazenabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/nas rwa bsgreng bar du rdzu 'phrul gyis thal byung du phebs nas bsnyung 'dri byas pa la 'brom gyis khyed kyis ngo tsha ba'i gnas de la yon tan du 'dzin nam gsungs bka' bkyon gyes tshar bcad pa lta bu yin/ des na yon tan thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims yin pas/ tshul khrims la gus pas gces spras su byed dgos te/ ston pasakyang nga'i nyan thos tshul khrims bsrung mkhan gang na yod pa der snang ba yod/ 'od yod/ des na nga la sems khral med gsungs pa lta bu yin pas bslab pa la dad par bya dgos/ dad pa med na dbang po rno yang dbang po dgrar langs ba lha sbyin lta bu yin pas/ ston pa dang bslab pa la ma gus par/ /dgag dgos/ de'i 'og tu bag med pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen por dran shes bzhin dang / ngo tsha dang / khrel yod sogs bskyedanas sgo gsum la dran pa nye bar bzhag ste/ 'gro 'dug sogs kyi spyod lam thamayocad bag dang ldan par bya dgos te/ dper na 'gro ba'i tshe chang tshong ma dang / smad tshong ma dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gror mi rung bas/yul yin min brtags pa dang / chu tshag 'chang tshul sogs la'ang chu'i srog chags rnams la mi gnod par bya zhing / sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ / ces sogs chu la sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad sogs 'don dgos la/ rngul gzan sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum 'chang dgos pas/ rngul gzan la yang da lta 'ga' zhig gis rdul gzanazer te/ de tshun chad nas bstan pa'i zur nyams par 'dug pas de 'dra mi rung / jul gzan zer ba nyin mo chos gos kyi nang du gyon rgyu dang /rngulagazan gyi gzan mtshan mo gyon rgyu de yin/ de bzhin du sham thabs yang mthang gos kyi 'og tu nyin mo gyon rgyu lcags ri dang / tshal bu med pa ma 537

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgon po ga4 stem/gtogs dbyibs mthang sham dang 'dra ba zhig yin pas/ da lta'i smad g.yogasazer ba 'di ni mthang sham dang dbyibs mi mtshungs pa de yin/ de nas gser dngul sogs rin po che la yang mi rung ba'i dngos pos byin rlabs bya dgos/ de ltar byas na nor rdzas sogs ci tsam yod kyang skyon du mi 'gyur te/ dper na phur bu spyog dang / rje don yod mkhas grub pa gnyis gsung sgrosaganang skabs phur bu sbog nas da lta bod na tshe blos btang zhig e yod gsungs pa la/ don yod mkhas grub pas de yod de/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shesayin gsungs pa ltar rang la byung ba la nges pa med/ rang gi ngos nas dge 'dun nam dkon mchog sogs gzhan la bsngos nas/ rang nyid kyes bdag tu ma bzung na de chos pa yin/ de yang lan gcig lha bzang gis paṇa chenatho bzang ye shes la rdo tshad brgya phul ba'i tshe/ pakhochen gyi zhabs phyi rnams nas/ nga tsho la da lo rdo tshad brgya phul ba'i 'bul ba 'di las che ba yong ma myong zer ba la/ paṇa chen gyis rdo tshad zer ba ga 'dra yin gsungs nas mi rnams kyis de la skur ba zhus pa lha bzang gis gsan nas/ min ni bla ma bog to paṇa chen zhes thal mo sbyor te gser dang bong ba mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa zer ba de yin gsungs nas/ lhag par gus pa cher song ba lta bu yin/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi khyad par rang rgyu mtshan du byas nas nga la dge slong zer gyi yod/ dge bshes zer gye yod/ ngas ming la bdag byed dgos snyam du nyes pa la 'dzem pa ngo tsha shes pa dang ston pa'i ye shes kyi spyanagyis gzigs yod pas thugs khrel yong snyam nas nyes pa la 'dzem pa la khrel yod pa ste/ 'di gnyis yod na sdom pa la ngo lkog mi 'byung / de ltar ma yin par sdom pa la ngo skog byung na rang gis yin 'dogs byas kyang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha dang brgya byin sogs kyis bstan pa'i chom rkun pa zer 538

༄/ /bde lamazinabrisabadudabyu'i thigasapa/ba yin la/ dam pa rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas dang / thams cad kyis mchil ma 'dor ba'i yul du gyur pa yin pas/ spyan snga pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyes/ zhabs bsil gyi snod du 'gro nyen yod gsungs pa lta bu yin/ bzhi pa nyonapongs mang pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nyon mongs kyis ni bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms/ / gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang 'dod chags shas che'i gnyen por mi sdug pa bsgom dgos pas/ thog mar rang gi dpral bar rma zhig byung stede cher song ba las rnag khrag sogs 'dzag pa dang / 'dul ba lung nas bshad pa ltar gyi 'du shes bcu yang bsgom dgos shing / nga rgyal gyi gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye bsgom dgos te/ de ltar byas pas ril 'dzin 'joms sla ba yin/ de ltar ltung ba'i sgo bzhi khegs nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig bsrung ba la tshul khrims kyi phan yon shes dgos pas/ tshul khrims kyi phan yon ni/ rje bla mas/ tshul khrims ni brgya byin gyi rgyal mtshan dang /tshong pa'i tshong dpon lta bur gsungs/ lha rnams dang lha ma yin 'thab pa na/pham na brgya byin gyis rgyal mtshan mi bsgreng zhing / rgyal na bsgreng ba ltar tshul khrims kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ nyon mongs pa las rgyal bas thar ba thob pa'i snga ltas yin pas sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin du byas na mngon mtho dang /thar ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa thob nus la/ de ltar ma byas na thob mi srid de/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ / ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyisamakhyen gzhan min pa/ / de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrugs/ / thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas ni blang dor gyi gnas 539

༄/ /yo ca bas pa'i 4 gsung 4ma/gang la yang 'khrul ba med pa yin pas/ des gsungs pa ltar lam bslab pa rinapo che gsum la bslab par bya'o/ / gsum pa mjug tu ji ltar bya ba ni sngar bzhin yin la/ /gnyis pa thun mtshams su yang so sor thar ba'i dbang du byas pa'i bslab bya rnams blta dgos/ de yang so sor thar ba'i skad dod ni pra ti mo kṣa zhes pa'i pra ti yang rnam 'grel las/ pra ma na pra ti ka zhes pa dang po la 'jug pa dang / gzhan yang mchog dang so so la 'jug tshul gsum sogs yod pa las/ 'dir so so la 'jug pa go ba bzang ste/ dper na las dge sdig so sor byas pa'i 'bras bu so sor myong bas/ so so skye bo zhes bshad pa bzhin 'dir yang rang rang gis tshul khrims bsrung na rang rang so sor thar nus la/ dem bsrung pa rnams thar bar mi nus pas so sor thar ba zhes bshad pa yin/ gzhan yang dbang po'i sgo sdom pa dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa dgos la/dbang po sdom pa dang / dbang po dgag pa gnyis mi gcig ste/dbang po dgag pa ni mthong ba dang / thos su mi 'jug pa yin la/ dbang po sdom pa ni de la yid kyis chags pa 'gog pa yin te/ rje mi las tsho drug bsdus par 'jog pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa dang gnad gcig ste/ 'di ni nyan sa'i yang man ngag yin no/ / zas kyi tshod rig pa dgos pas/ sha bas zhing zosapa'i dper ma song ba dgos te/ sngon sha ba zhig gis zhing du song nas tshod ma zin par za che bas 'gro ma thub pa/ dge slong zhig gis mthong ste gzan gyis thang gcig btang nas/ ming du song ba ma gtogs khyed sku tshe ring bo rang mi yong bar 'dug zer ba lta bur 'gro nyen yod pas/ zas kyi tshod rig pa sogs thun mtshams kyi bya ba 'di dag thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa bskyed pa'i thabs kyang bla na med pa yin no/ / gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i lamagyi rim pa la blo sbyangs pa ni/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten 540

༄/ /bde lamazinabrisabadudaci'i thigasapa/nas blo sbyangs pas/ thog mar dal 'byor la myong ba thon te blo nang nas chos la bskul ba zhig dgos/ de nas skyes bu chung ngu'i mi rtag pa dang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal la phyong ba thon pa'i tshe/ des 'jigs skrag nas de las thar ba zhig byung na snyam pa ma gtogs bsam rgyu med cing / nga ngan song du ma skyes pa zhig byung na des chog pa snyam pa'i tshod tsam skye/ de'i tshe bshes gnyen mkhas pas rim gyis yar 'khrid dgos/ 'khyed tshul yang ston pas gcung dga' bo byab chung ma puṇḍa ra ka zer ba la lhag par chags pas rab tu byung bar mi 'dod pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod rab tu byung bar 'dod dam gsungs pa la sangs rgyas ni gzi bajid che bas bka' las 'gong bar ma nus par rab tu byung ngo zhes zhus te/ phyi rol tu 'breg mkhan gyis skra breg par brtsam pa na/ nga mi ring bar stobs kyi 'khor bsgyur du 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe khyod kyi lag pa gcod do zhes bsdegs pa dang skrag nas 'breg mkhan kyang sbas so/ / de nas ston pa rang nyid kyis chu blug ste skra breg nas rab tu byung ste dge 'dun gyi khang skyong du bskos pas/ / ston pa 'khor bcas bsod snyoms la gshegs shul du phyag dar byas nas yul du 'gro snyam pa'i tshe/ ston pas phyag dar zin pa med par byin gyis rlabs pa'i stobs kyis ma nus pa dang / 'phro bshol te lam po che nas song na ston pa 'byon pa dang 'phrad kyi dogs nas/gsang lam zhig tu phyin pas ston pa'i mngon shes kyis gzigs nas lam de nas tshur 'byon pa mthong ste/ yal ga'i phag tu yib ste gnas las/ ston pa lam de nas tshur byon pa na yal ga rnams gyen du 'phags pas/ ston pas dga' po la gzigs te tshur shog gsungs/ ngo tsha bzhin du ston pa'i rjes su 'brang ste 'ong ba la/ ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas bltar bcug pas de la smon pa skyes te tshul khrims bsrung ba'i tshe ston pas dge 541

༄/ /༅ thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i ga4 4ma/slong rnams la/ khyed gcung dga' bo dang lhan cig tu stan la 'dug pa dang /gtam 'dri bar ma byed cig / de ci'i phyir na khyed cag gi lam mi gcig pa yin te/ dga' bo ni lha'i dpal 'byor 'dod pas tshangs par spyod pa yin la/khyed cag ni thar ba 'dod pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong rnams kyis de ltar byas pa'i tshe dga' bo yid skyo nas rim gyis 'bring gi lam dngos la tshud de mthar dgra bcom thob pa dang / kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gzhon pas rnamagayeng gi dbang du song nas thos bsam sgom pa sogs la brtson par mi byed pa'i tshe/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus lha gnas dang / dmyal ba sogs rim gyis bstan pas 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ste dgra bcom pa thob pa lta bu'i 'khrid tshul zhig dgos/ de ltar 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid log ste me 'bar ba'i 'ob ltar mthong ba na thar ba kho na don du gnyer zhing / des chog pa'i tshod tsam gyi blo skyes nas de las gzhan bsam rgyu med pa zhig yong bas/ de'i tshe zhi ba'i rgud par ltung nyen che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dir yang dang po gang yang ma byas pa'i dus na/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bzo lta 'dra ba zhig bzos pa yin la/ des zin pa'i theg pa chen po'i nyams len du yang 'gro zhing / dang po nas gol sa bcad pas theg dman du mi lhung ba'i thabs yin te/ dper na lha bris pas thog mar tshangs thig btab ste/ de nas rim gyis skya bris grub zin pa dang / gzod mtshon gtong ba'i 'go rtsom pa lta bu yin/ tshul 'di dgagatsug na rin chen gyi mdo dang / rgyur bla mar bsal la/ mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang / dang por sems bskyed dang / de nas gdams ngag gi skabs su bden bzhi dang skyabs 'gro sogs bstan zhing / skabs gsum par 'bring gi mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i gzhi shes bstan pa dang gnad gcig go /'bring las gong du 'khrid dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rang don gtso 542

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigs pa/bor don du gnyer ba rnams kyi nang nas drag shos nyan thos mchog zung lta bu yin la/ de dag kyang gzhan don lta zhog / rang don tsam yang ma rdzogs pa yin te/ mchog zung gis dmyal ba'i gnas rnams la gzigs pa'i che mu stegs pa'i ston pa rdzogs byed kyis rang gi slob ma rnams la 'phrin bskur ba de dag la gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'dis nged cag gi ston pa la bskur ba btab po zhes mo'u 'gal gye bu la brdung ste phyag zhabs thams cad 'dam bu ltar bcom nas bkrong ba yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa nas bzung ste/ de lta bu'i rgud pa thams cad las grol ba yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'phags pas na dang rga ba dang / / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ des na bshes gnyen mkhas pas theg pa chen por 'khrid dgos te/ po to bas/ rab brgal gcig la dze bcang gnyis min/ dang po nyid nas theg chen 'jug bya gsungs pa bzhin dang po nas theg pa chen po'i lam du 'jug dgos so/ / 'di la gnyis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed tshul dang / sems bskyed nas spyod pa la slob tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dngos dang /sems bskyed cho ga'i bzung ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la yang / rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sems bskyed tshul dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas byang chub tu sems bskyed tshul gnyis te/ snga ma ni sher phyin gye man ngag yin zhing bsgom rim las gsungs pa ltar jo bo rjes gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas sems bskyed tshul 'di sdong po bkod pa las gsungs pa bzhin klu sgrub kyis rin chen 'phreng ba mdo kun btus gzhan phan tshigs bcad sogs las gsungs shing / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi man ngag la brten nas/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug dang /mo3

sgo/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgon me'i ga4 4ma/bslab btus gnyis su gsal bar mdzad pa yin zhing 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni gzhan 'dra yang / yid 'ong gi rgyu'i drin dran lugs mi 'dra bar dgongs pa rab gsal las gsungs pa ltar snga ma la mar gyur tshul sogs kyi sgo nas drin bsam ste yid 'ong gi khyad par byams pa bskyed pa yin la/ gnyis pas dusagasum du phan btags tshul bsam nas de bskyed pa yin te/ de la dang po rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sems bskyed pa ni/ sngon du sems can thams cad la sems snyom pa bsgrub ste/ mar shes nas byang chub kyi sems kyibar bsgom pa yin pas/ 'di la gnyis/ thun gyi ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba dang / thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po spyor ba ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhes sogs sngar bzhin la/ de nas bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sems can thams cad la nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i sems snyoms pa dang /mar shes drin dran/ drin gzo/ byams snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs dgos shing / 'di nas bzung ste bdag dang ma sems can thams cad 'khor bar skyes nas yun ring ba la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs nga ba zhes mi zer ro/ / de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myongab byang chub kyi sems ma bsgom pas lan pa ma yin te/ nyan rang dgra bcom rnams kyis kyang byang chub kyi sems ma sgom kyang 'khor ba las thar ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ spyi bor bla ma lha bsgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas zhes sogs gsungs te/ de'i dgos pa ni/ 'dir yang bshes gnyen lhag par gal che ba/ rgyan las/ dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon bcas pa /'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ / zhes sogs dang / yongs 'dzin gye khyad 5rmā

༄/ /bde lamazinabresabadudaci'i thigasapa/par 'phags tshul sngar bshad pa ltar go ba'i ched yin no/ / de nas thog mar btang snyoms bsgrub pa la/ spyi'i dmigs pa bskyangs pas gar yang mi phyin pas/ bye brag tu dmigs dgos zhes rje bdag nyid chen pos gsungs pa ltar/thog mar ma la dmigs/ de nas gnyen dang / rim gyis dgra la dmigs te bsgom dgos la/ de'i tshe skye dka' bar byung na 'di snyam du ji rang drag /sems can gcig la sems snyoms pa mi skye na nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can thams cad la ji ltar skye/ rang nyid la cis kyang sems snyoms pa ma skyes pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam du sgo du ma nas 'bad de btang snyoms bsgrub dgos/ btang snyoms bsgrub pa'i tshe yang su la dga' zhing / su la mi dga'/dga' don yang med la sdang don yang mi 'dug snyam du btang snyoms bsgom na 'dir bshad pa'i btang snyoms 'di'i thun mong min pa'i dgra yin zhing /byang sems kyi sdom ldan zhig yin na rtsa ltung yang phog la/ de ni tshangs pa'i cod pan ma ltar/ ma brtags btang snyoms yin pas de 'dra mi rung / 'o na ji ltar sgom zhe na/ sems can thams cad la mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pasaganyen yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas dgra gnyen kun la sems snyoms pa bsgrub pa yin la/ de lta bu'i btang snyoms de ni/ gsang 'dus bla brgyud las/ btang snyoms sa gzhi byams pa'i chus brlan zhing / / zhes pa ltar/rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gye rtsa ba'i sa gzhi lta bu yin pas de'i grangs su mi 'dren la/ de bdun gyi grangs 'dren tshul yang rgyu drug dang / 'bras bu gcig gam/ yang na rgyu lnga dang 'bras bu lhag bsam dang sems bskyed gnyis so/ / yang na snying rje ni 'jug pa las gsungs pa ltar/ thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba gzhung shing lta bu yin pas/ de dngos gzhir byas te/des sbyor ba la bzhi dang / 'bras bu la gnyis su byed pa rgyan dang 'jug pa ma5

༄/ /gang ca bam pa'i sgronasa'i g.yo 4ma/bsdomapa'i man ngag yin no/ / de la dang po mar shes bsgom pa yang / rgyu mtshan med par sems can thams cad ma'o snyam du mig btsum nas mu de tsam yin nam 'khrul 'degs bzhin du gzhan zhig yod zhes dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar las gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar dris nas rigs pas bsgrub dgos shing / sgrub tshul ni/ dris lan blo bzang bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs las/ sgo rtsa'i khyi sogs sems can rnams/ / mar shes bsgom tshul rnam 'grel las/ / skye ba yongs su len pa na/ / zhes sogs rig pas thog ma'i mtha'/ / med par bsgrub pa'i lung rigs kyi/ / thabs mkhas 'khrul gyis bsgom zhes gsol/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i skye ba'i ya mtha' thug med du bsgrub dgos pa yin/ dge legs 'phel /5yo

༄/ /sbyoraba'ichosadrug lagatulen tshuyolamabazang ༅ pa'i 'jugayogs/༄༅/ / byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sngon 'gro spyor ba'i chos drug lag tu len tshul gsal bar bkod pa lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ / dpal ldan sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ / lam bzang de nyid 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /bla ma thub dbang brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ / zab rgyas nyams len bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i/ / khang bzang kun la rmang gzhi brtan po bzhin/ / med mi rung gi sngon 'gro spyor ba'i chos/ / lag tu blang ba'i rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ / de'ang dpal chos kyi grags pas/ / rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye bar/ / rjes su dpag pa gang yin te/ / don gzhan la ni mi ltos phyir/ /de ni rang bzhin yin par brjod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba med pa zhig bsgrubs na 'bras bu de nyid mi 'grub pa'i thabs med pa zhig yin gyi/ rgyu ma bsgrubs par 'bras bu 'dod kyang don med de/ dper na ston gyi lo tog phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dod phyin dpyid dus nas rmos glang gso ba dang chu lud 'dren pa sogs la 'bad dgos kyang / de dag gal chung du byas nas yal bar dor te lo tog rtsis su byas kyang skye ba'i thabs med pa bzhin 547

༄7/ /gung thang bstan ba'ilhaname'i gsung 'bum/ no/ /des na spyir nyams len mtha' dag dang / khyad par byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len byed par 'dod pa rnams kyis sngon 'gro spror ba'i chos drugagis rmang gzhi zin pa zhig nges par bya dgos te/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ rgyu rnam bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te/ / stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ /zhes rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bzhi gsungs pas/ dngos gzhi ni stong bar gnas zhes don dam byang chub kyi sems dang / sems can mi gtong zhes pas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems gnyisazung du 'jug pa'i skyes bu chen po'i lam rnams bstan/ ji skad smras bzhin byed ces pas lam gye rtsa ba bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten nas des ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du rim gyis slob tshul dang / bde gshegs byin rlabs can zhes pas zhing khyad par can la brten nas tshogs gsog sgrib spyong sogs byas te/ lam gye rtogs pa skye ba'i snod rung du sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro spyor ba'i chos 'di dag bstan pa yin no/ / don de nyid gsal bar byed pa la bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis lam gyi rim pa thams cad dad sogs lngar bsdus te bstan pas/ rkang pa dang po'i tshe 'khor pa spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i chung 'bring thun mong gi lam bstan pa yin la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshogs zhing gsal btab ste yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba sogs sngon 'gro'i chos kyang bstan pa yin te/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las byang chub sems dpa' phyogs gtsang mar skyil mo krung bcas te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs pa sngon du 548

༄/ /sbyoraba'itshal༄ga lag rtsalen tshugalamabazang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/'gro bas/ zhes sogs kyis de'i dgongs pa bkral ba yin zhing / der phyogs gtsang mar zhes pas gnas khang byi dor byas shing sku gsung rten gyi rten dgram/mchod pa legs par bshams nas dang ba 'dren pa zhig byed dgos pa de bstan/ skyil mo krung bcas zhes pas lus gnad lhag ma rnams dang kun slong la brtag tshul bstan/ lhag mas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshogs gsog tshul sogs bstan pa shi na tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na sngon 'gro spyor ba'i chos drug po 'di dag ni sher phyin gyi mdo'i don mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi man ngag byang chub lam gyi rim pa las gsal bar byas pa'i nyams len gyi spyi sdoms chen po yin pa shes par bya'o/ /des na 'di la drug /gnas khang byi dor byas shing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram pa/ mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pa mdzes par bsham pa/ bde ba'i stan la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang byi dor byed pa'ang mdzes chos tsam ma yin par der tshogs zhing rnams spyan 'dren pa'i don du bkur ste'i bsam pa dang / spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo las 'byung ba ltar rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi sgrib pa'i nyal nyil rnams bsal bar mos pa dang / rgyal sras kye spyod pa'i sdom chen po rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi ya gyal sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong pa'i rgyur dmigs pa sogs kun slong ji tsam rgya che ba bzhin phyags ma re re brgyab pa la'ang phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ste/ rtag ngus chos 'phags la bkur ste bya ba'i phyir sa rdul gnon byed la rang gi lus kyi rtsa bo che rnams gtar nas khrag gis chag chag byas pa dang / lam chung pas rdul phyis dri ma phyis zhes pa'i tshig gnyis po brjodabazhin du phyag dar byas te bden pa mthong ba'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /549

ro༅/ /shud thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gsung 'bum/phyagadar byed tshul yang chu gtsang gis chag chag legs par gdab la rdulami ldangab byed cing / dug gsum gyi rdul dang des bskyed pa'i las sgrib kyi dri ma'am/ yang na des bsgos pa'i bag chags shes sgrib kyis bsdus pa rnams bsal bar mos nas ngag tu'ang tshig de gnyi ga brjod bzhin par phyag dar byasan rten 'brel gyi sgo yod par rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsungs so/ / sku gsung thugs rten dgram tshul ni/ rgyu'i bzang ngan dang gsar rnying sogs gtso bor mi byed par bstan pa'i bdag po dang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje bdag nyid chen po sogs kyi sku rnams dbus dang gong du 'bab par byas/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung sogs kyang go rim bzhin du bsgrig / sdud pa yan chad sher mdo re med mi rung yin zhing / rgyud sde dang theg pa'i go rim bzhin bzhugs stabs bde na de bzhin byed la/ lta grub mi mthun pa'i dpe sogs de'i grangs su mi gzhug / thugs kyirten yangs sa tsā yan chad ci 'byor re nges par dgos so/ / gal te sku gsung thugs rten gyi rigs ci'ang ma 'byor na shing ngam g.yam pa lta bu'i maṇḍal gyi steng du dri bzang gi chus byugs la tshom bu lnga sogs bkod de/ de'i stengadu skyabs yul rnams bzhugs par mos pa byas na chog pas 'di la sgrub pa'i maṇḍal zhes zer ro/ / khrid yig snga ma 'ga' zhig tu tshom bu lnga'i dbus mar bla ma/ shar du yi dam/ lhor sangs rgyas/ nub tu byang sems nyan rang /byang du mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams gsal 'debs par bshad pa bzhin byas kyang chog /'og gi tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul dang go rim mi mtshungs kyangaskyon med de/ 'di ni sku gsung thugs rten dgram rgyu'i dod dang mtshon byed tsam yin pa4thad ka thad gar ji bzhin 'grig mi dgos so/ / gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa'i kun slong khe 'dod grags 'dod tshe 'di'i bde skyid sogs kyi 550

༄/ /sbyor ba'i chosakhrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/ched du dmigs na kun slong g.yo can yin pas de las bzlog ste thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur dmigs pa dang / bsham tshul yon chab lta bu la mtshon na rgyal po chen po'i gsol dpon bzhin thog mthar phra la bar du sbom pa kha mtho dman ran pa zhig dgos kyi/ bo na tshul khrims 'chal pa/ ma gang na longs spyod dbul ba/ ya yor song na lam log par gol ba/ rgyu gang ngan la byas na rang gi phun tshogs thams cad 'grib pa sogs nyen shin tu che bas/long pas mig ldan la mgo skor gtong ba lta bu byar mi rung bar gsungs ṭwāṃ /thā ga/ ma~X ༵ pa ༵dīlabye pa~Xmya // saṃ ༷ ṭwāṃ ༵ bha ṭwāṃ ༵ ṭwāṃ/ zlo dī dhri dīzlo ༵bhe baṭwāṃ//mahā te dza badzre/ mahā bibyu badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ mahā bo dhi maṇḍi pa si kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba naspo a wa ra ḍā bi sho dha na badzre swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rab 'joms kyi gzungs sam mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod bzhin par phul na phyog bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po nam mkha' gang ba 'byung bar gsungs pas gal shin tu che'o/ / gsum pa ni/ yun ring por sgom sgrub byed pa la rlan sogs kyis mi gnod pa'i phyir rlung rgyu tshul yod pa'i khri dra ba can/ de'i 'og tu sa dkar gyis g.yung drung g.yas skor du bris/ steng du rtswa dur ba rtse mo dbus dang rtsa ba phyir bstan nas dgram/ nyung ngu las med na rtse mo mdun dang rtsa ba rgyab tu bstan pas chog cing / dgun dus lta bu ma rnyed na de'i rtsa ba brkos pa gting bas kyang chog par gsungs so/ / de'i steng du 'bol gdan mdun dma' la rgyab cung zad mtho ba bting / phyed skyil byed tshul ni rkang pa g.yon pa nang dang g.yas pa phyir byas la gnyi ga'i rkang mgo gcig gcig gi 'og tu shor ba lta bu ma yin par gsang gnas kyi tshad du gleb pa bya/ lag pa lte 'og 551

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/sor bzhi tsam na g.yas pa steng dang g.yon pa 'og tu byas te mthe bong gnyis kye rtse cung zad sbyar ba mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bya/ rked pa drang por bsrang /mgrin pa cung zad dgug /so dang mchu rang lugs su bzhag /lce rtse rkan la cung zad sbyar/ mgo ma yo bar thad gar bzung / mig ha cang mi dbye ha cang mi zum pa sna rtse dang lte ba'i bar gyi nam mkha' la gtad/ phrag pa gnyis mtho dman med par bya/ 'di bdun dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rlung cham la 'beb pa ste rnam snang gi chos brgyad dang ldan par bya/ de'ang lus kyi spyod lam tshul mthun byung na rtsa rnams rang sor gnas shing de la brten pas rlung drang por rgyu ba'i stobs kyis sems gsal zhing brtan pa 'byung ngo / / sgra bsgyur mar pas bod kyi man ngag zab zab thams cad bsdoms kyang nga'i sdod tshul gcig pur mi do zhes gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin la/ lus gnad der yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dgos pa gsum gsum yod tshul sogs 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis gsungs so/ /de nas kha nang du bskor la kun slong 'chos pagal che ste/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ rtsa ba sman yin na yal ga dang lo ma'ang sman yin/ rtsa ba dug yin na yal ga dang lo ma'ang dug yin gsungs pa bzhin/ 'og gi dge sbyor mtha' dag gnad du 'gro mi 'gro thog ma'i kun slong 'chos tshul gyi legs nyes 'di kho na la ltos yod pas/ chos kyi dbu'i rgya gar skad bzhin du sgom gyi thog ma'i mgo 'dzugs 'di nas rten 'brel ma 'phyug pa zhig dgos par paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs so/ /des na blo kha nang du phyogs te rang rgyud la brtag pa'i tshe tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags la sogs pa don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa mngon du gyur na kun slong ma dag pa yin/ phyi mar bde 'gro lha mi'i mngon mtho tsam zhig dang / rang kho na'i ched du dman pa'i myang 'das don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa yod na de'ang 552

༄/ /sbyoraba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/kun slong ma dag pa yin pas/ rlung 'gro 'ong la brten nas kun slong ma dag pa de sbyang bar bya'o/ / de'i tshul ni sna bug nas rlung phyir btang ba'i tshe kun slong gi tog pa ngan pa mtha' dag du ba nag po'i rnam par phyir thon nas nam mkha'i dbyings su yal song snyam du bsam pa dang / nang du rngub ba'i tshe bla ma sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par rang gi sna bug nas zhugs te snying gar thim pas dge sems khyad par can mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ de'ang rlung sna bug g.yas nas dal bus rngub ste g.yon nas dal bus phyir gtong ba lan gsum/g.yon nas rngub ste g.yas nas 'bud pa gsum/ gnyi ga nas rngub ste gnyi ga nas phyir gtong ba gsum bya/ 'di la rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal ba zer/de nas sna bug gnyi ga nas rlung nang du rngub pa dang phyir gtong ba'i khug pa nyer gcig bgrang ngo / / de nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting dang mtha' med pa 'dir thog ma med pa zhig nas yun ring la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas mnar zhing / da dung yang ji tsam zhig myong dgos pa'i mtha' mi zin la/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mtha' yas bas mnar tshul dang sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de dag kyang rang la 'brel med pa zhig ma yin par yang nas yang du mar gyur te gnod pa thams cad las bskyabs/ phan pa thams cad la sbyar ba'i drin mo che sha stag yin/ des na de dgagi sdug bsngal sel ba'i khur bdag la babs kyang da lta ni nus pa ci'ang med/ de thams cad kyi don byed nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin pas/ bdag gis 'di dag gi phyir du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya snyam du bsams la skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis 553

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgronasa'i g.yo 4ma/btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa'i steng khar sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gi mdog can gsol ba/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de nyid kyi mtha' skor du dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogasakyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de dag rang rang gi mdun na gdan khri phun sum tshogs pa la rang rang gis gsungs pa'i lung gi chos rnams 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi po ti'i rnam pa brag ri brtsigs pa bzhin du khra chem me yod pa/ rang gi mtha' skor du pha ma rigs drug gi sems can sa'i dreg pa bzhin srug shig ge yod pa thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan mthong nas blo lings kyis khel ba'i dad pa shugs drag po skyes par bsams la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brgya stong sogs brjod/ de'i tshe dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / yi dam sangs rgyas rnams dang / chos po ti rnams dang / byang sems nyan rang mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang 554

༄/ /sbyor ba'i chosakhrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugayogs/bcas pa'i rgyun babs rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang / khyad par du bla ma'i sku la bsdos pa dang gsung bcag pa thugs dkrugs pa sogs bla ma la brten pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan bshig pa sogs sangs rgyas la brten pa dang /chos spong gi las sogs chos la brten pa dang / dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa sogs dge 'dun la brten pa'i nyes pa thams cad sbyangs te de dang de'i byin rlabs zhugs nas skyabs 'og tu chud song snyam pa'i mos pa rim bzhin byed/de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing dmigs pa ni/tshogs zhing thams cad kyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga'i rgyun babs/ dkon mchog gsum la brten pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te gsum ga'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i dmigs pa byed/ de rjes/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod rnams kyis/ / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gang mang brjod cing dmigs pa ni/ sbyin pa las byung ba dang / tshul khrims las byung ba dang / bsgoms pa sogs las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du myur basprur bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig / bdag gis ma sems can thams cad kyi don du myur ba myur bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyal sras kyispyod pa mtha' dag la tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o snyam du smon 'jug gi sems skyed shugs drag bsgoms pas bla ma thub pa'i dbang po las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang nyid la thim pas/ rang 555

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ nyid kyang bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis gyur/ rang thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mtha' skor na yod pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang la bkod par gyur pa'i mos pa byas te sems bskyed 'bras bu lam khyer gyi tshul du bsgom/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig snyam du btang snyoms tshad med dang / bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du byams pa tshad med dang / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces snying rje tshad med dang / sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam du dga' ba tshad med bsgom la/ de re re'i skabs su'ang de ltar gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / de ltar gyur cig snyam pa dang / de ltar bdag gis bya'o snyam pa dang / de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa ste khyad par bzhi bzhi tshang bar bya zhing bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi dmigs pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad tshad med bzhi la gnas par gyur song snyam du mos pa brtan po byed/ de nas khyad par gyi sems bskyed ni/ ma sems can thams cad kyi don du myur ba myur bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas byang chub lam kyi rim pa'i khrid bsgom pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pa lan mang du byas la tshogs zhing rnams rim gyes bsdus te smin mtshams byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo nas thim par bsam mo/ / 'jam dpal zhal lung gi 'khrid lugs ltar na dal 'byor gyi chos skor man chad la ltos te spyor ba'i chos drug 'byung yang / bshes gnyen bsten tshul gye dmigs skor gtso bor byed pa'i tshe 556

༄/ / sbyor ba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshul lamabazang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/sbyor ba'i chos snga ma de gsum po tsam yin gyi/ mtshams 'di nas dngos gzhir 'jod dgos/ de'i tshul yang bar 'dir bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phan yon/ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs/ rtsa ba dad pa sbyangs shing bka' drin rjes su dran te bsam pas bsten tshul gyi dmigs rnam legs par bskyangs la/ de nas spyor bas bsten tshul bkur ste dang rim gro dang rnyed pa dbul ba sogs kyi tshab tu tshogs zhing gsal btab nas phyag 'tshal ba/ sku khrus gsol ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba sogs byas pa yin pas phyi ma gsum la sbyor ba'i tha snyad mi 'thob bo/ / de bzhin du bde lam gye khrid rgyun 'di'i dbang du byas kyang sbyor ba'i chos drug tsam la thun gyi dngos gzhi tshang bar byas te bskyangs na'ang rung bas/de 'dra'i skabs su'ang dang po gsum sbyor ba dang / tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa man chad la dngos gzhir 'jog dgos so/ / de la bzhi pa tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul ni/ snga ma bzhin rang gi mdun gye thad drang gi nam mkha'i gnas su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa zhig gi steng khar sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gi mdog can mdzes par gsol ba/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dkyil na zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa steng phyogs su 'phros pa'i sne mor seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rgyal pardo rje 'chang la nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor 557
