༄/ /༅ thang bayo lo sgron dku ga4 4ma/nas bzhugs pa/ g.yas phyogs su 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne mor pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun byams pa la rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ g.yon phyogs su 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne mor pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ mdun phyogs su 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne mor seng khri pad zla'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rang la dngos su chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsams la/ mdun gye rtsa ba'i blam de ni zhal mjal dus kyi rnam pa can du byed/ tshogs zhing thams cad don ngo bo gcig kyang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam pa de nyid byinablabs 'jug pa'i yul gyi nye shos yin pas/ phyag mtshan yang shes rab rgyasapar 'dod na glegs ral/ tshe spel bar 'dod na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ longs spyod kyi don la bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed/ nad zhi ba'i don du bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs bzhin pa'i a ru ra gser mdog /ting nge 'dzin gtso bor bsgom na mnyam bzhag / sngags kyi rtogs pa rtsal du 'dod na rdor dril bsnams pa sogs su bya zhing / las so so la sku mdog kyang de mthun byar rung ngo / /de'i mthar gsal 'debs rgyu'i chos 'brel can gyi bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams la gdan gos 'bol brtsegs pa dang / 'das pa rnams la pad zla'i gdan byed cing / tshigs bcad gcig gis 'brel thogs pa yan chad grangs brtsis te ma chad pa shin tu gal che'o/ bla ma rnams kye phyi rol tu/ g.yas su gsang 'dus/ g.yon du bde mchog / mdun du 'jigs byed/ rgyab tu dus 'khor/ mtshams rnams su rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gzhan rnams dang de'i mtha' bskor du skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong sogs longs sprul rnams dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang chub sems dpa' 558

༄/ /sbyoraba'i chosadrug lag tu lenatshul lamabazang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/rnams dang / rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs nyan rang rnams legs par gsal gdab/ de dag gi mdun du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa rang la spyan hu re bar gzigs nas bzhugs pa/ rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du chos skyong srung ma ye shes pa rnams dang / de dag gi phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bstan pa bsrung ba'i tshul du rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs pa gsal gdab po/ / tshogs zhing de thams cad kyi thugs gar rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang yum bcas/ de'i thugs gar hūṃ yig ste sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du bsgoms na dgos pa shin tu che la/sems dpa' sum brtsegs ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ / nyan rang sogs kyi thugs gar rdo rje 'chang bsgoms pa ma 'brel snyam du bsam mi rigs te/ de thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul yin pas spangs rtogs mchog dman med cing / 'og tu so so'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i ngo bo 'bru lnga bsgom par gsungs pa dang yang mtshungs pas so/ de dag rang rang gi mdunan gdan khri phun sum tshogs pa la rang rang gis gsungs pa'i lung gi chos rnams 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi po ti'i rnam par yod pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba rgyal po chen po'i pho nya'i 'gro 'ong bzhin bar mtshams med pa lta bur bsams na ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo shin tu che'o/ / de nas gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi spyi bor me long lta bu'i ye shes dang rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo ā dmar po/ thugs gar chos dbyibs ye shes dang mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar mnyam nyid ye shes dang rin 'byung gi ngo bo swā ser po/559

༄/ /ca ca bayo yo/sgronasa'i g.yo 4ma/gsangaganas su bya sgrub ye shes dang don 'grub kyi ngo bo hā ljang gus mtshan par bsams/ de nas bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom4pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ bla ma dam tshig pa la bla ma ye shes pa dang / gsang 'dus dam tshig pa la gsang 'dus ye shes pa bstem pa tsam ma yin par/ tshogs zhingagi gtso bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po nas mtha'i rgyal chen bzhi'i bar re re la'ang tshogs zhing thams cad kyi ye shes pa cha tshang ba re bstem pa yin te/deltar byas na gnas skabs de dag la mchog dman du 'dzin pa'i 'du shes ldog ste bla ma gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul du mthong nas dad pa dang / rang nyid srid zhi'i rgud pa las skyob pa'i phyir rnam pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa zhig bzung bayin par go nas gus pa je cher 'gro la/ lam dus su 'di ltar bskyangs pa'i stobs kyis 'bras bu'i dus na rigs re re la'ang rigs thams cad tshang ba'i dam pa rigs brgya sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshe spro na/ ma lus sems can zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyang brjod la/ de nas dza : baṃ ho zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas te dbyer med du bstem/ de'ang spyir thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung tshan che zhing / khyad paradakor sgrib sogs kyis non pa'i dbang gis sgom sgrub la zhugs pa'i tshe nag thom gyis song nas sems mi gsal ba la khrus gsol sogs byas na phan shin tu che bas/ de'i byed tshul ni/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi mdun du khrus kyi khang pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub cing / rgya phib rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ne'u gsing me tog bkra bas phyogs kun mdzes shing / rin po che'i ljon shing rnam pa sna tshogs pas yongs su bskor ba/ khang ba'i phyogs bzhir sgo re re dang / sgo so so'i mdun du khrus kyi rdzing bu gru bzhi pa me tog sna tshogs pas 560

༄/ /sbyor ba'ichosakhrug lag tu len yo lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/brgyan cing / 'og gzhi gser gyi phye ma brdal ba/ phyogs rer rin po che'i them skas 'bab stegs kyi rnam par yod pa/ nang du dri zhim po'i ngad ldang ba'i spos chus yongs su gang ba re re yod pa/ khang pa'i dbus su seng khri sogs sngar ltar gsal btab la/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ / zhes sogs brjod pas tshogs zhing rnams na bza' med par khrus khang gi nang du khri rnams la 'khor par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas lha mo bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spro ba'am/ yang na rang lus lha grangs mnyam par sprul nas thams cad kyis lag tu bum pa thogs te dzing bu rnams las chu blangs nas khrus gsol bas 'gro ba'i snang ngor dri ma thams cad dag cing / thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can bskrun par bsams te tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas khrus gsol zhing / de dag sku la zhes sogs kyis sku dbyi ba spel mar bya/ de nas dri zhim po'i lde gus sku lus la byugs par mos shing /stong gsum kun tu zhes sogs dang / sprul sku rnams la chos gos rnam gsum/longs sku rnams la lha'i gos kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang rin po che'i rgyan/ khro bo rnams la stag sham rus rgyan sogs phul bar bsams la/ srab 'jam yang ba zhes sogs dang / rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i zhes sogs brjod/bdag dang 'gro la zhes pa nas bzhugs su gsol zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du tshogs zhing rnams bya khyu 'phur ba bzhin 'ur dir gyis byon pa sngar gyi rang rang gi khri la bzhugs shing / khrus khang mi dmigs par gyur par bsam/ khrus gsol 'di brel dus ma byas kyang chog pa yin no/ / de nas lnga pa bsag sbyang gagand bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'bul ba la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ / bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 561

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'itsho sa gakhrung 'bum/lo/ / phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i reb skong ba'i gsung / / ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ /shākya'i gtso bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ / mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i sde/ / seng bzang ku sā li gnyis gser gling ba/ / rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang / / zla ba grags pa rigs pa'i khu byug che/ / sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te/ / zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / / mchog gzigs te lo pa dang nā ro pa/ / dpal mchog ḍo sti ba dang a ti sha / nyams len byin rlabs brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes sogs lam rim bla ma brgyud pa dang / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal gang 'grub bya/ rgyas par byed na lam mchog sgo 'byed kyi gsol ba 'debs zhes pa phyag 'tshal du bsgyur cing / tshigs bcad gzhan yang ci rigs pa bsnan te phyag dngos su 'tshal na thog mar/ na mo mañtsa shri ye/ na mo su thi ye/ na mo yuttam thi ye swāhā/ zhes phyag stong 'gyur gyi sngags 'di'ang lan gsum tsam brjod na legs so/ / phyag 'tshal tshul ni lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i brkyang phyag tu grags pa'am/ yang na yan lag lnga'i phyag bya ste/ de'ang rkang pa gnyis gshib/ thal mo rab sbyi bor/ 'bring mgrin par/ tha ma snying gar sbyar/ de'ang car car por sbyar ba mu stegasakyi lugs yin pa dang / sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur bas de lta bu ma yin par mdzug rtse rnams sbyar lag pa'i mthil ma sbyar ba bya/ phan yonaspyi gtsug bltar mi mngon pa 'grub/ de nas brkyang phyag dang skum phyag gang yang rung ste yan lag lnga sa la phab nas btsal dgos kyi/ mgo sa la mi mo2

༄/ /sbyor ba'i chosakhrug lag tu len tshul lamabazang sgrubapa'i 'jugangogs/thug par sgur tsam byas na dmyal ba mgo 'phyangs su skye zhing thar nas kyang sgur skyon can du 'gyur/ tshul mthun du phyag btsal pa'i phan yon lus kyis ji tsam non pa'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par 'khor sgyur du skye bar gsungs pas sla chos su ma song bar tshul dang mthun pa byed dgos so/ / de nas rang gi lus grangs med pa sogs su sprul par mos la/ ji snyed su dag ces sogs gdon zhing / mchod pa'i skabs su gzhan nas 'byung ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyi mchod 'phreng ci rigs pa'ang bsnan nas byas chog la/ bla mchod sogs nas 'byung ba lta bu phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa cha tshang bar byas na'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ / sngags kyi skabs kun bzang mchod sprin zhes pa bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de nyid mchod pa'i yo byad mtha' yas pa'i rnam par shar ba la zer zhing / mdo lugs kyi kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa 'bul tshul ni padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar rang nyid kun tu bzang po/ 'dab ma stong la kun tu bzang po stong / de thams cad kyi lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nor bu rin po che re re/ de dag las mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams 'gengs par bsams nas 'bul ba la byed do/ / las dang po pa la 'di phan shin tu che'o/ / sdig pa bshags pa'i skabs ltung bshags dang spyi bshags sogs byas na legs la/de'ang gtso bor stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas rten gyi stobs ni sngar tshogs zhing gsal btab pa des 'grub la/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni tshe thog ma med pa nas sdig ltung dpag tu med pa bsags pa rgyal po'i gan mdzod bzhin du sna re re la bltas na'ang 'khor ba thog med nas 'di kho na bsags par 'dug snyam pa'i tshod lta bu bsam las 'das pa zhig yod cing / skye ba 'dir 563

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i sgronama'i g.yo bam/yang sdom pa gsum sogs khas blang rgya che la bsrung ba sna gcig kyang sems la 'dzin rgyu med pas dbugs 'gyu ba 'di chad ma thag 'gro sa dmyal ba las med pa rang gi myong thog nas thag chod par 'dug /kha sang tsam la shi yod na da tshodadamyal ba'i lcags khang du me dmar 'ur ru ru sdug bsngal gyi cho nge lhang lhang 'debs bzhin par yod pas bya thabs med kyang / da dung ma shi ba 'di kha rje che bas 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i skabs shig myur ba myur bar ma btsalaba'i thabs rang mi 'dug snyam du bsam/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bslab btus las mang du gsungs pas/ thun mtshams sogs ci rigs par de thams cad lag len du thebs pa dgos kyang / dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir ltung bshags sogs gang byed pa de'i tshe rnam smin la 'jigs pa dang / 'on kyang gnyen po des de sel nus par yid ches pa sogs blo 'khul nges pa dgos so/ / nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas pa'i sdeg pa la 'gyod pa'i sgo nas phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems drag po bya la/ phyin chad spong 'dod med pa'am yod kyang lag len la mi 'gel bzhin du phyin chad sdom mo zhes khas len pa ni nyes pa mi 'dag pa'i steng du rdzun gyi nyes par 'gyur bas/ sdig lhung 'phral du spong thub pa rnams ni ngos zin ma thag spong sdom tshul bzhin du bya la/ gal te 'phral du spong mi nus pa rnams kyang ji mi snyam par mi 'jog par lo zla ba'i bar ram nyin zhag re'i bar du mi byed snyam du sdom sems bya zhing lag tu blangs pa dang / bdag gis myur du 'di lta bu spong nus par shog cig snyam du smon pa sogs byas nas rim gyes goms par byas na skabs shig dngos su spong thub pa nges par 'byung ngo / /der ma zad blo'i gting na spongs thub snyam pa med kyang skabs der blo bcos nas spongs thub snyam pa tsam byas na'ang ltung thun byin rlabs byas pas 5yo

༄/ /sbyoraba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugangogs/las la mi bsgribs pa ltar sdig pa dag pa la phan che bas thabs ma byung na 'di tsam re yin kyang bya dgos par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ / bshags pa'i skabs 'dir sngar byas kyi nyes pa la nyes par mthong ba'i rnam par sun 'byin pa dang / phyin chad sdom pa slar ldog pa'i stobs gnyis po 'di gal che ba'i dbang gis bshags pa phal cher gye mjug tu mthong sdom dris pa yin pas don 'di go ba'ang gnad shin tu che'o/ / kha cig 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdig pa bsags pa la mtha' med pas bshags bsdams phran tshegs res go mi chod snyam pa ni las 'bras bsam tshul min gyi/ gnyen po la yid ma ches pa'i skur 'debs yin pas nyes dmigs lhag par che ste/nyes dmigs 'byung bar yang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yin la/ bshags na 'dag par yang des gsungs pa yin pas yid ches byed na gnyi ga la byed dgos tshul be'u bum sngon mo'i 'grel par gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de nas rjes su yi rang ni tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can yin te/'grel chung don gsal las/ rjes su yi rang yid la byed pas ni rang gzhan gyis dge ba byas pa mnyam pa nyid 'thob bo/ / zhes gzhan gyis dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas lo dang bskal pa mang por bsgrubs pa'i dge ba dang / de la snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rang byas pa'i tshe blo'i 'gyur ba gcig gis de dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams 'thob nus pas bya sla zhing don che la/ der ma zad yon tan rin po che sdud pa las nyan rang sogs kyi dge rtsa mtha' dag byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su yi rang gcig gis zil gyis gnon par gsungs te/'di la dgongs nas dbus mtha' rnam 'byed du dam pa bcu gnyis kyi nang nas rjes su yi rang la tshegs med pa dam pa zhes gsungs so/ / des na rang cagacong chub sgrub par khas 'che ba rnams kyis gzhan gyi dge ba la phrag dog 565

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgronasa'i gatshi stem/med par rjes su yi rang bsgom dgos te/ dper na mu ge'i tshe pha gcig gis bu mang zhig gso dgos pa la/ de'i nang nas gcig gis rang stobs kyis 'tsho ba rnyed na 'dis rang mgo thon pa 'ong bar 'dug snyam du rang gis rnyed pa las kyang dga' ba lhag par skye ba bzhin no/ / des na gnas ma yin pa dmag 'khrug dang g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa sogs la rjes su yi rang go log byas te don med par rang rgyud sdig pas gang ba mi byed cing / dge ba chung ngu zhig la mi brnyas par rjes su yi rang byed dgos tshul rnams bsam ste/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang zhes sogs brjod/ de nas dngos su maṇḍal gye steng du tshom bu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lta bu dgod la/ yid kyis rang nyid tshangs pa chen por mos te gser gye 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas/ chos 'khor skor bar bskul zhing zhal gyis bzhes par bsams la/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i zhes sogs dang / yang maṇḍal kha gsos te lag tu thogs la seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa phul bar bsam zhing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab nas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dmigs rnam dang bcas/ mya ngan 'da' ston zhes sogs dang / gnas skabs su bsgrub bzhin pa'i dge rtsa 'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag chud mi za zhing 'bras bu dman pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur bar mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur bsngo ba'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs bya/ de'ang yan lag bdun po 'di'i nang nas phyag 'tshal ba nga rgyal gyi gnyen po/ mchod pa ser sna'i/ bshags pa dug gsum gyi/ rjes su yi rang phrag dog gi /chos 'khor skor bar bskul ba chos spong gi / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debasapa bla ma'i thugs dkrug pa sogs kyi/ bsngo ba log lta'i gnyen por 566

༄/ /sbyoraba'ichosadrug lag tu len tshul lamabazang mapa'i 'jugangogs/'grob sogs rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i spang gnyen sbyor lugs dang dgos pa sgrub tshul 'gang che ba re yod la/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad kyang yan lag bdun po 'dir ma 'dus pa med par rje ngag dbang byams pa'i gsungazin bris su 'byung ba ltar yin pas cha thams cad nas nan tan snying por bya dgos so/ / drug pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/dper na yul gyi rgyal po sogs la zhu don gal che ba zhig byed pa'i tshe gsol ston sogs drangs zin pa'i rjes su rang gi snying nor gces pa zhig phul te zhu ba byed pa bzhin/ 'dir yang 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs pa'i thog mar maṇḍal 'bul ba la/ rgyu ni gser dngul zangs sogs rin po che dang / ma 'byor na shing rdo sogs las byas ba che chung gi tshad rang gis rgyun du 'bul rgyu la khru gang sogs chen po byung na legs/ de lta bu'i steng du ba byung gis byugs/rangagi mtheb srin gyi dri bzang gi chu blangs la mthe bong dbus su bzhag ste srin lag gis shar lho nas nub byang gi bar dang / de nas srin lag dbus su bzhag ste mthe bos nub byang nas shar lho'i bar bskor/ maṇḍal gyi dbus stong par bzhag na sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du skye bar gsungs pas/ de ma thag dbus su tshom bu gcig bzhag / de nas oṃ badzra zu mi zhes sogs kyi skabs su tshig ris bzhin gser dkyil lcags ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su ri rab/ steng du nyi zla/ phyogs su gling dang gling phran/ rgyal srid sna bdun/gzhan yang lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa gcig tu bsdoms nas phul bas dgyes bzhin bzhes te zhing khams rnams su sprul pa'i bkod pa ston par bsam/ maṇḍal nyer gsum ma 'di ni 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u brgyad pa las gsungs pa yin zhing / yongs grags ltar sgeg sogs lha mo rnams bsnan pa 'di 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus mdzad pa yin la/ blos lcogs na spyod 567

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonace' gsung 'bum/'jug tu/ nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ / zhes gsungasapa ltar zhing khams mtha' yas ba blos blangs te phul na de'i tshod kyi bsod nams rdzogs tshabs che la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal tshang bar byas na shin tu'ang legs so/ / de nas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ stsal tu gsol/ / zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma las rang 'dra gnyis pa chad de spyi bor byon/ rang dang kha lta phyogs mthun par bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bla ma la brten pa'i nyes tshogs sbyangs/rkang ba phyi ma lan gnyis pa brjod pas de'i byin rlabs zhugs shing / de nas tshogs zhing rnams la nga'i bu 'di brtse bas rjes su zungs shig ces ngo chen byed par bsam zhing / 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ / rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun mi pham mgon/ / rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med zhabs/ / sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes rkang pa phyi ma lan gnyis su brjod pas dang po'i tshe tshogs zhing spyi dang khyad par du de gsum ga'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas thog med nas bsags pa'i nyes ltung sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skye ba la gegs byed kyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ lan gnyis pa'i tshe de gsum las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad de rang la dzim pas rgya che ba'i lam gye rim pa de dang de skye ba'i snod rung du byin gyis brlabs byung snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rang gis thob tshul gyi brgyud rim ltar gyi gsol 'debs byed cing / zab mo lta brgyud kyi skabs su bdag gnyis su mtshan mar 'dzin pa sogs zab mo'i lam gyi gegs byed sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa byed pa tsam ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /568

༄/ / sbyoraba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshuyolamabazang sgrubapa'i 'jugayogs/de nas byin rlab spungs zhus kyi tshe'ang / gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes pa lan gnyis brjod pa na/ dang po'i skabs su bshes gnyen la ma gus pa sogs kyi nyes ltung rnams sbyangs shing / gnyis pa'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam spyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nus pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can skyes par bsam/ des mtshon te chos skor 'og ma rnams la'ang de dang de'i gegs byed sbyangs shing / de dang de'i rtogs pa skye rung du byin gyis brlabs par bsgom tshul gyi dmigs phyed dgos so/ / thun mong lam sbyangs snod du gyur pa na/ / zhes sogs kyi skabs su dmigs rnam skyong tshul ni/ sngar tshogs zhing thams cad sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal btab yod na des 'thus shing / med na nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'ibla ma rnams rdo rje 'chang la thim/ de thub dbang gi spyi gtsug nas mar byon te thugs gar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar yi dam gang yang rung ba'i rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ bla ma'i phung khams skye mched sogs kyang bla mchod ltar rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs kyi ngo bor bsams la/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len tshul la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slar yang yan lag bdun pa dang maṇḍal mdor bsdus dbul/ byang sdom dang sngags sdom gzung / de nas tshogs zhing rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bla ma thub dbang dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bo'i thugs ga'i rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar rang gi lce thog tu bzhag pa myang bas rgyud la bde stong gi 569

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgron me'i gsung 4ma/ye shes khyad par can skyes/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba shākya thub pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs can du gyur pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bos thugs ga'i rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka nas rig ma spros te/ rang gi snying ga'irdo rje 'chang gi yum la thim rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su sleb pas dga' ba bzhi dang / khyad par du bde stong dbyer med lhan skyes kyi dga'ab khyad par can rgyud la skyes te shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis dbang gsum pa thob pa'i skabs su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang bzhin pa'i dus na sems lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas de kho na nyid kyi don nges pa gnyis mnyam du yod pa de bzhin du/ don 'di goms par byas pa las mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku rang snang gi rig mdang kha spror ba'i lus can dang / de'i dus nyid na thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang stong pa nyid gnyis ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i 'od gsal thams cad stong pa gnyis ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed de/ de ni thob bya don gyi dbang bzhi ba yin no zhes zung 'jug gi don gdams pa na rang gi rgyud la go ba legs par skyes te tshig dbang thob pa'i mos pa byed/ dbang bzhi len tshul bsdus pa byed na sdom bzung mi dgos shing / bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkarapo'i tshogs byung / rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas bumadabang thob/ lus lhar bsgoms pa la dbang bar byas shing sprul sku grub pa'i nus pa bzhag / mgrin pa'i spru las 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po'i tshogs byung / rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas gsang 570

༄/ / sbyor ba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jugajags/dbang thob/ sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas shing longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag / thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od dang bdud rtsi sngon po'i tshogs byung /rang gi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas sher dbang thob/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang zhing chos sku grub pa'i nus pa bzhag / de'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gcig car byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas dbang bzhi pa thob/'bras bu zung 'jug 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/ de ltar lam bzang zhes sogs kyi skabs su chos srung rnams las rang 'dra'i sprul pa che chung dpag med spros te zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub ces gsung lhang lhang byon nad gdon sogs sha khrag gi rnam par zhal du gsol/ rang gi gnas lngar thim pas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par byin gyis brlabs byung snyam du nga rgyal brtan po byed/ mtshon cha'ang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ de nas skye ba kun tu zhes sogs kyis don bsdus nas smon pas rgyas 'debs bya/ de rjes tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te mtha' skor na bzhugs pa'i zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad la phog bas mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste/ rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / zab mo lta brgyud dang /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud dang / chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang 'og ma 'og ma nas rim gyis zhu ste/ rgya chen spyod brgyud byams pa dang / zab mo lta brgyud 'jam dbyangs la thim/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang la thim/ chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams kyang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis thub dbang la thim zhing / gdan pad zla gnyis kyang thub pa'i 571

༄༅/ /gung thang bsnyan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/seng khri la thim/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'ang thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs gar thim/ rdo rje 'chang thub pa'i dbang po'i spyi bo nas byon/ thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang sngar bzhugs pa la thim/ thub pa'i dbang po'i seng khri pad zla la thim/ mthar thub pa'i dbang po'ang rang gi spyi bo'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i dikyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu nga rdo rje skyel krung gis bzhugs bar mos la/ phun tshogs dge legs za mgos phyag 'tshal/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cadabashags/ / skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / 'khor ba ma stongs bar du legs bzhugs nas/ / 'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo/ /gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab rin chen bdun/ / rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ / thugs rjes bzhes nas byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa phul te phur tshugs gsol 'debs bya ba ni/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / sgrib bral chos sku'i bdag nyid bla ma lta/ / thub dbang nga bde chen longs sku'i bdag nyid ma sa sna tshogs sprul sku'i 2 nga bla ma kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i za ma yi dam kun 'dus mo nga sangs rgyas kun 'dus za mdam chos kun 'dus za za dge 'dun kun 'dus nga nga mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma ma chos skyong kun 'dus ma sa skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /572

༄/ / sbyor ba'i chosakhrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs/bdag dang ma sems can thams cad 'khor bar skyes nas yun ring la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa zhig myong ba 'di dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du ma bsten pas lan par 'dug pas/da bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma lha'i sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga nga khyad par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag / lus dwangs gsal nga khyad par du'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nus pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la skyes par bsam/ 'di ni bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ dmigs skor bye brag tu ma bcad par lam rim spyi tsam gyi sngon 'gror byed pa'am/ re zhig chos drag po 'di tsam skyong ba yin na/ bdag dang ma sems can zhes pa nas sna tshogs pa zhig myong ba 'di lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa tshul bzhin du ma skyes bas lan par 'dug pas/ da bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag tshul bzhin du skyed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma lha'i sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang /khyad par du lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa skye ba la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag / lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi 573

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sa gsung 'bum/rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba nasazung 'jug gi bar gyi lam gyi rtog pa mtha' dag rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la skyes par bsam mo/ /de nas bla ma rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab pas bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang nyid la thim pas rang thub pa'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis gyur/ rang thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros mtha' skor na yod pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang la bkod/ rang dang sems can thams cad thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po hūṃ ser pos mtshan pa'i mtha' skor du oṃ mu ne mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci mang bya/ mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / bla ma sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas/ / 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / thun mtshams su'ang dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi dmigs rnam gyi rtsi ma yal bar bya zhing lam rim che chung sogs la blta ba dang /dran shes bzhin dang ldan pas sgo gsum bag yod par byas te/ slar yang thun rjes ma la zhugs na lan re bzhin gyi skyed thon pas nyams rtogs gong du 'phel tedal 'byor don dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / zab rgyas gdams pa'i chu bo 'dus pa'i bcud/ / lam bzang tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /sgrub par sla zhing shin tu don che ba/ / sbyor ba'i chos drug lag tu bstar ba'i tshul/ / zhal shes man ngag du mas rab brgyan te/ / shin tu 574

༄/ /sbyor ba'i chosadrug lag tu len tshul lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs/gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub lam bzang du/ / zhugs nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan zin par shog / ces byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos drug lag tu len tshul gsal bar bkod pa lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo'i grwa rigs dad ldan dge slong dkon mchog sangs rgyas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / / mdo sngags lam bzang kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ / sngon 'gro spyor ba'i chos kyi rim pa 'di/ / sdom brtson gu shri blo bzang dkon mchog gis/ / par du bskrun pa'i chos sbyin dge tshogs mthus/ / tshogs bsags sgrib spyong zhing sa gshin po la/ / dngos gzhi rtogs pa'i lo 'bras smin pa yis/ / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus pa'i/ / gtan gyi 'dun ma bde blag 'grub gyur cig / / /575

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronalce'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / byang chub bde lam gyi dmigs skor cha tshang bar tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa lam mchog snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bde gshegs thugs rje mnga' ba shākya'i tog / ma pham 'jam dbyangs shingata che gnyis dang / / jo 'brom rgyal ba gnyis pa brgyud par bcas/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med mgon mdzod cig / gsung rab kun gyi snying po gcig bsdus pa/ / che ba bzhi ldan byang chub lam rim zhes/ / skal ldan thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs der/ / sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i nyams len bya/ / de'ang gnas khang byi dor byayoshing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'don bzhin du mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pa mdzes par bshamasal de ma thag 'bru gsum brjod de chab kyis bran pa'am/ dkon mchog gi bden pasabyin gyis brlab par bsam/ bde ba'i stan la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod cing / de dag kyang dgosadon sems kyi 'khyer sodang bcasapa dgosapasatshigasabacad kyi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo na4brjod de/chos mthun sgrub gnas gtsang byas nyams dga' bar/ / mchog gsum rten gye gzi 'od 'bar pa'i drung / / bkod legs phul byung mchod sprin bstar pa yis/ / gzhan don gzhir gyur rgyal ba'i zhing spyong bya/ / spyod lam dag pas lus kyi skyon sbyangs shing / / kun slong mi dge'i skyon gyis ma sbags 576

/ /bde lamagyidamig skor lamasachogasnyingawa/par/ / dge sems khyad par can gyis zin pa yis/ / rnam dag sgom sgrub rtsa ba tshugs par bya/ / mdun du seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng / / rtsa ba'i bla ma thub dbang rdo rjes 'chang / / dngos brgyud bla ma lhar bcas dkon mchog gsum/ / bdag sogs mgon du dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / thog ma med nas srid 'dir ches mnar yang / / da dung sdug bsngal gting mtha' mi mngon pas/ / da ni bslu med mchog gsum la brten te/ / cis kyang btsan sa zin par byed dgos pas/ / rje btsun bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / skyob pa dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / 'dren pa dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / yi dam lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / dam can chos srung rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum/ nyam thag ma rgan 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ / bdag gis byang chub mchog tu semasabaskyed cing / / zab mo bla ma'i lam gyis srog bzung ste/ / byang chub lam bzang myur du bsgrub par bya/ / lan gsum/ bla ma lha yi thugs rje'i 'od 'phros pas/ / 'gro kun thub pa'i dbang po'i skur bzhengs shing / / de nas skyabs yul mtha' dag gcig bsdus te/ / smin mtshams nas thim byin gyis brlab par gyur/ / slar yang seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng / / bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i phyogs bzhi ru/ / brgyud pa gsum dang dngos kyi bla ma'i tshogs/ / rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ / sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang / / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rgyal chen bzhi/ / 'gog lam rang bzhin gsung rab glegs bam bcas/ / dpag yasasprul pa'i bkod pa spro bzhin bzhugs/ / saso'i gnas lngar yi ge lngas brgyan pa'i/ / hūṃ gis spyan drangs rab 'byamasalha'i 'khor lo/ / rdzogs 5tha

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgron me'i ga 4ma/par bstem pas spangs rtogs dbyer med pa/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po sbos kyi chus/ / yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ / gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku dbyi'o/ / mchog gsum kun 'dus bla ma lha tshogs la/ / sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje mnga' ba rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid bran du 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes/ / sngon chad bka' dang 'gal rnams snying nas bshags/ /srid zhi'i dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / / nyam thag 'gro la phan bde'i lam ston phyir/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs su gsol/ / bdag la dus gsum dge ba ci yod pa/ / ma rgan rigs drug yongs la bsngos pa yis /rang rang sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las grol te/ / bla med bde ba mchog la reg gyur cig /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / phun tshogasadage legs bye bas bsgrun pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong pa'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ / rnam 'dren shākya seng ger gsol ba 'debs/ / byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ / mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i sde/ / seng bzang ku sā li gnyis gser gling pa/ / rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang / / zla ba grags pa rig 578

༄/ /bde lam gyidamigasaskoraglumamachogasnye wa/pa'i khu byug che/ / sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te/ / zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la gsol ba 'debs/ / thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /mchog gzigs ti lo pa dang nā ro pa/ / dpal mchog ḍo snyi pa dang a ti sha/ / nyams len byin rlabs brgyud la gsol ba 'debs/ / lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rim byon dang / / khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras sogs/ / yang dag lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / bshes la mi gus dal 'byor chud gzon zhing / / 'chi ba mi dran tshe 'di'i bde thabs bsgrub/ /ngan 'gror mi 'jigs yang dag skyabs mi 'tshol/ / las 'bras mi sems blang dor log par bsgrub/ / 'khor ba bder 'dzin de rgyu las nyon spel/ /thar par mi spro bslab gsum sten mi byed/ / ma rnams yal bor rang nyed gces par 'dzin/ / bdag tu mngon zhen sngags la mi mos sogs/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag rnams/ / myur du 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / bshes la dad gus dal 'byor snying po len/ /'chi ba rjes dran tshe 'di'i 'dun ma bskyungs/ / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs dran dkon mchog skyabs su 'dzin/ /las 'bras bsams nas blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrub/ / 'khor ba'ispyon mthong las nyon spong bar 'dod/ / thar pa don gnyer rnam dag bslab gsum bsten/ / ma rnams gces 'dzin rang nyid yal bar 'dor/ / bdag med don mthong sngags la mos pa sogs/ / phyin ci ma log blo sna mtha' dag rnams/ / myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / khyad par byams dang snying rje sems bskyed dang / /phyin drug la sogs rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ / snying po lam dus kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lus/ / yang snying 'bras bu'i dus kyi rdo rje'i sku/ / bdag med gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong ba yi/ / zhi 579

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i 0me'i ga4 stem/lhag gnyis sogs zab mo lta ba'i lam/ /snying po dpe dang don gyi 'od gsal gnyis/ / yang snying bde stong dbyer med chos sku ste/ / zab dang rgya che'i lam bzang snying por bcas/ / myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes bdud rtsi 'bebakhyang dang sgrags te gsol 'debs bya/ spro na khrus gsol gyi 'phror/ ji snyed su dag / ce4sogs kyisayan lag bdun pa dang / maṇḍal legasapar phyis/'bru rnamasadri bzang gisabarlan la sngags btab ste so bdun ma'am/ nyer gsum ma rgyas par dbul/ lam mchog sgo 'byed dang byin rlabayosrung zhusakyi steng nas gsol 'deb4byas kyang legs so/ /de nas tshogs kyi zhing rnams gtso bor thim/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs ka ru/ / spyan drangs sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid ni/ /slar yang rang gi spyi bor bzhugs par gyur/ / sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdeg ltung thams cad bshags/ / dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ / bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod sprin 'di/ / blo yis blangs nas bla ma lha la 'bul/ / thugs rjes bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rnam gsum sogs/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / mgon po khyod min re sa gzhan med pas/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btab pas sku lus las/ / 'od dang bdud rtsi sna lnga'i rgyun bab pas/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun nyes pa'i tshogs sbyangs nas/ / rtogs pa khyad 'phags rgyud la skye bar gyur/ / de dag ni sbyor ba'i rim pa'o/ /dngosagazhi ni/ thub pas dus mthar tha mal tshul 'dzin par/ /gsungs bzhin skal ba mnyam pa'i skur bstan nas/ / bstan pa'i snying po 580

༄/ /bde lam gyidamigasaskor lamasachogasnyingapo/rdzogs par 'doms mdzad pa/ / rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /'di nyid kho na legs tshogs rtsa ba ru/ / yid ches rnyed pas skyon rtog kun spangs te/ / sems dgus bsten cing rnyed dang bkur ste dang / /khyad par bka' bzhin sgrub pas mnyes par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin rgyas rlobs/ / mi khom skyon bral mthun rkyen kun tshang ba'i/ / dal 'byor 'di ni mngon mtho nges legs kun/ / 'grub bas yid bzhin nor las don che la/ / rgyu dpe ngo bo gang nas bsam na yang / / rnyed thabs med de bla ma'i drin las ni/ / lan gcig rnyed kyang sngon chad don med 'das/ / da ni tshe lhag cung zad gnas kyi bar/ /don ldan chos kyis snying po blang bar bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / phyi rkyen bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon dang bcas/ / nang nas dal 'byor rnyed dka'i lcag gis bskul/ / snying po len 'dod rnal ma skyes pa na/ / de yi thabs tshul ma nor tshang ba gces/ / de yang blo stobs spel phyir 'og ma dang / / thun mong lam la sngon du ma sbyangs par/ / gong ma'i rtogs pa skye ba'i skabs med pas/ / dang por tshe 'di'i snang shas bzlog par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / shin tu mi bzad stobs ldan 'chibadag ni/ / glo bur steng du bab cing zlog tu med/ / nyam chung srog gi mar me rkyen mang gi / bu yug 'tshub bas nam gsod cha med la/ / skabs der tshe 'di'i phun tshogs mtha' dag gis/ / bslus nas shul du skyur te 'gro dgos shing / / de tshe phan pa chos las gzhan med pas/ / rnam dag chos shig de ring nyid nas bya/ / de ltar nus bar bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis 581

༄/ /yo ca bayo ཿ 0sa ga 4ma/rlobs/ / sgo gsum sdig la gzhol ba'i ngang tshul 'dis/ / phyi ma'i skye gnas ngan 'gror thag chod cing / / da lta lus la me thig phog pa'am/ / zhag 'ga' tsam gyi bkres skom mi bzod na/ / mi lo dpag med btso bsreg dmyal bdang / / lo brgyar chu thigs mi myong yi dwags gnas/ / gcig la gcig za glen skug dud 'gro sogs/ / bzod thabs med pas de rgyu spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / 'jigs chen de las skyob par byed pa ni/ / srid pa'i lha chen rnams kyang mi nus pas/ / gang la brten na bslu ba med pa ni/ / 'jigs pa kun spangs gzhan sgrol thabs la mkhas/ / nye ring mi mnga' skyabs gnang dkon mchog gsum/ / kho nar yid ches skyabs 'gro la 'bad cing / / de yi phan yon mthong bas yid drangs te/ / gnang bkag bslab bya nyams pa med par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / bslab bya'i gtso dang 'jigs pa'i skyabs dngos ni/ / dkar nag las kyi blang dor nyid yin pas/ / las 'bras 'chol med nges shing 'phel che bar/ / yid ches rnyed pas mi dge bcu la sogs/ / che phra mtha' dag spong zhing brgya lam na/ / sdig ltung phra mos gos kyang phyir bcos dang / / stobs bzhi'i gnad tshang bshags pas myur sbyangs te/ / rnam smin rten bzang 'grub pa'i gdeng thob bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyes rlobs/ / dge bcu'i lam gyis bde 'gro'i rten thob kyang / / 'khor ba 'di las gtan du ma thar na/ / btson ra'i nang du yud tsam ngal gsos bzhin/ / yid brtan med par slar yang 'khor ba 'dir/ / lam gsum zo chun 'phyan pa ltar 'khyams nas/ / mtha' med ngan song sdug bsngal myong dgos pas/ / 'du byed sdug 582

༄/ /bdelamagyidamigasaskor lam chogasnying po/bsngal rang bzhin nyer len gyi/ / srid las thar 'dod nges 'byung bskyed par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / sdug bsngal de yang las nyon bdag 'dzin las/ /rim par 'byung tshul lugs 'byung lugs zlog gi / rten 'brel bsam nas srid rtsa gcod pa'i phyir/ / bden pa bzhi yi blang dor la 'bad cing / /khyadapar gnyen po'i bslab pa gnyis kyi rgyu/ / bstan pa'i gzhi ma lhag pa'i tshul khrims ni/ / dran shes bag yod brtan pos legs bsrungs te/ / nyes med thar ba'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / chags sdang 'khrul bas dgra gnyen phyogs ris su/ / bcad kyang khyad par med par 'gro 'di kun/ / thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ / yang dang yang du bdag gi ma byas te/ / gnod pa kun bsrungs phan pa kun la sbyar/ / gzhal dka'i drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ / des na yal bar 'dor ba mi rigs pas/ / phan pa bsgrub la drin du gzo bar bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / 'gro ba ma lus sdug pa'i bu bzhin du/ / yid 'ong rnam pa'i byams sems skyes pa na/ / de yi sdug bsngal mi bzod gces pa'i bu/ / me 'obs lhung la brtse ba'i ma bzhin du/ / shugs drag snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur te/ / ma lus bde sgrub sdug bsngal sel ba yi/ / khur chen zhum pa med par rang steng du/ /blangs bas lhag bsam rnam dag bskyed par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / sdug bsngal mi 'dod bde bas mi ngoms pa/ / bdag dang gzhan la khyad par yod min yang / / rang gces 'dzin pas nyes dmigs kun skyed la/ / ma rnams 5༅

༄/ /yo ca bamapa'i yo ga 4ma/gces 'dzin legs tshogs rgyur mthobanas/ / gtong len dmigs pas gzhan gyis sdig sdug kun/ / rang gi steng du len zhing rang nyid kyi/ / bde dge ma lus 'gro la gtong ba yi/ / thabs mkhas rlabs chen spyod pa'i 'phrul 'degs bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin rgyas rlobs/ / de yang bla med byang chub ma thob na/ / dman pa'i dgra bcom rnams kyang gzhan gyi don/ / lta ci rang gi don yang ma rdzogs pas/ / 'ching ba kun ldan bdag 'dra smos ci 'tshal/ / des na 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub pa'i/ / sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa'i cha res kyang / /'gro ba dpag med sgol nus sangs rgyas kyi/ / go 'phang thob 'dod sems mchog bskyed par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas zam thub pa'i dbang po'i rjes su zlosapar dmigasanas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ / ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ / byang chub thugs nibaskyed pa dang / / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ / rim pa bzhin du gnas pa ltar/ / bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ / rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyisasmon 'jug mnyam du len pa'am/ sangs rgyasachosatshogasam tshar gsum gyisasemasabaskyed gzung la/ e ma longabs nor bu rnyed pa bzhin/ / rin chen sems mchog rnyed 'di skal ba bzang / /da ni phan yon bsam zhing dus drug tu/ / sems skyed bzung ste sems can blos mi spong / / de nyid 'phel phyir dkon mchog mchod la brtson/ / nag chos bzhi spangs dkar chos bzhi la slob/ / mdor na ji ltar khas blangs bslab bya kun/ / srog dang bsdos te rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ / de 5yo

༄/ /bde lamagyidamigasaskorabamasachogasnyengapo/ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / zhing dang bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa yis/ / lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i 'bras bur bcas/ / ma lus zhen pa med par gtong ba'i sems/ / spel bas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs byed cing / / rang gis khas blangs sdom gsum bcas mtshams kyi/ / nyes ltung mtha' dag sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / / dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed kyi/ / tshul khrims rnams la tshul bzhin bslab par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / gnod byed kun la bzod pa'i go bgos te/ / sdug bsngal rkyen ngan mtha' dag lam du slong / /zab mo chos la mi skrag slob ba sogs/ / rnam gsum bzod pa'i phar phyin sgom byed cing / / sems zhum bya ba ngan la zhen pa sogs/ / g.yeng ba kun spangs snying stobs go bgos te/ / dge chos sdud cing mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don/ /sgrub pa lhur len brtson pa'i stobs bskyed bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / nyes pa lnga spangs 'du byed brgyad kyi sgos/ / dmigs pa'i rten la g.yo med ting 'dzin mchog / bying rgod skyon bral dwangs gsal ngar dang bcas/ / shin sbyang stobs ldan zhi gnas sgrub byed cing / / dgag bya'i snang tshul myeng pas ngos bzung ste/ / dri med rigs pas spros pa'i mtha' bkag nas/ / zab mo'i gnas lugs ji bzhin nges pa yi/ / so sor rtog pa'i lhag mthong bskyed par bya/ / de ltar nus bar bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / 'khrul snang rdzun pa'i ngabamatshar rig pa yis/ /gdod ma'i dngos po rtag pa'i mtha' 'gog cing / / gdod nas stong bas chad pa'i mtha' bkag ste/ / snang tsam bya byed bsnyon med 'grub nus 585

༄/ /ca ca bam pa'i sa ga ཿma/pas/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug chos kun dgongs pa'i mthil/ / klu sgrub lugs bzang ji bzhin nges byed cing / / rang gis ji ltar nyams su blangs pa bzhin/ / bsdu ba bzhi yis 'gro rnams smin par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / de nyid bcu ldan rdo rje slob dpon la/ / brten nas zab gsang rdo rje theg pa yi/ / 'jug sgo rnam dag dbang gis smin byas te/ /bla ma lhar bcas dpang du legs bzhag nas/ / ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig sdom pa kun/ / srog dang bsdos te tshul bzhin bsrung ba yis/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi rtsa ba tshug par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / gzhi yi 'chi ba bar do skye ba gsum/ / lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kyi sku gsum du/ /sgyur byed bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor gyis/ / tha mal snang zhen dri ma kun spyong zhing / / rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa yis/ / zhugs gnas thim pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya che/ / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku dang zung 'jug pa'i/ /rdzogs rim spyod dang bcas la bslab bar bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na bshes gnyen dam pa'i ded dpon gyis/ / yongs bzung tshul khrims dag pa'i gru gzings mchog / gsung rab kun la phyogs rer ma gyur pa'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i dri bzhon gyis bskul te/ / myur ba myur bar sku gsum go 'phang mchog /yid bzhin nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur nas/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba srid mtsho las bsgral te/ / bde chen thar pa'i sa la 'god par bya/ / de ltar nus par bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis byin gyis rlobs/ / zhesarim pa bzhin gyi tshig don dang bdud rtsi 'bebasasbyang gi 586

༄/ /bde lam gyidamigasaskor lamamachogalhangapo/dridī /༵rnam phyu/chode rdoni byā sdi~X nāswādi rdo dī ༷/ ni hūṃ~X sdodī dī nghrusdusbyo nibyongasabadagagazhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ / de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru/ / byang chub mchog gi rjes su mi mthun pa'i/ / shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang / / 'khor dang longs spyod rnyed dang bkur ste'i rgyur/ / skad cig tsam yang nam yang mi smin par/ / bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig / rgyal sras smon lam gaṅgā'i klung rnams ni/ / dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ / gsungs phyir dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa ni/ /kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / bdag gis ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / zhesasogasabasngo smon rnam par dag pa'i mtshamasasbyar te rgyal ba'i ṭwāsgyu nā rji ༵rjisasu ṭwāṃ~Xpapa di dhrirji jinidzo dīdrosdudī trī trīgadal nitt+waṃ ṭwāṃshā ༵ ṭwāṃdri rdo gyi nying khu dang / / man ngag ge sar bcud bsdus pa'i/ / snying po sprang rtsi'i thigs pa bzhin/ / byang chub lam gyi rim pa yi/ / dmigs skor tshang zhing mdor bsdus pa/ / bsnyad pa'i dge 'dis 'gro ba kun/ / yang dag lam la spyodagyur cig / cesapa 'di ni sngar byang chub bde lam gyi don tshogasabacad du bsdeb4pa shin tu nyung ngu zhig brisayod pa de lasacung zad rgyasapa zhig dgosatshul/ba ron sunyid shog nasadad brtson blo grosakyi nor dang ldan zhing sgrub pa la gzhol ba gu tho1bzang dkon mchog gisabaskul ba ltar/ don tshan gal che ba du ma4zur bskang4snye /byebhebherdo/ bhe hūm̐ /dhū / de kṣiṃhūṃ hūṃ/rdo dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyisa'adi nyid par du bsgrub4pa'i tshe/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabrisapa'o/ / sarba mgo li/ /587

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronayo khrung 4ma/dkon ཿgakunadangos 'jig med da4rsājis/ /bshad sgrub༄napa'i jagapharadabang༄ra tshon/ /lung rto0nya zlazungarga meryā/ /skyeba'i rmongs munasalab 'di rmadabyung /rṣa da4 mang pa tas mdzad pa'i tshogs 4da kyis ban stes te mkhas grub yongs kyi ga4 rgyan rje ༄na dkon 4ga ༄na pa'i sgron me'i ཿnga stemarapelo byed par 4na mamar mag a ri'i 4 pa'i zes mamakhaparabug rje chetha/ khuzla 2 4lo ༅ bo
